works.caption: Gérôme stages the Circus Maximus at full gallop, chariots blurred with dust while the crowded stands and Egyptian obelisk anchor the vast architectural sweep.
works.title: Chariot Race

works.caption: White magnolia blossoms and glossy leaves rest on folds of blue-green velvet. Heade gives the petals a smooth, almost waxy finish, setting their pale curves against the darker cloth and plain brown background.
works.title: Magnolias on Light Blue Velvet Cloth

works.caption: Mondrian tilts his grid onto a diamond, the primary-color blocks balanced against a field of white with quiet, exacting tension.
works.title: Lozenge Composition with Yellow, Black, Blue, Red, and Gray

works.caption: A young painter turns to meet the viewer's gaze, his loaded palette catching the only bright color in an otherwise somber, deeply shadowed composition.
works.title: Self-Portrait

works.caption: Two mounted warriors clash in a swirl of dust and drapery, their rearing horses and flashing blades charged with Romantic violence and movement.
works.title: The Combat of the Giaour and Hassan

works.caption: A young aristocrat poses with cool self-possession against emerald drapery, the crisp linear precision of his features and sword hilt set off by lush, painterly greens.
works.title: Amédée-David, the Comte de Pastoret

works.caption: Tilted perspectives and a rumpled white cloth hold a basket of apples in restless tension, Cezanne's faceted brushwork turning still life into architecture.
works.title: The Basket of Apples

works.caption: A woman supports a child on her lap and washes one small foot in a basin. Their lowered faces draw close together, while the striped dress, patterned carpet and painted furniture fill the room with interlocking shapes.
works.title: The Child's Bath

works.artist: Francisco José de Goya y Lucientes
works.artistSort: Lucientes, Francisco José de Goya y
works.caption: A wide-eyed child in ruffled finery rides a bell-collared ram, Goya balancing courtly costume against a loose, atmospheric landscape.
works.title: Boy on a Ram

works.caption: Cockscombs and maize stalks rise in sparse, asymmetric rhythm across a shimmering gold-leaf ground, the six-panel screen's emptiness as eloquent as its plant forms.
works.medium: Six-panel screen; ink, color, and gold on paper
works.title: Maize and Cockscombs

works.caption: A woman glimpsed from behind at her dressing table dissolves into feathery, near-abstract strokes of silvery white and blue, intimacy rendered as pure brushwork.
works.title: Woman at Her Toilette

works.caption: Long strips of poem paper dangle like calligraphic rain from a gnarled maple's autumn canopy, the gold-ground screen glowing behind scattered red leaves.
works.medium: Six-panel screen (one of pair); Ink, colors, gold leaf, and gold powder on silk
works.title: Autumn Maples with Poem Slips

works.caption: A milliner studies an orange-brown hat in her hands, surrounded by displays of pink, cream, green and blue headwear. Loose strokes build the shop around her sober olive dress.
works.title: The Millinery Shop

works.caption: A woman absorbed in a magazine sits before dappled greenery, her black hat and coat cut in broad, confident strokes against the sketchy garden behind her.
works.title: Woman Reading

works.caption: Fishing boats beached on shingle anchor a wide grey-and-turquoise seascape, the clouded sky given as much weight as the water below it.
works.title: The Beach at Sainte-Adresse

works.caption: Two young women walk along the flowered cliff at Pourville, one beneath a red parasol. The headland cuts into a blue-green sea dotted with small sailboats.
works.title: Cliff Walk at Pourville

works.caption: A young woman in a red hat sits beside a little girl on a riverside terrace. Despite the title, the models were not sisters; Renoir links them through bright touches of colour that reappear in the basket of yarn and the shimmering foliage.
works.title: Two Sisters (On the Terrace)

works.caption: An armoured saint on a rearing white horse holds his lance high, its point hanging down by the horse's chest above a winged dragon that sprawls across the foreground, jaws open and one clawed foot reaching up at his stirrup. Gold tooling picks out his halo and the horse's harness. Behind, townspeople crowd a grey castle's walls, and a crowned young woman in pink raises her hands beside a sheep.
works.title: Saint George and the Dragon

works.caption: A circus rider balances on a cantering white horse as she prepares to rise and leap through a paper hoop held in the foreground. Sketchy pastel and charcoal strokes keep horse, rider and ring in motion.
works.title: Equestrienne (At the Cirque Fernando)

works.artist: Rogier van der Weyden and workshop
works.caption: A man seen to the waist turns towards the left, eyes looking aside, his raised hands pressed together palm to palm with a ring on one finger. He has dark hair cut in a straight fringe and wears a black gown trimmed with fur at the neck and cuff, over a red collar and a white undershirt. The background is a plain dark blue.
works.title: Portrait of Jean Gros (recto); Coat of Arms of Jean Gros (verso)

works.caption: Gabriel kneels at the left in a green robe over a pale blue-grey gown, one hand raised and a gold sceptre in the other. Mary kneels at a wooden desk with an open book, in a blue dress and red mantle; her right hand is raised, palm out, and her left is held lower, open, above the book. A white dove in a soft glow flies between them. A marbled column, an arched vault and a red-curtained bed fill the room around them.
works.title: The Annunciation

works.caption: Terracotta rooftops and a factory's plume of smoke give way to a broad band of cobalt bay and hazy mountains, built from Cezanne's characteristic parallel strokes.
works.title: The Bay of Marseille, Seen from L'Estaque

works.caption: Soldiers jeer at a seated, thorn-crowned Christ against near-total blackness, the composition's flattened, almost collaged figures scandalizing Manet's own contemporaries.
works.title: Jesus Mocked by the Soldiers

works.caption: Lily pads drift across a mirrored pond where sky, cloud, and willow reflection dissolve into a single continuous field of violet and green.
works.title: Water Lilies

works.caption: Steam and smoke billow beneath the iron-and-glass train shed as a locomotive idles at the platform, the whole scene rendered in a haze of blue-grey vapor.
works.title: Arrival of the Normandy Train, Gare Saint-Lazare

works.caption: Umbrella-bearing Parisians cross a rain-slicked intersection of wedge-shaped buildings, the wet cobblestones and converging perspective giving the canvas an almost photographic clarity.
works.title: Paris Street; Rainy Day

works.caption: Christ, crowned with thorns and dressed in pale blue, leans his head against the cross with his eyes nearly shut, both hands gripping the beam. Behind him crowd a young man and a man in a steel helmet. Beyond, at upper right, tiny figures and riders cross a dim landscape below a distant city and a reddish sky.
works.title: Christ Carrying the Cross

works.caption: The Virgin, in a red dress under a blue and green mantle, looks down at the Christ Child sitting on her knee with one small hand raised. The young Saint John kneels beside her, bare-backed, with a band of fur at his waist and a blue cloth round his legs; her hand rests at his back. On one side a wooden lattice is hung with leaves and pale fruit; on the other, trees and blue mountains.
works.title: Virgin and Child with the Young Saint John the Baptist

works.caption: Two fishermen haul a herring-laden net over the gunwale of a pitching dory, the heaving grey-green swell and lowering sky conveying real physical danger.
works.title: The Herring Net

works.caption: Christ stretches in his carpenter's workshop at day's end, his shadow falling across the tool rack as a cross, the painting's obsessive Pre-Raphaelite detail turning a genre scene into prophecy.
works.title: The Shadow of Death

works.caption: The infant Christ reaches up to touch Mary’s face as she supports his bare body on her lap. Joseph and Elizabeth lean into the group, while the young John approaches beside a lamb; their linked gestures make the sacred gathering feel intimate.
works.title: The Holy Family with Saints Elizabeth and John the Baptist

works.caption: Bathers recline on a saturated pink shore before a towering green idol, Gauguin flattening the Tahitian beach into bold, unmodulated fields of color.
works.title: Mahana no atua (Day of the God)

works.caption: A woman rests her head on crossed arms beside a goldfish bowl, the decorative wrought-iron pattern behind her locking the whole canvas into a taut, patterned grid.
works.title: Woman before an Aquarium

works.caption: Two elongated, mask-like faces float above swaths of near-abstract color — Lipchitz's tall grey collar and Berthe's white lace framing the picture's warmest passage.
works.title: Jacques and Berthe Lipchitz

works.caption: Tilted perspective and clashing complementary blues and ochres turn a simple bedroom into a vibrating field of color, the red coverlet the single hot note.
works.title: The Bedroom

works.caption: Eakins' unflinching realism picks out every crease of a weathered face against near-total darkness, the white collar the sole bright anchor.
works.title: Portrait of Mary Adeline Williams

works.caption: A young bearded man stands full-length in a long, very dark robe with broad facings and a narrow white collar. He holds a pair of brown gloves in one hand and points down with the other towards a white dog with brown ears, which stands at his side and looks out. Behind him is a grey wall with pilasters and, at top left, a dark green curtain edged with gold. The floor is tiled in pink, white and olive squares.
works.title: Gian Lodovico Madruzzo

works.caption: A procession winds below a cliffside temple bathed in warm late light. Claude restores ancient Delphi to imagined grandeur, using atmospheric distance to soften the hills beyond.
works.title: View of Delphi with a Procession

works.caption: Vivid blue and red hoop skirts pop against a dark screen of trees as a foursome pauses mid-game, Homer's crisp figure drawing carrying the whole composition.
works.title: Croquet Scene

works.caption: A church tower rises beyond a sunlit village, while a cart stands in the shady lane beneath spreading trees. Constable’s broken white highlights flicker across sky and ground, giving the rough paint surface the sparkle of a landscape still wet after rain.
works.title: Stoke-by-Nayland

works.caption: A billowing sail cuts through churning surf as storm clouds break to blue, Turner dissolving boats and figures into pure light and atmosphere.
works.title: Fishing Boats with Hucksters Bargaining for Fish

works.caption: A hazy gold moon hovers over a nearly monochrome blue-grey harbor, Whistler reducing boats and shoreline to whispered silhouettes in a meditation on tonal harmony.
works.title: Nocturne: Blue and Gold—Southampton Water

works.caption: Saint John writes among fragments of ancient stone, with an eagle just behind him. Beyond this small foreground scene, Poussin arranges trees, an obelisk, a temple and distant hills into a landscape of measured intervals and clear, steady light.
works.title: Landscape with Saint John on Patmos

works.caption: Mars raises a knotted cord over the blindfolded Cupid while Venus reaches across to restrain him. Cupid’s wings spread beneath his body; a bow, arrows and helmet lie on the ground as doves fly away at the upper right.
works.title: Cupid Chastised

works.caption: A brick castle tower crumbles beside still water under a brooding, cloud-massed sky, Ruisdael's dramatic tonal contrasts giving ordinary ruins real weight.
works.title: Landscape with the Ruins of the Castle of Egmond

works.caption: Regulars crowd a cropped table at the Moulin Rouge while singer May Milton’s face enters from the right edge in acid green light. Off-centre figures, mirrors and empty floor keep the nightclub space unsettled.
works.title: At the Moulin Rouge

works.caption: Cezanne builds his wife's form from flat planes of maroon and ochre against cool grey-blue, the yellow chair's pattern the only decorative flourish in an otherwise architectural portrait.
works.title: Madame Cezanne in a Yellow Chair

works.caption: Two wheat stacks glow pink and mauve against a lavender hillside, Monet capturing a fleeting moment of late-day light in loose, vibrating touches of color.
works.title: Stacks of Wheat (End of Summer)

works.caption: Bold black outlines bind red, orange, blue and white forms around several circular shapes. Hartley’s thick paint and compressed rhythm evoke the energy of modern Berlin and music without resolving into a single scene.
works.title: Movement

works.caption: Sargent's loose, sun-dappled brushwork turns the marble fountain and the painter's white-clad companions into a shimmering study of light and shadow.
works.title: The Fountain, Villa Torlonia, Frascati, Italy

works.caption: Church stages a snow-capped volcano behind a plunging waterfall, the tropical foreground foliage and tiny figures giving scale to an operatic South American panorama.
works.title: View of Cotopaxi

works.caption: Zurbarán isolates the crucified Christ in near-total darkness, the raking light carving the anatomy into sculptural relief against an almost black void.
works.title: The Crucifixion

works.caption: Mary, in a blue mantle and a transparent veil, holds the Child against her cheek as he reaches round her neck and looks up at her. At the left a smaller angel with joined hands looks up at them, beside a metal vase. Behind, an arched opening shows hills and trees under a pale sky.
works.title: Virgin and Child with an Angel

works.caption: Van Gogh's pointillist-inflected brushstrokes vibrate across the coat and background while his steady, appraising gaze anchors the composition.
works.medium: Oil on artist's board, mounted on cradled panel
works.title: Self-Portrait

works.caption: Delacroix whips riders, rearing horses, and snarling lions into a single writhing mass of struggle beneath a churning, storm-lit sky.
works.title: Lion Hunt

works.caption: Manet blurs the racehorses into onrushing streaks of paint, flattening the crowd along the rail into a dark frieze that heightens the sense of speed.
works.title: The Races at Longchamp

works.caption: A solitary woman under a tree gazes across the Seine, its still surface doubling the riverside village in soft, mirrored color.
works.title: On the Bank of the Seine, Bennecourt

works.caption: Game birds hang like pendulums beside a cut melon and cabbage in a dark stone niche, Sánchez Cotán's austere geometry and raking light making the mundane feel sacred.
works.title: Still Life with Game Fowl

works.caption: A red-roofed watermill spills white foam beneath towering, wind-tossed trees, Hobbema's billowing Dutch clouds giving the whole scene an expansive, breathing scale.
works.title: The Watermill with the Great Red Roof

works.caption: A potted geranium's loose green fronds spill over a cluttered tabletop of statuettes and pitchers, Matisse's Fauvist blues and pinks flattening the whole still life into pattern.
works.title: Still Life with Geranium

works.caption: The Virgin ascends in swirling blue and crimson robes above astonished apostles, El Greco's electric color and elongated, flame-like figures charging the whole canvas with visionary energy.
works.title: The Assumption of the Virgin

works.caption: Two disciples' faces catch a warm inner glow against near-black shadow, Tanner's spiritual chiaroscuro turning a gospel scene into an intimate study of quiet urgency.
works.title: The Two Disciples at the Tomb

works.caption: Broad planes of blue, red and gold surge around two black cannon barrels at lower right. Kandinsky frees colour and line from ordinary description, leaving the martial forms suspended at the edge of abstraction.
works.title: Improvisation No. 30 (Cannons)

works.caption: Autumn foliage frames a distant Niagara Falls beneath brooding storm clouds cracked open by golden light, Cole staging the sublime scale of the American wilderness.
works.title: Distant View of Niagara Falls

works.caption: A plumed velvet cap, steel gorget, and heavy gold chain glint from deep shadow, Rembrandt's warm chiaroscuro dignifying an aged, weathered face with theatrical costume.
works.title: Old Man with a Gold Chain

works.caption: A wounded cavalry scout slumps over his horse while the troops behind him flee an unseen ambush. Remington's crisp desert light and taut, muscular horses charge the scene with narrative tension.
works.title: The Advance-Guard, or The Military Sacrifice (The Ambush)

works.caption: A deep blue, fur-lined gown pools across the floor as Dora Wheeler rests against a carved chair. Chase sets her against the embroidered silk tapestry she designed, with a porcelain vase and yellow flowers beside her.
works.title: Portrait of Dora Wheeler

works.caption: A skeleton, standing for Death, rides a pale horse at full gallop to the left around the fenced curve of an empty racecourse, raising a long curved scythe. A snake rears its head in the dark foreground at lower left, and a bare, dead tree stands by the rail at right. Heavy dark clouds hang over low hills beyond.
works.title: The Race Track (Death on a Pale Horse)

works.caption: The Medicine Master Buddha sits in the upper centre before a large halo, above a tall tiered pedestal, one hand raised and the other resting palm-up in his lap around a small dark shape. Two pale-faced attendants stand beside the pedestal, and armoured generals, far smaller than the Buddha and several red-faced, gather at both sides and along the bottom of the dark ground; inscribed panels fill the two top corners.
works.medium: Hanging scroll painting; ink, color, gold, and silver on silk
works.title: Medicine Master Buddha and the Twelve Divine Generals

works.caption: Flames engulf the Houses of Parliament across the Thames, their molten orange smeared into a churning sky and doubled in the water below. Turner turns catastrophe into pure incandescent spectacle.
works.title: The Burning of the Houses of Lords and Commons, 16 October 1834

works.caption: A bearded man in a black cap and a dark coat with broad brown sleeves is shown beside a table on a terrace with a stone balustrade, one knee bent. Behind his legs at lower right, dark turned spindles and a fringed blue cloth show low down. He looks off to the right, his left arm thrown out with the palm open, while his right hand rests on a sheet of paper beside sprigs of leaves and small white flowers on a blue cloth. A gold chain hangs across his chest and a sword at his waist, under a blue sky with a few clouds.
works.title: Portrait of a Man, Possibly Girolamo Rosati

works.caption: Peter sits with clasped hands beside a rooster, recalling his denial of Christ before the bird crowed. The lantern at his feet lights his face, fingers and robe, drawing a small circle of warmth within the dark room.
works.title: Saint Peter Repentant

works.caption: Faceted strokes of blue and orange build Mont Sainte-Victoire out of pure structure, pine boughs framing the peak like a proscenium. Cézanne's patchwork of color planes turns landscape into architecture.
works.title: Mount Sainte-Victoire

works.caption: A single white morning glory fills the entire canvas, its ribbed petals flaring out from a pale green throat against a sliver of shadowed leaf. O'Keeffe's radical close-up scale makes the flower monumental.
works.title: Morning Glory with Black

works.caption: A wide forest landscape full of hunters, hounds and game, with a large white castle on a hill at the top. Stags leap into a river with hounds after them, while riders and men on foot with spears attack deer, boars and a bear in the clearings beyond. Richly dressed men with crossbows wait among the trees along the bottom. At the right a woman aims a crossbow from a small group of figures, and four people ride in a boat on the river.
works.medium: oil, originally on wood, transferred to masonite
works.title: Hunting near Hartenfels Castle

works.caption: Two six-panel screens, shown one above the other. On the upper screen a dragon twists out of dark, swirling cloud above crested waves. On the lower one a spotted tiger sits hunched on a rock among wind-bent bamboo, with a waterfall at the right.
works.medium: Pair of six-panel folding screens; ink on paper
works.region: Japan, Muromachi period (1392–1573) to Momoyama period (1573–1615)
works.title: Dragon and Tiger

works.caption: Lily pads drift across a mauve and green sheet of water that dissolves any horizon, reflection and surface fusing into pure atmosphere. Monet's late, near-abstract handling makes the pond feel boundless.
works.title: Water Lilies (Agapanthus)

works.caption: A young woman in a diaphanous white gown pauses on a garden terrace beside a live peacock, a single rose held out toward the viewer. Silvery, feathery brushwork unites her gauzy dress with the bird's shimmering tail.
works.title: Portrait of Catherine Grey, Lady Manners

works.caption: Florence spreads below a hilltop terrace, Brunelleschi's dome and the Palazzo Vecchio's tower rising through golden evening haze. Cole balances grand panoramic sweep with small, intimate figures resting in the foreground shade.
works.title: View of Florence

works.caption: A smirking, winged Cupid leans back against a sleeping Psyche on a richly carved daybed, crimson drapery pooling around them. David's cool, sculptural precision gives the embrace an oddly knowing, unsentimental edge.
works.title: Cupid and Psyche

works.caption: A gnarled, hollow-trunked tree arches over a winding blue stream and drifts of white chrysanthemums, all set against a flat gold ground. The tree's dark, twisting silhouette gives structure to an otherwise pure decorative surface.
works.medium: Two-panel folding screen; ink and color on gilded paper
works.title: Paulownias and Chrysanthemums

works.caption: Saint Catherine appears twice in this small panel: on the right she gives her cloak to a beggar; on the left, Christ returns it to her. Giovanni di Paolo brings successive moments of the story together within one architectural setting.
works.title: St. Catherine of Siena and the Beggar

works.caption: A green-skinned goddess sits on a lotus seat in the red, arched niche of a tiered shrine, one foot stepping down onto a small pink lotus. Rearing beasts standing on elephants flank her throne, a tiny figure with joined hands sits by her lowered hand, and leafy trees and three white domes with gold spires crown the shrine against a dark ground.
works.medium: thangka; gum tempera, ink, and gold on sized cotton; mount: silk
works.title: Green Tara

works.caption: Inside a round frame, the Virgin, under a sheer veil, bends her head until her cheek rests against the Child's brow, as she holds him upright on her lap. He reaches one arm across to rest his hand at the base of her neck. At left the young Baptist, in a red cloak, looks up with his hands pressed together, a thin cross on a long staff beside him. Green hills rise on both sides under a pale blue sky.
works.title: Virgin and Child with the Young Saint John the Baptist

works.caption: Danaë reclines on white and gold sheets, reaching toward the shower of gold in which Jupiter enters her chamber, while a winged attendant lifts the dark curtain. Dramatic light makes the figures tangible against the deep shadow.
works.title: Danaë

works.caption: An old bearded man in a red robe sits in a wooden chair at the left, writing on a sheet of paper with a pen. Next to him a young woman in dark green, low on the floor, holds out a newborn on a white cloth. Behind them a woman lies in a bed hung with green curtains, and at the right another woman holding a dish stands in front of a carved wooden structure with an open door.
works.title: The Birth and Naming of John the Baptist

works.caption: A bird's-eye view of Lower Manhattan reduces buildings, tracks and the passing Church Street elevated train to flat planes of salmon, cream and black. Sheeler concentrates the city into a rhythmic pattern of shape, colour, light and shadow.
works.title: Church Street El

works.caption: The Holy Family gathers on a classical stone platform, children reaching toward each other beneath a portico and a brilliant blue sky with billowing clouds. Poussin's cool, architectural clarity gives the tender gestures a monumental, timeless calm.
works.title: The Holy Family on the Steps

works.caption: Two oarsmen strain against their blades in a slender racing scull, a blue pennant snapping overhead against a hazy river lined with spectators. Eakins' crisp, sunlit precision captures the exact mechanics of the stroke.
works.title: The Biglin Brothers Turning the Stake

works.caption: The Hell Courtesan turns before a folding screen, her richly patterned robes spilling across the floor. Kyōsai fills the garment with figures from the Seven Gods of Good Fortune and the court of Enma, making the costume itself carry a second, intricate story.
works.medium: Hanging scroll; ink, color, gold, and silver on silk
works.title: Hell Courtesan

works.caption: A fiddler and two listeners gather inside a barn, while a Black labourer listens from outside the open door. Music connects the four men across the composition, but Mount keeps their spaces visibly divided, reflecting the racial boundaries of antebellum America.
works.title: The Power of Music

works.caption: Christ, eyes open, is fixed to a dark blue cross, upright body, legs side by side with the feet splayed apart, arms stretched along the crossbeam, a gold halo behind his head and a dark loincloth tied with an orange sash. Six small scenes on gold flank his body, pairs of standing figures fill the arm ends, a row of figures runs across the top, and white letters mark a red block at the foot.
works.title: Crucifix with Scenes of the Passion

works.caption: The wealthy merchant Tieleman Roosterman poses in a sober black suit set off by a broad white collar and lace-edged cuff, one hand gloved. Hals's visible brushstrokes and the sitter's direct, confident gaze animate the formal likeness.
works.title: Portrait of Tieleman Roosterman

works.caption: The Virgin, in a dark red mantle over a blue headcloth, presses her cheek to the Christ Child's. He tips his head back to look up at her and holds a rolled scroll tied with cord, while her hand supports him from below. Behind them is a cracked gold ground, and the panel's top corners are cut away.
works.region: Republic of Venice, Kingdom of Candia, Candia (Heraklion, Crete, Greece) or Byzantine Empire, Constantinople (Istanbul, Turkey)
works.title: Icon of the Mother of God and Infant Christ (Virgin Eleousa)

works.caption: A seated woman holds a young child while an older child sleeps on the grass beside her outstretched legs. Through a gap in the trees, the dome of St Peter’s places this carefully composed rest within a distant view of Rome.
works.title: Rest

works.caption: A trader and his son travel down the Missouri in a narrow canoe, their reflections stretching across still water. A small tethered animal sits at the bow, its dark silhouette balancing the paddler against the pale, hazy distance.
works.title: Fur Traders Descending the Missouri

works.caption: A storm-blackened wilderness on the left gives way across the great bend of the river to a sunlit, cultivated valley on the right — Cole's before-and-after of the American land in a single sweeping view.
works.title: View from Mount Holyoke, Northampton, Massachusetts, after a Thunderstorm—The Oxbow

works.caption: A colossal stone goblet brimming with its own lake and tiny sailboats erupts from an Italianate landscape — Cole's strangest, most surreal invention.
works.title: The Titan's Goblet

works.caption: A boy on a stone plinth dangles a gold chain before his pet squirrel, Copley's razor-sharp rendering of pink silk and pale skin set against a deep, columned shadow.
works.title: Daniel Crommelin Verplanck

works.caption: A standing musician plays a double pipe while two companions recline on the grass. Eakins sets their unadorned bodies within a deep green woodland clearing, giving a classical pastoral subject the particularity of observed models.
works.title: Arcadia

works.caption: Three men huddle over a chessboard in a cluttered, lamplit parlor, Eakins carving each absorbed face out of a rich, almost Rembrandt-dark interior.
works.title: The Chess Players

works.caption: A breaking wave curls white against slate-green swells while black rock shoulders into the foreground — Homer distilling the Maine coast to water, stone, and weather.
works.title: Cannon Rock

works.caption: A lone farmer, seen from behind in a broad-brimmed hat, white shirt, braces and grey trousers, swings a scythe through a field of tall golden wheat under a blue sky. Cut stalks lie around his feet, and a discarded dark jacket in the stubble at lower right marks him as a former Union soldier.
works.title: The Veteran in a New Field

works.caption: Virginie Amélie Avegno Gautreau stands in a low-cut black gown with jewelled straps, her pale face turned in sharp profile to the right. Her right hand rests on a round table with an ornate gold-coloured base, and her left holds a folded dark fan against her skirt. Her auburn hair is swept up with a small jewel, against a plain brown background.
works.title: Madame X (Virginie Amélie Avegno Gautreau)

works.caption: Washington’s pale face and white neckcloth stand out against his dark coat and a green curtain. This portrait belongs to Stuart’s Vaughan group, one of the sets of likenesses through which he established the president’s public image.
works.title: George Washington

works.caption: A woman in a white mantle over a dark dress sits on a carved red chair with a large golden kithara in her hands. Behind the chair a girl stands, one hand on its top rail and the other showing through the slats. Both look straight out, against a red wall.
works.title: Wall painting from Room H of the Villa of P. Fannius Synistor at Boscoreale

works.caption: A square palace with a gate on each side sits inside the rings of a mandala. At its centre a blue goddess with six arms sits cross-legged, with eight smaller figures around her. Roundels of deities and lamas fill the corners, and rows of small figures run along the top and bottom.
works.title: Mandala of Jnanadakini

works.caption: A large figure in a jewelled crown sits cross-legged on a lotus, holding a small object in his lap. Two standing figures flank him and smaller crowned figures sit in rows on either side; seven robed figures, most in flat hats, line the top edge, and a couple and a monk sit in the bottom corners.
works.title: Amitayus, the Buddha of Eternal Life

works.caption: A green Buddha, crowned and jewelled, sits cross-legged on a lotus throne with his right hand raised palm outward, before a large arched backing striped in red, pink and gold. Two standing attendants flank him and eight smaller seated figures fill the upper corners; along the bottom, five many-armed goddesses in red arches sit beside an offering stand and a seated monk.
works.title: Buddha Amoghasiddhi with Eight Bodhisattvas

works.caption: At the centre of a six-petalled lotus, a dark blue, many-armed figure embraces a partner and stands on two figures lying beneath his feet, one pale and one red; a smaller figure appears on each petal. A square palace with a gateway on each side encloses them, inside circular bands that include a ring of flames. Small figures, trees and fires crowd the outer edges, and five haloed figures sit in arched niches along the bottom.
works.title: Chakrasamvara Mandala

works.caption: Two robed figures, each with a smaller companion, cross a plank bridge towards a two-storey pavilion on a rise; twisted, nearly bare trees hung with vines stand nearby, and fainter trees fade into haze.
works.medium: Handscroll; ink and color on silk
works.title: Old Trees, Level Distance

works.caption: Steep, wooded peaks crowd the left half of the long scroll, the tallest rising just left of centre, while lower ridges fade into mist above a wide river on the right. Boats with tall masts are moored along the near shore at lower right, and tiered roofs show among trees at the foot of the peaks.
works.medium: Handscroll; ink and color on silk
works.title: Summer Mountains

works.caption: Two finches perch on separate sprays of pale blue-green bamboo, one higher at left, the other lower near the centre, beside a craggy rock at right; red seals crowd both edges of the silk, and a bold black ink mark sits over a large seal at upper right.
works.medium: Handscroll; ink and color on silk
works.title: Finches and bamboo

works.caption: Wang Xizhi, in a white robe and a hat with long black ribbons, stands at the rail of a pavilion looking out over the water, where two white geese float to the right, turned back towards him. A smaller figure waits behind him. Bright blue rocks, pale green banks, bamboo and leafy trees surround the pavilion.
works.medium: Handscroll; ink, color, and gold on paper
works.title: Wang Xizhi watching geese

works.caption: A young, curly-haired Saint John in a red robe sits on a rock, writing in a book on his knee with an inkpot in his other hand. He looks up at the Virgin and Child, who appear at upper left in a golden glow ringed by clouds, the Virgin standing on a crescent moon. At lower left a black eagle with a halo stands on a closed book; behind John stretch a lake, blue mountains and a tall tree.
works.medium: Oil, gold, and white metal on spruce
works.title: Saint John on Patmos

works.caption: Joan of Arc stares transfixed into the garden air as ghostly saints materialize among the trees behind her, Bastien-Lepage suspending her mid-gesture between peasant reality and vision.
works.title: Joan of Arc

works.caption: Mary, in a blue-green mantle, sits on a gold cloth with the naked Child on her lap inside the roofless walls of a ruined castle. Three kings bring gold vessels: one kneels in front in pink, two stand at right, one of them dark-skinned and dressed in white. An old man kneels at left with a staff, a white dog sits in the foreground and an ox lies in an archway. Overhead, angels stretch a green cloth across the sky above a wide landscape.
works.title: The Adoration of the Magi

works.caption: In his cell, Saint Jerome, a bald old man with a long grey beard, kneels in white with his hands joined while a priest in a pink cope holds the communion wafer to his open mouth. Two brown-robed friars lean over him, and one gathers his robe at the hip. Two boys hold tall candles at the left, and at the back stands an altar with a crucifix and palm fronds.
works.title: The Last Communion of Saint Jerome

works.caption: A knight and Cupid flank a maiden playing a chamber organ amid a border of flowers, Burne-Jones dissolving medieval romance into a hushed, jewel-toned reverie. Cupid works the bellows while the figures remain absorbed in music and thought.
works.title: The Love Song

works.caption: Canaletto lays out the full sweep of Piazza San Marco in crisp perspective, the campanile and basilica anchoring a bustling crowd rendered in confident, sunlit detail.
works.title: Piazza San Marco

works.caption: Four boys in loose classical robes crowd together. At the centre one in a white shirt and a red mantle holds a lute, fingers on its strings, and looks out at us, while another behind him turns towards us with parted lips. At right a boy seen from behind, a white cloth slipping from his shoulder and a dark red sash at his waist, holds open a sheet of music. At left a winged boy with a quiver of arrows, dressed as Cupid, bends over a bunch of grapes, and a violin and bow lie on the cloth in front.
works.title: The Musicians

works.caption: Christ’s dead body rests on a damaged throne between Saint Jerome and the prophet Job. Bare rock and leafless branches at the left give way to a cultivated, inhabited landscape at the right, extending the painting’s meditation on death and life.
works.title: The Meditation on the Passion

works.caption: Three men concentrate on their cards while a fourth stands behind them, smoking a pipe. Cézanne built this compact gathering from studies of local farmhands, giving each hat, coat and bent arm a carefully balanced place around the table.
works.title: The Card Players

works.caption: Cézanne's wife sits rigid in a red dress against a mismatched blue wall, her face built from flat, deliberate planes that hold the whole restless composition together.
works.title: Madame Cézanne (Hortense Fiquet, 1850–1922) in a Red Dress

works.caption: Apples tumble across a rumpled white cloth beneath a potted primrose, Cézanne's tilted table and shifting color planes turning a simple still life into a study of pure structure.
works.title: Still Life with Apples and a Pot of Primroses

works.caption: A boy leans over a wall to blow a giant soap bubble, a smaller child peeking up in wonder, Chardin freezing the fragile globe at its most luminous instant.
works.title: Soap Bubbles

works.caption: A reclining nude raises a parrot on her hand, her tumbling hair and rumpled sheets given the same sensuous, tactile weight as her body, Courbet at his most frankly physical.
works.title: Woman with a Parrot

works.caption: A man in silver armour and a broad white-feathered hat lined with red sits under a tree beside a white horse, looking up. A bearded man in red armour holds a glass ball, and three naked women in gold chains stand before them. Cupid aims from a cloud at upper left; beyond lie a lake, a town and a castle on a crag.
works.title: The Judgment of Paris

works.caption: Mary, in a white veil and a blue-and-gold patterned gown, holds the Christ Child, who sits on a cushion on a ledge draped with yellow cloth and clutches a small bird. A cucumber and apples hang among leaves at the top, in front of a pink hanging, with trees and sky on either side. A large fly sits on the white marble ledge at the left, and a small paper label pinned to the yellow cloth carries the painter's signature.
works.title: Madonna and Child

works.caption: Daumier dissolves a crowded third-class carriage into somber ochres and umbers, isolating a nursing mother, a basket-clutching grandmother, and a sleeping boy in a silence that feels monumental despite the sketch-like handling.
works.title: The Third-Class Carriage

works.caption: The Virgin stands in a red mantle under a tall arch, holding the Child, while two angels in flight hold a gold crown above her. Below, an angel in green plays a harp and an angel in blue a lute. Behind her lies a walled garden with a small figure in white, and towers beyond.
works.title: Virgin and Child with Four Angels

works.caption: David marshals Neoclassical rigor into high drama, Socrates reaching for the hemlock while pointing skyward, his composed body a study in stoic geometry against the grief of the disciples around him.
works.title: The Death of Socrates

works.caption: Degas fractures the dance studio with mirror reflections and a violinist's angular bowing arm, the tulle skirts dissolving into powdery brushwork that anticipates his pastel dancers.
works.title: The Dancing Class

works.caption: Ducreux paints herself mid-performance at the harp, striped silk gown catching the light as she turns to meet the viewer with an easy, confident smile.
works.title: Self-Portrait with a Harp

works.caption: Three half-length figures fill a dark green ground. An older woman in a white head-cloth looks out wide-eyed, her hand on the shoulder of a young woman in red, who lowers her eyes and presses her palms together. At lower left a curly-haired baby lies with his eyes closed.
works.title: Virgin and Child with Saint Anne

works.caption: Van Dyck poses the collector Lucas van Uffel beside a classical bust and a globe, the sitter's twisting glance and rumpled sleeve giving Baroque swagger to an image of connoisseurship.
works.title: Lucas van Uffel (died 1637)

works.caption: The young Van Dyck paints himself with tousled hair and an appraising sidelong glance, lifting one languid hand to his chin. The fluid black cloak and absence of palette or brushes present the painter with aristocratic ease.
works.title: Self-Portrait

works.caption: Fuseli conjures a ghastly night-hag looming over a corpse-pale infant, a spectral witches' ride glimpsed in the murk behind her, the whole scene lit like a fever dream.
works.title: The Night-Hag Visiting Lapland Witches

works.caption: Gauguin flattens a Tahitian veranda into bold planes of pink, yellow-green, and orange, the women's languid poses and patterned cloth turning an afternoon rest into a decorative, dreamlike frieze.
works.title: The Siesta

works.caption: Gentileschi stages Esther's fainting collapse before Ahasuerus with theatrical chiaroscuro, the queen's swooning gold silk pooling against the king's startled, leaning-forward alarm.
works.title: Esther before Ahasuerus

works.caption: Gérôme's obsessive perspective marches striped horseshoe arches into deep recession, pigeons wheeling through shafts of light above rows of praying worshippers.
works.title: Prayer in the Mosque

works.caption: The banker Francesco Sassetti faces almost frontally, while his young son Teodoro turns toward him in profile. Their red caps echo one another against a pale, distant landscape; the boy’s patterned tunic contrasts with his father’s broad red robe.
works.title: Francesco Sassetti (1421–1490) and His Son Teodoro

works.caption: Under a wooden stable roof, Mary, wrapped in a dark blue-green mantle, lies on a red mattress, looking down. Below her an old king kneels, his crown on the ground, and lifts the Christ Child out of the manger. Joseph holds out a small red gift, two crowned kings wait at right, and angels fly over the roof against the gold.
works.title: The Adoration of the Magi

works.caption: A man with thick dark hair cut in a fringe and a short, stubbly beard looks off to the right, his hands pressed together in prayer at the lower edge. He wears a dark robe with a high collar. Behind him, past a slim stone column, a window opens onto blue sky, a green hill and trees.
works.title: Portrait of a Man

works.caption: Van Gogh fills a white pitcher with cobalt irises whose thick, urgent strokes electrify the pale ground. The violet-blue flowers and green leaves turn the still life into an experiment in vibrating colour.
works.title: Irises

works.caption: Van Gogh flattens Madame Ginoux against searing chrome yellow, her pensive chin-in-hand pose and stack of yellow novels rendered in bold outline and jabbing brushstrokes.
works.title: L'Arlésienne: Madame Joseph-Michel Ginoux (Marie Julien, 1848–1911)

works.caption: Van Gogh whips the sky into rolling, rope-thick swirls behind a flame-like cypress, wheat field and cloud rendered with the same restless, coiling energy.
works.title: Wheat Field with Cypresses

works.caption: Two majas in pale, gold-trimmed dresses lean across a wrought-iron balcony rail, sharing a teasing glance as shadowy, cloaked men loom behind them. The scene's authorship is currently attributed to Francisco Goya.
works.title: Majas on a Balcony

works.caption: El Greco erupts the Cardinal's rose-magenta silk into jagged, electric folds, spectacles and cool appraising eyes giving the sitter an intensity that outshines the pomp of his office.
works.title: Cardinal Fernando Niño de Guevara (1541–1609)

works.caption: El Greco isolates a bald, bearded head against near-black shadow, the starched ruff and searching eyes carrying the whole psychological weight of the portrait.
works.title: Portrait of an Old Man

works.caption: El Greco turns Toledo into a visionary silhouette beneath a churning, storm-lit sky, the hilltop city glowing an eerie green-grey against near-black clouds.
works.title: View of Toledo

works.caption: El Greco's late visionary style dissolves Revelation into a phosphorescent turmoil of writhing bodies and unearthly color, Saint John's upraised arms conducting the storm of drapery below.
works.title: The Vision of Saint John

works.caption: Hals catches a raised wineglass and a burst of laughter mid-gesture, the couple's flushed cheeks and feathered hat brim rendered in loose, virtuoso brushwork that seems to move.
works.title: Young Man and Woman in an Inn

works.caption: Haverman packs an arched niche with an extravagant tumble of tulips, roses, and grapes, a snail and butterfly adding quiet incident to the dense, dark-ground bouquet.
works.title: A Vase of Flowers

works.caption: A young man in a black cap and a loose black gown lined with fur looks out at the viewer, his forearms resting on a green-covered table. One hand, with a gold signet ring, holds a folded piece of tan leather. At lower left lies a clasped brown book with a slip of paper tucked into it. Gold lettering on the blue background reads ANNO.1532. on the left and ÆTATIS.SVÆ.29. on the right.
works.title: Hermann von Wedigh III (died 1560)

works.caption: Ingres renders porcelain skin and a cascading gold chain with crystalline precision, the sitter's poised half-smile and richly patterned shawl anchoring a masterclass in Neoclassical portraiture.
works.title: Madame Jacques-Louis Leblanc (Françoise Poncelle, 1788–1839)

works.caption: Klimt dissolves the girl's white dress into a mosaic of floral confetti against violet, letting the pattern nearly swallow the sitter's composed, direct gaze.
works.title: Mäda Primavesi (1903–2000)

works.caption: A single sweep of iridescent white satin carries the whole portrait; look at how loosely brushed drapery still reads as weighty, luminous fabric.
works.title: Serena Pulitzer Lederer (1867–1943)

works.caption: A ring of thieving hands closes on the oblivious young dandy while the fortune-teller's gaze holds his; La Tour's cool, sculptural lighting and covert pickpocketing make this a masterclass in narrative misdirection.
works.title: The Fortune-Teller

works.caption: Mary Magdalen clasps her hands over a skull on her lap. A candle burns beside her and appears again in the mirror, its doubled flame illuminating her profile, white blouse and orange-red skirt against the surrounding darkness.
works.title: The Penitent Magdalen

works.caption: Lawrence lets the fur-trimmed cloak billow into the landscape, the sitter caught mid-turn with a knowing half-smile against a wind-scudded sky.
works.title: Elizabeth Farren (born about 1759, died 1829), Later Countess of Derby

works.caption: Mary, in a blue mantle over a red dress, holds the naked Christ Child as he lies across her lap and turns the pages of a book set on a red cushion. An open pomegranate lies beside the book. Through a window behind them, two columns frame a walled town, a river and bridges.
works.medium: Tempera, oil, and gold on wood
works.title: Madonna and Child

works.caption: A woman in strict profile stands in a room, in a red gown edged with pale fur over a dark, gold-flecked sleeve, a pearl necklace and a tall red headdress trimmed with pearls. At left a man in a red hat looks in through a narrow opening, his hands on a shield striped black and gold, and a window behind her opens onto a small landscape.
works.title: Portrait of a Woman with a Man at a Casement

works.caption: A young saint with a gold halo, in a grey-blue dalmatic with a green mantle over his shoulder and knees, sits on a grey stone throne holding a palm and a red book. Two haloed saints in round red hats stand on either side, each with a palm: the one at the left in a yellow-orange cloak over pink and blue, the one at the right in a pink cloak over a blue tunic. Before the throne three men kneel in prayer, two in red at the left and one in pink at the right, all against a gold background.
works.title: Saint Lawrence Enthroned with Saints and Donors

works.caption: A naked woman in a jewelled headdress and white veil reclines on a blue cloth before a red hanging, rose petals scattered over her. At left a winged boy crowned with leaves holds a leafy wreath, hung on a blue ribbon from her raised hand, and pees through it toward her.
works.title: Venus and Cupid

works.caption: Manet's Spanish singer strums against a bare brown ground, the still-life of onions and jug at his feet painted with the same blunt, confident economy as the figure.
works.title: The Spanish Singer

works.caption: A cross-dressed toreador stares out with flat, matter-of-fact composure, the bullfight behind her rendered as a loose, almost collaged vignette.
works.title: Mademoiselle V. . . in the Costume of an Espada

works.caption: Abruptly cropped boat and sail press a sailor and his companion against broad planes of aquamarine water. Manet combines bright, sketchy outdoor painting with strong diagonals and flattened colour inspired by Japanese prints.
works.title: Boating

works.caption: Mary kneels with joined hands, her blue mantle spread on the ground, and the naked Christ child lies on its hem among cherubs in blue clouds. Joseph sleeps at the left in a yellow cloak, by a wattle fence and an ox. At the right two shepherds in torn clothes lean in, one with joined hands, the other holding his hat. Beyond them a river winds through fields, and two more figures approach at the far right.
works.medium: Tempera on canvas, transferred from wood
works.title: The Adoration of the Shepherds

works.caption: A laden table of melon, grapes, bread, and copper vessels catches raking light against a distant blue landscape; Meléndez's precision makes every rind and crumb tactile.
works.title: The Afternoon Meal (La Merienda)

works.caption: Two panels shown side by side. On the left, a man with short brown hair and a dark robe presses his hands together in prayer against a black ground. On the right, a young woman in a dark red gown with a broad white collar, a jewelled gold necklace and a tall black headdress with a sheer veil also joins her hands. Each figure sits inside a painted frame.
works.title: Tommaso di Folco Portinari (1428–1501); Maria Portinari (Maria Maddalena Baroncelli, born 1456)

works.caption: Three towering haystacks loom over a flock crossing the plain beneath a bruised, stormy sky; Millet's silhouetted shepherd anchors the scene's quiet monumentality.
works.title: Haystacks: Autumn

works.caption: The winged sphinx presses against Oedipus's bare chest, claws sunk into his thigh, while a scattering of severed limbs at the base names the stakes of the riddle.
works.title: Oedipus and the Sphinx

works.caption: Three arched panels share one landscape. At left Christ stands in a river as a kneeling man baptizes him; at centre a bearded old man kneels on a grassy ledge, a stone raised in one hand and a small crucifix on the ground before him; at right a monk in black holds a red book and beads while strange creatures crowd behind him. Rocky crags rise behind, and a wide stretch of water opens out at the right.
works.title: The Penitence of Saint Jerome

works.artist: Piero di Cosimo (Piero di Lorenzo di Piero d'Antonio)
works.artistSort: d'Antonio), Piero di Cosimo (Piero di Lorenzo di Piero
works.caption: Fire breaks out in a dark forest while nude men, men in animal skins and goat-legged satyrs hunt, one swinging a club. In the centre foreground a lion, two bears and a man are locked together, and to their left a white beast on the back of a second, roaring lion bites its head; deer and other beasts flee at the left, and a dead man lies at the lower right.
works.medium: Tempera and oil transferred to Masonite
works.title: A Hunting Scene

works.caption: A woman climbs a sunlit path past a walled village tucked into rolling farmland; Pissarro's high vantage and layered greens give the hillside real depth and air.
works.title: Jalais Hill, Pontoise

works.caption: A bird's-eye view looks down the boulevard Montmartre in Paris as it runs into a misty grey distance between rows of bare winter trees. Carriages and other horse-drawn vehicles move along the pale roadway and people walk the pavements, past a tall street lamp in the foreground and a kiosk at right. Long rows of cream-coloured buildings with grey roofs and chimneys line the right-hand side.
works.title: The Boulevard Montmartre on a Winter Morning

works.caption: The blind giant Orion strides toward the rising sun with tiny Diana perched in the clouds above; Poussin's mythic landscape dwarfs its figures beneath an immense, atmospheric sky.
works.title: Blind Orion Searching for the Rising Sun

works.caption: Romulus's raised cloak signals the ambush as chaos erupts across the piazza; trace how Poussin choreographs dozens of wrestling, grasping figures into distinct, legible pairs.
works.title: The Abduction of the Sabine Women

works.caption: Enthroned above kneeling saints, the Madonna's tender downward glance anchors a monumental altarpiece capped by God the Father and flanking angels — Raphael's architectural clarity organizes the whole crowded field.
works.title: Madonna and Child Enthroned with Saints

works.caption: The cabinetmaker Herman Doomer turns toward the viewer beneath a broad black hat. Fine strokes pick out his moustache and pleated white collar, while his hand and dark clothing emerge more softly from the brown shadows.
works.title: Herman Doomer (ca. 1595–1650)

works.caption: A blind of shadow swallows the room while Rembrandt's raking light finds Aristotle's hand resting on Homer's marble brow — a meditation on fame painted almost entirely in umber and gold.
works.title: Aristotle with a Bust of Homer

works.caption: A plumed hat, richly tooled sword belt and fur-trimmed costume emerge from the surrounding dark as the standard bearer grips his flagstaff. Rembrandt's vigorous handling models the face, hair and details with concentrated force.
works.title: The Standard Bearer (probably Floris Soop, 1604–1657)

works.caption: Rembrandt painted himself here at fifty-four. Thick touches of paint catch the light across his brow, nose and cheeks, while his dark cap and brown coat frame a face rendered with close attention to its changing texture.
works.title: Self-Portrait

works.caption: Three ruddy-cheeked infants clamber over an allegorical mother in Reni's cool, porcelain palette — tenderness rendered with an almost sculptural polish.
works.title: Charity

works.caption: The Virgin rises weightless against a furnace of golden cloud, her rose and blue robes and the flanking angels arranged with Reni's characteristic clarity and poise.
works.title: The Immaculate Conception

works.caption: A tall, self-possessed young officer leans against his horse under a wind-tossed tree, Reynolds' scarlet coat blazing against somber greens and grays.
works.title: Captain George K. H. Coussmaker (1759–1801)

works.caption: Mary and the Christ Child form a bright foreground group with Saints Anne and Catherine of Alexandria, while Joseph and another figure recede into shadow. A woven basket of fruit glows at the lower right, grounding the sacred gathering in ordinary detail.
works.title: The Holy Family with Saints Anne and Catherine of Alexandria

works.caption: At left the angel Gabriel, with wings marked by eye-like spots, wears a gold-and-maroon patterned robe over white and holds a tall staff. At right Mary kneels at a reading desk in a deep blue mantle over red, one hand raised, a book open in front of her. Behind her rises a bed hung with red curtains; through a window at the back lies a walled garden. Lilies stand in a metal jug at lower right.
works.title: The Annunciation

works.caption: Rubens paints his own family as a garden idyll — himself, his young wife Helena, and their son, with a macaw and fountain adding flashes of exotic color.
works.title: Rubens, Helena Fourment (1614–1673), and Their Son Frans (1633–1678)

works.caption: Venus clings to a departing, red-draped Adonis while his hounds strain at the leash — Rubens builds the whole drama from the collision of warm flesh and cool landscape.
works.title: Venus and Adonis

works.caption: A churning, full-throttle hunt: horses, hounds, and wolves lock together in a diagonal tangle of violence that Rubens choreographs across the whole canvas.
works.title: Wolf and Fox Hunt

works.caption: Ruisdael gives two-thirds of the canvas to a towering sky of piled cumulus, the wheat fields below rendered almost as an afterthought beneath that drama.
works.title: Wheat Fields

works.caption: A boy in an animal skin, kneeling at left, offers a blue-green globe to a curly-haired infant, who stands on a cushion steadied by a woman in pink. Behind them a bald, bearded old man rests a hand on the globe and looks out. Green drapery hangs behind, and a red cloth spills across the front.
works.title: The Holy Family with the Young Saint John the Baptist

works.caption: A bearded man in a loose pink garment, a dark red cloth behind his shoulder, writes with a quill beside a small oil lamp and turns to look up at a winged angel in blue-violet behind him. Through openings at the edges, a moonlit building with small figures shows at the left and three figures gathered round a fire at the right.
works.title: Saint Matthew and the Angel

works.caption: Seurat's pointillist dots resolve, at a distance, into gaslit sideshow performers frozen mid-gesture — a deliberately airless, hieratic take on popular entertainment.
works.title: Circus Sideshow (Parade de cirque)

works.caption: Music, drinking and laughter fill a crowded terrace. At the centre a woman extends an empty glass, while a child plays beside a dog below; overhead, an owl perches next to a hanging cage, adding another small incident to Steen’s unruly gathering.
works.title: Merry Company on a Terrace

works.caption: Two half-length figures, one bare-chested and pleading, the other richly dressed in red satin, embody Sweerts' unusual blend of Caravaggesque charity and cool Northern restraint.
works.title: Clothing the Naked

works.caption: A young mother in a red dress and blue mantle, a pale veil over her red-gold hair, bends her head towards the naked baby lying across her lap, one hand under his foot. Faint rings of halo circle both heads. A green cloth hangs behind them; to the right, two tree trunks stand against a landscape with water and distant towers.
works.title: Madonna and Child

works.caption: A man with shoulder-length auburn hair and a full reddish beard turns his head to look back over his shoulder at the viewer. A white collar with a soft, frayed edge sits above a black garment with a woven pattern. At lower right his fingers grip something soft and grey, against a dark background.
works.title: Portrait of a Man

works.caption: A naked woman, seen from behind, sits on a red cloth and reaches an arm around a young man in a short pink tunic. He holds a spear raised in one hand and two hounds on a leash in the other, and looks back down at her. At the left a winged child clutches a white bird behind a mound, below a bow and quiver hanging in a tree. A faint rainbow arcs across the sky, and light breaks through the clouds at the upper right.
works.title: Venus and Adonis

works.caption: Two women flank a top-hatted dandy under electric cabaret light — Toulouse-Lautrec flattens the scene into bold outline and caricature-sharp color.
works.title: The Englishman (William Tom Warrener, 1861–1934) at the Moulin Rouge

works.caption: A ghost ship dissolves into fog and spray, Turner reducing masts and sails to a few pale, wind-scraped strokes almost swallowed by the surrounding atmosphere.
works.title: Whalers

works.artist: Velázquez (Diego Rodríguez de Silva y Velázquez)
works.artistSort: Velázquez), Velázquez (Diego Rodríguez de Silva y
works.caption: Juan de Pareja, held in slavery in Velázquez's studio, is shown half-length, his shoulders turned to the left and his eyes meeting ours. He has thick dark hair, a moustache and a short beard, and wears a dark olive-grey doublet and cloak with a broad white collar whose lace edge falls in ragged points. His right arm crosses his waist, the hand resting against his body, before a plain grey background.
works.title: Juan de Pareja (ca. 1608–1670)

works.artist: Velázquez (Diego Rodríguez de Silva y Velázquez)
works.artistSort: Velázquez), Velázquez (Diego Rodríguez de Silva y
works.caption: María Teresa's formal wig spreads wide around her solemn young face, its rows of silver butterfly ribbons flickering against the dark ground. Velázquez's compact likeness was made as a model for assistants producing official portraits of the infanta.
works.title: María Teresa (1638–1683), Infanta of Spain

works.artist: Velázquez (Diego Rodríguez de Silva y Velázquez)
works.artistSort: Velázquez), Velázquez (Diego Rodríguez de Silva y
works.caption: A man with thick, dark hair falling to his collar, an upturned moustache and a small beard turns his head to look back at us over his shoulder. He wears a black doublet with a stiff white collar against a plain grey-brown background. He may be Velázquez himself, though this is uncertain.
works.title: Portrait of a Man, Possibly a Self-Portrait

works.caption: A servant dozes over an untouched table of fruit and wine, sunlight slicing through a doorway beyond — Vermeer's early mastery of interior light and psychological suspension.
works.title: A Maid Asleep

works.caption: An unfinished-looking tronie, the sitter's face luminous against near-total black — Vermeer strips away narrative to leave pure, uncanny presence.
works.title: Study of a Young Woman

works.caption: A young woman in a white hood and broad white collar, a dark blue skirt and a dark bodice trimmed in gold, rests one hand on an open leaded window and the other on the handle of a gleaming metal pitcher. The pitcher stands in a wide basin on a table covered with a red patterned carpet, beside a small box. A blue cloth lies heaped on the chair behind, and a map hangs on the pale wall at upper right.
works.title: Young Woman with a Water Pitcher

works.caption: A cupid binds Mars and Venus together while another attends the warhorse at the right. The horse stands quietly beside the lovers, its cool grey coat contrasting with gleaming armour, pink drapery and the deep blue cloth around Venus.
works.title: Mars and Venus United by Love

works.caption: An oval format tightens the focus on Vigée Le Brun's sitter, her powdered curls and pale blue sash set glowing against pure black, a folded letter caught mid-gesture in her hand.
works.title: Madame Grand (Noël Catherine Vorlée, 1761–1835)

works.caption: Vigée Le Brun poses her sitter in a broad-brimmed hat and cascading black ribbon against emerald velvet — informal, direct, and remarkably fresh in handling.
works.title: Comtesse de la Châtre (Marie Charlotte Louise Perrette Aglaé Bontemps, 1762–1848)

works.caption: A young girl kneels in prayer between rose-pink curtains, her plain sewing cushion and scattered wildflowers grounding Zurbarán's otherwise devotional stillness in domestic realism.
works.title: The Young Virgin

works.caption: Flame-shaped cypresses twist upward against a swirling turquoise sky — van Gogh's brush turns still trees into something almost combustible.
works.title: Cypresses

works.caption: A seated laborer in a plain hat and coat, blocked out in Cézanne's characteristic slabs of muted color and rebuilt, faceted brushwork rather than smooth modeling.
works.title: Seated Peasant

works.caption: The daughters of Catulle Mendès gather around a piano: one sits at the keyboard, another holds a violin and bow, and the third leans beside them. Blue and violet strokes enliven their pale dresses, linking the figures to the curtains behind.
works.title: The Daughters of Catulle Mendès, Huguette (1871–1964), Claudine (1876–1937), and Helyonne (1879–1955)

works.caption: The queen stands beside a crown resting on a velvet cushion, her cascading lace sleeves and pearl-trimmed bodice painted with Van Dyck's characteristic silvery elegance.
works.title: Queen Henrietta Maria

works.caption: The Union warship Kearsarge lies off Boulogne, its long dark hull set against a turquoise sea and the brown sail of a nearer boat. Manet painted it after its victory over the Confederate Alabama off the French coast in 1864.
works.title: The "Kearsarge" at Boulogne

works.caption: Carracci packs the mourners into a dense triangular knot around Christ's pallid body, the whole scene lit as if by a single guttering torch just outside the frame.
works.title: The Burial of Christ

works.caption: Two tiny silhouettes stand dwarfed beneath a gnarled, half-dead oak, their backs to us as they gaze at a sliver of moon — Friedrich's Romantic sublime distilled to near silence.
works.title: Two Men Contemplating the Moon

works.caption: Three fashionably dressed sisters pause on a country path to offer alms, Courbet setting their pale silks and parasols against a raw limestone gorge.
works.title: Young Ladies of the Village

works.caption: A lion feeds on spotted prey beneath an immense screen of leaves and flowers. The small, bloody encounter is almost engulfed by Rousseau’s carefully layered foliage, whose repeated shapes turn the imagined jungle into a dense ornamental world.
works.title: The Repast of the Lion

works.caption: Follow the ancient plum's gnarled black trunk as it lunges across four gold-leaf panels, pale blossoms scattered like stars against the glowing ground.
works.medium: Four sliding-door panels (fusuma); ink, color, gold, and gold leaf on paper
works.title: Old Plum

works.caption: Pale waves curl into clawlike tips across a two-panel screen, their long ink contours crossing a gold-leaf ground. Kōrin gives the swelling water both weight and rhythm, repeating its restless curves from one edge to the other.
works.medium: Two-panel folding screen; ink, color, and gold leaf on paper
works.title: Rough Waves

works.caption: Five tall trees with leafy crowns stand together on a rocky bank dotted with dark moss, pale water stretching behind them. Across the water a large mountain rises at upper left, with lower peaks to its right. Two blocks of writing and a few red seals sit in the sky, and more seals are stamped down both edges and in the bottom corners.
works.title: Woods and Valleys of Mount Yu

works.artist: Giovanni di Paolo (Giovanni di Paolo di Grazia)
works.artistSort: Grazia), Giovanni di Paolo (Giovanni di Paolo di
works.caption: At the upper left, a haloed, bearded God in blue, carried by a crowd of blue-winged heads, reaches down and points at a great disc of blue, white and grey rings with one red band, a brown-and-green land at its centre. At the right, a naked angel with gold wings and halo pushes a naked Adam and Eve out of a garden of flowers and fruit trees. Below them, four dark streams flow down from a long dark band to the bottom edge.
works.title: The Creation of the World and the Expulsion from Paradise

works.artist: Giovanni di Paolo (Giovanni di Paolo di Grazia)
works.artistSort: Grazia), Giovanni di Paolo (Giovanni di Paolo di
works.caption: Christ, in a pale pink robe and dark mantle, sits beside the Virgin on one throne upholstered in red and gold brocade and reaches across to set a crown on her head. She wears a white mantle patterned in gold, hands at her breast. Haloed angels crowd behind the throne; two more sit on the marbled floor in front, one playing a small organ, the other a harp.
works.title: Coronation of the Virgin

works.caption: A goldsmith in red sits at his counter holding up a small balance, while a richly dressed couple stands at his side. Shelves behind him hold tall lidded pitchers, a string of beads, brooches, a branch of coral and a box of rings. A round mirror propped up at the right shows a street and two passers-by.
works.title: A Goldsmith in his Shop

works.caption: Two girls study the music at a piano, one seated at the keyboard and the other leaning over her shoulder. Their inclined heads and reaching arms draw the figures together, while pink clothing, green curtains and a blue-patterned vase soften the room into colour.
works.title: Two Young Girls at the Piano

works.caption: Wu Bin renders the legendary Luohans with wildly inventive, individualized features and gnarled, otherworldly trees, the ink line moving between flesh, bark, and drapery with the same wiry energy.
works.medium: Handscroll; ink and color on paper
works.title: The Sixteen Luohans

works.caption: A vast panoramic ascent up Mount Tai unfolds in blue-green washes, with tiny figures, temples, and processions threaded through the folds of rock in Wang Hui's synthesis of court grandeur and landscape mastery.
works.medium: Handscroll; ink and color on silk
works.title: The Kangxi Emperor's Southern Inspection Tour, Scroll Three: Ji'nan to Mount Tai

works.caption: A boy with short dark hair and large brown eyes looks out calmly, his head turned slightly. He wears a white tunic with a narrow purple stripe at one shoulder, and a few lines of dark Greek letters are painted below its neckline.
works.title: Portrait of the Boy Eutyches

works.caption: A father gestures amid globes, busts, and a memento mori skull while his large family gathers close, Le Brun weaving portraiture and vanitas into one dense, shadowed interior.
works.title: The Jabach Family

works.caption: A shepherd crouches in anguish among rocks while a procession of nude figures drifts along the horizon above, Hodler's flattened, symbolist landscape turning grief into pattern.
works.title: The Dream of the Shepherd (Der Traum des Hirten)

works.caption: An old bearded fishmonger grips a cleaver and lays his other hand on a fish at a wooden table covered with salmon steaks, whole and cut fish. On the right a woman in a red jacket rests her folded hands on a pot, beside a large metal bowl and a round table of fish. Women with baskets stand behind, and through a stone archway men carry baskets in front of a tall tower.
works.title: Fish Market

works.caption: A guitarist glances up from her instrument, her exposed shoulder and rumpled red drapery caught in a single raking light against total darkness, Vouet at his most Caravaggesque.
works.title: Woman Playing a Guitar

works.caption: A painted mandala hangs in its fabric mounting, with a cloth cover gathered up at the top. A square palace inside a large circle holds the red Raktayamari and his consort at the centre, ringed by eight smaller figures in petal-shaped panels, with another figure in each of the four gates. Rows of small seated and standing figures run along the top and bottom.
works.title: Mandala of Raktayamari

works.caption: A black, three-eyed Mahakala with bared fangs and a crown of skulls stands with bent knees on a corpse, before a red, patterned aureole. A bar rests across his forearms and a skull cup sits just below it. Small seated figures, most in red and orange robes, and dark fierce deities in arched niches frame him along the top and sides; more fierce figures fill the band at the bottom.
works.title: Mahakala, Protector of the Tent

works.caption: A tight bouquet of roses, tulips, and narcissus glows against a near-black ground, each petal and dewdrop picked out with jewel-like precision, Peeters at the height of her powers.
works.title: A Bouquet of Flowers

works.caption: A man with bristling whiskers and a cap sits high on a grey ledge at upper left, one arm raised and the other flung out, gazing down. Far below, a jointed staff slants into a burst of spray, and higher up near the right edge a dragon's whiskered head rises out of the mist. A long pale band curves down from the overhanging rock above him.
works.title: Daoist Master Fei Zhangfang

works.caption: Two lines of slender trees with thin, light foliage stand on a grassy bank beside the Seine, under a blue sky full of white clouds. A woman stands and a child sits on the grass in the middle distance, and a sandy path leads left towards buildings with a red roof. At right the river opens out, with a boat and its tall mast in the distance and a bank of trees on the far side.
works.title: The Seine at Bougival

works.caption: A mother leans back against a great tree trunk as her children press close, Reynolds using the deep shadow of the foliage to set off the glow of pink silk and pale skin.
works.title: Lady Elizabeth Delmé and Her Children

works.caption: Van Gogh sets himself against a churning field of blue brushstrokes, the same restless rhythm animating both his coat and the space around him.
works.title: Self-Portrait

works.caption: A young girl in black cape and white satin reaches toward a rose bush, Reynolds balancing the solemnity of her dark dress against a bright, breezy sky.
works.title: Lady Caroline Howard

works.caption: A crowded feast of gods in a shadowed grove, finished by Titian after Bellini's death; watch the light strike the blue and white robes among the trees.
works.title: The Feast of the Gods

works.caption: Cattle graze beside the lake on Francis Slater Rebow’s Essex estate, with his red-brick house visible between the trees. Constable gives almost half the picture to clouds, whose shifting shadows cross the lawns and water.
works.title: Wivenhoe Park, Essex

works.caption: Saint Martin sits high on a white horse, lowering part of his green cloak toward the nearly nude beggar. Gold-edged armor and monumental figures rise above a distant view of Toledo.
works.title: Saint Martin and the Beggar

works.caption: A bullfighter lies flat and foreshortened on bare ground, the wound almost an afterthought; Manet strips the death of all theater.
works.title: The Dead Toreador

works.artist: Andrea Mantegna or Follower (Possibly Giulio Campagnola)
works.artistSort: Mantegna, Andrea or Follower (Possibly Giulio Campagnola)
works.caption: Judith, in a white gown and a blue mantle, stands at the opening of a pink tent and looks away to the right. With one hand she lowers a severed head into a sack held open by a turbaned servant; in the other she holds a sword, point down. Behind her, a bare foot sticks up from a bed.
works.title: Judith with the Head of Holofernes

works.caption: The younger woman's frank, dimpled smile as she leans on the sill plays against her companion's half-hidden amusement behind a white shawl, all framed by warm, worn wood.
works.title: Two Women at a Window

works.caption: Mary, in a red dress with a blue mantle across her lap, sits before a low wall with the naked Christ Child standing in her lap. He hooks an arm round her neck, lays a hand on her chest and looks out, while she looks down to one side, his foot resting in her hand. Behind them lies open country, with trees, water and a road at the left and a domed church on a hill at the right.
works.title: The Small Cowper Madonna

works.caption: A brooding sky presses down on the lit windmill and quiet river below, Rembrandt's chiaroscuro turning a humble landscape into a meditation on weather and light.
works.title: The Mill

works.caption: A young man with long fair hair and a black cap turns to look back over his shoulder, straight out of the picture. His blue garment is cut low enough to leave his shoulder bare, and one hand rests on the cloth at his chest above a dark sleeve. The background is a plain deep green.
works.title: Bindo Altoviti

works.caption: Joanna Hiffernan stands in a white dress against a white curtain, holding a lily at her side. Her red hair, the blue patterned carpet and scattered flowers interrupt the pale surfaces; an animal pelt confronts us with glassy eyes and bared teeth.
works.title: Symphony in White, No. 1: The White Girl

works.caption: The empty scale balances against the Last Judgment painting behind her, Vermeer's raking window light turning a quiet domestic moment into meditation.
works.title: Woman Holding a Balance

works.caption: Church positions the viewer at the very brink of Horseshoe Falls, the water's curve and a faint rainbow drawing the eye endlessly downward.
works.title: Niagara

works.caption: A youth in a flat-topped crimson cap, his wavy dark blond hair falling to his shoulders, tilts his head and looks out from a black background. His right hand rests on the chest of his brown tunic, whose collar and front seam are edged in white, above a narrow grey stone ledge.
works.title: Portrait of a Youth

works.caption: Magdalene's head falls back in rapture, throat bared and eyes shut, Gentileschi turning penitence into a study of pure physical abandon.
works.title: Mary Magdalene in Ecstasy

works.caption: Mary sits on the grass beside a tree stump, in a blue mantle over a pink dress, a book in one hand. The naked Christ Child stands against her with one knee bent up on her lap, leaning out toward the kneeling young John the Baptist, who wears an animal skin; both boys grip the same thin cross, and Mary looks across toward it. Behind them pale turquoise water, buildings and blue hills stretch under a pale blue sky with a few small clouds, all inside a circle.
works.medium: oil on panel transferred to canvas
works.title: The Alba Madonna

works.caption: Mary, in a rose dress with a green lower sleeve and a blue mantle, looks down at the naked child on her lap. He smiles out at us and grips the gold-trimmed neckline of her dress. Thin gold halos and a sheer veil stand out against a clear blue sky.
works.title: The Niccolini-Cowper Madonna

works.caption: Saint George drives his lance into the dragon as his white horse rears and turns its head toward us. The long diagonal of the weapon cuts across the horse’s body, while the princess kneels in prayer beyond its raised tail.
works.title: Saint George and the Dragon

works.caption: A catboat heels hard as young sailors lean to keep it upright, Homer's salt spray and taut canvas capturing the exact instant before the wind wins.
works.title: Breezing Up (A Fair Wind)

works.caption: Ingres records the light-absorbing black lace and velvet of Madame Moitessier's gown with minute precision, setting its dense textures against her cool gaze and flower-crowned hair.
works.title: Madame Moitessier

works.caption: Laocoon and his sons writhe among serpents on a bare hill above a spectral view of Toledo, El Greco setting classical myth in his own adopted city.
works.title: Laocoön

works.caption: A woman reclines along a gray sofa, wrapped in ivory cloth and a shimmering silver-gray skirt. Sargent's loose strokes turn her languid pose into an image of calm, private luxury.
works.title: Nonchaloir (Repose)

works.caption: Judith Leyster turns in her chair to look at us with parted lips, a brush in her right hand held towards the canvas on her easel, where a laughing violin player in a blue cap is painted. She wears a white cap, a wide lace-edged white collar and a black bodice with shimmering mauve sleeves. In her other hand she holds a palette, a white cloth and a fistful of brushes.
works.title: Self-Portrait

works.caption: William Grant glides toward us with folded arms, his head turned to the side and one skate trailing behind. Painted after a skating outing in London’s Hyde Park, the portrait sets his dark clothes against pale ice and a winter sky.
works.title: The Skater (Portrait of William Grant)

works.caption: Venus, pearls threaded through her blonde hair, sits half-wrapped in a fur-lined dark red velvet mantle with a gold-patterned border, one hand at her breast. A winged child seen from behind holds up a black-framed mirror that shows part of her face, while a second, fair-haired child behind it raises a wreath of leaves.
