works.title: Venus with a Mirror

works.artist: Fra Angelico and Fra Filippo Lippi
works.artistSort: Angelico, Fra and Fra Filippo Lippi
works.caption: A crowded Adoration fills a round panel. The Virgin sits with the Child outside a thatched stable, where an old man with a gold band round his head kneels to hold the Child's foot to his face. A peacock perches on the roof, and at its other end a tangle of two pheasants plunges head down. At left, beyond the kneeling figures, saddled horses wait below ruined walls where five near-naked youths stand and clamber. At upper right a long procession with camels winds down the hill past a walled town.
works.title: The Adoration of the Magi

works.caption: A boy with cropped dark hair, shown to below the waist against a dark ground, glances to one side. A black cloak, with a white Maltese cross over his left upper arm, hangs open over a rose-red doublet with a small white ruff. His right hand holds a pale glove, and a gold-hilted sword hangs at his left hip from an ornate belt.
works.title: Ranuccio Farnese

works.caption: The Virgin, in a deep blue mantle, holds the naked Child, who stands on a green cushion with a small fruit in one hand. A red cloth hangs behind her. At the left a window opens onto wooded hills, a winding path and a castle tower, and a coat of arms sits in each lower corner.
works.title: Madonna and Child [obverse]

works.caption: An old man with a long grey-white beard, seen to the waist, turns his head and gazes off to the left. He wears a red cardinal's biretta and a red buttoned cape over a white sleeve, and holds one hand out low at the right, palm turned up. Light falls from the left, against a plain dark brown background.
works.title: Cardinal Pietro Bembo

works.caption: Henrietta Maria’s blue satin catches the light beside Sir Jeffrey Hudson’s red suit. She reaches toward the monkey he holds; a crown partly tucked into the gold curtain and the massive column frame this intimate gesture with royal display.
works.title: Queen Henrietta Maria with Sir Jeffrey Hudson

works.caption: Giuliano de' Medici, in a red garment with grey-trimmed edges and a thin white collar, turns his head to the right, almost in profile, with his eyes cast down. He is framed by a grey window. Behind him one wooden shutter of a second window stands open on pale sky. At lower left a turtledove perches on a bare branch at the sill.
works.title: Giuliano de' Medici

works.caption: A long boat carrying several figures glides beneath towering foreground trees. Carracci uses their deep shadow to frame a river, sunlit fields, and hazy mountains beyond.
works.title: River Landscape

works.caption: At the dark mouth of a cave on the right, Mary in a blue mantle kneels with joined hands and white-bearded Joseph in a golden-orange cloak leans on a rock; both look down at the naked Child lying on a white cloth on the ground. Two shepherds in worn clothes come from the left, one kneeling, the other stooping behind him with a staff. The heads of an ox and another animal show in the shadows of the cave. On the left a landscape opens onto a river, a tower and distant blue mountains, and a small winged angel in white hovers among the treetops at the upper left.
works.title: The Adoration of the Shepherds

works.caption: A girl turns her back on us to watch a train's steam rise beyond an iron fence, while her companion's blank, direct gaze makes Manet's modern-life scene both intimate and estranging.
works.title: The Railway

works.caption: Gabriel and Mary meet in a soaring church interior. Rainbow wings, a jeweled red-and-gold robe, Mary's deep blue dress, and the patterned floor reward close looking.
works.medium: oil on canvas transferred from panel
works.title: The Annunciation

works.caption: Napoleon stands mid-stride at 4:13 a.m., candle guttered and papers strewn, David turning an official portrait into a study of a workaholic emperor caught between night and dawn.
works.title: The Emperor Napoleon in His Study at the Tuileries

works.caption: An old man with a white beard frowns as he looks off to the left, wearing a tall gold and red cap over a white coif. A gold mantle with a diagonal row of large gold buttons and a white border crosses his chest over a crimson robe. His ringed right hand grips a fold of his robes. Lettering sits at the upper left of the brown background.
works.title: Doge Andrea Gritti

works.caption: Marchesa Doria's silvery satin gown and towering ruff catch the light with almost photographic brilliance, Rubens turning textile description into pure virtuoso display.
works.title: Marchesa Brigida Spinola Doria

works.caption: A young woman in a goldenrod-yellow gown absorbs herself in a small book. Fragonard's rapid, lively strokes keep the dress, ribbons, cushion, and blushing face in motion.
works.title: Young Girl Reading

works.caption: A woman tunes her lute beside a violin and open songbook, Gentileschi's raking light and richly worked satin sleeve showing Caravaggio's influence refined into something more lyrical.
works.title: The Lute Player

works.caption: A seated writer turns to meet our gaze, her quill resting on the paper and pearl earrings catching the light. Vermeer sets the yellow, fur-trimmed jacket against a deep blue tablecloth and quiet gray wall.
works.title: A Lady Writing

works.caption: A doll-like boy in striped stockings sits atop jagged rocks, his square-on pose and oversized features set against a pale blue sky. Rousseau's flattened space gives the small portrait an uncanny presence.
works.title: Boy on the Rocks

works.caption: A boatman’s dark back fills the foreground opposite a woman holding a baby. The curved yellow-green hull, pale sail and high strip of distant shore turn the boat into an arrangement of bold, interlocking shapes.
works.title: The Boating Party

works.caption: A girl in a voluminous ice-blue chemise arranges her long braid while looking toward a mirror just outside the frame. Pink patterned wallpaper and a washbasin turn the private moment into a carefully observed interior.
works.title: Girl Arranging Her Hair

works.caption: One woman steps into the water while another loosens her patterned wrap, with a man holding a spear farther out. Gauguin’s dark, winding tree divides the figures from a shore painted in broad swirls of pink, purple and orange.
works.title: Fatata te Miti (By the Sea)

works.caption: Gauguin paints himself haloed against blood-red and mustard grounds, apples dangling like forbidden fruit beside a coiled green serpent — a self-mythologizing icon.
works.title: Self-Portrait

works.caption: A young Arlésienne in a striped jacket sits against flat turquoise, van Gogh's directional brushstrokes turning fabric and skin alike into vibrating fields of color.
works.title: La Mousmé

works.caption: Five people in tattered clothes gather around an old violinist, their varied poses spread across a bare patch of ground. Manet gives the displaced figures the scale and gravity of a public statement.
works.title: The Old Musician

works.caption: The girl holds a green watering can upright and a few daisies at her side. Small strokes of pale colour pick out the lace on her dark blue dress and scatter across the path, echoing the flowers that surround her.
works.title: A Girl with a Watering Can

works.caption: The Virgin, in dark blue, kneels over the naked Christ Child, who lies on the hem of her robe on the bare earth floor of a ruined stable. Four winged angels kneel around him; Joseph stands at right with a staff, holding his hat, and men look in through the windows and over the broken wall. A carved stone arch frames the scene, with nude statues of Adam and Eve on its columns.
works.title: The Nativity

works.caption: Daniel prays amid a den of lions rendered with ferocious anatomical specificity, Rubens turning a crowded menagerie into a single coiled arc of tension.
works.title: Daniel in the Lions' Den

works.caption: Dense tropical foliage opens onto a river disappearing into luminous mist. Look closely at the two red-breasted birds on a curving stem at the left: their tiny, sharply coloured forms contrast with the hazy sun and distant canoe.
works.title: El Rio de Luz (The River of Light)

works.caption: Ginevra's pale, unsmiling face is set against a spiky juniper bush — a pun on her name — with Leonardo's soft sfumato modeling already announcing a new kind of portraiture.
works.title: Ginevra de' Benci [obverse]

works.caption: A woman lowers her eyes beneath a sheer white veil that falls in crisp, wide planes, her hands folded at the lower edge. Rogier distills her presence into austere geometry against a deep blue-green ground.
works.title: Portrait of a Lady

works.caption: Crowds, carriages, and a tricolor flag animate a sunlit Parisian bridge, Renoir stacking tiny, precisely placed figures against the broad blue Seine and sky.
works.title: Pont Neuf, Paris

works.caption: A woman alone at a café table rests her cheek on one hand beside a glass of plum brandy, gazing into the distance. Manet's pink dress, burgundy banquette, and gray-streaked marble sustain the pensive pause.
works.title: Plum Brandy

works.caption: A nude woman stands amid jewel-toned green, pink, and purple while a masked kneeling figure watches from beneath a tree. A red-and-green serpent at upper right sharpens Gauguin's elusive image of temptation and evil.
works.title: Parau na te Varua ino (Words of the Devil)

works.caption: A single candle flame reduces the world to a few glowing planes, La Tour using the skull and the Magdalen's shadowed profile to stage a meditation on mortality.
works.title: The Repentant Magdalen

works.caption: A baby's face and one small hand emerge at the crest of a mountain of frilled white cloth and mosaic-like patchwork. Klimt lets shifting patterns and vivid color fill almost the entire square canvas.
works.title: Baby (Cradle)

works.caption: A towering, sun-shot cloudbank dwarfs the crowded river traffic below, Cuyp's golden light turning an ordinary harbor scene into something monumental.
works.title: The Maas at Dordrecht

works.caption: A broad scarlet-red hat and sumptuous blue robe concentrate the color in Vermeer's tiny panel. Bright glints on pearl earrings, lips, nose, and chair finials sharpen its otherwise soft, hazy light.
works.title: Girl with the Red Hat

works.caption: A wall of black-coated men crowds around masked women in a dense, almost claustrophobic sea of top hats, Manet's rapid brushwork capturing the anonymity of Parisian nightlife.
works.title: Masked Ball at the Opera

works.caption: A child slumps deep in a vivid blue armchair while a small dog curls asleep in the matching chair opposite. Cassatt's cropped field of upholstered furniture makes the girl's informal pose feel all the more unguarded.
works.title: Little Girl in a Blue Armchair

works.caption: Wind-whipped clouds and grass echo the billowing parasol and skirt, Monet's broken brushwork making the whole canvas seem to move in the same breeze as his figures.
works.title: Woman with a Parasol - Madame Monet and Her Son

works.caption: Cézanne’s son Paul poses as Harlequin, holding a white wooden sword across his red-and-black costume. The diamond pattern gives the slender figure a strong rhythm against a mottled blue wall, with a draped curtain overhead.
works.title: Harlequin

works.caption: Bodies and horses tumble diagonally out of a shaft of light in full baroque tumult, Rubens choreographing the plunging chariot with a dancer's sense of mass and momentum.
works.title: The Fall of Phaeton

works.caption: Restless green brushstrokes swirl behind a heavy jug of white roses, Van Gogh's late still life vibrating with the same nervous energy as his skies.
works.title: Roses

works.caption: Rembrandt confronts his own aged face with unsparing directness, thick impasto catching light on the brow while the surrounding darkness swallows everything else.
works.title: Self-Portrait

works.caption: Lucretia holds a dagger toward her chest and looks down with red-rimmed eyes, suspended in the instant before her suicide. Rembrandt builds the tragedy from warm light, tawny fabric, gold, and pearls.
works.title: Lucretia

works.caption: A man with a sweeping moustache and a pearl drop in his ear looks out at us from under a tall dark fur hat banded with gold. A heavy gold chain with a pendant and a dark tassel hangs over the wide fur collar of his cloak, and his left hand grips a gold-topped staff.
works.title: A Polish Nobleman

works.caption: A needlewoman bends over the cloth in her hands, her absorbed downward gaze carrying the intimacy of the scene. Velazquez leaves the sewing and parts of the costume in economical, unfinished strokes.
works.title: The Needlewoman

works.caption: Layers of lace, white ribbon, and pink roses ornament the marquesa's silvery gown. Goya sets its elaborate shepherdess fashion against a small bell-collared pug and a pale green park landscape.
works.title: The Marquesa de Pontejos

works.caption: At the left, a seated dancer rests her head on one hand beside a cello lying on the floor. Farther into the long room, another dancer adjusts her green sash; the broad stretch of worn floor separates these quiet pauses in rehearsal.
works.title: The Dance Lesson

works.caption: A pale, direct face emerges from an almost black ground. Goya's vibrant, economical brushwork suggests the white lace mantilla and the broad orange-and-black shawl wrapped around the sitter's shoulders.
works.title: Señora Sabasa Garcia

works.caption: Wind lifts Elizabeth Sheridan's loose curls and translucent scarf as she sits in a rose-pink gown beneath an arching tree. Gainsborough's swirling, fluttering strokes let sitter and landscape share the same restless air.
works.title: Mrs. Richard Brinsley Sheridan

works.caption: Under a dark, heavy sky, sunlight falls on a clump of trees and on an arched stone bridge over a river. Two small boats carry figures, one passing beneath the arch and one in the foreground where a man pushes with a long pole. Houses and a cart stand at the left, and a church spire rises in the distance at right.
works.title: The Stone Bridge

works.caption: A foundered three-master lies in violent surf beneath sheer cliffs and a storm-darkened sky pierced by sunlight. Tiny figures search the beach for survivors, sharpening Nuijen's Romantic vision of human fragility before nature.
works.title: Shipwreck off a Rocky Coast

works.caption: Smoke and battle haze roll across a churned field crowded with mounted officers and fallen soldiers, Pieneman staging the historic moment with sweeping panoramic ambition.
works.title: The Battle of Waterloo

works.caption: An older man with long grey hair under a black cap, in a dark robe with a white collar, is shown at bust length, turned to the right. Behind him a landscape of hills, trees and buildings lies under a blue sky. A quill pen and a pair of compasses lie crossed on a red ledge in front.
works.collection: Mauritshuis, The Hague (on loan to the Rijksmuseum)
works.title: Portrait of Giuliano da Sangallo

works.caption: A shaft of light picks a golden-clad lieutenant and the ghostly girl in yellow out of the militia's swirling dark ranks, Rembrandt turning a group portrait into pure theatrical drama.
works.title: The Night Watch Militia Company of District II under the Command of Captain Frans Banninck Cocq

works.caption: Five wardens and their bareheaded servant look up from a table covered with a rich red carpet. Their varied poses make the meeting seem interrupted, while white collars and the open book punctuate the broad areas of black clothing.
works.title: The syndics: the sampling officials (wardens) of the Amsterdam drapers

works.caption: A weathered tronie built from thick, glinting strokes of paint describing the folds of a white turban and a searching, deep-set gaze.
works.title: An oriental

works.caption: Look at the man's golden sleeve and the tenderness of the two hands resting on the woman's chest, painted with astonishing thickness and warmth.
works.title: Isaac and Rebecca, Known as ‘The Jewish Bride’

works.caption: A young man's face glows faintly from beneath a deep, shadow-swallowing cowl, the paint handling loose and atmospheric.
works.title: Titus in Monk's Habit

works.caption: Rembrandt at about twenty-two peers out from deep shadow as light glances along one cheek. Scratches made with the butt of his brush pick out the curls of his tousled hair in the wet paint.
works.title: Self-portrait

works.caption: An intricate lace collar and steady, appraising gaze anchor this quietly assured portrait set in a shadowed archway.
works.title: Portrait of a woman, possibly Maria Trip

works.caption: The prophet slumps beside gleaming gold vessels while a burning city glows faintly in the distance, grief rendered through posture alone.
works.title: Jeremiah Lamenting the Destruction of Jerusalem

works.caption: Light from behind the reader falls on the open book and the single hand resting across its page, leaving her face in shadow. The bright paper and wrinkled skin draw attention to the act of reading rather than to her uncertain identity.
works.title: Old Woman Reading, Probably the Prophetess Anna

works.caption: Rembrandt looks out past the viewer, sword hilt and manuscript pages caught in warm light, questioning and unguarded at once.
works.title: Self Portrait as the Apostle Paul

works.caption: Soaring white piers and a hanging organ case demonstrate Saenredam's uncanny precision in rendering perspective and pale interior light.
works.title: Interior of the Church of St Bavo in Haarlem

works.caption: A stark, whitewashed nave recedes under heavy timber beams, tiny worshippers giving scale to the austere architecture.
works.title: Interior of the Sint-Odulphuskerk in Assendelft

works.caption: Rugged rocky mountains enclose a broad valley where a river winds past scattered trees, houses and a small tower under a grey-blue sky. On the dark slope at lower left a man in dark clothes walks with a bundle on his back, and two tiny figures stand on a path at right.
works.title: River valley

works.caption: Plaster casts and a flayed figure litter the floor of a shadowy academy where students draw from posed sculpture.
works.title: A Painter’s Studio

works.caption: A boisterous multigenerational family sings and plays instruments around a laden table, chaos rendered with real warmth.
works.title: The merry family

works.caption: In a tiled room with a big hearth, a young man in pale clothes dances at right, near an egg and an upturned wooden bowl on the floor. A bagpiper stands at the back. At left a man leans back on his chair with a jug held high, beside a woman in a white headcloth and a table laid with bread and food.
works.title: The Egg Dance

works.caption: A white swan rears up beside its nest with wings spread wide and beak open, its head turned towards a dog whose head breaks the water at lower left. Eggs lie in the nest at right, and loose feathers drift through the air against a blue and orange sky. Painted words label the dog, the swan and one of the eggs.
works.title: The Threatened Swan

works.caption: Crowds of skaters, walkers and a horse-drawn red sledge fill a frozen waterway that runs between snowy houses and bare trees into a misty distance. A church with a blue-grey roof and tower stands at the left, and in the left foreground a dog and crows pick at a dead horse.
works.title: Winter Landscape with Skaters

works.caption: Vulcan clamps Prometheus's chains shut while Mercury looks on with an unsettling grin, the composition built on straining, twisted anatomy.
works.title: Prometheus Chained by Vulcan

works.caption: Three-year-old Helena van der Schalcke stands alone in a silk dress adorned with bows and carries a small straw purse. Her adult-like finery contrasts with the walking reins still visible at her back.
works.title: Helena van der Schalcke

works.caption: The standing woman’s silver satin catches the light as an officer gestures toward her and a seated woman drinks from a glass. A bed, dressing table and watchful dog furnish the room, but the purpose of this encounter remains uncertain.
works.title: Gallant Conversation, Known as ‘The Paternal Admonition’

works.caption: A seventy-gun British warship pitches on a high wave after a squall has broken its mast and torn one sail loose. Van de Velde sets the dark, churning sea against a bright opening near the horizon.
works.title: A Ship on the High Seas Caught by a Squall, Known as ‘The Gust’

works.caption: A maidservant pours milk with monumental stillness in a bright, bare room. Hundreds of colorful dots carry light across the bread, basket, and other surfaces while only the thin stream of milk seems to move.
works.title: The Milkmaid

works.caption: Framed through a doorway past a broom and discarded slippers, a woman receives a letter from her maid, Vermeer turning a domestic threshold into quiet psychological theater.
works.title: The Love Letter

works.caption: Vermeer's weathered brick facades and whitewashed doorway hold two women at quiet domestic tasks, the whole scene built from perfectly calibrated planes of color and texture.
works.title: View of Houses in Delft, Known as The Little Street

works.caption: A woman absorbed in a letter stands beside a wall map, Vermeer's ultramarine jacket and pearly light distilling an entire private world into stillness.
works.title: Woman Reading a Letter

works.caption: Grapes, lemons, pomegranate, plums, cherries, blackberries, chestnuts, and roses cascade from a ring before a dark niche. De Heem's minute detail extends to the beetles, butterflies, and snails feeding among them.
works.title: Festoon of Fruit and Flowers

works.caption: Flowers spill from an earthenware vase decorated with playing putti, with a nest of eggs on the ledge beside it. The towering crown imperial and curling tulip petals stand against a pale garden setting, where a statue of Flora appears at the left.
works.title: Still Life with Flowers

works.caption: A narrow red mountain track curves through dense green scrub above the Mediterranean near Monaco. Red, green, and blue strokes shimmer in high sunlight, while a lone walker's short shadow marks the hour.
works.title: La Corniche near Monaco

works.caption: Prince Diponegoro, promised safe conduct and then arrested during peace talks, is escorted from the veranda as his followers sit below. Commissioned by De Kock, the work recasts the Dutch betrayal as the prince's submission.
works.title: The Arrest of Diponegoro by Lieutenant General De Kock

works.caption: A large turkey pie presides over a table crowded with oysters, Chinese porcelain, a Pacific nautilus shell, Indian pepper, and a pewter pitcher. Claesz turns imported luxuries from several continents into a single opulent display.
works.title: Still Life with Turkey Pie

works.caption: A single bundled sheaf of white asparagus glows against near-total darkness, Coorte reducing still life to one object and one beam of light.
works.title: Still Life with Asparagus

works.caption: A writhing tangle of muscular soldiers and slaughtered infants spirals across the foreground, Cornelisz. pushing Mannerist anatomy to violent extremes.
works.title: The Massacre of the Innocents

works.caption: Adam and Eve accept the forbidden fruit from a serpent with a human torso while God warns them from a cloud in the distance. A monkey, cat, dog, hedgehog, frog, fox, owl, and slugs crowd their richly imagined Paradise.
works.title: The Fall of Man

works.caption: Christ hangs on a tall dark cross in the centre while four angels, three in the air and one kneeling beside the cross level with his feet, hold out chalices toward him. Mourners stand and kneel at lower left, horsemen and soldiers crowd the right, and at lower right a richly dressed woman kneels holding up a cloth bearing Christ's face. Smaller scenes fill the green hills behind, with a walled city at upper right.
works.title: Calvary

works.caption: Before a thatched stable set in ruined stone arches, the Virgin holds the naked Child, who reaches into a gold cup offered by a kneeling, bald-headed king. Two more kings stand at the left, one bearded and one Black, with Joseph at the right. Behind them, riders with banners, and one on a camel, come through hills and rocks.
works.title: The Adoration of the Magi

works.caption: Seventy-six-year-old Goya gives the judge Don Ramon Satue an unusually informal portrait: he stands with hands in his pockets, black coat open at a red-lined collar. The sparse setting makes his relaxed pose carry the image.
works.title: Portrait of Don Ramón Satué

works.caption: Loose, flickering brushstrokes build a starched lace collar and a knowing half-smile, Hals capturing motion in what should be a static pose.
works.title: Portrait of a Man

works.caption: A married couple lounges informally on a garden terrace, their relaxed intimacy and confident half-smiles breaking sharply from the era's stiff portrait conventions.
works.title: Portrait of a Married Couple, Likely Isaac Abrahamsz Massa and Beatrix van der Laen

works.caption: A flushed, laughing face and raised hand catch a fleeting moment mid-toast, Hals's rapid brushwork making the whole figure seem to shift as you look at it.
works.title: The Merry Drinker

works.caption: Look at the raking light along the pewter jug and gilt standing cup, and the crumpled white cloth that anchors this glittering breakfast display.
works.title: Still Life with a Gilt Cup

works.caption: A pelican's outsized bill anchors a crowded menagerie of exotic waterfowl, each feather and reflection in the pool rendered with naturalist precision.
works.title: A Pelican and other Birds near a Pool, Known as ‘The Floating Feather’

works.caption: The fiddler's gap-toothed grin and raised wine glass, set against a richly patterned oriental carpet, exemplify the Utrecht Caravaggisti at their most direct.
works.title: The Merry Fiddler

works.caption: A woman squeezes lemon into her glass as a man leans toward her across the table. Behind them, one servant brings a drink while another scrubs a copper kettle over a wooden barrel; sunlit brickwork sets their shaded gathering in relief.
works.title: Figures in a Courtyard behind a House

works.caption: A maidservant shows a small child the contents of her lidded jug on a checkered pantry floor. Doorways open toward the cellar and a front room where daylight streams in pure white.
works.title: Woman with a Child in a Pantry

works.caption: A green curtain drawn back like a stage prop reveals the soaring white piers of the Oude Kerk, where worshippers and a strolling dog animate the vast interior.
works.title: Interior of the Oude Kerk in Delft

works.caption: Bright reflections pick out the silver jug’s curling ornament beside a blue-and-white porcelain bowl of citrus fruit. A glass rises behind them in an elaborate gold mount, while an open watch sits near the dark table edge at the lower right.
works.title: Still Life with a Silver Jug

works.caption: Israelites dance around the golden calf in the central panel while families feast in the foreground and Moses appears on Mount Sinai beyond. The wings continue the same landscape. The triptych warns against faithlessness and debauchery.
works.title: Worship of the Golden Calf

works.caption: A mother comforts her pale, listless child in a pose that recalls the Virgin mourning Christ. The Crucifixion painting on the wall reinforces that echo, while a small pot and spoon keep the scene rooted in domestic care.
works.title: The Sick Child

works.caption: A young man in a black cap with a round gold medallion is shown half-length, turned to the right, against a dark background. A red-and-gold patterned collar with a hanging golden fleece lies over his white pleated shirt. His patterned gold gown is lined with dark fur. At lower right one hand gestures, while the fingertips of the other rest at the edge.
works.title: Portrait of Philip the Fair, Duke of Burgundy

works.caption: Berckheyde records the newly built mansions of Amsterdam's most expensive canal stretch with mathematical precision. By omitting the young trees that actually lined the quay, he gives the Golden Bend an unusually clear, monumental frontage.
works.title: The ‘Golden Bend’ in the Herengracht, Amsterdam, Seen from the West

works.caption: Narcissi and columbines crowd a small glass of water while a butterfly, ladybird, and other insects occupy the flowers and tabletop. The costly profusion would have appeared exceptionally lavish to a seventeenth-century viewer.
works.title: Still Life with Flowers in a Glass

works.caption: The elderly preacher rests a steady hand on his chest, Rembrandt building his careful, worn face out of warm impasto against an almost bare, atmospheric ground.
works.title: Johannes Wtenbogaert

works.caption: A churning cascade tumbles over boulders beneath windswept oaks, Ruisdael piling dramatic cumulus clouds into a sky that seems to move faster than the water itself.
works.title: Landscape with waterfall

works.caption: Hands folded and eyes closed, an old woman gives thanks over bread, cheese, fish, and a bowl. A cat tugs at the tablecloth, adding a small test of self-control to this image of piety.
works.title: Old Woman Saying Grace, Known as ‘The Prayer without End’

works.caption: Rembrandt concentrates the light on the face of Ephraim Bueno, a Jewish physician, poet, and translator. This small painted study for an etched portrait leaves the clothing and hands comparatively coarse.
works.title: Portrait of Ephraim Bueno

works.caption: Five Dutch warships struggle through a storm near Gibraltar while wreckage churns in the foreground. The fleet had been sent to protect merchant vessels; several ships sank or were damaged, including the Hollandia shown at the right.
works.title: Warships in a Heavy Storm

works.caption: A family walks along a country road while a son leads a dog beside them. A carriage approaches in the distance and a shepherd tends livestock farther back, extending the portrait into a broad pastoral landscape.
works.title: Portrait of a Couple with Two Children and a Nurse in a Landscape

works.caption: A Van der Borcht nobleman gestures toward a sea battle connected with Dunkirk below. Van Dyck painted the head and hands, while his studio completed much of the costume and setting.
works.title: Portrait of a Nobleman, possibly Adriaan van der Borcht

works.caption: Tulips, roses, poppies, anemones, narcissi, and irises fill a stone vase as snails, a caterpillar, a bee, and a dragonfly move among them. An open gold watch on a blue ribbon turns the profusion into a reminder of transience.
works.title: Still Life with Flowers and a Watch

works.caption: More than ten flower species, including iris, poppy, rose, and carnation, share a bouquet that could never have existed in nature because they bloom at different times. Rachel Ruysch assembled it from extensive studies of living and preserved flowers.
works.title: Still Life with Flowers on a Marble Tabletop

works.caption: A young man smokes a pipe beside an open illustrated book as a green curtain hangs from a copper rod above him. Dou's illusionistic niche makes the curtain seem ready to slide across the painting.
works.title: Man Smoking a Pipe

works.caption: The reader holds her book close, its printed words and small illustration rendered with remarkable clarity. Fur, folded fabric and wrinkled skin surround the pale pages, where the heading identifies a passage from the Gospel of Luke.
works.title: Old Woman Reading

works.caption: Abraham de Potter, an Amsterdam silk merchant, stands soberly dressed in black with an unfashionably stiff pleated ruff. Fabritius sets the conventional pose against a weathered plaster wall and adds a painted nail above his signature as a small illusionistic surprise.
works.title: Portrait of Abraham de Potter, Amsterdam Silk Merchant

works.caption: A mother searches her child’s hair for lice beside the curtained bed. At the left, a dog faces the sunlit room beyond the open doorway; repeating tiles and doorframes lead the eye from this domestic task toward the garden outside.
works.title: A Mother Delousing her Child’s Hair, Known as ‘A Mother’s Duty’

works.caption: Oysters with lemon, bread, wine, pomegranate, grapes, chestnuts, quinces, gourds, plums, and peaches crowd a marble tabletop. A goblet, glass, watch, snails, butterflies, spider, and dragonfly extend Mignon's display of foods and costly imports.
works.title: Still Life with Fruit and Oysters

works.caption: The ten regents of Amsterdam's Aalmoezeniersweeshuis sit and stand around a carpeted table while an orphan boy waits at the right. Troost identifies the orphanage's governors as an imposing civic body within a monumental interior.
works.title: Regents of the Aalmoezeniersweeshuis Orphanage in Amsterdam, 1729

works.caption: Two women stack freshly pressed linen in a cupboard while a girl plays kolf on the tiled floor. Beyond the darker interior, sunlight falls on the canal houses outside; the cupboard and its key also signal the mistress's authority over the household.
works.title: Interior with Women beside a Linen Cupboard

works.caption: Pharaoh and his wife mourn over the body of their firstborn son in a shadowed Egyptian temple. Moses and Aaron appear at the upper right, having returned after the final plague to secure the Israelites' release.
works.title: The Death of the Pharaoh’s Firstborn Son

works.caption: Twenty-year-old Marten Soolmans stands full-length in an expensive black costume with lace collar, bows, cuffs, garters, and shoe rosettes, holding a glove in his left hand. Painted with Oopjen Coppit a year after their marriage, the pair are Rembrandt's only life-size, standing, full-length couple.
works.title: Portrait of Marten Soolmans

works.caption: A girl in the foreground displays a bucket of treats from St Nicholas while the wailing boy at left finds only a switch in his shoe. Steen builds the December feast from gifts, sweets, songs, and the children's sharply different reactions.
works.title: The Feast of St Nicholas

works.caption: Oopjen Coppit holds a black feather fan in her bare hand, its gold chain catching the light. Rembrandt sets her white lace collar and cuffs against a patterned black dress, with pearls, a silver bow and a glimpse of an embroidered shoe marking her wealth.
works.title: Portrait of Oopjen Coppit

works.caption: Ludovic Lepic sits between his two daughters, their white dresses and red accents set against a green shutter. Degas lets the three figures overlap and crowd the narrow bench, making this family portrait feel unusually immediate.
works.title: Ludovic Lepic and His Daughters

works.caption: Klimt drapes Flöge in a shimmering mosaic gown of ovals and swirls, her painted face the only naturalistic anchor in a field of decorative pattern.
works.title: Portrait of Emilie Flöge

works.caption: Van Gogh's yellow café awning glows against a star-flecked cobalt sky, the cobblestones rendered in thick, restless strokes that pull the eye down the receding street.
works.title: Terrace of a Café at Night (Place du Forum)

works.caption: Apollo, still running, clasps Daphne round the waist as she turns into a laurel: her arms have become two great leafy trees and one leg sinks into the ground. A white scarf streams out behind him, and a river winds through the wide valley beyond.
works.title: Apollo and Daphne

works.caption: Henchmen press the crown of thorns onto Christ's head with long sticks as he endures the abuse amid a sombre crowd. In this major late work, Titian dissolves contours into rough, expressive paint to intensify the torture scene.
works.title: Christ Crowned with Thorns

works.caption: Camille Monet turns in a red kimono whose embroidered warrior appears to move with its folds. Her blond wig stresses her Western identity, while a fan in French colours and a wall of Japanese fans make the picture a witty response to Paris's fashion for Japanese art.
works.title: La Japonaise (Camille Monet in Japanese Costume)

works.caption: A woman turns to look back over her shoulder, her pale back prominent against green water. Other nude figures, flowing hair and a large goldfish fill Klimt's shimmering underwater scene.
works.title: Goldfish

works.caption: Parisians stroll, lounge, sail, and fish on a sunny bank of the Seine at La Grande Jatte. Seurat constructs the large scene from tiny dabs of different colours, intended to blend in the viewer's eye into more luminous hues.
works.title: A Sunday on La Grande Jatte — 1884

works.caption: Marie Suzanne Giroust, an accomplished artist and Roslin's wife, appears dressed for a masquerade in the Bolognese style. She holds a closed fan to her cheek and half-hides her smiling face behind a black silk veil, balancing intimacy with disguise.
works.title: The Lady with the Veil. The Artist's Wife Marie Suzanne Giroust

works.caption: A nude woman sits on the ground at the edge of a wood, crossing her arms and bending one leg toward her body. Her white stockings and red shoes punctuate the dark earth, foliage, and water around the isolated figure.
works.title: Woman with White Stockings (La Femme aux bas blancs)

works.caption: A pale, androgynous dandy lies with one hand at the heart and takes a final look in a small mirror. Women gather against the blue-purple background while the other man performs the role of a professional mourner, turning the death into an ambiguous, staged ritual.
works.title: The Dying Dandy

works.caption: Saint Catherine meets the viewer with a steady gaze, holding the book and palm frond that identify her as a learned martyr. Her purple silk dress signals royal birth, and the light lifting her figure from the landscape suggests divine inspiration.
works.title: St. Catherine of Alexandria

works.caption: Christ hangs on a cross against a gold ground, a dark, worn bush growing from its top. Mary, in a blue mantle, stands at left with her hands clasped; John, in a pink-red cloak over blue, stands at right with his hands raised to his face. Between them, at the foot of the cross, Mary Magdalene kneels with her back to us in a red cloak, both arms flung upward.
works.title: Crucifixion

works.caption: The three Magi kneel before the Holy Family with precious gifts while a richly dressed, multi-ethnic procession and exotic animals fill the main panel. Three episodes of their journey cross the background, and embossed metal leaf gives spurs, weapons, garments, and the elaborate frame physical relief.
works.title: Adoration of the Magi

works.caption: A winged angel with a wreath of flowers in his curls kneels at the left, holding up a tall stem of white lilies. Mary, in a blue mantle over rose sleeves, stands on a raised step beside a lectern with an open book, eyes lowered. Two men look on from behind a ledge at the right, and two pale figures appear in a doorway behind them. A central arch opens on trees under a blue sky.
works.title: Annunciation with Two Kneeling Donors

works.artist: Andrea del Verrocchio and Leonardo da Vinci
works.caption: John the Baptist, at right, pours water from a small bowl over the bowed head of Christ, who stands ankle-deep in a stream with his hands pressed together. Two angels kneel at lower left. The far-left one, with a pale pink cloth over his arm, is generally credited to the young Leonardo. Above, two hands and a white dove send down golden rays, and a river valley winds into the distance.
works.title: The Baptism of Christ

works.caption: A dark-haired woman with red lips, her body in profile, turns her face towards us over a bare shoulder as a patterned robe slips down her arm. She holds an open fan against her chest. Behind her a bright yellow ground is scattered with pink and blue lotus blossoms, leaves and large long-tailed phoenixes.
works.title: Woman With a Fan

works.caption: Ophelia floats with her mouth open and arms spread at the moment in Shakespeare's Hamlet when she sings before drowning. Millais surrounds her with closely observed plants and symbolic flowers: poppy for death, daisies for innocence, and pansies for love in vain.
works.title: Ophelia

works.caption: Survivors cling to wreckage beneath a towering, sunlit wave, Aivazovsky dissolving water and light into an almost translucent glow of pink and gold.
works.title: The Ninth Wave

works.caption: The defeated Satan shields his face beneath folded dark wings while looking outward with wounded pride. Above him, a legion of radiant angels rises toward God, sharpening Cabanel's contrast between despairing rebellion and heavenly joy.
works.title: Fallen Angel

works.caption: Rembrandt freezes the sacrifice at its most violent instant, the angel's hand still gripping Abraham's wrist as the dropped knife hangs in midair.
works.title: The Sacrifice of Abraham

works.caption: Klimt dissolves a lakeside manor into a shimmering mosaic of green dabs, its reflection breaking apart in the still water below.
works.title: Water Castle

works.caption: A young woman works at a mortar beside fish, eggs and garlic while an older woman gestures behind her. At upper right, Christ visits Martha and Mary in a scene whose relation to the kitchen remains deliberately ambiguous.
works.title: Christ in the House of Martha and Mary

works.caption: Christ kneels at the edge of a step and writes on it with one finger, letters running across the step. A young woman stands just beyond him, hands together at her waist. A crowd of bearded elders and onlookers presses close, one bent over a stick. The scene is painted in greys.
works.title: Christ and the Woman Taken in Adultery

works.caption: Velázquez renders the king's silver-embroidered costume in dazzling, almost abstract flickers of paint that resolve into pattern only at a distance.
works.title: Philip IV of Spain in Brown and Silver

works.caption: Men and boys relax in bright, hazy sunlight beside the Seine at the industrial suburb of Asnières. Their still profiles contrast with the river's sailboats and the railway bridge, road bridge, gasworks, and factory chimneys on the far bank.
works.title: Bathers at Asnières

works.caption: Renoir dissolves a bustling riverside bathing spot into flickering strokes of blue and green, the crowded pontoon a study in fashionable Parisian leisure.
works.title: La Grenouillère

works.caption: A faceless firing squad levels its rifles at a man flinging his arms wide in a pose of martyrdom, the lantern's harsh light making his white shirt the painting's unbearable focal point.
works.title: The Third of May 1808

works.caption: Mary, in a rose-red dress and dark blue mantle, holds the Child in a white cloth; he raises one hand in blessing and holds a white rose, a red coral necklace at his neck. Two angels, one in pale blue and one in pink, stand behind. Through a doorway at upper left, sunlight from a window falls across a back room.
works.title: Madonna di Senigallia

works.caption: Two women in lace veils lean towards one another behind a balcony railing, their bright gowns set against two men wrapped in dark capes. Their faces are visible; the veils soften their outlines while the men recede into shadow.
works.title: Majas on the Balcony

works.caption: Lucretia looks down as she brings a dagger towards her exposed breast, her pearl-adorned hair, gold bracelets and deep green drapery contrasting with the violence of the act.
works.title: Lucretia

works.caption: A young woman in a gold dress stands at the centre with a small organ tipped downward in her hands, her eyes raised to a band of angels in the clouds, some holding open books. Beside her stand a bearded man in red and green leaning on a sword, a young man, an older bearded man with a crozier, and a woman who looks straight out, a silver jar at her side. Broken musical instruments lie scattered at their feet.
works.title: The Ecstasy of Saint Cecilia

works.caption: Christ looks straight out, a wreath of thorny branches on his head and his hands crossed over a red robe. Grey ropes are tied round his wrists and upper arms. Small grey-white angels circle his head against a black ground, carrying a cross, a ladder, a lance and other objects.
works.title: The Man of Sorrows

works.caption: Christ sits behind a white-covered table, eyes raised, one hand lifted and the other on a loaf, with a bearded man reaching toward him on each side. Richly dressed adults and children crowd round. In front, two small girls in gold-patterned dresses hug a big brown dog; at the left, columns open onto a landscape.
works.title: Supper at Emmaus

works.caption: Fortitude sits on an ornate marble seat, wearing armour over her dress and red drapery across her knees. A sceptre rests across her lap, giving this personification of perseverance the attributes of a ruler.
works.title: Fortitude

works.caption: Two haloed women meet in profile in a street, one arm around a shoulder and a hand at a waist, while two more women behind them look straight out. Their pink, blue, green and orange robes fill almost the whole panel; far down the street at the lower left are two tiny figures, one of them seated.
works.collection: Parrocchia di San Michele Arcangelo, Carmignano
works.title: Visitation of Carmignano

works.caption: Rembrandt raises a tall glass as Saskia sits on his lap, both turning towards the viewer. His feathered hat, smiling face and richly coloured costume give the double portrait a mood of exuberance.
works.title: Rembrandt and Saskia in the parable of the Prodigal Son

works.caption: Saint Bernard, in a white habit, sits at a lectern with an open book and raises both hands as the Virgin, in red and blue, stands before him with two angels behind her. Two more haloed figures stand at his back. Between the two groups, a stone arcade opens onto hills, slender trees and distant buildings.
works.title: The Vision of Saint Bernard

works.caption: A knight of Malta turns his gaze to the side, his illuminated face and large white cross standing out against dark clothing and a brown background.
works.title: Portrait of Fra Antonio Martelli

works.caption: Pablo de Valladolid stands with his feet apart and one arm extended, his black clothes outlined against an empty, earth-toned background. A shadow beneath his shoes gives the figure a foothold without defining a room.
works.title: Portrait of Pablo de Valladolid

works.caption: Olivares turns towards the viewer from a rearing horse, his armour catching the light and a command baton raised in his hand. Troops and drifting smoke spread across the distant landscape below.
works.title: Equestrian Portrait of the Count-Duke of Olivares

works.caption: Red poppies spread across the foreground in loose strokes, surrounding figures whose clothes merge with the field. Beyond them, trees and village roofs gather around a church tower beneath a broad, cloudy sky.
works.title: Poppy Field near Vétheuil

works.caption: The court entertainer known as Don Juan de Austria poses in pink and black with a command baton and a feathered hat. Armour and ammunition lie at his feet, while a naval battle fills the opening behind him.
works.title: The Jester Named Don John of Austria

works.caption: Blue umbrellas crowd a Parisian street. Renoir's changing style is visible across the canvas: the softly painted mother and children at right contrast with the firmer outlines of the woman carrying a bandbox at left.
works.title: The Umbrellas

works.caption: A smiling woman in a red bonnet and flower-patterned dress faces the viewer as her partner holds her at the waist. Foliage fills the background, with a table beside the couple and a straw hat on the ground.
works.title: Dance in the Country

works.caption: Golden rays cross an arched interior towards Mary, who bends at the right as Gabriel approaches from the left. Receding columns frame a distant lake and trees beyond the angel.
works.title: The Annunciation

works.caption: The infant lies on a bright white cloth amid figures in red, blue, green and yellow drapery. Above the worshippers, winged angels hold a long curling banner against the dark background.
works.title: Adoration of the Shepherds

works.caption: A crowd fills a broad classical hall. At centre a man sits enthroned on a stepped platform under a vaulted apse, surrounded by onlookers, while armoured riders mill below. Groups of women cluster at both ends, and stone reliefs of fighting men fill the upper corners above the doorways, beside dark pilasters with gold scrolls.
works.title: The Story of Virginia

works.caption: Before a dark tomb opening, the fainting Virgin, supported by John in red, has Christ's body across her lap. A woman at right supports Christ's head, another at lower left presses his cloth-wrapped feet to her cheek, and a third at left hides her face in her mantle. At the top Joseph of Arimathea, in yellow, raises the crown of thorns and the nails and looks upward.
works.title: Lamentation over the Dead Christ

works.caption: In a broad square framed by classical buildings, a woman lies dead on a bier while armed men crowd round, some hiding their faces. Above her a soldier in a red cloak holds out a sword, beneath a white statue on a tall column. At a doorway on the left a soldier seizes a woman; under an arch on the right a woman collapses into men's arms.
works.title: The Story of Lucretia

works.caption: Mary sits in a meadow in a blue mantle, her fingertips pressed together, looking down at the naked child asleep across her lap. At the left a dark bird perches in a bare tree, and in the field a white bird raises its wings at a snake on the ground in front of it. Behind her are fenced fields with oxen and herdsmen, and a walled castle with towers below a cloudy blue sky.
works.title: Madonna of the Meadow

works.caption: Strawberries rise in a cone above a shallow woven basket. A glass of water and two white carnations sit at the left; a peach and smaller red fruits balance the arrangement at the right.
works.collection: Department of Paintings of the Louvre
works.title: Le Panier de fraises des bois

works.caption: Christ bends his head beneath the crown of thorns as two men wield long staffs above him. Light catches his exposed torso and the polished armour of an observer whose back faces the viewer.
works.title: The Crowning with Thorns

works.caption: Joseph Roulin sits facing the viewer in a blue postal uniform with yellow buttons and cuff decorations. His long beard spreads over his chest, and both hands rest low in the composition against a pale blue background.
works.title: Postman Joseph Roulin

works.caption: A yellow wooden chair with a woven seat holds a pipe and tobacco pouch. It stands on reddish tiles beside a blue door, with a signed box of sprouting bulbs partly visible at the left.
works.title: Van Gogh's Chair

works.caption: Mary stands at right in a red patterned wrap, carrying the haloed Christ child on her shoulder. Two women join their hands in devotion nearby, while a partly hidden angel and piled fruit frame Gauguin's Tahitian reimagining of a Christian subject.
works.title: Ia Orana Maria

works.caption: A magpie perches on the crossbeam of a gallows that stands on a rock near a group of dancing villagers. Beyond the wooded foreground, a winding river leads past a castle, settlements and rocky heights into a pale blue distance.
works.title: The Magpie on the Gallows

works.caption: Charles V rides a dark horse through a wooded landscape, wearing gleaming armour and a red sash. His long weapon angles upward across the sky, while red plumes decorate his helmet and the horse’s head.
works.title: Equestrian Portrait of Charles V

works.caption: Christ kneels in prayer on a tall rock, looking up towards a small winged child who holds out a gold cup in the sky. Three disciples sleep on the bare ground below. Beyond a river, soldiers with spears and shields walk along a road through a wide landscape, under clouds lit pink and peach low in the sky.
works.title: Agony in the Garden

works.caption: The dead Christ lies across the lap of his mother in blue, while a young man in orange-yellow holds him from the left. Grieving women, an angel with a gold chalice, another with a veil and three men crowd around. Above, under the rounded top, five winged children fly through a blue sky carrying a cross, a column and long poles.
works.collection: Musée des Beaux-Arts et d'Archéologie de Besançon
works.title: Deposition of Christ

works.caption: Two large gravediggers bend over Lucy’s body, with mourners gathered behind them and a bishop at the right. A towering brown wall and a dark arched recess occupy much of the space above the burial.
works.title: The Burial of Saint Lucy

works.caption: Ursula lowers her head towards the arrow in her chest, her hands gathered around the wound. The bowman faces her from the left, while witnesses emerge from the dark background.
works.title: The Martyrdom of Saint Ursula

works.caption: Prisoners walk in a circle within a courtyard enclosed by high brick walls. Green, blue and ochre strokes cover the masonry, while three men stand apart at the right.
works.title: Prisoners Exercising

works.caption: Men and boys of one family gather on stone steps before an altar, under a blue sky with clouds. On the altar a cross in a gold stand rises between two lit candles, beside a jug. A white-bearded old man in a dark purple robe lined with spotted fur rests a hand on the altar; next to him a bearded man in a red fur-lined robe lays a hand on his chest. A bearded young man in pink and three boys stand at the left, three more boys at the right; the smallest, in red stockings, sits on a step holding a little white-and-tan dog.
works.title: Portrait of the Vendramin Family

works.caption: A nude woman sleeps on her back on a blue cloth, one arm folded over her head. A winged child sleeps curled against her side. At the left a smiling satyr, his legs shaggy with hair, holds the blue cloth up above her. Dark trees close in behind, with a glimpse of sky at the upper right.
works.title: Venus and Cupid with a Satyr

works.caption: At the centre, Justinus van Nassau offers a key to Ambrosio Spínola, who places a hand on his shoulder. Soldiers and horses gather on either side, with a dense row of upright pikes at the right and smoke rising over the distant landscape.
works.title: The Surrender of Breda

works.caption: Francisco Lezcano sits beneath a dark rocky overhang, holding what appears to be a pack of cards. One shoe sole faces the viewer, while a distant mountain landscape opens at the right.
works.title: Portrait of Francisco Lezcano

works.caption: Sardanapalus reclines on a red bed above a crowded scene of killing, with a richly harnessed horse at the lower left. Pale bodies, bright textiles and gold vessels fill the foreground beneath the dark palace interior.
works.collection: Department of Paintings of the Louvre
works.title: Death of Sardanapalus

works.caption: Tall dark cypresses rise behind a balustraded terrace, over which a white sheet hangs, above a pale wall whose arched opening is boarded up with planks. Two men in hats stand in front of it between clipped hedges, and a statue stands in a niche in the wall at right.
works.title: View of the Garden of the Villa Medici

works.caption: Mars sits with his chin resting on one hand, wearing an ornate helmet and a blue cloth around his waist. Pink drapery covers the seat, while armour and a sword lie at his feet.
works.title: Mars Resting

works.caption: The young prince rides a rearing horse, holding a baton beneath a cloudy sky. His pink sash trails to the right above a broad landscape of hills and snowy mountains.
works.title: Equestrian Portrait of Prince Balthasar Charles

works.caption: Susanna sits beside the water, turning her face upward while two elders lean towards her from behind. White cloth gathers around her body, and one elder raises a finger to his lips beneath the dark foliage.
works.title: Susanna and the Elders

works.caption: Soldiers overrun a snow-covered village. A block of armoured horsemen with upright lances waits in the middle, while men on foot drive pikes down into a heap on the ground. Villagers plead, run or sit with their hands to their faces, and at the right men with an axe force their way into a brick building.
works.title: The Massacre of the Innocents

works.caption: A bearded God the Father, arms flung wide, rides the sky on an eagle, a lion and an ox, while two small angels hold up his arms and a winged angel reaches in from the left. Faint angel heads crowd the glowing opening behind him; far below lies a small landscape.
works.title: Ezekiel's Vision

works.caption: Three shepherds and a woman gather around a stone tomb. Two men point toward its inscription, “Et in Arcadia ego,” bringing a reminder of mortality into the wooded Arcadian landscape.
works.collection: Department of Paintings of the Louvre
works.title: Et in Arcadia ego

works.caption: Mary smiles down at the child on her lap, holding out a tiny sprig of pale flowers. He grips her hand and studies the flower. Both wear thin gold haloes. Behind them, in a dark room, a bright arched window opens at the upper right.
works.title: Benois Madonna

works.caption: Mary holds the infant Jesus before a crowded ring of winged angel heads. Red wings and pale clouds fill the blue background around her dark mantle.
works.title: Madonna of the Cherubim

works.caption: A man in a green headdress with long hanging folds and a red robe trimmed with fur gazes off to the left, behind a cracked stone ledge. His right hand holds a small rolled paper with writing on its outside. Large capitals on the ledge read LEAL SOVVENIR, with a short line of small white letters above them and a line of white script below.
works.title: Portrait of a Man ('Léal Souvenir')

works.caption: Saturn grips a mutilated body in both hands and bites into it, his eyes wide open. Pale flesh and red blood stand out against the surrounding darkness in this work from Goya’s Black Paintings.
works.title: Saturn Devouring His Son

works.caption: Pine trees rise out of pale mist across a six-panel folding screen, one of a pair. Some are painted in dense, rough black strokes, others in washes so faint they almost dissolve into the paper. Wide stretches of the paper are left bare, and the far right panel holds only the faint outline of a peak near its top. Two small seals sit on the far left panel.
works.title: Pine Forest

works.caption: Pale water-lily blossoms rise above blue and violet pads, while long green reflections descend through the pond. The open water at the lower right reflects a patch of blue sky.
works.title: Nymphéas en fleur

works.caption: Courbet paints a landscape at the centre of a crowded studio, beside a standing nude woman, a boy and a white cat. The assembled figures turn the studio into an allegory of his artistic and social world.
works.title: The Painter's Studio

works.caption: A white cockatoo is enclosed in the glass vessel of an air pump as an audience watches the demonstration. Candlelight illuminates their differing reactions, from a girl covering her face to a couple looking at each other.
works.title: An Experiment on a Bird in the Air Pump

works.caption: Friends gather beneath a striped awning on a riverside terrace, talking around a table crowded with bottles, glasses and fruit. At the lower left, a woman holds a small dog close to her face.
works.title: Luncheon of the Boating Party

works.caption: Belshazzar turns toward a mysterious hand writing Hebrew letters on the wall. His raised arm and the spilling vessel beside him carry the sudden shock through the richly dressed banquet guests.
works.title: Belshazzar's Feast

works.caption: A candle between Christ and the seated priest lights their faces and an open book. The priest raises a finger while Christ stands with his hands together; other figures remain in shadow.
works.title: Christ before the High Priest

works.caption: Nine panels open into a single scene. At the top centre Christ in red sits on a rainbow against a gold sky, with a lily on one side of his head and a sword on the other. Under him an angel in white holds a pair of scales, and four angels in rose-crimson blow long trumpets. Rows of seated figures, most with haloes, fill the panels to either side. Naked people climb out of the ground along the bottom: at far left an angel meets a few at a golden Gothic gateway, at far right others tumble into flames.
works.title: The Last Judgment (Beaune Altarpiece)

works.caption: In a room with a black-and-white tiled floor, a young woman in a yellow bodice and white satin skirt plays a harpsichord whose open lid is painted with a landscape. A man with long dark hair sits with his back to us on a red-backed chair, and a standing woman in a grey fur-trimmed jacket sings from a sheet of paper. A rug-draped table and a viola da gamba fill the left foreground, and two large paintings hang on the wall behind.
works.title: The Concert

works.caption: The young Christ sits beside a sheep, resting one hand on its back and holding a shepherd’s staff across his lap. Broken classical stonework and a distant flock place the devotional image in a pastoral landscape.
works.title: The Good Shepherd

works.caption: A young woman in a broad black hat rests her hands over the lower edge of a painted frame. Her fingers appear to cross the boundary of the picture, bringing Rembrandt's figure unusually close to the viewer.
works.title: Girl in a Picture Frame

works.caption: The Virgin, in blue, sits enthroned before a green canopy, and two small angels hold a jewelled crown above her head. On her lap the Child lifts a rose garland toward a kneeling old man in a gold cope at left, while she sets another on the head of a kneeling man in red at right. Crowds press in on both sides, and at her feet an angel sits playing a lute.
works.title: Feast of the Rosary

works.caption: A brilliant light radiates through the blue sky above a white house with green shutters and an orange-red roof. Short, restless strokes animate the walls, trees and pale road, where a dark-clad figure passes in front of the garden.
works.title: White House at Night

works.caption: A seated woman bends over her joined hands beside a candle resting on an empty chair. Warm light falls across her exposed chest and legs, leaving her face and clothing partly in shadow.
works.title: Woman Catching Fleas

works.caption: A helmeted fireman carries children through a burning room as a woman reaches up toward them. Firelight colours their faces and clothing red, while flames remain visible behind his legs.
works.title: The Rescue

works.caption: Mary turns toward Christ above a crowded town square. Below, richly dressed women pray among people receiving help, a musician plays beside a seated man, and a dog rests in the foreground.
works.title: Madonna of the people

works.caption: Mary joins her hands and looks upward, wearing a white robe and a billowing blue mantle. A crescent moon curves beside her feet, while angels among the clouds carry flowers and branches.
works.title: Immaculate Conception of El Escorial

works.caption: A woman turns her eyes upward to the side, wearing gold-coloured hoop earrings and a necklace. White cloth falls below one exposed shoulder and breast, with green fabric and a partly visible fan at the bottom of the portrait.
works.title: Study of a Woman

works.caption: Andrew's bound body cuts diagonally through the surrounding darkness, its aged skin sharply illuminated. Above him, a man holds up a small statue of Jupiter, urging the apostle to abandon his faith even as his execution proceeds.
works.title: Martyrdom of Saint Andrew

works.caption: Sebastian stands bound to a tree, with arrows piercing his exposed body and clothing. Two archers handle their bows at right, while a winding path, a walled town and water extend into the distance behind them.
works.collection: Royal Museums of Fine Arts of Belgium
works.title: The Martyrdom of St Sebastian

works.caption: Daylight from the open window illuminates a mother with her needlework and a serving girl beside the wicker cradle. Gleaming vessels, folded cloth and baskets make this tall, shadowy room a study in carefully distinguished textures.
works.collection: Department of Paintings of the Louvre
works.title: The Young Mother

works.caption: Mary kneels beside the newborn Christ, whose radiance lights her face and open hands. Behind her, Joseph points out the child to shepherds at the doorway; an ox and donkey lean towards the manger.
works.title: Nativity

works.caption: Two women sit beside water: one rests her cheek on a hand beneath a pink halo, while the other holds a red fruit. A large pale flower rises at right, with more figures, rocks and trees behind them.
works.title: Sacred Spring: Sweet Dreams (Nave nave moe)

works.caption: A returning exile stands inside an open doorway, holding his hat. A woman rises from an upholstered chair toward him, while children at a table and a woman beside the piano turn to look.
works.title: They Did Not Expect Him

works.caption: Pale diagonal strokes veil a ploughed field and distant hills with rain. Van Gogh painted this view from his room at Saint-Rémy, setting the falling streaks against the field's sweeping furrows and enclosing wall.
works.title: Rain

works.caption: Diego de Covarrubias wears a black cap and a white ecclesiastical garment over a dark collar. A gold-and-green pectoral cross hangs from a pale ribbon against the gathered fabric, beneath his grey beard.
works.title: Portrait of Diego de Covarrubias y Leiva

works.caption: Two harvesters rest beside a stack of straw, one lying on her side and the other reclining with his hands behind his head. Shoes and sickles lie nearby, while oxen and a cart stand farther across the yellow field.
works.title: The siesta (after Millet)

works.caption: An elderly man wearing spectacles leans toward a candle amid open books, loose papers and money bags. Coins lie on the table below, while the light catches his face, ruff and decorated pale garment.
works.title: The Parable of the Rich Fool

works.caption: A woman personifying Finland braces on a rocky shore, holding a law book as a two-headed eagle attacks its pages. Her white dress and blue sash stand out against dark clouds and breaking waves.
works.title: The Attack

works.caption: A pale horse, tinted green, lowers its head to drink from a dark stream. Two bareback riders recede among trees behind it, while twisting branches and pale flowers frame the foreground.
works.title: The White Horse

works.caption: A man in a tall black hat and a brown cloak leans against a plain wall. A glass of pale green drink stands on the ledge beside him, and a dark bottle lies on the ground near his feet.
works.title: The Absinthe Drinker

works.caption: Six men in cloaks and caps move in a line from left to right, linked by long staffs and hands on shoulders. At right the leader lies on his back in a ditch, and the man behind him is falling on top of him. Behind them stand cottages, trees and a church with a tall spire.
works.title: The Blind Leading the Blind

works.caption: A player at left reaches behind his back for a concealed ace of diamonds. A woman points toward him while a servant holds wine, and the richly dressed young man at right studies his cards.
works.collection: Department of Paintings of the Louvre
works.title: The Cheat with the Ace of Diamonds

works.caption: Within a rocky grotto, Mary rests a hand around the kneeling infant John while holding her other hand above Christ. Christ raises his hand in blessing, and the angel beside him points toward John and turns toward the viewer.
works.collection: Department of Paintings of the Louvre
works.title: Virgin of the Rocks

works.caption: Guests at a Jewish wedding in Morocco fill the shaded edges of a white-walled courtyard trimmed in blue-green. At left a woman in a gold-embroidered bodice and dark skirt dances with one arm raised, a white scarf in her hands, while musicians sit cross-legged on mats in the centre, one in a white turban and red vest playing a round-bodied stringed instrument beside a man with a frame drum. Faces peer down from the balconies above.
works.collection: Department of Paintings of the Louvre
works.title: Jewish Wedding in Morocco

works.caption: A man in a black cap and a fur-trimmed gown turns to the left against a green ground. His face is made of dead birds and fish. Sheets of handwritten paper sit at his neck, and a stack of tied books shows at the bottom of the gown.
works.title: The Jurist

works.caption: A young couple kisses beside a stone staircase. The man holds the woman’s face beneath his feathered hat, with one foot on a step; her pale blue dress catches the light against his brown cloak.
works.title: The Kiss

works.caption: Elegantly dressed men and women gather on a garden terrace beneath flying cupids. A lute player sits among them, while a statue of Venus sends water into a fountain at right and trees open onto a distant landscape at left.
works.title: The Garden of Love

works.caption: An elderly man with a grey moustache and stubbled chin looks down, his face half in shadow beneath a tall golden helmet covered in raised ornament and topped with a plume of feathers. Light glints on the iron collar at his neck, and the rest of his dark, reddish-brown clothing fades into a near-black background.
works.title: The Man with the Golden Helmet

works.caption: Ursula lies asleep, her cheek on her hand, in a canopied bed with a red coverlet at the left of a tall room. At the right a golden-haired angel in blue, with dark wings, stands in a doorway holding a palm. Light falls across the floor, and a crown rests on the step at the foot of the bed.
works.title: The Dream of St. Ursula

works.caption: Four blue horses overlap in a tall, tightly packed formation, their heads turning left at different heights. Pale highlights divide their bodies into angular planes, against yellow, orange and red shapes beneath a curved rainbow.
works.title: The Tower of Blue Horses

works.caption: Snow-covered peaks rise beyond successive dark ridges, with a tall, layered rock formation in the foreground. Small trees and patches of green vegetation grow among the nearer rocks beneath a pale blue sky.
works.collection: Alte Nationalgalerie; on loan from Deka, Frankfurt am Main
works.title: The Watzmann

works.caption: A crowd swarms over a huge red barrel, climbing its wooden supports and holding up bowls and jugs, while men lie sprawled on the ground at lower left. At right, a rider on a pale horse holds a sword to his cloak above figures on the ground.
works.title: The Wine of Saint Martin's Day

works.caption: A tall oak with leafy lower branches and a bare, broken crown rises beside a pool. A shepherd leans against its trunk as sheep graze across the meadow, with villages and blue mountains stretching into the distance.
works.title: Solitary Tree

works.caption: Bacchus leaps from his cheetah-drawn chariot toward Ariadne, his pink cloak billowing against the blue sky. She turns back toward him as a noisy procession of revellers emerges from the trees at right.
works.title: Bacchus and Ariadne

works.caption: A laurel-crowned figure in an embroidered red costume and broad lace collar sits between two comic companions. More revelers crowd behind them, while a table laden with food and an open-lidded tankard fills the foreground.
works.title: Merrymakers at Shrovetide

works.caption: Snow is falling on a village of heavy roofs and bare trees, flecking everything with white dots. A crowd with laden pack animals fills the street. At the far left, figures kneel at an open shelter, and at lower right villagers carry buckets beside a frozen stream.
works.title: Adoration of the Magi in a Winter Landscape

works.caption: Soldiers pin Samson to the ground, chain his wrist and drive a blade into his eye. Behind the struggle, Delilah looks back while holding his cut hair and scissors, her figure lit against the dark curtains.
works.title: The Blinding of Samson

works.caption: A woman in a dark veil and dress looks toward the viewer, holding an open red-brown fan in a pale glove. Her other hand gathers the veil at her chest; beads and a hanging cross appear beside a blue ribbon at her waist.
works.title: The Lady with a Fan

works.caption: Moored sailboats fill the foreground of a river view, their pale hulls and tall masts reflected in the water. Trees and houses line the opposite bank, while a bridge with dark arches extends into the scene from the right.
works.title: The Argenteuil Bridge

works.caption: Three women sit among patterned cushions and carpets while a fourth turns beside the curtain at right. Light falls across white sleeves, jewellery and glazed tiles, linking the figures to the rich surfaces of the room.
works.collection: Department of Paintings of the Louvre
works.title: The Women of Algiers

works.caption: Venus reclines on a foaming wave, her long hair spread across the water and one arm curved above her face. A chain of winged children sweeps through the blue sky, echoing the long curves of her body.
works.title: The Birth of Venus

works.caption: Inside a pale columned loggia at left, Christ stands at a column topped by a gilded statue while two men raise their arms to scourge him. A man in a tall hat sits watching at far left, and a turbaned man stands with his back to us. Outside in the right foreground, three larger men stand together: one bearded in a black hat, a barefoot youth in red, and one in a blue-and-gold robe.
works.title: Flagellation of Christ

works.caption: Two richly dressed men stand beside shelves holding globes, measuring instruments, books and a lute. A green curtain hangs behind them, and a distorted skull stretches diagonally across the patterned floor between their feet.
works.title: The Ambassadors

works.caption: John and Nicodemus support Christ’s pale body above a projecting stone slab, his right arm hanging toward its edge. Behind them, three women gather against the dark background, one lifting both hands above her head.
works.title: The Entombment of Christ

works.caption: Christ's naked body is held upright, with a figure in red at the left hauling on a cloth band slung across the red robe, while a bald, bearded man supports him from behind and a figure in green stands close at the right. A woman is down on the ground at lower left; the lower right corner is left bare and unpainted. A dark rock rises at the upper right, and hills and sky open at the left.
works.title: The Entombment

works.caption: Haymakers rake and pile hay onto a wagon in a sunlit field below a rocky crag. On the road in front, three workers walk by, two with rakes on their shoulders, past people carrying baskets on their heads and a rider on a pale horse. Beyond, villages and a winding river stretch into the distance.
works.title: The Hay Harvest (early summer June/July)

works.caption: Blindfolded Lady Jane Grey kneels in a white satin underdress, reaching toward the execution block as a man guides her arm. Two attendants turn away at left, while the executioner waits at right with his axe resting beside the straw-covered platform.
works.title: The Execution of Lady Jane Grey

works.caption: Two older children stand beside a wooden cart carrying their younger sibling. The boy lifts a switch above his head, while tall sunflowers rise at left and a white fence separates the children from the distant houses and countryside.
works.title: The Hülsenbeck children

works.caption: A church with pointed windows and a square bell tower rises against a deep blue sky. Pale paths divide around its blue-violet walls, and a woman walks along the left branch beside patches of green grass and small flowers.
works.title: The Church at Auvers

works.caption: Dr Samuel Gross stands with a bloodied scalpel while doctors bend over a patient’s exposed thigh. A woman shields her face at left, and rows of seated observers rise behind the operating group in the surgical amphitheatre.
works.collection: Philadelphia Museum of Art and Pennsylvania Academy of the Fine Arts
works.title: The Gross Clinic

works.caption: Five figures of different ages gather on the shore beneath a luminous yellow sky. Five sailing vessels lie at different distances offshore, giving Friedrich’s quiet coastal scene the rhythm of a journey through life.
works.title: Life stages

works.caption: A mermaid sits among shore rocks, drawing a comb through her long red-brown hair. Her silvery tail curves beside a shell holding pearls, while waves break below high cliffs and a dark rock arch opens onto the sea.
works.title: A Mermaid

works.caption: A standing nude holds a tilted water jar beside her head. Its stream falls past her curved body into the pool at her feet, set against a narrow recess of rock and foliage.
works.title: The Source

works.caption: A fisherman grips his oars in a small wooden dory, turning toward a distant sailing vessel. Two large halibut lie aboard as choppy waves lift the boat beneath a grey bank of approaching fog.
works.title: The Fog Warning

works.caption: A woman in a yellow garment bends over a lace pillow, holding fine threads between her hands. Red and white threads spill from a blue sewing cushion in the foreground, their soft outlines contrasting with her working fingers.
works.collection: Department of Paintings of the Louvre
works.title: The Lacemaker

works.caption: A woman in a feathered hat and dark, fur-trimmed coat sits in an open carriage, looking toward the viewer. Orange upholstery and polished rails frame her against pale city buildings with snow along their roofs.
works.title: Portrait of an Unknown Woman

works.caption: Calumny, in white and blue, drags a nearly naked man by the hair across the red floor of a portico open to the sea, lined with statues and gilded reliefs. A hooded man in dark rags walks at her side and two women dress her hair with flowers. At right, two women lean close to the ears of an enthroned king. At left, black-robed Penitence turns toward naked Truth, who points upward.
works.title: Calumny of Apelles

works.caption: Gabriel kneels in a flowered garden, holding a lily and raising one hand toward Mary, who sits beside a carved lectern with an open book. Dark trees frame a distant harbour and pale blue mountains.
works.title: Annunciation

works.caption: Three panels. In the centre a bearded man kneels at a low wall among richly dressed figures and hybrid creatures, a broken tower beside him and a village burning behind. On the left a figure in black is carried through the sky while men help a sagging figure along a plank walkway. On the right a man in a dark cloak sits with a book, a pale nude standing in a hollow tree across from him.
works.collection: Museu Nacional de Arte Antiga, Lisbon
works.title: Temptation of Saint Anthony

works.caption: A lion lowers its head beside a sleeping traveller in striped clothing beneath a round moon. A stringed instrument, walking stick and tall jar lie near the figure, with water and pale hills stretching across the background.
works.title: The Sleeping Gypsy

works.caption: A young woman turns towards us while a man behind her looks down at the paper they hold. Light from the left window catches the music and blue-and-white jug on the table.
works.title: Girl Interrupted at her Music
