works.caption: Bonaparte rides a mule along a narrow, snowy mountain path, wearing a grey coat and black bicorne. A guide with a long staff walks beside the animal, while another traveller follows behind.
works.collection: Department of Paintings of the Louvre
works.title: Bonaparte Crossing the Alps

works.caption: Napoleon raises a crown above the kneeling Josephine, while the seated pope lifts a hand behind him. Clergy, officials and attendants fill the cathedral interior beneath tall columns, draped galleries and an altar crowded with candles.
works.collection: Department of Paintings of the Louvre
works.title: The Coronation of Napoleon

works.caption: A man in a straw hat lifts a spoonful of beans toward his open mouth, looking toward the viewer. Bread, vegetables, a plate of food, a knife, a jug and a glass crowd the white-covered table.
works.title: The Bean Eater

works.caption: Adults and children form a circle around a blazing bonfire on Skagen beach. Wind-blown flames light faces and clothing in orange and yellow against the dark blue sea and sky, with a pale moon at upper right.
works.title: Midsummer Eve Bonfire on Skagen Beach

works.caption: A woman in a pale veil and a blue mantle over red stands on a carved pedestal with winged creatures at its corners. She carries a naked child who clings to her shoulder and holds a closed book against her hip. Two small children cling to her legs. At the left a friar in a grey habit holds a small cross; at the right a young man in red holds a large book.
works.title: Madonna of the Harpies

works.caption: Figures in richly coloured robes gather with winged angels above a bank of clouds. Below, crowded warships with masts, flags and long banks of oars meet amid smoke in the Battle of Lepanto.
works.title: Allegory of the Battle of Lepanto

works.caption: A helmeted gladiator stands over fallen fighters, holding a sword and shield as one man raises an arm from the sand. Spectators lean over the arena barrier, several extending their thumbs downward above patterned hanging textiles.
works.title: Pollice Verso

works.caption: A bearded man with shoulder-length dark brown hair looks round over his shoulder at the viewer. His huge quilted sleeve, a pale violet-blue, lies along a parapet in the foreground, with a dark outer garment behind it and a plain grey background. A T and a V are painted faintly on the front of the parapet.
works.title: Portrait of Gerolamo (?) Barbarigo

works.caption: A woman in pale clothing sits beside a dark-coated man with a pipe, each looking in a different direction. Glasses and a carafe occupy the angled café tables, while dark silhouettes appear in the mirror behind them.
works.title: L'Absinthe

works.caption: Innocent X sits in a red chair before a dark red curtain, wearing a shining red cape over white robes. His eyes face the viewer; one hand rests on the chair arm and the other holds a written sheet.
works.title: Portrait of Innocent X

works.caption: Thomas Cole and the poet William Cullen Bryant stand on a rocky ledge above a wooded ravine. Durand brings several Catskill landmarks together in an imagined view, making the landscape a tribute to Cole and their shared love of nature.
works.collection: Crystal Bridges Museum of American Art
works.title: Kindred Spirits

works.caption: Christ holds bread at a white-covered table between two seated companions, while a young server leans forward with a platter. Pale light surrounds his head beneath a tall shadowed arch, setting the small gathering apart from the dark interior.
works.collection: Department of Paintings of the Louvre
works.title: The Pilgrims of Emmaus

works.caption: Lisa Gherardini sits with one hand resting over the other, her face softly modelled between light and shadow. Beyond her dark clothing, winding paths, water and rocky peaks recede into a blue-green haze.
works.collection: Department of Paintings of the Louvre
works.title: Mona Lisa

works.caption: Europa looks back toward the shore as a white bull carries her into the water. A seated companion raises both arms beside a standing woman, while pale horses and an ornate carriage wait beneath dark trees.
works.title: The Abduction of Europa

works.caption: A young woman faces the viewer against a loosely brushed red background. Her pale green dress and white blouse are framed by a blue shawl densely patterned with pink, orange and white flowers, with her hands visible near its lower edges.
works.title: Portrait of Fräulein Lieser

works.caption: A horse draws a plough across the foreground, while a shepherd stands among sheep and a fisherman leans toward the water. Beside the large sailing ship at lower right, Icarus’s legs rise from the sea amid small splashes.
works.collection: Royal Museums of Fine Arts of Belgium
works.title: Landscape with the Fall of Icarus

works.caption: Three women sit closely together in a carved wooden church pew. Two look down at open books, while the woman at the left clasps her hands; striped and checked dresses contrast with dark head coverings and a bright white apron.
works.title: Three Women in Church

works.caption: William Hallett and Elizabeth Stephen walk arm in arm beneath trees, with a white dog looking up beside her. Gainsborough's light brushstrokes connect the dog's shaggy coat, her pale silk dress and the surrounding foliage.
works.title: Mr and Mrs William Hallett ('The Morning Walk')

works.caption: Napoleon faces forward on his imperial throne, wrapped in red velvet and white ermine beneath a gold laurel crown. A sceptre and the Hand of Justice flank his body, turning the portrait into an imposing display of authority.
works.title: Napoleon I on his Imperial Throne

works.caption: Bonaparte turns his head back while gripping a flagstaff in one gloved hand and holding a sabre low in the other. Gold embroidery and a red-and-white sash brighten his dark uniform against the billowing flag and smoky background.
works.collection: Department of Paintings of the Louvre
works.title: Bonaparte at the Pont d'Arcole

works.caption: Venus stands nude on a broad shell, lifting her long hair with both arms. Winged cupids sweep through the cloudy sky above, while figures gather in the water around her and two men blow into large conch shells.
works.title: The Birth of Venus

works.caption: Madame de Pompadour reclines in a blue-green gown trimmed with flowers and pink bows, an open book resting on her lap. Papers, books and a writing desk surround her; a small black dog sits on the floor beside her feet.
works.title: Portrait of Madame de Pompadour

works.caption: Mrs. Hammersley sits on a tan sofa in a vivid rose-coloured gown, one arm extended along its back and the other hand resting beside her. Pale strokes trace the dress’s folds and glittering trim against broadly brushed brown drapery.
works.title: Mrs. Hugh Hammersley

works.caption: Lydia Cassatt sits in profile in a dark armchair, wearing a pink bonnet and dress with pale gloves and a ruffled white collar. She holds a cup and saucer before her, while white and violet flowers rise behind her shoulder.
works.title: The Cup of Tea

works.caption: The long-haired, bearded head of Christ turns slightly to the left, with his eyes lowered. Golden light picks out his forehead, nose and cheek, while his dark hair and reddish-brown robe merge into the muted background.
works.title: Head of Christ

works.caption: Hersilia stretches both arms between two armed men, her white dress bright against the crowded battlefield. Women and children fill the foreground, while horses, raised spears and standards gather before the walls and rocky heights of Rome.
works.collection: Department of Paintings of the Louvre
works.title: The Intervention of the Sabine Women

works.caption: Mary looks down at the Christ Child as he feeds at her breast, his eyes turned out toward the viewer and a small bird held in his other hand. She wears a red dress and a blue mantle lined in orange against a dark wall, where two arched windows open onto blue sky, clouds and distant mountains.
works.title: Madonna Litta

works.caption: Eleonora di Toledo sits before a deep blue background in a silvery-white silk gown patterned with black arabesques and large gold motifs. A net of gold cord set with pearls covers her shoulders, and she wears a short pearl necklace with a pendant and a long rope of pearls. She looks straight out. Her right hand rests on the shoulder of her young son Giovanni, who stands at left in a violet tunic with an embroidered collar and lays a hand on her skirt. Her other hand lies in her lap, fingertips on a chain from which a small pearl-studded purse hangs just below.
works.title: Portrait of Eleanor of Toledo and her son Giovanni de' Medici

works.caption: Two white sails rise from a boat on the blue river, while a broad tree trunk and leafy canopy frame the view from the right bank. Across the water, a pale embankment runs beneath trees and scattered buildings, all rendered in small touches of contrasting colour.
works.collection: Royal Museums of Fine Arts of Belgium
works.title: The Seine at La Grande Jatte

works.caption: Europa lies across a white bull in the water, raising pink drapery above her head. Two winged children carrying bows hover overhead, while another rides a fish below; distant figures gesture from the rocky shore.
works.title: The Rape of Europa

works.caption: White prayer shawls and illuminated faces stand out against the synagogue’s warm browns. Men and boys gather in the foreground, with women above and behind them, their varied glances and gestures giving the crowded scene an intimate scale.
works.title: Jews Praying in the Synagogue on Yom Kippur

works.caption: Elisabeth Lederer stands facing the viewer in a pale dress and patterned wrap, her hands resting low in front of her. Small costumed figures fill the blue-green background around her, while colourful floral and curling motifs flank her skirt above an orange patterned floor.
works.title: Portrait of Elisabeth Lederer

works.caption: Three women gather leftover grain in a harvested field: two bend deeply to reach the ground, while the third leans forward holding stalks. Behind them, large stacks, a loaded cart and distant workers stretch across the pale, open landscape.
works.title: The Gleaners

works.caption: A goldfinch perches on the upper rail of a wall-mounted feeder, a fine chain attached to its foot. Its red face and yellow wing markings stand out against the pale wall, where the bird and feeder cast a broad shadow to the right.
works.title: The Goldfinch

works.caption: Christ hangs on a tall cross against a blue sky, the ends of his white loincloth flying out on both sides. Two angels in dark blue fly beside him, and one more hovers in each side panel. Below, a young man in red looks up, a woman in blue kneels and holds the cross, and a man in black and a woman in a white headdress kneel with hands joined. In the left panel a woman in a grey-black mantle holds a small jar; in the right, a woman in red holds up a cloth bearing a face. One rolling landscape with towns and towers runs behind all three panels.
works.title: Crucifixion Triptych

works.artist: Antonio del Pollaiuolo and Piero del Pollaiuolo
works.caption: Sebastian, pierced by arrows and naked but for a loincloth, stands bound to a tree high above six archers. Four aim up at him while two bend to load crossbows. Behind them a river winds through a wide valley towards blue hills, with horsemen in the middle distance and a ruined arch at left.
works.title: Martyrdom of Saint Sebastian

works.caption: Two teams of oxen pull ploughs across a field, their white and russet coats catching the light above the freshly turned soil. Men guide the animals and ploughs, while green fields and wooded hills extend beneath a broad pale-blue sky.
works.title: Ploughing in the Nivernais

works.caption: A bare-breasted woman sits on an ornate yellow seat against a red ground, with two figures behind her. At the lower left, a pale bird stands over a dark lizard; Gauguin joins these forms through broad areas of saturated colour.
works.title: Vairumati

works.caption: Two women and a man sit on dark shoreline rocks, facing the sea and two sailing ships. The rising moon is partly hidden by horizontal clouds, casting a bright band across the water beneath a violet and gold sky.
works.title: Moonrise over the Sea

works.caption: A nude Venus and the winged boy Cupid kiss on the lips as his hand covers her breast, amid tightly crowded figures. She holds a golden apple low in one hand and raises an arrow in the other. At right a smiling boy lifts a fistful of roses; above, a bald, bearded, winged old man with an hourglass behind his shoulder stretches an arm across a blue cloth. A figure clutches its head at left, two masks lie at lower right, and white doves sit at lower left.
works.title: Venus, Cupid, Folly and Time

works.caption: Twisting almond branches spread across a turquoise-blue sky, bearing pale blossoms and unopened buds. Dark outlines and curved strokes define the limbs, while patches of white and pink flowers punctuate the open blue spaces.
works.title: Almond Blossom

works.caption: A winged angel holds a curling banner above Mary and the infant lying on a cloth over straw. Figures gather around them in the dark stable, their faces, hands and robes picked out by light; an ox stands behind Mary.
works.title: Nativity with Saint Francis and Saint Lawrence

works.caption: Amélie Matisse turns her face toward the viewer beneath a large blue-brimmed hat filled with colourful forms. Green strokes mark her forehead and nose, while pink, yellow and mauve patches shape her face against a loosely brushed pastel background.
works.collection: San Francisco Museum of Modern Art
works.title: Woman with a hat

works.caption: Danaë reclines on white bedding beneath a shower of golden coins, looking upward as an older woman spreads a cloth to catch them. A small dog curls beside her hand, and deep red drapery frames the bed against the dark cloud above.
works.title: Danaë

works.caption: Danaë curls on her side with closed eyes, her red hair spreading beside her face and a bent leg filling the foreground. A stream of golden shapes runs down the left side, while dark purple fabric patterned with gold circles curves around her body.
works.title: Danaë

works.caption: Saul shields his eyes on the ground as Christ reaches down from the upper right, supported by an angel. A soldier and a restless horse crowd the space between them in Caravaggio’s first version of the conversion.
works.title: The Conversion of Saint Paul

works.caption: The angel descends from the darkness at upper left, one hand extended toward Mary. She bows her head beside a bed, her blue cloak and the angel’s pale drapery emerging from the sparsely furnished room.
works.collection: Museum of Fine Arts of Nancy
works.title: Annunciation

works.caption: Caroline Friedrich stands with her back to the viewer at an open lower window, wearing a long green dress. A ship mast rises beyond the window frame, with pale trees visible below; two small bottles rest on the sill inside the sparsely furnished room.
works.title: Woman at a Window

works.caption: Suzanne Hoschedé stands in a pale dress beneath a green parasol, facing left as a blue veil streams from her hat. Broad blue and cream strokes fill the cloudy sky, while green and reddish touches describe the grassy rise beneath her.
works.title: Woman with a Parasol, facing left

works.caption: A laughing boy with tousled brown hair shows his teeth above a loosely painted white collar. Bright strokes on his nose and curls stand out against the brown background of the circular panel.
works.title: Laughing boy

works.caption: Christ turns towards Peter and Andrew while gesturing ahead. Peter holds two fish, and Andrew points towards himself; their illuminated faces and hands carry the encounter against a dark background.
works.title: The Calling of Saints Peter and Andrew

works.caption: Yellow gaslights cast broken vertical reflections across the blue Rhône beneath scattered bright stars. Dark buildings line the opposite bank, while two figures stand together on the foreground shore beside moored boats.
works.title: Starry Night Over the Rhone

works.caption: Mary turns and raises her arms toward the infant held above her by Joseph. Pink, blue, green and orange drapery fills the foreground of the circular painting; beyond a low wall, nude figures sit and stand, with the young John the Baptist at the right.
works.title: Doni Tondo

works.caption: Delphine Ramel rests her cheek against one finger, with a jeweled ring and pearl bracelet on the raised hand. Her blue dress and translucent white sleeves stand out against a dark background, while ribbons, lace and ornaments surround her neatly parted hair.
works.title: Portrait of Delphine Ramel

works.caption: Twisted oak trees rise from stony ground beneath a sky of broad blue-green and yellow strokes. The abbey appears at far left beyond the scrub, while the distant fields glow through a gap in the trees.
works.title: Sunset at Montmajour

works.caption: Apollo receives a kneeling poet as a Muse places a laurel wreath on his head. Below them, a reclining woman personifies the Castalian spring, while winged children carry cups of its water to the surrounding poets.
works.title: Parnassus

works.caption: A woman in black peers through opera glasses, her profile sharply framed by her raised arm. Across the theatre, a man looks toward her through his own glasses, making her both spectator and subject of another person’s attention.
works.title: In the Loge

works.caption: A seated, bare-chested man looks up at a woman bending toward him with a candle in one hand and the other raised. The flame lights her red dress, pale apron and cuffs, while his clasped hands and thin torso emerge from the surrounding darkness.
works.collection: Musée départemental d'Art ancien et contemporain
works.title: Job Mocked by his Wife

works.caption: Two musicians confront one another: the hurdy-gurdy player holds a knife while his opponent raises a lemon above him and grips a woodwind instrument. A woman at the left looks outward with her mouth open; two musicians watch from the right.
works.title: The Musicians' Brawl

works.caption: Two women in straw hats sit in a rowing boat, one in dark blue and the other in a pale dress. Angular blue, green and white strokes describe the lake behind them, where ducks swim near the boat.
works.title: Summer's Day

works.caption: Winged children dance around a statue of Venus and hover among fruit garlands beneath a broad red cloth. Adult figures gather on either side, while trees, a fountain and distant classical columns extend the wooded setting.
works.title: The Feast of Venus

works.caption: Venus stands on a large scallop shell near the shore, covering herself with one hand and her long golden hair. At the left, two winged figures fly together among scattered roses; at the right, a woman holds a flowered cloak open beside the trees.
works.title: The Birth of Venus

works.caption: A woman holds the ribbons of a pearl necklace as she looks into the small mirror beside the window. Her yellow jacket and curtain catch the cool light, while the table and chair form a dark foreground around the luminous wall.
works.title: Woman with a Pearl Necklace

works.caption: A woman in a pink dress and pearl necklace sits in a red theatre chair, holding a fan across her lap. A mirror behind her reflects her shoulder and the curved balconies filled with spectators.
works.title: Woman with a Pearl Necklace in a Loge

works.caption: Nicolas Rolin kneels at a blue-covered desk facing Mary and the infant, who raises a hand in blessing. An angel holds a jeweled crown above Mary; patterned tiles and carved columns frame a view of a garden, river, bridge and distant buildings.
works.collection: Department of Paintings of the Louvre
works.title: Madonna of Chancellor Rolin

works.caption: A large tilted blue rectangle overlaps a dark horizontal bar and a narrow red diagonal on a white ground. A long green rectangle occupies the upper left, with smaller yellow, orange, black, blue and pink shapes arranged around the larger forms.
works.title: Suprematist Composition

works.caption: A young woman in a violet dress stands beneath an ivy-covered opening, holding a long striped scarf near her chest. A man bends over her other hand behind her, while scattered pink petals lie on the stone floor below.
works.title: April Love

works.caption: Small red horsemen ride along a dark horizon beneath an expansive sky that fades from deep blue to pale cream. Below them, broad green and black bands alternate with narrower red, blue, ochre and white strips of ground.
works.title: Red Cavalry Riding

works.caption: Böcklin holds a brush and paint-covered palette, his head turned slightly as a skeleton plays a fiddle behind his shoulder. The skull and reddish instrument emerge from the dark background beside the painter’s illuminated face and white collar.
works.title: Self-Portrait with Death Playing the Fiddle

works.caption: A nude woman sits beside two clothed men in a wooded clearing, looking toward the viewer as one man extends his hand. Clothing, a tipped basket, fruit and bread lie in the foreground; farther back, a woman in a pale garment bends beside the water.
works.title: Luncheon on the Grass

works.caption: Mary bends over the brightly illuminated infant Christ while visitors gather beside the manger. A woman raises a hand near her face, a shepherd holds a tall staff, and angels hover above on a cloud; a dim landscape opens beyond the shadowed stable.
works.collection: Gemäldegalerie Alte Meister, Staatliche Kunstsammlungen Dresden
works.title: Nativity

works.caption: A naked woman with loose dark curls reclines on a green divan, propped on lace-edged white pillows at the right with both arms folded behind her head. She looks straight out at us. A white sheet spreads beneath her towards the left end of the couch, where her bare feet rest close together, against a plain brown background.
works.title: La maja desnuda

works.caption: An immense unfinished tower rises above a town and harbour, its pale outer walls broken by exposed red masonry and rock. Tiny workers occupy the ramps and scaffolding, while a richly dressed group approaches stonecutters in the foreground.
works.title: The Tower of Babel

works.caption: A huge round tower rises in tiers of arches, its unfinished red-brick top bristling with scaffolding. Clouds pass across its right side. Tiny figures, carts and huts crowd its ramps and base; ships fill a harbour at lower right, and fields and houses stretch away to the left.
works.title: The Tower of Babel

works.caption: A woman, bare to the waist, sits before dark leaves with patches of blue sky. One hand holds a sheer veil against her chest; the other rests on red cloth in her lap. She wears a striped gold-and-blue head wrap with a jewel and a hanging pearl, and a blue band on her upper arm lettered RAPHAEL VRBINAS.
works.title: La fornarina

works.caption: A diagonal beam of light, accompanied by winged angels, reaches toward Mary and the infant Christ beneath a timber roof. Richly dressed kings and attendants gather below, surrounded by horses, a camel, an ox, lambs and a dog, beside large classical ruins.
works.title: Adoration of the Magi

works.caption: Five figures gather around a table beneath a hanging oil lamp in a dark room. At the left, hands reach toward a dish of potatoes; at the right, a woman pours from a pot beside several cups, while the central figure sits with her back to the viewer.
works.title: The Potato Eaters

works.caption: A large sailing ship with furled sails stands in the harbour beneath a broad yellow evening sky. Smaller boats cross the water before the distant town and church towers, while three dark figures gather beside a boat and fishing nets on the near shore.
works.title: The Port of Greifswald

works.caption: A small sailing boat cuts across the foreground of a choppy blue-green sea. Beyond it, warships are partly obscured by thick grey smoke, with white sails, dark hulls and rigging visible against the pale sky.
works.title: The Battle of the Kearsarge and the Alabama

works.caption: Mallarmé rests against cushions, one hand in his coat and the other holding a cigar above papers at his side. Quick, open brushstrokes carry the face, white cuffs and patterned furnishings through the surrounding dark suit.
works.title: Portrait of Stéphane Mallarmé

works.caption: Wally Neuzil tilts her head toward the viewer, her blue eyes outlined against a pale face and reddish hair. She wears a dark dress with a broad white collar; a slender branch with dark leaves rises at the right against the light background.
works.title: Portrait of Wally

works.caption: Two girls in white dresses tend glowing paper lanterns amid tall white lilies and pink flowers. Warm orange light shines through the ribbed lanterns and touches their faces and hands, contrasting with the blue-green foliage and violet shadows around them.
works.title: Carnation, Lily, Lily and Rose

works.caption: Philibert Rivière sits in a wooden armchair with gilt decorations, wearing a black coat, white cravat and pale trousers. One hand rests on the chair arm and displays two rings; the other is tucked inside his coat. Books and printed sheets lie on a red-covered table beside him.
works.collection: Department of Paintings of the Louvre
works.title: Portrait of Philibert Rivière

works.caption: Madame Rivière leans against blue velvet cushions in a white dress, with a cream cashmere shawl spreading across her shoulders and lap. Its patterned border and fringe fall beside her arm; a translucent veil frames her dark curls, and gold jewellery accents her neck, wrist and hands.
works.collection: Department of Paintings of the Louvre
works.title: Madame Rivière

works.caption: Mary, in a dark mantle streaked with gold lines over a red dress, sits on a towering golden throne against a gold ground, her right hand turned toward the Child on her lap. He raises his right hand with two fingers extended and holds a small scroll in his left. Eight winged angels flank the throne, four on each side. Below, four bearded, haloed men hold inscribed scrolls in the throne's arches.
works.title: Madonna and Child Enthroned with Angels and Prophets (Santa Trinità Maestà)

works.caption: Three figures in tall pointed hats hover in darkness, holding a naked man between them. On the ground, one man covers his ears while another moves away beneath a white cloth; a donkey watches from the shadows.
works.title: Witches' Flight

works.caption: A pale Victorian house rises behind a railroad track that crosses the foreground and hides its base. Sunlight illuminates the left wall and parts of the tower, while deep blue-grey shadows cover the porch and right side beneath a lightly brushed blue sky.
works.title: House by the Railroad

works.caption: Ingres turns his head toward the viewer beside an upright canvas. A brown cloak falls over his dark clothing and white collar; one hand holds it near his chest, while the other holds a pale drawing tool near the canvas edge.
works.title: Self-Portrait Aged 24

works.caption: Black lace spreads over the sitter’s pink dress and rises around her reddish hair. Her turned head and outward glance animate the compact pose, while the pale neckline makes the mantilla’s delicate pattern especially clear.
works.title: Portrait of Doña Isabel de Porcel

works.caption: The winged Gabriel steps forward barefoot in white and pale rose garments fastened with gold ornaments. He holds a slender sceptre diagonally across his body and opens his other hand, looking upward beside a leafy tree beneath dark clouds.
works.title: The Archangel Gabriel

works.caption: Six men occupy a spacious studio filled with paintings: three gather around an easel, two sit or stand beside the stairs, and another plays the piano. Framed canvases hang on the pale walls or lean beneath a large window, with a sofa, upholstered chair and stove arranged across the room.
works.title: Bazille's Studio

works.caption: Antonia Zárate sits on a golden sofa in a black dress and lace mantilla. Pale silk mitts cover her forearms, and a closed fan rests in her hands; Goya gives her face a calm, direct presence.
works.title: Portrait of Doña Antonia Zárate

works.caption: Isabella Stewart Gardner faces the viewer in a long black evening dress, her hands clasped below jewelled strands around her waist. A gold and reddish patterned textile fills the background, its large central motif framing her head like a halo.
works.title: Portrait of Isabella Stewart Gardner

works.caption: Romaine Lacaux sits facing the viewer in a grey dress edged with blue over a white blouse, holding red flowers in her lap. Pale drapery fills the left background, while a colourful bouquet and the wooden chair appear at the right.
works.title: Romaine Lacaux

works.caption: A broad central strip narrows toward the top between branching columns of smaller coloured bands. Orange, yellow, blue, pale green and grey rectangles form an irregular grid, with wide horizontal blue bands stretching across the upper edge.
works.title: Highway and Byways

works.caption: Mary holds the Christ Child close, their cheeks touching against a dark background. One hand reaches up to her chin; the other plays with the toes of his own foot. He looks out of the picture while she looks down. Her blue mantle frames long reddish-gold hair and a narrow jewelled headband.
works.title: Virgin and Child

works.caption: Louis XIII kneels in a fleur-de-lis mantle, raising a crown and sceptre toward Mary and the Christ Child above him. Winged figures draw back dark curtains around the cloud-borne group, while two small angels below hold an inscribed tablet.
works.collection: Montauban Cathedral (on loan to Musée Ingres-Bourdelle, 2025–2027)
works.title: The Vow of Louis XIII

works.caption: A woman with dark curled hair turns her face toward the viewer, wearing a red shawl over a brown low-necked dress. A pearl necklace, dangling earrings and a slanting comb accompany the portrait, set within an oval against pale blue and white sky.
works.title: La Belle Zélie

works.caption: Ruby Loftus leans toward a lathe, one hand near its cutting mechanism and the other resting beside a control. She wears blue work clothes and a bright green hair covering; curling metal shavings fill the foreground, with other factory workers behind her.
works.title: Ruby Loftus Screwing a Breech Ring

works.caption: Beneath a tall wooden cross, the dead Christ lies diagonally across the lap of a woman in a dark blue mantle, who lays both hands on his chest. A young man in a pinkish-red robe supports Christ's head on a white cloth, and a woman in red sits at the left with her hands raised together. A walled town, winding paths, rocky hills and distant blue ridges stretch behind the group.
works.collection: Department of Paintings of the Louvre
works.title: The Lamentation over the dead Christ

works.caption: A man with a heavy brown fringe and hair cut in a bob turns his head toward the left while his eyes swing back to the viewer. Strong light picks out his face, stubble and neck above a black garment with a thin white collar and one small fastening, against a near-black background.
works.title: Portrait of a Man, called condottiere

works.caption: Saint Elizabeth of Portugal stands crowned against a dark background, holding roses in a fold of her sumptuous skirt. A golden mantle falls behind her blue-green bodice and orange sleeves, with pearls and jewelled bands accenting her clothing.
works.title: Saint Elizabeth of Portugal

works.caption: A woman seen from behind stands on a path between large rocks, her arms extended slightly away from her dark dress. An orange-gold sky spreads above layered hills, with a small group of trees to the left and distant ridges beyond.
works.title: Woman in Front of the Setting Sun

works.caption: A single asparagus spear lies almost horizontally across pale marble, its purplish tip at the left and light stem extending to the right edge. Loose grey strokes mark the surface, with a dark shadow beneath the vegetable and a painted initial above.
works.title: L'Asperge

works.caption: Mary Magdalene looks upward, lips slightly parted, her long copper-blonde hair falling over her shoulders and body. One hand is pressed flat to her chest; her other forearm crosses below, holding the hair against her. One breast is fully bare; the other shows only in part between strands of hair. A pale lidded jar stands at the lower left, and white clouds drift in a deep blue sky at the upper left.
works.title: Penitent Magdalene

works.caption: A bearded man in a black coat with a broad fur collar stands full length in a grey stone niche. His bare hand hangs over the shoulder of a small boy in an ermine-lined jacket, who holds on to his father's arm and looks off to the side. The man's other hand, gloved, rests by his sword hilt.
works.title: Portrait of Iseppo da Porto and his son Adriano

works.caption: The Duke of Lerma, wearing armour and a white ruff, holds a baton while riding a white horse with one foreleg raised. A tree frames the left side, and small mounted figures with upright lances appear beneath the clouded blue sky in the distance.
works.title: Equestrian Portrait of the Duke of Lerma

works.caption: Catherine, crowned and dressed in blue and gold, kneels beside the Virgin and Child on a stepped throne. Musicians with stringed instruments and an open book gather at the left, while winged figures carry a crown and palm above the group beneath billowing clouds.
works.title: The Mystic Marriage of St. Catherine

works.caption: Christ’s pale body rests on a white cloth as two men support him beside Mary, who clasps her hands beneath a white veil. Other mourners gather behind them, while a kneeling cleric prays at the right. A crown of thorns and nails lie below, and Latin inscriptions run across the frame.
works.title: Pietà

works.caption: A dark steam boat sits low among rough waves, with a slender mast rising against a pale opening in the storm. Broad curves of grey, white and brown sweep around the vessel, while a dark plume bends across the upper part of the sky.
works.title: Snow Storm: Steam-Boat off a Harbour's Mouth

works.caption: Mary supports the standing Christ Child beneath branches laden with apples. Her long reddish-gold curls fall over a blue-green cloak and red garment; the Child holds bread in one hand and an apple in the other. A lake and a castle on a rocky outcrop appear at the left.
works.title: Madonna and Child under the Apple Tree

works.caption: Mary, in a blue mantle over a pink dress, sits on a carved golden throne against a gold ground with the Child on her lap. He raises his right hand with two fingers extended and holds a small scroll in his left. Six winged angels stand three on each side, one above another. Small painted roundels with figures run all the way round the frame, gable included.
works.title: The Madonna and Child in Majesty Surrounded by Angels

works.caption: Mary kneels with her hands joined before the Christ Child, who sits on a dark cloth held by an angel and raises his arms. Five angels gather around them beneath leafy branches and pink roses. Flowers dot the grass below, and a bridge crosses water in the distant landscape at the left.
works.title: Madonna Adoring the Child with Five Angels

works.caption: A crowned Mary in a deep blue robe breastfeeds the Christ Child, dressed in red, on her lap. She sits in a stone niche under a pointed arch; small statues stand on the pilasters and tiny carved scenes crowd the top. Flowering plants grow at either side of the base.
works.title: Virgin and Child Enthroned

works.caption: Robert Andrews stands with a gun and a dog beside Frances Andrews, seated in a pale blue dress on a green bench beneath a large tree. Fields, sheaves of grain, fences and distant sheep extend across the right side under a broad clouded sky.
works.title: Mr and Mrs Andrews

works.caption: Ellen Terry, portrayed as Lady Macbeth, holds a jeweled crown above her head with both hands. Long reddish braids fall over a shimmering blue-green gown, whose hanging sleeves frame her raised arms against a dark background.
works.title: Ellen Terry as Lady Macbeth

works.caption: Ten artists and writers gather around a framed portrait of Delacroix. Fantin-Latour includes himself in a white shirt at the left, its brightness breaking the surrounding dark suits and turning the group portrait into a personal tribute.
works.title: Homage to Delacroix

works.caption: Two bare-breasted women rest on pink ground beside patches of blue water and dark rocks. The foreground woman sits with a flower garland in her hair and one knee raised, while the other reclines behind her. Red patterned cloth and green foliage contrast with their ochre-brown skin.
works.title: Aha Oe Feii?

works.caption: Mary sits on a raised throne at the left of a patterned terrace, with robed figures near her and behind the white balustrade. Two nearly nude men stand at the far right, and children gather around a small tree in a dark pot at the center. Beyond the balustrade, still water reflects a rocky landscape dotted with buildings and figures.
works.title: Holy Allegory

works.caption: Fruit, vegetables, grain and flowers combine into a frontal bust of Rudolf II as Vertumnus. A pear forms the nose, rounded red fruit shapes the cheeks, and bunches of grapes and ears of grain fill the hair. A diagonal garland of flowers crosses the leafy torso against a dark background.
works.title: Rudolf II as Vertumnus

works.caption: A woman in a deep red-violet dress, with full white undersleeves and a dark grey sash, stands behind a parapet and looks straight out. A fine gold chain hangs in two loops at her neck, a sheer scarf lies over her shoulders, and her hair is gathered at the sides in grey coverings flecked with gold. One hand hangs low at her side. The other rests on top of a raised slab carved with a woman's head in profile. The letters T and V are marked on the parapet below her, against a plain dark background.
works.title: La Schiavona

works.caption: Mary holds the Christ Child close as he turns his face to the left and rests a hand against her blue mantle near the shoulder. Two angel heads appear at the lower sides of the circular painting, beneath tall flames on matching candleholders against a dark background.
works.title: Madonna of the Candelabra

works.caption: The winged archangel Raphael, haloed and holding a small box, strides beside Tobias, who holds the angel by the wrist. Tobias, in a blue tunic and red hose, carries a rolled paper and a fish hanging from a cord. A curly white dog trots at the angel's heels, and a river, green hills and a towered castle open out behind.
works.title: Tobias and the Angel

works.caption: Children and adults gather around a model of the solar system as a philosopher explains its workings. A lamp takes the place of the Sun, lighting the watching faces while the nearest figure becomes a dark silhouette.
works.title: A Philosopher Lecturing on the Orrery

works.caption: An alchemist kneels beside a flask glowing with phosphorus in a vaulted laboratory. Two assistants watch from the left, where a small flame provides another pool of light; the moon is visible through the window above.
works.title: The Alchemist Discovering Phosphorus

works.caption: Three large leafless trees rise around a snow-covered stone tomb, their broken trunks and twisting branches outlined against a pale yellow and blue-grey sky. Snow catches along the branches and low shrubs, while smaller bare trees recede into the mist at the right.
works.title: Cairn in Snow

works.caption: Tarquin leans over Lucretia on a bed, raising a dagger while gripping her upstretched arm. She presses her other hand against his chest; a third figure peers from behind the dark green curtain at the left. His red clothing contrasts with her bare skin and the white bedding.
works.title: Tarquin and Lucretia

works.caption: A weeping angel with red-gold hair and a many-coloured wing holds up the dead Christ from behind. His head falls back, eyes almost closed and mouth open; blood streams from the wound in his side, and a small wound marks the palm of his open hand at right. A white cloth lies across his lap, with blue drapery behind and beside him. Beyond, trees and a crumbling stone wall give way to a walled city, and skulls, bones and broken stumps litter the ground.
works.title: The Dead Christ Supported by an Angel

works.caption: Overlapping curved and angular forms spread across the canvas in blue, yellow, green, pink and red, crossed by dark outlines. Boccioni reduces the cyclist to a dense central cluster of shapes, surrounded by sweeping bands of colour.
works.title: Dynamism of a Cyclist

works.caption: Christ, thin and nearly naked, stands with his wrists bound at a tall column speckled red and white. On either side a man in a short pink tunic raises a whip; the man on the right wears red hose. Buildings with blue roofs rise at both edges against a gold ground, above a low wall.
works.title: The Flagellation of Christ

works.caption: Mary Magdalene looks upward toward a bright opening in dark blue clouds, her hands folded in her lap. Long golden hair falls over her white blouse and dark cloak; ivy climbs the rock beside her, above a skull and a small glass vessel.
works.title: The Penitent Magdalene

works.caption: A broad blue sky streaked with dark marks fills the upper half of the canvas, with pale clouds clustered at the left. Below, yellow and green wheatfields stretch toward a low horizon, their curved bands and short strokes punctuated by small red and white marks.
works.title: Wheatfield under Thunderclouds

works.caption: Three skeletons in black robes tend rows of potted plants on wooden shelves. The nearest tips a green watering can, the central figure holds a small blue flower close to its face, and the third faces away; a path leads between trees beyond the garden.
works.title: The Garden of Death

works.caption: A seated young woman looks directly outward, her long dark hair tied with a red ribbon and falling over a white blouse. Her hands rest together on a red-and-white striped skirt, with a few green leaves near her fingers; broad patches of green foliage fill the background.
works.title: In the Summer

works.caption: Titus pauses over his papers with a pen in his right hand and his thumb against his chin. An inkwell and pen case hang from his left hand, while Rembrandt's broad brushwork gives the desk a rough, tangible surface.
works.title: Titus at his desk

works.caption: Mary turns from an open book toward an angel standing on a cloud, his broad grey-and-black wings spread behind a golden robe. A white dove hovers between them; lilies rise beside the angel, while a sewing basket and a small vase sit near Mary’s feet.
works.title: The Annunciation

works.caption: Madame Duvaucey faces the viewer from a red upholstered chair, wearing a black dress and a cream shawl with a patterned border. A partly opened ornate fan rests near her lap, while necklaces, bracelets and rings stand out against her bare neck and arms.
works.title: Portrait of Madame Duvaucey

works.caption: The white-bearded Jacob leans forward from his bed, resting a hand on a fair-haired boy’s head while a turbaned man stands behind him. A second boy looks outward and a woman watches from the right; dark curtains frame the group above a broad red bedcover.
works.title: Jacob Blessing the Sons of Joseph

works.caption: A red-haired woman bends over a man whose head rests against her chest, wrapping a bare arm around his shoulders. Her hair falls across both figures, while their dark clothing merges with the blue-black background.
works.title: Vampire

works.caption: Mary, seated, holds out an open book and the Christ Child reaches up for it; the young John the Baptist, in a shaggy skin, stands beside him. Two angels at the right look down at a sheet one of them holds. The two angels at the left are only flat greenish shapes and faint lines, and Mary's cloak shows just its dark modelling.
works.title: The Virgin and Child with Saint John and Angels ('The Manchester Madonna')

works.caption: Susanna bends forward at the edge of a pool, turning her face outward as one of two men behind her grips her white cloth. A red garment and slippers lie on the stone ledge at the right, while trees and large buildings recede into the darker background.
works.title: Susanna and the Elders

works.caption: A woman reclines against a pillow with a cigarette between her lips, wearing a pink camisole and loose green-and-white striped trousers. Blue fabric patterned with pale flowers covers the bed and frames the scene; two closed books lie near her bare feet.
works.title: The Blue Room

works.caption: A pale-faced man fills the foreground, separated from a couple beneath a fruit tree behind him. The woman's open red garment exposes her body as she reaches upwards, while dark contours and strong colour give the scene its uneasy intensity.
works.title: Jealousy

works.artist: Peter Paul Rubens and Frans Snyders
works.caption: Prometheus lies twisted across rocks, his raised legs and chained wrist pulling in opposite directions. An eagle spreads its wings above him, pressing a talon against his face and tearing at his side; white and blue cloth gathers beneath his bare body.
works.title: Prometheus Bound

works.caption: A naked man sits at the bottom of the panel with one hand pressed to his head, while a green, bat-winged creature with clawed feet and an open, fanged mouth grips his wrist. At lower right another naked figure curls up beneath a pale, whiskered beast. Behind them hands and heads rise from dark water below a black crag, and flames burst from its peak into a glowing, smoky sky.
works.title: Visions of the Hereafter: Hell

works.caption: Men on ladders lower Christ from the cross into waiting arms, his pale body lit against the dark sky. A young figure holds a light beside him; at the right, a white-veiled woman sags into the arms of her companions, while people at the lower left spread a pale cloth on the ground.
works.title: The Descent from the Cross

works.caption: Seen from above, the boulevard narrows between rows of tall buildings beneath a pale, cloudy sky. Carriages fill the sunlit road, pedestrians crowd the pavements, and fresh green foliage breaks up the façades; a dark streetlamp rises prominently in the foreground.
works.title: Boulevard Montmartre, Spring

works.caption: Three painted stone archways, each lined with statues, open onto three scenes. At left, a haloed woman in blue holds a newborn while a bearded man in green writes, a red-curtained bed behind them. At centre, a man in a red cloak raises his hand over a near-naked man standing in a river, an angel kneeling beside him and a figure in a red cloud above. At right, a richly dressed woman holds out a dish as an executioner sets a severed head on it, a body lying at their feet and a banquet in a hall far behind.
works.title: The Altar of St. John

works.caption: A naked man stands with his back to the viewer, drawing a white towel across his upper body. A large metal bathtub occupies the right side, while clothes lie on a chair at the left, boots stand below it, and a crumpled white garment rests on the floor near his feet.
works.title: Man at His Bath

works.caption: A skeleton in a blue robe patterned with crosses grips a red club at the left. Across a broad gap of dark green, a cluster of women, a child, and an embracing couple is enclosed by brightly colored patterns; pale faces and bare limbs emerge between the ornaments.
works.title: Death and Life

works.caption: A bearded half-length figure built of books stands before a grey-blue curtain. An open volume fanned out on top makes the hair, closed books stack up into the face and chest, and a large red book rises at the left like a shoulder.
works.title: The Librarian

works.caption: Dark storm clouds gather above a mountain lake, with pale peaks appearing through a brighter opening at the upper left. Sunlight catches cliffs beyond the water, while the wooded slope at the right falls into shadow; small mounted figures cross the grassy foreground near fallen trees and rocks.
works.title: A Storm in the Rocky Mountains, Mt. Rosalie

works.caption: Gold-colored branches curl into broad spirals across this working drawing. A black bird with a red eye perches to the right of the patterned trunk, while blue eye-shaped motifs, circular ornaments, and flowers punctuate the design; handwritten notes remain visible between the branches.
works.title: Tree of Life — working drawing for the Stoclet Frieze, Part 4

works.caption: A man in a broad black hat leans forward beside a red-upholstered chair, looking toward the viewer. His open hand extends to the right, while the other rests beside the chair; a wide white lace collar and cuffs contrast with the patterned black clothing and rows of dark bows.
works.title: Portrait of a Man Rising from His Chair

works.caption: Mary, in a blue mantle, cradles the dead Christ's head and presses her cheek to his face. At the left, John in red reaches over to grip her mantle; at the right, Mary Magdalene sits with her hands joined, a small white lidded jar on the ground beside her. A skull lies at the front edge, and the upright of the cross stands against a glowing sky.
works.collection: Royal Museums of Fine Arts of Belgium
works.title: Pietà

works.caption: Fyodor Chaliapin stands on a snowy rise in a dark fur-trimmed coat and hat, one hand at his chest and the other holding a walking stick. A white dog looks up beside his feet; behind him, crowds, bright fairground stalls, a tall slide, and horse-drawn sledges fill the snow-covered town.
works.title: Portrait of Fyodor Chaliapin — Russian Museum version

works.caption: Juno, crowned and dressed in red, reaches toward a peacock’s spread tail as an attendant holds Argus’s severed head. His headless body stretches across the foreground beside the gilded chariot; children gather among the birds at the left, and a rainbow arcs through the cloudy sky.
works.title: Juno and Argus

works.caption: The Comtesse d'Haussonville, in a pale blue dress with red ribbons in her hair, stands in front of a blue-draped mantel and looks out at us, the fingers of one hand at her chin and the other arm folded across her waist. The tall mirror behind her shows the back of her head and shoulders. On the mantel stand vases, flowers, a few white cards with turned-up corners and a pair of black opera glasses, and a yellow shawl lies over a chair at lower right.
works.title: Comtesse d'Haussonville

works.caption: Mary holds the Christ Child on a tall throne above two saints: an armored figure bearing a red-and-white banner at the left and the barefoot Francis of Assisi in grey at the right. A patterned green cloth hangs over the pedestal, while towers, trees, and distant blue mountains rise behind the red curtain.
works.title: Castelfranco Madonna

works.caption: Truth emerges naked from a well, mouth open and one leg reaching over its rim. She grips a whip whose loose lashes trail towards the ground, giving Gérôme's allegory a confrontational presence.
works.title: Truth Coming Out of Her Well

works.caption: Simeon kneels with the infant Christ in his arms, his white beard and richly patterned robe catching the light. Mary sits close beside him as a tall robed figure gestures from the left; rows of onlookers and enormous columns recede into the shadowed temple above and behind the group.
works.title: Simeon's song of praise

works.caption: Christ’s wounded body lies diagonally across a white shroud, surrounded by mourners. Mary kneels in blue beneath the cross, while a bishop in an embroidered cope prays at the right. A skull rests in the foreground, and green hills, walled towns and a castle stretch behind the figures.
works.title: Lamentation of Christ

works.caption: A woman raises her glass as a man pours wine, while an older woman follows a song sheet beside a mother and infant. At the right, a laughing man helps a child smoke a pipe and a boy plays the bagpipes. The proverb in the title warns that children imitate their elders’ example.
works.title: 'As the Old Sing, So Pipe the Young'

works.caption: A smiling young woman looks toward the viewer while holding a violin and drawing its bow across the strings. Red and yellow feathers rise above her head, and a patterned sash crosses her yellow robe. Bright light on her face, hands and clothing contrasts with the dark background.
works.title: The Violin Player

works.artist: Willem van de Velde the Younger
works.artistSort: Younger, Willem van de Velde the
works.caption: A Dutch warship fires a cannon shot over calm water, a white cloud of smoke spreading to the left of its carved stern. Pale sails hang from the densely rigged masts. Small open boats flank the ship, while another vessel lies farther away beneath the broad, clouded sky.
works.title: The Cannon Shot

works.caption: Jacob de Gheyn turns towards us with his lips slightly parted. Light picks out his face and broad white collar against dark clothing and a plain grey-brown background.
works.title: Portrait of Jacob de Gheyn III

works.caption: A red-haired woman leans forward over a work surface, turning her profile toward the window at the left. Her loose white blouse is rendered in strokes of pale blue, green and pink against the dark interior. A piece of white cloth lies beneath her outstretched arm.
works.title: La Blanchisseuse

works.caption: A young man crouches beside two fighting roosters while a young woman watches from a fountain. Gérôme sets their smooth, pale bodies against weathered stone and a distant sea, with a damaged sphinx carved behind them.
works.title: Young Greeks Attending a Cock Fight

works.caption: A small cart travels away along a snow-covered road between low buildings and a wooded bank. Tracks and blue-gray shadows mark the pale foreground, while snow weighs on the roofs and bare branches. The tiny dark figures in the cart stand out beneath a broad, light winter sky.
works.title: A Cart on the Snowy Road at Honfleur

works.caption: A pale cliff at Étretat ends in a rock arch standing in a grey-green sea edged with white surf. Below it a pale beach curves round from a grassy slope at left, where a weathered rock outcrop holds a small arched door, and three boats, two dark and one small and grey, are drawn up on the beach at right. Out at sea are a boat with reddish sails and a tiny white sail, under a pale blue sky streaked with white cloud.
works.title: The Cliff at Étretat after a Storm

works.caption: Fortune stands beside an enormous wheel in a deeply folded gray robe. Three nearly naked men occupy its right edge: a chained slave above a crowned king holding a sceptre, and a laurel-crowned poet below. Their overlapping bodies and the wheel fill almost the entire narrow canvas.
works.title: The Wheel of Fortune

works.caption: Robert de Montesquiou sits with his head turned, holding a cane in one white-gloved hand. Boldini's sweeping strokes animate the grey-brown suit, while the elongated pose gives the writer a deliberately theatrical air.
works.title: Portrait of Robert de Montesquiou

works.caption: Seen from behind, a naked woman sits beside a bath with a towel gathered around her head and draped over the chair. One arm bends toward her hair while the other stretches to the right. Layered pastel strokes in pink, yellow, blue and gray describe her back, the cloth and the surrounding room.
works.title: After the Bath, Woman Drying Herself

works.caption: The Virgin sits under a red canopy with the Christ Child standing on her lap. He raises his right hand; she rests a hand on his chest and leans her head towards his. John the Baptist stands at the left, holding a thin cross-staff wound with a scroll, and Mary Magdalene stands at the right, looking upward and lifting a small lidded pot. Fruit trees fill the background.
works.title: The Virgin and Child with the Magdalen and Saint John the Baptist

works.caption: An architect reclines among books and drawings atop a monumental column, framed by green curtains and an arch. Beyond him, an imaginary waterfront combines classical temples, arcades and distant pyramids with a dark Gothic church at the left. Tiny boats and crowds emphasize the enormous scale of the buildings.
works.title: The Architect's Dream

works.caption: Mary and the Christ Child sit beneath a golden apse, surrounded by six saints. Three angels play instruments at the foot of the throne, their bright robes bringing colour to the base of Bellini's spacious architectural setting.
works.title: Madonna and Child enthroned with Saints and Angels

works.caption: Eleven men haul a barge along a sandy bank of the Volga, broad straps crossing their chests. Most lean forward, while the younger man in a torn pink shirt stands more upright and grips his strap. Behind them, the barge floats on the calm river beneath a pale, open sky.
works.title: Barge Haulers on the Volga

works.caption: Doge Leonardo Loredan is seen from the chest up behind a reddish-brown parapet, against a plain blue background. His face is turned three-quarters, and his pale blue eyes look off to our left. His white robe, patterned in gold, is fastened down the front with a column of large round buttons. His cap rises to a curved peak at the back and has a broad orange-gold patterned band; beneath it a white under-cap frames his face, with two thin strings hanging down. A small paper on the parapet reads IOANNES BELLINVS.
works.title: Doge Leonardo Loredan

works.caption: A young man faces straight out under a red cap, his curling hair spreading to either side of his face. His plain brown doublet has a pale furry edging down the front and is tied at the neck, just below a white collar. Light from the left falls on his face against a dark background, leaving the right side of his face and neck in shade.
works.title: Portrait of a Young Man

works.caption: Mary sits on a stone throne in a classical room, holding the Child on her lap as he raises one hand. Two men in red robes kneel before her. Four saints stand at the sides: on the left a woman holding a small silver jar and a man with a thin cross-staff, on the right a friar with a cross and a crowned woman beside a spiked wheel.
works.title: Sant'Ambrogio Altarpiece

works.caption: The Virgin, in a deep blue mantle and white veil over a red dress, holds the naked Christ Child upright on a ledge in front of her, one hand across his chest and the other over his groin. He raises his right hand in blessing. Thin gold haloes circle both heads. Behind them, towns, a tall tower and hills stretch under a blue sky with white clouds. A small folded paper on the front of the ledge reads IOANNES BELLINVS.
works.title: Contarini Madonna

works.caption: Mezzetin sits with crossed legs in an overgrown garden, playing a guitar and tilting his face upward. His striped costume is paired with a white ruff, pink hat and short cape. A female statue in the background turns away from the theatrical character.
works.title: Mezzetin

works.caption: Breton women in white headdresses crowd the foreground, some with hands joined in prayer. A thick tree trunk cuts diagonally across the red ground, separating them from Jacob wrestling a yellow-winged angel at the upper right. Dark outlines and broad areas of color flatten the scene.
works.title: Vision After the Sermon

works.caption: Christ, wrapped in red drapery, gestures above Saint Roch, who looks upward with a hand on his chest. An angel holds an inscribed tablet, and a dog stands beside the saint’s pilgrim staff and hat. Below the stone ledge, sick and partly unclothed figures reach upward or recline together.
works.title: Christ Appointing Saint Roch as Patron Saint of Plague Victims

works.caption: Silenus reclines naked on a pale cloth, raising a shallow cup while a companion pours into it from a wineskin. A horned satyr leans over him at the right, and a donkey opens its mouth at the upper left. Strong light picks out the figures against the dark background.
works.title: Drunken Silenus

works.caption: Three bare-chested workers kneel over wooden floorboards, scraping their surfaces amid scattered curls of wood. Light from the tall window spreads across the floor, whose long lines lead toward the paneled wall. A bottle and glass stand at the right, with tools lying between the men.
works.title: Les raboteurs de parquet

works.caption: Marie Krøyer reads in a deckchair beneath a spreading bush of white roses. An empty chair stands beside her, and a dog lies curled on the ground. Sunlit blossoms and patches of bright grass contrast with the deep shade around the seated figure.
works.title: Roses

works.caption: A shark approaches Brook Watson in the water beside a crowded rowboat. Two rescuers bend over its side toward him, while a man at the stern raises a hooked harpoon and another holds a rope. Ships and the towers of Havana line the distant harbor.
works.title: Watson and the Shark

works.caption: An ostrich egg hangs beneath a shell-shaped niche above the Virgin and sleeping Christ child. Saints and angels stand around them within an ornate vaulted interior, while Federico da Montefeltro kneels in armor at the right, his hands joined in prayer.
works.title: Madonna and Child with Saints, Angels and Federico da Montefeltro (San Bernardino Altarpiece)

works.caption: A young woman in a thin white dress sprawls across the back of a white bull swimming out to sea. One hand grips a horn while the other waves a red cloth above her head. Two winged children with bows and arrows fly overhead, a third rides a dolphin at lower left, and tiny figures stand on the distant shore below blue mountains.
works.title: The Rape of Europa

works.caption: A woman reclines with her arms raised behind her head on patterned cushions, white cloth covering her legs. Beside her, a seated musician plays a long-necked string instrument, while a turbaned attendant stands behind a golden railing. Red curtains, blue fabric and geometric patterns fill the interior.
works.title: Odalisque à l'esclave

works.caption: A woman in a red cloak and white headcloth rides a donkey down a hillside path, a swaddled infant at her breast, while a man in grey walks ahead. Below them a broad river widens between rocky crags, wooded banks and small towns, towards a distant island peak under a blue, cloud-streaked sky.
works.title: Landscape with the Flight into Egypt

works.caption: Pope Paul III sits beside a red-covered table, turning toward his grandson Ottavio as he bends forward at the right. Cardinal Alessandro stands behind the pope at the left and looks toward the viewer. Red robes and a heavy curtain surround the three figures against a dark background.
works.title: Pope Paul III and His Grandsons

works.caption: Anna Ancher and Marie Krøyer walk together beside the water in pale dresses, seen from behind. Footprints cross the broad beach, and the curved shoreline leads toward distant dunes. Blue evening light brings sea and sky close in color, with yellow highlights on the sand and clothing.
works.title: Summer Evening on Skagen's Southern Beach

works.caption: A young woman rests one forearm on a dark windowsill and supports her cheek with the other hand. Light picks out her face, white blouse and red jacket against the shadowed background. Broad brushstrokes describe the folds of her sleeves and the fabric around her neck.
works.title: The Kitchen Maid

works.caption: A knife grinder and his sharpening machine break into overlapping blue, green, orange and gray planes. Repeated hands, feet and sections of the wheel suggest successive movements of the worker. Malevich combines a fragmented Cubist vocabulary with Futurism’s emphasis on motion.
works.title: The Knife Grinder

works.caption: On the left panel Richard II, crowned and in a gold-patterned robe, kneels on bare ground with his hands raised and open. Three haloed saints stand behind him, holding an arrow, a ring and a lamb. He faces the right panel, where the Virgin in blue holds the Child among eleven angels in blue with tall white wings, one carrying a white banner with a red cross. Flowers cover the ground at their feet, and both panels have patterned gold backgrounds.
works.title: Wilton Diptych

works.caption: A man in a broad-brimmed black hat stands beside a seated woman, both wearing bright white collars against dark clothing. An empty chair with a red cushion occupies the left foreground. Light reveals their faces, the wooden floor and a map on the wall, while the room recedes into shadow at the right.
works.title: A Lady and Gentleman in Black

works.caption: Georgiana, Duchess of Devonshire, turns toward the viewer beneath a broad black hat trimmed with feathers. Loose curls fall around her face and shoulders, and a pink rose rests against her pale dress. Light, sweeping strokes describe the gauzy neckline and folds gathered in her hands.
works.title: Portrait of Georgiana, Duchess of Devonshire

works.caption: Large string instruments fill a shaded stall beside a seated man at the left. Beyond them, a Delft church, canal bridge and rows of houses appear in bright daylight. The exaggerated scale of the foreground and curving street create an unusual perspective, whose intended viewing arrangement remains uncertain.
works.title: A View of Delft

works.caption: Cleopatra holds a pearl above a tall glass as Mark Antony watches from across the banquet table. Servants, guests and a dog surround them beneath monumental columns, with musicians on a balcony beyond. The scene illustrates her legendary wager to consume a fortune by dissolving the pearl in vinegar.
works.title: The Banquet of Cleopatra

works.caption: Pale, mask-like faces crowd towards the viewer beneath a sky of red and yellow waves. A railing cuts sharply across the fjord view, setting the figures' rigid stares against Munch's restless bands of colour.
works.title: Anxiety

works.caption: Iphigenia sleeps beneath a tree with her arms raised above her head, pale drapery spreading across the rocky ground. Cymon stands at the right in a red cloak, looking down at her, while other figures sleep nearby. Warm orange light illuminates the folds, and a bright disk touches the distant sea horizon.
works.collection: Art Gallery of New South Wales
works.title: Cymon and Iphigenia

works.caption: A soldier slumps on a bench with his head lowered and a gun across his lap. A small dog sits beside him, while columns, an arch and a staircase carry the eye into the quiet space behind.
works.title: The Sentry

works.caption: Small stars punctuate a blue-green sky above the coast at Åsgårdstrand. The shoreline curves toward a dark mass of trees at the right, with a pale fence crossing the foreground diagonally. Thin streaks of light reflect in the water, while broad, uneven strokes blur the boundaries between sea, sky and land.
works.title: Starry Night

works.caption: A young man with shoulder-length brown hair and a thin moustache turns his head to look straight at us over his shoulder. He wears a dark, curly-textured cap, a brown coat with an open white collar, and a steel breastplate held by a leather strap that catches the light. Behind him is a grey sky with a bank of pale cloud.
works.title: Young Man in a Fur Cap

works.caption: Christ tilts his thorn-crowned head upward beside the tall wooden cross at the right. Drops of blood mark his forehead and elongated neck, while his pale hand rests against the beam. Light catches his face, fingers and red tunic against the dark background.
works.title: Christ with the Cross

works.caption: Lady Agnew looks directly outward from a floral-upholstered armchair. A lilac sash gathers her white dress at the waist and falls in broad folds across her lap. One arm rests along the chair while the other hand holds a pale flower. Blue silk patterned with gold lettering hangs behind her.
works.title: Lady Agnew of Lochnaw

works.caption: White water plunges beside a rocky cliff at the left, while further falls curve across the distance. Spray veils the river below; a faint rainbow crosses the sunlit rocks in the lower right.
works.title: Niagara Falls, from the American Side

works.caption: A bather stands with her back to the viewer, holding a white cloth around her hips and raising her other hand toward a seated woman. Their gestures meet beneath dense foliage beside the water. The painting’s nude figure and ambiguous exchange provoked controversy at the Salon of 1853.
works.title: The Bathers

works.caption: A woman in a long pale-yellow dress stands in profile beside a seated brown dog. Both look toward the water, where a narrow trail of white reflections breaks the blue surface. Her gathered sleeves and yellow waistband stand out against the nearly uninterrupted sea, with small waves reaching the beach below.
works.title: Summer Evening at Skagen. The Artist's Wife and Dog by the Shore

works.caption: Marie and P.S. Krøyer walk arm in arm along the beach, with a brown dog beside them. Her white dress and his pale suit stand against the blue sea. A yellow moon casts broken reflections toward the shore, while a distant sailboat appears near the left edge.
works.title: Summer Evening at Skagen Beach – The Artist and his Wife

works.caption: Sunlight lays bright rectangles and leafy shadows across a blue wall. A girl sits near the window, her hands busy with needles, while yellow curtains and blue chair cushions turn the small room into a study of blue and gold.
works.title: Sunlight in the Blue Room

works.caption: A nude young performer stands on a small rug with a large snake coiled around his body, raising its head in one hand. Seated spectators line the blue-tiled wall, while a musician plays a wind instrument at the right. Painted inscriptions and floral patterns cover the tiles above them.
works.title: The Snake Charmer

works.caption: Christ hangs on a T-shaped cross, head dropped and eyes closed, against a red hanging creased into squares, with a plaque reading INRI above him. At left a woman in white robes and veil presses the cloth to her face and looks down; at right a young man in white looks up, his right hand raised beside his face and his left open at his chest. The cross and the two mourners stand on rocky ground.
works.collection: Royal Monastery of San Lorenzo de El Escorial
works.title: Crucifixion of Scheut

works.caption: A young man in a black coat, his white shirt showing at the neck with a frilled collar and frilled cuffs, looks off to our right against a dark background. A thin chain with a small pendant hangs on his chest. His bare hand, a ring on one finger, points down at the lower left. His other hand wears a beige glove and holds a second, empty glove, beside a stone block at the lower right.
works.title: Man with a Glove

works.caption: Richly dressed guests crowd long white-covered tables on a colonnaded terrace, with Christ, a halo round his head, seated at the centre beside the Virgin Mary in dark blue. In front of them a group of musicians plays stringed instruments, while a servant at right pours from a large jug and dogs roam the chequered floor. Behind a stone balustrade, servants carve meat and carry dishes, and onlookers lean from the buildings at either side against a blue sky with white clouds and a distant bell tower.
works.collection: Department of Paintings of the Louvre
works.title: The Wedding at Cana

works.caption: A girl turns her head toward the viewer above an ochre jacket and a narrow white collar. Blue cloth wraps her forehead, with a yellow length falling behind her shoulder. Small highlights catch her eyes, parted lips and large drop earring, while the background appears dark.
works.title: Girl with a Pearl Earring

works.caption: Madame de Pompadour stands in a pink gown trimmed with pale ruffles and bows, resting one arm on the pedestal of a garden sculpture. She holds a closed fan, with a small spaniel seated on the green bench below. Flowers and dark foliage surround her, and one slipper projects beneath the skirt.
works.title: Madame de Pompadour

works.caption: Mary Magdalene rests her cheek on one hand and lays the other on a skull in her lap. A smoking oil lamp lights her profile and the books beside her, leaving the surrounding room in deep shadow.
works.collection: Los Angeles County Museum of Art
works.title: Magdalen with the Smoking Flame

works.caption: Snow covers sloping roofs and curved dormer tops in a view across closely packed buildings. Red chimney pots and tall dark flues rise above the pale surfaces. Bare trees and grey walls recede toward a hazy sky, while the nearest roof fills much of the foreground.
works.title: Vue de toits

works.caption: Flowers assemble into a face in left profile: pale blossoms trace the skin, a rose fills the cheek and a large pink bloom forms the ear. A dense cluster of multicoloured flowers replaces the hair. White flowers edge the collar, while overlapping green leaves build the neck and shoulders against a dark background.
works.collection: Department of Paintings of the Louvre
works.title: Spring

works.caption: A gnarled tree trunk forms a head in right profile, with knots and split wood suggesting the eye, nose and ear. Bare branches rise above it, and ivy spreads behind the head. Layered fungi shape the lips. A woven mantle wraps the lower trunk, with a leafy branch bearing two fruits across its chest.
works.collection: Department of Paintings of the Louvre
works.title: Winter

works.caption: Fruit and vegetables assemble into a head in right profile: a long green vegetable forms the nose, a rounded pink fruit the cheek, and an open pea pod the mouth. Cherries and leaves crowd the hair. Ears of grain edge a woven straw collar, with an artichoke rising beside the shoulder.
works.collection: Department of Paintings of the Louvre
works.title: Summer

works.caption: Two barefoot wrestlers grapple on a patch of bare earth at a Paris racecourse. The paler man, in dark trunks, buries his face against his bearded opponent and hooks one arm over his head, while the bearded man in red trunks lays an arm across his shoulders. Spectators fill a covered stand at right, with trees and a pale building beyond under a blue sky.
works.title: The Wrestlers

works.caption: An upturned dark bowl becomes a hat above a face assembled from vegetables. A large onion forms one rounded cheek, roots project as the nose, and green leaves frame the head. Rotated by half a turn, the same arrangement becomes a bowl filled with vegetables.
works.title: The Gardener

works.artist: Attributed to Geertgen tot Sint Jans
works.caption: Mary, crowned and in a red mantle, sits on a crescent moon above a black dragon, holding the infant Christ inside an oval of golden light. The child holds a small round bell in each hand. Rings of angels surround them, carrying musical instruments, banners and objects associated with Christ's Passion.
works.title: The Glorification of the Virgin

works.caption: Two men stand on rocks near the water while two women sit closer to shore. Beyond them, a pale golden glow spreads across the sea beneath a bank of cloud, drawing the four figures into the same quiet act of looking.
works.title: Moonrise over the Sea

works.caption: A young woman appears in left profile beneath a flower-trimmed bonnet tied with a dark ribbon. Her yellow-gloved hand grips a parasol whose shaft crosses her shoulder diagonally. Fine floral marks cover her pale dress, contrasting with the broad green strokes of the foliage behind her.
works.title: Spring

works.artist: Jan Brueghel the Elder and Peter Paul Rubens
works.caption: Venus, partly covered by blue drapery, examines a painting shown by Cupid in a room crowded with pictures and sculpted heads. A globe, telescope, jewellery and measuring instruments fill the foreground. Beyond the collection, an arched opening reveals a palace and garden, while a long gallery recedes at the right.
works.title: The Sense of Sight

works.caption: Minerva looks up from an open book, wearing a laurel wreath and a richly embroidered cloak. Her helmet and shield remain in the shadowed background, while warm light picks out her face, pale clothing and the raised texture of the embroidery.
works.title: Minerva in Her Study

works.caption: Rembrandt turns his head towards the viewer, with light falling across his forehead, cheek and white collar. His curly hair and dark clothing merge with the shadowed background, while a small highlight catches the metal gorget at his neck.
works.title: Self-portrait with a Gorget

works.caption: Sunlight streams past a white curtain into an unoccupied room, casting bright patches across the wooden floor. Two chairs stand beside a tall, dark-framed mirror, which reflects an upholstered seat and a picture on the opposite wall. The curtain curves into the room beside the balcony doorway.
works.title: The Balcony Room

works.caption: Workers use long tongs to guide a glowing iron billet into the rollers of a crowded mill. Wheels, beams and hanging chains fill the smoky hall above them. At the edges of the production scene, men wash on the left and eat a meal behind a metal screen on the right.
works.title: The Iron Rolling Mill

works.caption: A young man with red-gold curls, bare to the waist, glances to our left with lips slightly parted. A crimson cloth falls over his shoulders and arms against a dark background. An arrow is lodged in his side below the ribs, and he holds a second arrow loosely across his lap.
works.title: Portrait of a Young Man as Saint Sebastian

works.caption: Dürer's father, seen to the waist, turns and looks towards the left. He wears a black cap and a brown cloak lined with black fur. At the bottom of the panel his hands hold a string of red beads. At the top left, against the dark green background, '1490' is painted in gold above an AD monogram.
works.title: Portrait of the artist's father

works.caption: Pedestrians and horse-drawn carriages fill a tree-lined Paris boulevard beneath pale buildings with rows of windows and balconies. In the foreground, adults and children pass beside a streetlamp and advertising column. Short strokes of green, yellow, blue and violet break up the foliage, pavement and figures.
works.title: The Grands Boulevards

works.caption: A young woman in a blue jacket accompanies two little girls along a park path. One girl holds a doll, the other a muff; their pale fur trim and soft blue-green clothes emerge from Renoir's loose, flickering brushwork.
works.title: Mother and Children

works.caption: A woman in a blue patterned dress raises a saucer of tea beside a gleaming samovar. Watermelon, fruit and baked goods crowd the white-covered table, while a cat stands on the railing beside her shoulder. Beyond the terrace, church towers and market buildings stretch beneath a blue sky with pink clouds.
works.title: Merchant's Wife at Tea

works.caption: Horse-drawn sleighs carry bundled passengers across snowy hills above a town of church towers and colourful buildings. Crowds gather around fairground attractions below, while people sit beneath frost-covered trees at the right. Flocks of dark birds cross a sky streaked with pink, yellow and green.
