works.title: Shrovetide

works.caption: A young woman with fair hair, bound up in a plain white cloth, is seen in profile facing left against a blue sky with faint clouds. Her sleeve is red patterned with large gold leaves; the cream front of her dress carries green foliage and red flowers. Below her runs a pale stone ledge set with dark speckled discs.
works.title: Profile Portrait of a Young Lady

works.caption: Christ sits on the edge of an octagonal well, raising a hand towards the Samaritan woman. She carries a red pitcher on her head and a bucket suspended from a rope at her side. Four disciples watch from the town gateway, its pink walls and green architectural details set against a gold ground.
works.title: Christ and the Samaritan Woman

works.caption: Andromeda twists against a coastal rock, partly covered by white drapery and encircled by a winged sea monster. An arrow protrudes from the creature's back as it raises its head beside her. High above, Perseus rides a white winged horse in a bright opening between the cliffs.
works.title: Perseus and Andromeda

works.caption: The newborn Christ lies on white cloth over straw, his body casting light onto the surrounding faces. Mary lifts the cloth at the right, two young angels lean towards him from the left, and Joseph watches from the shadows behind her. The bright manger stands out against the dark background.
works.title: Adoration of the Child

works.caption: A woman wearing a white fur cap and folded white shawl holds a red squirrel on her arm. The animal nibbles a nut, its chain draped beside her wrist, while a starling perches on a leafy branch behind her shoulder. The dark clothing and spotted bird contrast with the blue-green background.
works.title: A Lady with a Squirrel and a Starling (Anne Lovell?)

works.caption: The infant Christ lies on the ground before Mary, surrounded by Joseph, angels and approaching shepherds. Vases of flowers and a sheaf of grain occupy the central foreground. On the side panels, kneeling members of the Portinari family appear beneath their patron saints, with a landscape continuing across all three panels.
works.title: Portinari Triptych

works.caption: A young man climbs over a garden wall as a woman in a pale yellow gown turns to look left, her arms spread. Roses and dense foliage surround the pair. Above them, a statue of a woman with a small winged child stands on a pedestal beneath the tall trees.
works.title: The Progress of Love: The Meeting

works.caption: John the Baptist leans towards Christ in the foreground river, beneath a towering rock formation. Patinir carries the view far beyond them through wooded banks, settlements and pale blue distance, bringing an expansive landscape into the biblical scene.
works.title: The Baptism of Christ

works.caption: Saint Sebastian stands bound to a tree, his head tilted upwards and his body pierced by arrows. Blood marks his shoulder and the white cloth tied around his hips. A bow and quiver lie beside the exposed roots, while dark foliage frames a distant landscape beneath a cloudy sky.
works.title: Saint Sebastian

works.caption: Sheep and lambs gather on a sunlit coastal slope, some standing or grazing and others lying on the ground. Brambles and small pink and white flowers fill the foreground. Beyond the flock, a steep cliff drops towards the blue-green sea, with a grassy headland extending across the distance.
works.title: Our English Coasts

works.caption: Long black diagonals cross a cluster of overlapping coloured shapes on an off-white ground. Yellow and red triangles, checkerboard grids and curved lines surround a black-ringed circle with a red centre. A broad violet curve bends around the right side, while three parallel black bars sit near the lower corner.
works.title: On White II

works.caption: Naked people gather on a steep green hillside with angels in red. At lower left a winged angel bends over two seated figures; at right another angel and a naked figure stand among a crowd, all looking upward. On the summit a carved stone fountain stands with birds on its rim, a pale animal grazes nearby, and dark woodland fills the right side.
works.title: Visions of the Hereafter: Terrestrial Paradise

works.caption: Vigée Le Brun faces the viewer beneath a broad straw hat decorated with red, white and blue flowers and a curling white feather. She wears a rose-pink dress with a white ruffled neckline and a black wrap. One hand holds a palette and brushes; the other opens toward us against a cloudy blue sky.
works.title: Self Portrait in a Straw Hat

works.caption: Dark gondolas crowd the foreground beneath the domes of Santa Maria della Salute. Two striped mooring posts rise at left, while thin poles punctuate the boats at right. Short strokes of yellow, pink, green and blue cover the water, buildings and sky, giving the entire view a mosaic-like surface.
works.title: Entrance to the Grand Canal, Venice

works.caption: Inger Munch sits in profile on rounded shoreline rocks, wearing a long white dress with a dark belt. Her hands rest on a straw hat against her knees. Blue-grey water fills the background, where a small boat and slender poles interrupt the broad horizontal strokes; green, pink and ochre mark the foreground stones.
works.title: Summer Night. Inger on the Beach

works.caption: Sappho rests her clasped hands on a cushion as Alcaeus plays a kithara from a wooden chair opposite her. Four women listen from the tiers of pale marble seating behind her. Greek lettering marks the stone, and branching trees frame a strip of dark blue sea beyond the terrace.
works.title: Sappho and Alcaeus

works.caption: A flower-crowned goddess sits on a golden chariot amid figures carrying wreaths and baskets of blossoms. Two winged children hover above her, while others gather flowers beside the wheels. Reclining nude figures stretch across the foreground; dancers and flower bearers move beneath dark trees against a cloudy sky.
works.collection: Department of Paintings of the Louvre
works.title: The Triumph of Flora

works.caption: A woman reclines on her stomach among white pillows and deep blue drapery, turning her face toward the viewer. A loose white garment covers her upper body while her bare legs extend across the cushions. A red flower decorates her dark hair; a lidded vessel and small open box sit at lower left.
works.collection: Department of Paintings of the Louvre
works.title: Brown Odalisque

works.caption: A woman with long red hair stands facing out of a dark wood, both hands raised into her hair and her white dress hanging open over red beneath. At lower left a man in black sits hunched with his back to her, one hand pressed to his bowed head, while strands of her hair trail towards him. Thin, pale tree trunks rise against the dark reddish-brown forest behind them.
works.collection: National Museum of Art, Architecture and Design
works.title: Ashes

works.caption: Munch faces the viewer in a dark jacket, white collar and black bow tie. His brightly lit face and raised hand stand out against loosely brushed blue, grey and brown shadows. A small white cigarette rests between his fingers, with a wavering plume of blue-grey smoke rising beside his face.
works.collection: National Museum of Art, Architecture and Design
works.title: Self-Portrait with Cigarette

works.caption: A couple in dark clothes stand locked in an embrace beside a window, their faces merged into one shape as they kiss. At left a blue-green curtain is drawn almost across the window, leaving only a narrow bright strip of the world outside. The rest of the room lies in deep reddish-purple shadow.
works.title: The Kiss

works.caption: Angels descend through a bright opening in dark clouds above a crush of horses and soldiers. A pale horse rears near the centre as its turbaned rider looks upward. Fallen, partly naked bodies fill the foreground, while mounted figures flee toward the right beneath slanting spears and streaming banners.
works.title: The Defeat of Sennacherib

works.caption: Two women in feathered hats, waiting for clients, stand on a round grey traffic island in the foreground. The one at left wears a black coat with a dark veil over her face; the other wears a long blue-green coat with a white collar. Around them a bright green street tilts away, with men in dark suits walking past, a domed building at upper left and a pink building with arched openings behind.
works.title: Potsdamer Platz

works.caption: Christ faces straight out against a dark background, raising two fingers of his right hand in blessing. On his left palm rests a clear orb, with the blue robe visible through it. Long curls fall past his shoulders, and gold bands with interlaced patterns cross in an X on his chest.
works.title: Salvator Mundi

works.caption: Max Schmitt turns towards us from his narrow rowing boat on the Schuylkill River. Other boats and a pair of bridges recede behind him, while reflections and the long sweep of the oars give the still water a precise, measured geometry.
works.title: Max Schmitt in a Single Scull

works.caption: Jan de Leeuw looks toward the viewer beneath a dark folded cap. A brown fur collar frames his face above a nearly black robe. At the bottom of the portrait, he holds a small gold ring with a red stone between thumb and forefinger; the dark background keeps attention on his face and hand.
works.title: The Goldsmith Jan de Leeuw

works.caption: A young Black woman sits in an armchair draped with a deep blue cloth, turning her head to look straight at us. A white cloth is wound round her head, its loose end hanging beside her face, and she wears a gold hoop earring. Her white dress, tied at the waist with a red sash, has slipped to bare one breast, against a plain pale grey-beige background.
works.collection: Department of Paintings of the Louvre
works.title: Portrait of Madeleine

works.caption: Harvesters bend among red and orange vines beneath a pale sun ringed with yellow strokes. Their blue and green clothing contrasts with the foliage. A horse-drawn cart crosses the distant field; at right, a yellow-and-blue strip of water narrows toward the horizon, while turquoise trees line the left edge.
works.title: The Red Vineyard

works.caption: A stack of cheeses and curls of butter rises above pretzels, dried fruit and almonds. Beside them, a lidded Venetian glass and a brown jug catch the light, while the blue-and-white dish brings a cool accent to Peeters's warm palette.
works.title: Still Life with Cheeses, Almonds and Pretzels

works.caption: Vigée Le Brun turns toward the viewer while holding a brush beside an unfinished portrait of Marie Antoinette. She wears a black dress with a white ruffled collar and a white head wrap tied above her curls. A bright red sash bows at her waist; her other hand supports a palette and a bundle of brushes.
works.title: Self-portrait of Élisabeth Louise Vigée Le Brun

works.caption: Van Gogh wears a blue cap edged with black fur and a green coat marked by long vertical strokes. A white bandage covers one ear and passes beneath his chin. Behind him, a pale canvas stands on an easel at left, a Japanese print shows figures beneath a mountain, and blue panels border the yellow-green wall at right.
works.title: Self-Portrait with Bandaged Ear

works.caption: Van Gogh holds a pipe between his lips, its yellow smoke curling across a background divided into orange and red. A white bandage wraps beneath his chin from the ear covered by his dark fur-edged cap. Short green and brown strokes describe his heavy coat, while yellow and orange marks model his face.
works.title: Self-Portrait with Bandaged Ear and Pipe

works.caption: Jagged slabs of ice tilt upward into a central mound, their grey-green edges capped with snow. Long broken sheets overlap across the ochre foreground. At right, the dark, decorated stern of a wrecked ship protrudes from the ice; smaller distant ridges fade into a pale blue-grey sky.
works.title: The Sea of Ice

works.caption: A naked man braces his feet on rocks while carrying an elderly man and gripping a broken tree branch. With his other hand he pulls a woman upward; she holds an infant as another child clings to her. Orange, blue and dark red drapery streams around them, with rising water below and lightning across the sky.
works.collection: Department of Paintings of the Louvre
works.title: Scene of the Flood

works.caption: In a ruined palace, Mary sits with the Child on her lap while an old king kneels before her with joined hands, his hat and sceptre on the floor. Richly dressed kings and courtiers crowd in from both sides and angels hover overhead. In front, one dog lowers its nose to the broken paving and another sits upright in the lower right corner.
works.title: The Adoration of the Kings

works.caption: Tall mooring poles cut across the view of Santa Maria della Salute, whose domes and adjoining buildings appear in blue, pink and yellow. Small dark boats lie among the poles on the left. Short strokes of turquoise, lavender, rose and gold spread across the canal, breaking the buildings' reflections into ripples.
works.title: Grand Canal, Venice

works.caption: Christ, in pink and blue with a halo, looks down, one hand on his chest. Below him a woman has sunk to the floor in a pale blue bodice and a wide gold skirt, a jewelled chain hanging loose at her breast. A woman in a white veil holds her hand and points towards him, while men and women crowd round. At the left a naked child slips behind a robe beside a dog's head, in front of white columns and a curving courtyard.
works.title: The Conversion of Mary Magdalene

works.caption: A large red field fills the upper right, separated by black bars from two pale rectangles on the left and a broad pale strip below. A blue block occupies the lower-left corner. At the lower right, a narrow white rectangle sits above a yellow one, divided by a short, thick black bar.
works.title: Composition II in Red, Blue, and Yellow

works.caption: Gondolas, rowing boats and moored sailing vessels crowd the water in the foreground, their oarsmen standing to row, while a gondola with a black cabin is rowed across the middle of the canal. On the left the domed church of Santa Maria della Salute rises above a broad flight of steps on the quay, and tall palaces line the canal at right under a blue sky with white clouds.
works.title: The Entrance to the Grand Canal, Venice

works.caption: Gondolas and a richly decorated covered barge cross the green-blue Grand Canal. The pink facade of Santa Croce rises beside the quay on the right, while pale buildings line the opposite bank. A dome and bell towers mark the distant bend, beneath a broad blue sky crossed by low bands of white cloud.
works.title: Venice: Upper Reaches of the Grand Canal facing Santa Croce

works.caption: A pale house with red-orange roofs and a pointed turret stands behind dense riverside trees. Tall, narrow trees rise beside it into a light blue sky. Across the lower half, dark green water reflects the foliage and pale walls in broad vertical patches, interrupted by short horizontal strokes near the bank.
works.title: Along the Banks of the Marne

works.caption: A shaft of moonlight illuminates Endymion's sleeping body as a winged youth lifts the branches above him. The Louvre identifies this figure as Zephyr; Girodet contrasts the sleeper's smooth, pale skin with the dense darkness of leaves and rock.
works.collection: Department of Paintings of the Louvre
works.title: The Sleep of Endymion

works.caption: A nude woman reclines on a blue couch with her back to us, looking over her shoulder from under a striped turban hung with gold tassels. She leans on blue cushions above rumpled white sheets and a fur, holding a peacock-feather fan in a hand that rests on her bent leg. A blue curtain patterned in red and gold hangs at right, beside a smoking metal stand and a long pipe.
works.collection: Department of Paintings of the Louvre
works.title: Grande Odalisque

works.caption: Charles V stands full length, a green curtain pulled aside at the left and a dark brown wall behind. He wears a black hat with a white feather, a fur-lined silvery cape, an embroidered golden-brown doublet and white legwear from knee to toe. His right hand grips a gilded hilt hung with a white tassel; his left rests on the neck of a large pale dog, just behind its dark collar, and the dog lifts its muzzle towards him.
works.title: Portrait of Charles V with a Dog

works.caption: Rebecca stands in blue with a hand on her chest as Eliezer addresses her beside the well. Around them, women carry and fill water jars; Poussin links their varied poses through bright draperies, gestures and the orderly lines of the architecture.
works.collection: Department of Paintings of the Louvre
works.title: Eliezer and Rebecca

works.caption: Cleopatra, in a deep blue dress, stands with her attendants on a stone quay as a man in red approaches. Workers handle small boats at the water's edge, beneath the tall masts of ships on the left. A columned building and trees rise on the right, while low golden light stretches across the harbor toward a hazy horizon.
works.collection: Department of Paintings of the Louvre
works.title: Cleopatra Disembarking at Tarsus

works.caption: A blue tiled roof stands beside thatched cottages, with garden walls cutting across the foreground. Van Gogh varies his strokes from the roofs' close-set lines to the curling movement of trees and shrubs, making the village seem full of restless energy.
works.title: Houses at Auvers

works.caption: In the foreground a princess in a blue dress, a red mantle billowing behind her, rushes toward us, one hand thrust out. Behind her a dead man lies on the grass. Further back, an armoured rider on a pale horse drives his lance into a dragon's jaws, below walls and a burst of light in the clouds with a small figure at its centre.
works.title: Saint George and the Dragon

works.caption: The Virgin stands holding the Child before a red cloth patterned in gold, her dark blue mantle falling onto a small fringed carpet. On the left a monk in a white habit kneels with his hands together, and a saint in red and green rests a hand on his shoulder. On the right a saint in a dark hooded mantle holds a gold crown. Through the arches, hills and trees appear on one side and a riverside town with a bridge on the other, above a tiled floor.
works.title: The Virgin and Child with St. Barbara, St. Elizabeth, and Jan Vos

works.caption: Thomas Cromwell sits facing left in a black cap and a black gown with a broad brown fur collar. One hand grips a small white paper and wears a ring set with a green-blue stone. On the green-covered table lie letters, a red wax seal, a gilded book set with stones, a quill and scissors. Behind him are wood panelling and a dark blue patterned wall covering.
works.title: Thomas Cromwell

works.caption: A tall woman in a pink dress and a white robe patterned in blue and gold looks upward, a small sun above her head and one foot on a globe. Beside her a bearded man wrapped in a lion's skin looks down. At his feet a winged child gazes up, and crowns and pearls lie on the floor.
works.title: Allegory of Wisdom and Strength

works.caption: The Christ Child sits astride a white lamb and looks up toward Mary, who bends down to support him. Joseph leans over them, grasping a long staff with both hands. Mary's red dress and blue mantle face Joseph's blue tunic and ochre cloak, against a landscape of buildings, trees, water and distant blue hills.
works.title: The Holy Family with a Lamb

works.caption: Mary, in a red dress with an olive-gold sleeve and a blue cloth over her knees, sits looking down at the Child on her lap. He leans into her, one hand at her neckline, and looks out at the viewer. She holds his back with one hand and his foot with the other. Behind her, jars and a bottle stand on a shelf in a dark room.
works.title: Madonna d'Orleans

works.caption: Adonis sleeps with his head in Venus's lap as she holds a small fan above him. Cupid restrains one of the hunting dogs while another rests beneath the hunter; orange clothing and violet patterned silk glow against the surrounding trees.
works.title: Venus and Adonis

works.caption: Félix Fénéon appears in left profile, wearing an ochre coat and extending a pale flower. His other hand holds a black top hat, gloves and a cane. Behind him, wedges of curving stripes, circles, scrolls and yellow stars radiate from a point near his shoulder, built from small contrasting touches of color.
works.title: Opus 217. Against the Enamel of a Background Rhythmic with Beats and Angles, Tones, and Tints, Portrait of M. Félix Fénéon in 1890

works.caption: A pregnant woman bows her head above an exposed breast, one hand raised near her face. A skull peers from beside her belly. Her long garment spreads downward in red, gold and multicolored circles and spirals, enclosing three bowed female heads with raised hands against a dark, gold-flecked ground.
works.title: Hope II

works.caption: A soccer player's body merges with overlapping curves and angular planes of blue, violet, red-brown and ochre. A rounded calf remains recognizable near the center, surrounded by darker forms. Pale blue, white and yellow wedges cut across the composition, with small strokes of contrasting color covering the surface.
works.title: Dynamism of a Soccer Player

works.caption: Two women in long violet and dark green coats, pale fur collars and elaborate hats stand among men in dark suits and hats. Their pink faces and elongated bodies are outlined with sharp, dark strokes. A man at the right leans forward beside the blue street edge, while a broad pink pavement narrows into the crowded background.
works.title: Street, Berlin

works.caption: A cat's broad face fills the picture, with long pale eyes, green irises and narrow dark pupils. Fine lines trace its pointed ears, cheeks and whiskers around a red, heart-shaped nose. A small pink bird appears between the eyes on its forehead, against washes of ochre, rose and blue-green.
works.title: Cat and Bird

works.caption: Tehamana faces us in a high-collared dress striped in blue and white, with white flowers in her dark hair and a red flower at one ear, holding a pale pink fan across her body. Behind her, gold glyph-like signs run across the upper wall, and at left stands a female deity figure above the painted words of the title. Two ripe red and orange fruits lie at lower left.
works.title: Merahi metua no Tehamana

works.caption: A blonde woman sits with crossed legs on layered rugs, wearing a sheer wrap and gold jewelry. A bare-breasted woman kneels beside her with a chain in her hands, while a dark-haired woman in pale sleeves sits at the right. A fourth figure faces away beside a decorated chest in the dim background.
works.title: Parisiennes in Algerian Costume or Harem

works.caption: Jane Morris sits among the branches of a sycamore, a book open on her lap and honeysuckle held above its pages. Her gaze drifts to the side; the deep green folds of her dress echo the dense leaves that enclose her.
works.title: The Day Dream

works.caption: Lucrezia sits facing out in a red dress with puffed, ruffled sleeves and pale, finely pleated cloth filling the neckline. Pearls with a round pendant and a long chain hang across her chest, and a row of stones marks her waist. One hand rests on an open book in her lap, the other on the arm of her chair. The background is almost black.
works.title: Portrait of Lucrezia Panciatichi

works.caption: Labille-Guiard sits before an easel in a pale blue satin dress and a broad hat trimmed with ribbons and feathers. She holds a palette and brushes while two pupils stand behind her green chair. Sculpted figures emerge from the dark background, and the shining folds of her skirt extend across the wooden floor.
works.title: Self-Portrait with Two Pupils

works.caption: A young woman in a white dress with a pink sash looks toward the viewer, one hand resting on a drawing board tilted across her lap. A pink garment hangs over her chair. Light enters through a large window with a broken pane, beyond which two figures stand beside a railing.
works.title: Marie Joséphine Charlotte du Val d'Ognes (1786–1868)

works.caption: Mary turns her face towards us while the Christ Child looks upwards. A red hanging cloth sets off her deep blue mantle, and a narrow view of buildings, fields and distant mountains opens beside the two figures.
works.title: Madonna and Child

works.caption: Mary lifts a white cloth around the infant Christ as shepherds gather with raised hands beneath a stone arch. Bright pink, yellow and green garments stand out against the dark setting. Winged children carry a curling banner overhead, while a white lamb lies beside a staff at the front.
works.title: The Adoration of the Shepherds

works.caption: Van Gogh faces the viewer beneath a broad yellow straw hat, wearing a blue-gray coat over a white collar. Short strokes of yellow, orange, green and blue describe his face and beard. Curving marks follow the hat brim and coat, while pale blue and pink strokes spread across the background.
works.title: Self-Portrait with a Straw Hat

works.caption: In this ceiling design, Apollo stands in a golden glow beneath a broad expanse of pale sky. Horses, winged figures and other deities gather on banks of cloud. Groups representing the continents line the edges, surrounded by a painted architectural border with white figures and gold ornament.
works.title: Allegory of the Planets and Continents

works.caption: Tall sunflowers with broad green leaves rise through a garden packed with smaller blossoms. Yellow flower heads cluster near the upper edge, while red, orange, blue and white flowers spread below them. Dense strokes of green fill the spaces between stems, leaving no visible sky or horizon.
works.title: Cottage Garden with Sunflowers

works.caption: A dark-haired nude reclines across a red couch, her arms raised around her head and her face turned toward the viewer. Dark outlines trace her pale body against the patterned upholstery. White cushions appear beneath her head and legs, while her hands and feet extend beyond the edges of the canvas.
works.title: Reclining Nude

works.caption: A man and a small dog sit beside dark water under a heavy band of storm clouds. Sunlight picks out the rocky foreground and narrow grassy shores. A rower crosses the inlet, a white sail rises farther away, and a thin bolt of lightning appears beneath the clouds at the left.
works.title: Approaching Thunder Storm

works.caption: Warm sunlight falls across the Parthenon's surviving columns and broken roofline beneath a clear blue-gray sky. Fallen blocks, column drums and carved fragments cover the rocky foreground. A tall damaged column rises close to the right edge, and a small figure stands among the ruins beyond it.
works.title: The Parthenon

works.caption: Rooks gather around bulky nests in the bare branches of white-barked birches, with several birds flying across the cloudy sky. Snow covers the foreground beside brown thaw water that reflects the trees. Beyond a wooden fence and low roofs, a church bell tower rises above a flat landscape streaked with snow.
works.title: The Rooks Have Returned

works.caption: In a room with a red floor, Mary kneels at a wooden prie-dieu with an open book on it, facing out of the picture with both palms raised. On the right a winged angel in blue kneels with a stem of white lilies and lifts one arm high, and above him God appears in red on a cloud, framed by an arch. A striped cat runs across the floor between them, and beyond the arch lies a terrace and a garden of tall trees.
works.title: Recanati Annunciation

works.caption: A woman in an orange-and-green dress with puffed sleeves looks toward the viewer beneath a curled headdress. She holds up a drawing of Lucretia and gestures with her other hand. A Latin inscription and a small yellow flower lie on the red-covered table, beside an empty wooden chair.
works.title: Portrait of a Woman inspired by Lucretia

works.caption: Saint Francis stands in a hooded brown habit, his eyes lifted and his hands hidden inside the sleeves held across his waist. Light falls on one side of his face and the broad folds of his robe. A knotted rope hangs down the front against an almost black background.
works.title: Saint Francis of Assisi according to Pope Nicholas V's Vision

works.caption: Newton, nude and muscular, sits hunched on a rock crusted with orange, green and blue growths, apparently on the sea bed. He bends low over a scroll unrolled on the ground, holding a pair of compasses to it with one hand and touching the drawn diagram with the other, a white cloth falling from his shoulder. The background is a deep, speckled blue-black.
works.title: Newton

works.caption: Two nude figures lie embracing on a crumpled white sheet, their heads close together at the upper right. One figure's back faces the viewer, with a hand spread across the shoulder. Dark contours outline the bodies and the sheet's angular folds against a roughly brushed yellow-green background.
works.title: The Embrace

works.caption: A figure with a skull for a head and a yellow-brown body presses its teeth to the mouth and chin of a pale nude woman from behind. One of its hands holds her long reddish-brown hair, the other her side. Her head tips back and a tear runs down her cheek. She lifts a long white cloth in both hands; a dark tree trunk stands at right.
works.title: Death and the Woman

works.caption: Gondolas and masted boats crowd a blue-green canal beneath a pale, cloud-streaked sky. Tall waterfront buildings line the left bank, their façades reflected in the water. At the right, figures gather on broad church steps, while a covered gondola casts a dark reflection in the foreground.
works.title: Venice, from the Porch of Madonna della Salute

works.caption: Cardinal Richelieu appears three times against a dark background: facing the viewer between two inward-facing profiles. Red robes and skullcaps, broad white collars and blue ribbons repeat across the canvas. Grey hair frames his face, with a curled moustache and pointed beard visible in each view.
works.title: Triple Portrait of Cardinal de Richelieu

works.caption: A young woman with braided red-gold hair looks out at the viewer. A dark fur-lined cloak covers her left shoulder and her lower body, leaving her right breast bare. Her right hand presses the fur to her chest and her bare left forearm lies folded across her body below. She wears pearls in her hair, pearl drop earrings, a pearl necklace, a jewelled gold bracelet and a ring, against a plain brown background.
works.title: Girl in a Fur

works.caption: Juliette Récamier sits sideways on a cushioned chair, her white dress falling towards her bare feet. A golden shawl gathers around her lap, while a hanging cloth and an arched garden view frame Gérard's quietly poised sitter.
works.title: Portrait de Juliette Récamier

works.caption: Alfonso d'Avalos stands in dark armour patterned with broad gold bands, his bearded face turned slightly to the right. A gold collar and pendant encircle his neck. At the lower left, a page looks up while holding an open helmet; bright reflections mark the breastplate, shoulder and arm.
works.title: Portrait of Alfonso d'Avalos, Marchese del Vasto, in Armor with a Page

works.caption: Jane Seymour is shown half-length against a blue background, her face turned a little to our left and her hands clasped at her waist. Her red dress has wide gold-latticed oversleeves, grey undersleeves patterned with foliage, and white lace-edged cuffs. Pearls and gold-set dark stones edge her angular hood and square neckline. A gold pendant with a pearl drop hangs at her throat, and a brooch spelling IHS in dark stones, with three pearls below, is pinned to her bodice.
works.title: Jane Seymour

works.caption: Giuseppe Verdi faces the viewer beneath a tall black top hat. Grey curls, a spreading moustache and a white beard frame his face. A white scarf with blue and ochre stripes crosses his dark coat; loose diagonal marks remain visible in the grey-brown background, beneath a dated inscription at the upper right.
works.collection: Galleria Nazionale d'Arte Moderna e Contemporanea di Roma
works.title: Portrait of Giuseppe Verdi

works.caption: Bacchus holds out a shallow glass of red wine, his dark curls crowned with grape leaves and fruit. White cloth crosses one shoulder and gathers around his waist, where his other hand holds a black ribbon. A wine carafe and a basket of mottled fruit fill the foreground against a plain brown background.
works.title: Bacchus

works.caption: Mary sits on an ornate pointed throne, holding the pink-robed Christ Child on her lap. Her deep blue-green mantle falls in broad folds across her knees. Haloed angels and saints crowd either side; two kneeling angels present flower-filled vases at the foot of the throne, all set against a gold background.
works.title: Madonna Enthroned (Ognissanti Maestà)

works.caption: The three Wyndham sisters gather on a patterned sofa in pale gowns whose folds spread across the foreground. Two look towards the viewer, while the sister seated higher at the right turns to the left. White flowers fill the lower right, and a large gold-framed portrait hangs above them in the shadowed room.
works.title: The Wyndham Sisters: Lady Elcho, Mrs. Adeane, and Mrs. Tennant

works.caption: A mother holds a standing, unclothed child close beside her face. The child's hand rests at her neck, while she supports the child's thigh. An oval mirror in a dark frame rises behind their heads. Broad blue and white strokes describe the mother's sleeves and the fabric gathered across her lap.
works.title: Mother and Child (The Oval Mirror)

works.caption: A field worker leans forward on a hoe, both hands resting on its handle and his mouth slightly open. He wears a pale shirt, dark cap, blue trousers and heavy clogs. Stones and clods cover the foreground; small figures and rising smoke appear across the distant field beneath a pale sky.
works.title: Man with a Hoe

works.caption: Cotopaxi sends a dark plume into a broad red-orange cloud at the left of a glowing sun. The sun casts a bright reflection across a distant lake. Below, water plunges into a mist-filled gorge between steep cliffs, with trees and tiny figures along the foreground's left edge.
works.title: Cotopaxi

works.caption: Four simplified nude figures occupy broad vertical bands of green, black, cream and blue. Dark outlines divide their grey bodies into angular shapes with pink patches. The leftmost figure stretches an arm overhead beside large leaves, while the two figures at the right have blank oval faces.
works.title: Bathers by a River

works.caption: Nude women sit, recline and stand within a crowded circular composition. In the foreground, a woman wearing a wrapped headdress holds a stringed instrument with her back to the viewer. At the right, another reclines on a patterned cushion with her arms overhead; small decorated vessels occupy a low table below.
works.collection: Department of Paintings of the Louvre
works.title: The Turkish Bath

works.caption: A bearded priest in a tall cap joins Mary's and Joseph's hands as Joseph holds a ring to her outstretched hand. Women stand at the left and men holding rods at the right, where a young man bends a rod across his knee. Behind them a square laid out in light and tan bands leads back to a many-sided domed temple on broad steps, its open central doorway showing sky beyond.
works.title: The Marriage of the Virgin

works.caption: Nude figures tumble through the centre, their limbs tangled among winged and animal-headed demons. A shaft of pale light descends from angels at the upper left, contrasting with red-orange flames below. Dark creatures crowd the lower edge, gripping and dragging bodies into the shadowed foreground.
works.title: The Fall of the Damned

works.caption: Mary, in a red dress and a blue mantle lined with green, looks down as she holds the Child against her. One hand rests on his body and the other supports him from below; a pale cloth wraps his middle and his bare feet hang free. He glances sideways, out of the picture. Thin gold halos circle both heads against a black background.
works.title: Madonna del Granduca

works.caption: Three figures flee along a rocky ledge as a blaze engulfs the cities behind them. A jagged bolt of lightning cuts through the darkness, while the enormous curve of fire makes the people seem small and vulnerable.
works.title: The Destruction of Sodom And Gomorrah

works.caption: Sarah Siddons turns her head to the left beneath a broad black hat with dark feathers. A blue sash crosses her striped gown, and a yellow mantle wraps her shoulders. Her hands rest around a brown fur muff in her lap, while red drapery fills the background.
works.title: Mrs Siddons

works.caption: A young woman with long, crimped red-gold hair tilts her head and glances off to the right. Her loose white shift has slipped down on one side, baring the upper part of one breast. One hand holds a pink patterned mantle against her body; the other, low at the left, holds a small bunch of flowers. The background is dark.
works.title: Flora

works.caption: Pale sunlight breaks through clouds above snowy mountain peaks and a still lake. Waterfalls descend the dark cliffs at the left and in the distance. Deer stand at the wooded shore on the right, while small ducks gather among the foreground reeds.
works.title: Among the Sierra Nevada, California

works.caption: Jacob lies asleep on the ground, his head resting on one hand beside a dark rock. His other hand lies open in front of him, and his sandalled feet extend to the left. A broken tree trunk rises behind his brown clothing, beneath a cloudy sky streaked with pale golden light.
works.title: Jacob’s Dream

works.caption: A sower steps across a dark field, extending one hand to scatter seed while the other holds a bag at his waist. His brown jacket, blue trousers and wrapped lower legs fill the foreground. Along the pale horizon, a much smaller worker follows a team of animals.
works.title: The Sower

works.caption: A man with a long white beard, in a black hooded cloak, walks head down with his hands clasped. Behind him a barefoot man in ragged clothes, crouching inside a ringed globe topped by a cross, cuts a red purse from the cloak with a small knife. Small spiked objects lie on the path; a shepherd, a flock and a windmill stand in the distance. Two lines of Gothic lettering run beneath the round scene.
works.title: The Misanthrope

works.caption: A split carcass, a pale hairless head and loops of pale sausage hang over a table piled with food: a half-skinned head, trotters, small pies, fish on a plate and a broad bowl of white liquid. Two dead fowl lie across a basket at right. Through an opening at the back, a woman on a donkey holds a baby and reaches out towards a boy holding up a bowl.
works.title: A Meat Stall with the Holy Family Giving Alms

works.caption: A young woman in strict profile faces left against a plain, mottled buff ground. A thin band crosses her forehead; at the back her hair is held in a lattice-patterned cap and falls in a long tail bound with crossing bands. Her dark bodice has a knotwork border at the shoulder, with reddish-brown fabric beneath.
works.title: La Bella Principessa

works.artist: Lucas Cranach the Elder and workshop
works.artistSort: Cranach, Lucas the Elder and workshop
works.caption: Adam and Eve stand nude before a dark wall of foliage, with a tree trunk at the right. Eve holds an apple to Adam's mouth and reaches up with her other arm to a branch, one leg bent back against the trunk. Adam looks out at us, a hand on her shoulder, and holds a leafy branch across them both. A grey snake coils on the branch above, and apples hang at the top left and on the right.
works.title: Adam and Eve

works.caption: Henry Pelham looks to the left while holding a fine chain above a glass of water. A small squirrel sits on the polished table beside him, with its reflection visible below. His dark coat has a pink collar and white cuffs; broad red drapery hangs behind his head.
works.title: A Boy with a Flying Squirrel (Henry Pelham)

works.caption: From a rooftop terrace at the lower right, Juliet and her nurse overlook a crowded Venetian square. Fireworks light the sky beyond the domes and bell tower.
works.title: Juliet and her Nurse

works.caption: Old women are brought to a large rectangular pool from rocky hills at the left: in horse-drawn carts, on horseback, on a stretcher, on a man's back and in a wheelbarrow. Nude women bathe around a tall fountain column. At the right, young women climb out, a richly dressed man greets them, and one stands naked in the opening of a red tent; beyond, couples dance and feast at a white-covered table.
works.title: The Fountain of Youth

works.caption: The Infanta Margarita stands between two attendants in pale, full-skirted dresses. At the left, Velázquez holds a brush and palette beside the back of a large canvas. A dog lies in the foreground, while a man stands in a brightly lit doorway and the royal couple appear in the rear mirror.
works.title: Las Meninas

works.caption: A young woman inclines her head and looks down to the left, wrapped in a loosely painted shawl. Warm colour touches her face against the cool blue-grey background, while broken strokes soften the boundaries between clothing, light and air.
works.title: The Milkmaid of Bordeaux

works.caption: Germanicus lies propped against white pillows beneath a dark blue canopy. Helmeted soldiers crowd the left side of his bed, one raising a finger while another reaches toward him. At the right, a seated woman covers her face with a cloth, surrounded by children and other mourners in an arched interior.
works.title: The Death of Germanicus

works.caption: Van Gogh reaches towards his easel with a brush, a vase of sunflowers close beside him. Gauguin compresses the studio into broad areas of yellow, green and blue, setting the painter's concentrated profile against an almost flat background.
works.title: Vincent van Gogh Painting Sunflowers

works.caption: Christ raises a hand over the bread on a white-covered table. Two disciples sit beside him, one mostly seen from behind and the other leaning forward with a hand at the table’s edge. An innkeeper and an older woman stand behind them, their faces and pale headcloths lit against the dark background.
works.title: Supper at Emmaus

works.caption: Thick reddish-brown cypress trunks twist across a gold ground, their branches spreading beyond the screen edges. Small clusters of green foliage follow the thinner limbs. Blue water and angular grey-green rocks appear through openings between the trees and broad bands of gold.
works.title: Cypress Trees

works.caption: A dense crowd gathers beneath tall trees, with black top hats scattered among pale dresses and bonnets. Two seated women in yellow occupy the left foreground; children stand near the centre. Curving metal chairs and a fallen umbrella fill the lower right, while distant faces merge into small strokes of colour.
works.title: Music in the Tuileries Gardens

works.caption: Peter sits in a red upholstered chair, looking up at Alexei, who stands beside a table with his head lowered. Papers, an inkwell and a quill lie on the patterned table covering; another sheet has fallen onto the black-and-white tiled floor. Framed paintings and empty wooden chairs line the dim room.
works.title: Peter the Great Interrogating the Tsarevich Alexei Petrovich at Peterhof

works.caption: A young man in black, with a gold cap, holds a ring in one hand and a young woman's fingers in the other. She wears a red dress, a white ruffled collar, a pearl necklace and a dark cameo. Behind them a smiling winged child with a quiver of arrows sets a brown yoke on both their shoulders; sprigs of leaves grow from it, against a dark background.
works.title: Marsilio Cassotti and His Bride Faustina

works.caption: A young man in a black beret and a black cape over shimmering red silk sleeves sits at a table covered with a patterned carpet, holding a partly unfolded letter. On the table stand a clear glass vase of carnations and other sprigs, a small gilt cylinder, and a round metal box of coins beside quills in holders. The green plank wall behind him carries shelves with books, a hanging pair of scales, a gilded ball, keys, and letters tucked behind wooden battens.
works.title: The Merchant Georg Gisze

works.caption: The Lady of Shalott sits beside her loom in a red dress, both arms raised behind her head. A woven design stretches across the frame, with a shuttle resting on her lap and balls of coloured yarn on the tiled floor. The large circular mirror behind her reflects a river, an arched bridge and pale buildings with red roofs.
works.title: "I am half sick of shadows" said the Lady of Shalott

works.caption: Ophelia sits sideways on a sloping tree trunk above dark water covered with lily pads and white flowers. She raises both hands toward her long reddish hair, where red and white flowers are tucked. Her pale dress has jewelled cuffs and a gold belt; small flowers lie across her lap amid reeds and overhanging branches.
works.title: Ophelia

works.caption: A seated woman looks down at an open music book on her lap, holding a violin upright by its neck and lifting a page with her other hand. Her pale dress has a lavender bodice and gathered sleeves, with a matching ribbon in her hair. A bow lies across her lap, and a gold-toned upholstered chair stands against dark architectural panelling.
works.title: Portrait of a violinist

works.caption: Men on a crowded wooden raft reach toward a tiny ship on the horizon, with one standing high above the others to wave a cloth. Bodies lie across the foreground planks, while a seated older man supports a limp figure at the left. A mast, ropes and billowing sail rise behind them beneath dark clouds and a pale strip of sky.
works.collection: Department of Paintings of the Louvre
works.title: The Raft of the Medusa

works.caption: A dark-haired man's bare-shouldered bust, cut off below the collarbones, sits in a round opening in a pale wall. His face is turned toward the left and his eyes look the same way. Orange-gold Latin capitals run round the mottled green disc behind him. In the corners are a gold patch of stars with the sign of Leo (upper left), the date 1526 and Dürer's monogram (upper right), a red shield with green clover leaves (lower left), and a helmet with a small figure holding clover sprigs (lower right).
works.title: Portrait of Johannes Kleberger

works.caption: Christ’s pale body and white loincloth stand out on a cross tilted steeply across the dark scene. Men beneath him brace and push the wood, including an armoured figure seen from behind and a man in a blue cap beside Christ’s feet. A richly dressed man wearing a pale turban watches from the left.
works.title: Raising of the Cross

works.caption: Light hidden behind Christ throws his profile into deep silhouette and illuminates the astonished disciple across the table. A smaller pool of light picks out a servant in the back room, extending Rembrandt's drama of recognition into the surrounding darkness.
works.title: The Supper at Emmaus

works.caption: A man turns his head over his shoulder beneath a broad, folded dark cap with long feathers. Light catches one eye, his curled moustache and the bright metal gorget around his neck, while the brim shadows the other side of his face. A sword hilt appears beside his ochre jacket and reddish cloak against a cracked grey wall.
works.title: Man in a gorget and a plumed cap

works.caption: Judas kneels at the right with his hands clasped near his face, while silver coins lie scattered across a bright patch of floor. A richly dressed seated priest extends one hand toward him, surrounded by standing figures. Light also falls on a large open book at the left, while the arched passage behind the group remains dark.
works.title: Judas Repentant, Returning the Pieces of Silver

works.caption: Jan Rijcksen turns from a ship drawing on a green-covered table as Griet Jans offers him a small note. He holds a pair of dividers, with his other hand resting on the drawing. She keeps one hand on the door’s ring handle; their white collars stand out against dark clothes, with papers, an inkwell and a quill at the left.
works.title: Portrait of Jan Rijcksen and his Wife Griet Jans

works.caption: A small group rests beside a bright fire beneath trees at the left, with nearby figures and animals emerging from the darkness. The fire and seated figures reflect in the water across the foreground. A large building with tiny lit windows stands on the distant hillside below a broad, pale opening in the cloudy night sky.
works.title: Landscape with the Rest on the Flight into Egypt

works.caption: A skater glides toward the right with his arms folded and one leg stretched behind him. His black hat, coat and stockings contrast with a white neckcloth and the pale grey-green ice. Curving skate marks cross the foreground beneath a muted grey and pink sky, with a low, dark hillside at the left.
works.title: The Skating Minister

works.caption: A small figure bends in a green meadow beneath a turbulent sky. Van Gogh sets short, bright strokes across the field against broad curling bands of cloud, with trees and red-roofed buildings marking the distant edge of the open space.
works.title: Landscape Under a Stormy Sky

works.caption: Saint Bartholomew sits in a brown robe, looking toward the left with a knife held across his lap. Light picks out his lined forehead, nose, hand and white cuff, while his beard and the folds of his clothing recede into shadow. The pale blade curves against the dark cloth beside a wooden chair arm at the right.
works.title: Saint Bartholomew

works.caption: A conjurer in a tall black hat and red gown stands at the right, holding up a small round object between finger and thumb, a wicker basket at his belt. On the table in front of him are two cups, small balls, a wand, a striped cone and a frog. Across from him a crowd watches. One man bends far over the table, while at the far left a man in spectacles looks skyward and holds a purse at the bent man's waist. A small dog in a hood and belled harness sits by the table.
works.title: The Conjurer

works.caption: In this archival photograph, a procession of richly dressed horsemen fills a narrow passage beneath steep rocks. The foreground rider sits on a pale horse with an elaborate bridle and breast strap. Behind the clustered hats and fur-trimmed garments, plants cling to the rock face and distant towers rise into an open sky.
works.collection: Original stolen 1934; copy in St Bavo's Cathedral, Ghent
works.title: The Just Judges

works.caption: Mary nurses the child beneath a dark canopy of trees, her blue cloak spreading across the rocky foreground. A basket and flask rest on the ledge beside her; farther back, Joseph leans his head on his hand beneath a straw hat. A donkey stands at the left, overlooking a pale town and distant hills.
works.collection: Royal Museum of Fine Arts Antwerp
works.title: Rest on the Flight into Egypt

works.caption: Christ’s pale body stretches across white cloth in the foreground, his head resting against Mary’s blue cloak. Mary opens both arms while a red-robed figure supports Christ’s wrist. At the right, one angel presses dark fabric to its face beneath a broad gray wing; another clasps its hands above.
works.collection: Royal Museum of Fine Arts Antwerp
works.title: The lamentation over the dead Christ

works.caption: Masked figures crowd around a pale face beneath a tall black top hat. Pink, yellow and white masks show narrow eyes, red lips and dark open mouths above green, ochre and red costumes. At the right, a red-cloaked figure carries a small doll, while a skull-like mask peers out beneath a straw hat.
works.collection: Royal Museum of Fine Arts Antwerp
works.title: The Intrigue

works.caption: Catherine leans against a large wooden wheel and looks up towards a golden break in the clouds, one hand pressed to her chest and the other resting on the red folds over her hip. Round dark studs are set into the wheel's rim. She wears green sleeves, a blue-grey dress and a red mantle lined with yellow. Behind her, still water reflects trees along a low rural shore.
works.title: Saint Catherine of Alexandria

works.caption: Francis kneels on a rocky ledge with his wounded palms open, his brown habit parted at the wound in his side. Above him at the left, a winged crucified figure appears amid golden clouds. A companion raises an arm below, while a skull and open book lie among the rocks and foliage at the lower right.
works.title: Saint Francis of Assisi Receiving the Stigmata

works.caption: A reaper bends at the left of a yellow wheatfield, surrounded by broad curls of cut grain and upright stalks. A low stone wall separates the field from pale buildings and blue-green hills. Above them, a round yellow sun hangs in a greenish sky filled with slanting strokes.
works.title: The Wheatfield behind Saint Paul's Hospital with a Reaper

works.caption: Saint Casilda gathers roses in the folds of her richly patterned gown and turns her face towards us. Zurbarán gives gold ornament, pale cloak and red sleeves distinct textures, making the full-length figure stand out sharply against an empty dark background.
works.title: Saint Casilda

works.caption: Antonia Zárate faces the viewer beneath a pale headscarf edged with blue and gold. Dark curls fall across her forehead, and a translucent scarf wraps loosely around her neck and chest. Broad pale fur trim borders her reddish-brown coat, while the dark background leaves her large eyes and softly lit face prominent.
works.title: Portrait of the Actress Antonia Zarate

works.caption: A red-and-cream striped balloon fills the center of a blue sky crossed by white clouds. Fine ropes descend to a small basket, where a passenger leans outward beside a trailing red cloth. Birds fly below at the left, and a narrow strip of treetops and earth runs along the bottom.
works.title: The Balloon

works.caption: Mary holds white cloth beneath the infant Christ at the lower right, while shepherds kneel and bend toward him. A woman approaches from the left with a tray of fruit, her blue drapery billowing. Above, flower-bearing cherubs hover among broken beams and fluted columns; a distant angel and shepherds appear through the opening behind.
works.title: Adoration of the Shepherds

works.caption: Broad arcs of yellow, white and red surround a pale center, with violet at the upper right and darker brown near the lower left. A faint seated figure appears above the middle. Below, small rounded heads and loosely drawn forms gather around a dark mound, while thin curves cross the golden foreground.
works.title: Light and Colour (Goethe's Theory) – The Morning after the Deluge – Moses Writing the Book of Genesis

works.caption: A ship’s masts rise at the left beneath dark red clouds, while a pale sun casts a bright vertical reflection across the rough sea. Hands and a shackled leg emerge among chains in the foreground, with birds and fish crowding the waves. Red, gold and gray strokes spread across the water beneath the luminous sky.
works.title: The Slave Ship

works.caption: A tall standing stone rises from the snowy foreground beside a calm blue-gray fjord. Small dark birds gather among the rocks and bare shrubs nearby. Across the water, steep cliffs and snow-covered mountains recede beneath a pale pink sky, with warm light touching the highest peaks and the stone’s tip.
works.collection: National Museum of Art, Architecture and Design
works.title: Winter at the Sognefjord

works.caption: Yellow buildings with green shutters stand beneath a deep blue sky, their reddish roofs rising above the street corner. Small figures walk past the doors and along the road at the right. Mounds of earth and a trench cross the foreground, while a distant train sends pale curls of smoke above a bridge.
works.title: The Yellow House

works.caption: A pale, fair-haired woman faces right, holding a gray machine gun across her chest. Long ammunition belts hang over her dark red clothing. Helmeted soldiers crowd beneath her, their faces partly hidden in shadow, while red and orange strokes rise behind them against a nearly black background.
works.title: Madonna with Machine Gun

works.caption: A tall man in a gray suit holds a pipe near his face above a seated nursing mother and an older woman in a headscarf. Angular faces and heavy clothing fill the narrow canvas beneath a gray sky, dark branches and bands of reddish foliage.
works.title: Refugees

works.caption: A man in a broad black hat raises one hand while holding a woman’s hand in a furnished room. Her green gown spreads across the floor beside a small brown dog. A brass chandelier hangs above them, and the convex mirror on the back wall reflects their backs and two figures at the doorway.
works.title: Arnolfini Portrait

works.caption: Three panels. On the left, angels fall from the sky and Adam and Eve are driven from a garden. In the centre, crowds and riders swarm around a huge cart of hay while strange creatures haul it to the right; on top, people make music beneath Christ in the clouds. On the right, devils climb a ladder up a round tower as flames and smoke rise behind.
works.title: The Haywain Triptych

works.caption: A woman wearing a dense wreath of flowers and foliage holds a flowered staff at the left. Light picks out her face, pearl earring and embroidered gown against a dark, leafy setting. Her other hand gathers pale green drapery across the front of her costume.
works.title: Flora

works.caption: Van Gogh shows himself with a clean-shaven face and swept-back reddish hair against a pale green background. Short strokes of yellow, orange, pink and green model his forehead and cheeks, while blue and violet marks follow the folds of his buttoned jacket.
works.title: Self-portrait without beard

works.caption: Danaë reclines on white and gold bedding, lifting an open hand toward falling gold coins and ribbons. Behind her, Cupid raises both arms to draw back a dark curtain. Bright skin and crumpled fabrics stand out against the deep shadow above the bed.
works.title: Danaë and the Shower of Gold

works.caption: A wave breaks over the raised bow of a fishing boat as men pull at the ropes and damaged sail. Bright foam, pale canvas and yellow clothing stand out beneath an opening in the clouds at the left. Christ sits among the darker figures near the stern on the right.
works.title: The Storm on the Sea of Galilee

works.caption: Paris sits nearly nude on a stool beside a bed, holding a lyre at his left side. Helen stands close in pink and white drapery, leaning her head toward his as he looks up. Blue curtains, carved figures and orange bedding surround them in a classical interior.
works.collection: Department of Paintings of the Louvre
works.title: Paris and Helen

works.caption: A cobalt-blue foal stands in profile against broad hills of red, yellow and green. Dark outlines simplify its rounded body, while the small dedication at the upper right records the picture’s young recipient.
works.title: Little Blue Horse (Children's Picture)

works.caption: Eight-year-old Margarita Teresa stands within the broad outline of her blue and silver dress. Velázquez suggests the gleam of its trim with quick, broken touches, contrasting the formal shape of court clothing with the softness of the child's face.
works.title: Infanta Margarita Teresa in a Blue Dress

works.caption: Christ stands with his arms held behind him, his head bowed beneath a crown of thorns and his waist wrapped in white cloth. Two men flank him while a third crouches in the foreground handling bundled rods. Strong light reveals their bodies against the dark background, with the column rising behind Christ.
works.title: The Flagellation of Christ

works.caption: The young woman turns from the keyboard towards us, with a viola da gamba waiting in the foreground. A landscape decorates the virginal's lid, while the framed picture above her shows a very different musical encounter: Baburen's The Procuress.
works.title: A Young Woman seated at a Virginal

works.caption: Judith walks through a landscape carrying a curved sword and a leafy branch, her pale blue-gray clothing falling in long folds. Behind her, a servant in orange steadies Holofernes’s severed head on her own head. Small figures and buildings appear beyond them, beside a tree at the right.
works.title: The Return of Judith to Bethulia

works.caption: Rembrandt shows himself as an old man in a pale cap, leaning towards us with his head tilted and his mouth half open in a smile, deep creases across his brow and cheeks. A robe with a broad gold-brown band falls over his shoulder against a dark ground. At the far left edge a second figure, only dimly visible, is seen in profile.
works.title: Self-Portrait

works.caption: An angel in a pale robe lifts the Christ Child towards Mary, while a second angel looks up from behind. The Child reaches out with both arms. Mary, in a blue mantle over a rose-red dress, looks down and holds his foot in her hand. Beyond a stone parapet lie rocks, a round building and tall, slender trees.
works.title: Madonna and Child and Two Angels

works.caption: Three nude women embrace beneath a garland of pink and white roses, with the central figure’s back turned toward us. Thin drapery crosses their bodies and hangs from the tree at the left. A fountain pours water at the right, while deer stand in the sunlit landscape beyond.
works.title: The Three Graces

works.caption: Mary holds the Christ Child on her lap inside a circular panel, with three angels on each side of her. Her hand holds up a split pomegranate; the child curls his fingers over the top of it and raises his other hand. Two angels hold open books, the outermost pair carry lilies and garlands of roses, and fine gold rays fall from a disc at the top.
works.title: Madonna of the Pomegranate

works.caption: The Virgin, seen in profile in a red dress and a gold-patterned red headscarf, holds the bare-limbed Christ Child against her chest, his legs hanging over her lap. He tips his head back, eyes turned up and to the right, while she looks down at him. Her blue cape lies over her knees at the right. A second curly-haired boy leans in from the right, a thin cross rising behind the two children's heads. Above, a green curtain is tied back at the top right corner, opening onto pale sky.
works.title: Madonna della tenda

works.caption: Mary sits by an open window and looks down, the Christ Child on her lap gazing up at her. Her hand rests on an open book propped on a white cushion with a gold tassel, and his hand lies on hers. She wears a deep blue mantle with a gold star on the shoulder. Behind the Child a patterned bowl is heaped with fruit, and in his other hand he holds small gold nails, with a gold crown of thorns over that arm.
works.title: Madonna of the Book

works.caption: A woven basket rests on a narrow ledge against a plain ochre background. Pale and dark grapes spill over its rim among apples, pears and figs. Spotted leaves rise behind the fruit, while torn and curling leaves extend beyond the basket on both sides.
works.title: Basket of Fruit

works.caption: Inside a round landscape, a man in a pink robe with an upside-down funnel on his head cuts into the scalp of a stout man strapped into a chair, a pair of clogs beneath it. A man in black holding a metal jug looks on, and a woman with a red book on her head leans on a round table. Gold Gothic lettering and looping gold ribbons fill the black border.
works.title: The Extraction of the Stone of Madness

works.caption: Peter holds both hands against his chest as a helmeted soldier and a woman point toward him. Light catches their faces and hands against a dark background, bringing the three closely grouped figures into sharp focus.
works.title: The Denial of Saint Peter

works.caption: A boy in a red waistcoat leans his head against one hand, resting his elbow on a green-covered table. His other arm stretches down across his lap. Broad patches of white, blue and gray shape his shirt, while a dark curtain frames the seated figure.
works.title: The Boy in the Red Vest

works.caption: Tall trees lean inward above groups of nude bathers gathered beside water. Seated and reclining figures fill the foreground, while others stand beneath the trunks. Blue, green and ochre patches connect the bodies, trees, water and cloud-filled sky.
works.title: Les Grandes Baigneuses

works.caption: David bends over Goliath's body, tying a cord around the hair of the severed head. Light catches the boy's bare shoulder, bent arms and pale clothing, leaving much of the giant and the surrounding space in darkness.
works.title: David and Goliath

works.caption: Giuliano de' Medici turns his head to the right, almost in profile, with his eyes lowered, against a plain blue-green ground. Thick dark wavy hair falls to his neck. A thin white collar shows above a red garment with a grey-edged front opening, and a brownish sleeve appears at lower left.
works.title: Portrait of Giuliano de' Medici

works.caption: Saul lies on a red cloak with his eyes closed and both arms raised beneath a large brown-and-white horse. The animal bends its head and lifts one foreleg as an older attendant holds its bridle. Brightly lit bodies and hands emerge from the dark background.
works.title: Conversion on the Way to Damascus

works.caption: St Mark plunges headfirst out of the sky towards an almost naked man lying on his back among a crowd. A man in a white turban raises a hammer head and a broken handle, and snapped tools and loose cords lie on the floor. At the right a bald, grey-bearded man in red leans out from a raised seat. Columns stand at the left; behind, under a vine-hung pergola, a lattice fence and a pedimented building close the view.
works.title: Miracle of the Slave

works.caption: Joseph’s brothers present a pale tunic to Jacob, who raises one hand from his seat at the right. Two bare-chested figures stand at the left, with three more men gathered behind the garment. A small black-and-white dog faces them beside a patterned red carpet.
works.collection: Royal Monastery of San Lorenzo de El Escorial
works.title: Joseph's Tunic

works.caption: The kneeling king presents his gift to the tightly wrapped Christ Child on Mary's lap. Velázquez draws the figures out of the darkness through lit faces and broad passages of white, gold and red, bringing the sacred gathering close to the viewer.
works.title: Adoration of the Magi

works.caption: Jupiter carries the infant Hercules toward Juno, who reclines on richly draped bedding and raises an arm as milk streams from her breast. Stars appear above her; an eagle and two peacocks occupy the right side. Four winged children hover around the figures and clouds.
works.title: The Origin of the Milky Way

works.caption: Saint Francis bows his head toward a skull held in his hands. Light catches his face, the skull and the torn shoulder of his brown habit against a dark background. A simple wooden cross lies diagonally across the foreground.
works.title: Saint Francis in Meditation

works.caption: Francis kneels with his head bowed and his hands held together near his face. A skull and an open book bearing a crucifix lie before him. Light picks out his brow, hands and the folds of his brown habit, while a broken tree trunk rises behind him in darkness.
works.title: Saint Francis in Meditation

works.caption: A rider in yellow balances on a white horse while an acrobat turns headfirst beside her. At the right, a ringmaster holds a long whip whose line curls across the arena. Rows of spectators sit behind them, and a red-haired clown seen from the back fills the foreground.
works.title: The Circus

works.caption: Raphael looks out at us from behind his companion, a hand resting on the other man's far shoulder. The bearded companion turns his eyes back toward him while pointing out of the picture, a gold-banded sword hilt at the bottom edge beside his other hand.
works.collection: Department of Paintings of the Louvre
works.title: Self-portrait with a friend

works.caption: Three richly dressed kings bring gifts to Mary, who sits with the Child on her lap in front of a ramshackle thatched hut. A half-naked man in a red cloak and tall gold headdress stands in its doorway, and onlookers peer down from the roof and round the far corner. On the side panels a man and a woman in black kneel beside their saints, with hills, a ruined building and a distant town behind them.
works.title: Triptych of the Adoration of the Magi

works.caption: Christ extends an arm toward Lazarus, whose pale body is supported above a hanging burial cloth. One of Lazarus’s hands rises while the other hangs down, and surrounding figures lean toward him or look toward Christ. A vast dark wall fills the space above them; bones and a skull lie below.
works.title: The Raising of Lazarus

works.caption: Blue irises rise among long, curling green leaves, with a white bloom standing out at the left. Orange-brown soil fills the foreground, while smaller yellow flowers dot the greenery behind. Dark outlines trace the petals and leaves within the closely cropped garden view.
works.title: Irises

works.caption: Mary, in a red dress and blue mantle, crouches low between two children. At right the Christ Child sits on a draped rock and points down toward the young John the Baptist, who kneels at left holding a blank scroll. Behind them are hills, a river, ruined buildings and a blue mountain under a deep blue sky.
works.title: Esterhazy Madonna

works.caption: An angel grips Abraham’s knife-bearing wrist and points toward the ram at the right. Abraham holds Isaac’s head down as the boy lies across a rocky ledge with his mouth open. A landscape of trees, buildings and pale sky opens behind the tightly grouped figures.
works.title: Sacrifice of Isaac

works.caption: Greek captives sit and recline across the foreground, with a woman and infant lying at the lower right. A turbaned rider on a rearing horse towers above them beside a bound woman. Smoke rises over distant buildings and scattered figures beneath a broad, clouded sky.
works.collection: Department of Paintings of the Louvre
works.title: The Massacre at Chios

works.caption: Medusa’s severed head fills a round shield, her eyes wide and mouth open. Coiling snakes surround her face, and streams of blood descend from the cut neck. A deep painted shadow falls against the green background inside the decorated rim.
works.title: Medusa

works.caption: An ivy-crowned youth turns toward the viewer over his bare shoulder, holding pale grapes in both hands. White cloth wraps his torso, and dark grapes and two peaches lie on the stone ledge below against a dark background.
works.title: Self-Portrait as Bacchus

works.caption: Venus reclines at left in a white gown while Mars sleeps at right with his head tipped back and lips parted. Four small satyrs play with his equipment: three carry a lance behind the lovers, one wearing a helmet and another blowing a conch beside Mars, while the fourth crawls through his breastplate.
works.title: Venus and Mars

works.caption: Danaë reclines nude on a curtained bed, extending one hand toward the light at left while resting the other arm on a white cushion. An older woman peers from behind the curtains, and a gilded winged figure sits above the headboard. Warm light picks out the body and bedding against the dark room.
works.title: Danaë

works.caption: Three of the artist’s sisters gather around a chessboard with their nurse. The eldest looks toward the viewer with one hand over the board; the youngest smiles between the players, while the sister at right raises an open hand. Their embroidered gowns and jewellery contrast with the nurse’s white head covering.
works.title: Portrait of the Artist's Sisters Playing Chess

works.caption: Artemisia Gentileschi holds a lute across her body, one hand on the strings and the other along its neck. Light travels over her face and blue sleeve, revealing gold embroidery and the soft folds of her head wrap against the dark background.
works.title: Self-Portrait as a Lute Player

works.caption: A young man, naked but for a white loincloth, stands against a lopped tree trunk with his arms behind his back. Arrows stick out of his chest, sides and one thigh; his head is tilted and his eyes heavy-lidded. In the distance, small riders with lances cross a plain on the left below towers and spires by the water. A nearly bare tree stands at the left edge, and rocky cliffs rise on the right.
works.title: Saint Sebastian

works.caption: Seven scenes of human sin form a ring around Christ at the centre of an eye-like circle. Four smaller circles show Death, the Last Judgment, Hell and Heaven at the corners. Scrolls bearing Latin inscriptions stretch above and below the central ring.
works.title: The Seven Deadly Sins and the Four Last Things

works.caption: A woman in a white gown lies across a bed with her head and one arm hanging over its edge. A small demonic figure sits on her torso and looks outward, while a horse’s pale-eyed head emerges between dark curtains at left. Her brightly lit body contrasts with the shadowed figures and red drapery.
works.title: The Nightmare

works.caption: The executioner holds John the Baptist’s severed head by the hair above a platter supported by Salome. She looks aside at left, while an older woman bows her head behind her. Light catches the faces, the executioner’s bare shoulder and Salome’s white drapery against the dark background.
works.title: Salome with the Head of John the Baptist

works.caption: Salome, wrapped in a red cloak, holds a platter bearing John the Baptist’s severed head. An older woman in a white head covering stands behind her, while the executioner at right bends his head toward the platter. His bare shoulder and Salome’s face stand out against the dark background.
works.title: Salome with the Head of John the Baptist

works.caption: Two monkeys with reddish caps of fur sit in an arched window opening, both chained to one iron ring on its ledge. One looks straight out; the other hunches with its head bowed. Broken nutshells lie beside them, and beyond, sailing boats cross pale water, and a distant town lies along the horizon.
works.title: Two Chained Monkeys

works.caption: Two men stand with their backs to the viewer on a rocky woodland path, looking toward a crescent moon. One rests an arm across his companion’s shoulder. A leaning tree with exposed roots and bare branches curves across the right side, framing the amber sky between dark trees and boulders.
works.title: Two men contemplating the Moon

works.caption: An old, bearded man, very probably Blake's Urizen, crouches naked inside a blazing yellow disc ringed by dark red and grey clouds, his long white hair and beard streaming out to the left. He reaches one long arm straight down through the rays of light, spreading a pale pair of compasses against the darkness below.
works.title: The Ancient of Days

works.caption: Christ stands behind a stone parapet with his wrists bound, a crown of thorns on his lowered head and a reed held against his bare torso. A man behind him lifts a purple cloak around his shoulders. At right, Pilate faces the viewer and gestures toward Christ with open hands.
works.title: Ecce Homo

works.caption: Mary reclines on straw at lower left, holding the infant against her red robe. Four men lean toward them from the right, one clasping his hands and another gripping a staff. A donkey stands in shadow behind Mary, while wooden beams, scattered straw and a bundle of belongings fill the dark shelter.
works.title: Adoration of the Shepherds

works.caption: Saint Anthony hangs in the air amid demons with wings, horns, claws and scales. One presses a hand on his head while others drag at his robe and arms, and a shaggy creature raises a club above him. Far below, a river winds past rocks and wooded banks, with a small sailing boat.
works.title: The Torment of Saint Anthony

works.caption: Christ bends beneath a large wooden cross in the foreground, turning his thorn-crowned face toward the viewer. A man in white grips the long beam of the cross at left as armed and brightly dressed figures press behind them, one raising a whip. Beyond the crowd, two smaller figures stand before a distant walled city.
works.collection: Royal Monastery of San Lorenzo de El Escorial
works.title: Christ Carrying the Cross

works.caption: A woman stands with her back to the viewer at a virginal, beside a gentleman near the rear wall. A mirror above reflects her face. Light enters through the windows at left across a patterned tile floor; a bowed string instrument lies near a blue chair, and a white jug rests on the carpet-covered table at right.
works.title: The Music Lesson

works.caption: Matthew turns from his open book towards an angel suspended above him in swirling white cloth. The angel gestures with its fingers while the saint holds his pen poised, their separated hands making inspiration feel like an exchange across the darkness.
works.title: The Inspiration of Saint Matthew

works.caption: A young man in a red cap turns his face three-quarters to the right against a dark background. Curled hair falls beside his cheeks, above a dark tunic and broad ochre panels. At the lower edge, his hand holds a folded sheet bearing musical notation.
works.title: Portrait of a Musician

works.caption: A nearly nude executioner bends over the fallen Matthew, gripping his raised wrist while holding a sword in his other hand. From a cloud above, a winged angel lowers a palm toward the saint. Figures at left raise their hands, and a boy in white turns outward with his mouth open beside the altar steps.
works.title: The Martyrdom of Saint Matthew

works.caption: A dark locomotive approaches along a railway bridge that cuts diagonally across the foreground. Pale rain and steam soften the distant landscape, while a separate arched bridge and a small boat emerge at left.
works.title: Rain, Steam and Speed – The Great Western Railway

works.caption: Mary sits in a meadow in a red dress and a blue mantle, a closed book resting at her wrist. The naked Christ Child stands at her knee and looks up at her. She holds one of his hands in hers and has her other arm round his back. The young John the Baptist kneels at the right with a thin cross on a long staff. Beyond them a lake and blue hills open on the left, and a town with towers rises on the right.
works.title: La Belle Jardinière

works.caption: A young man with long, wavy brown hair and a thin double gold halo is seen half-length against a pale sky. He wears a red cloak with an embroidered gold border over a black robe patterned in gold, with a chain around his neck. In one hand he holds a single arrow lightly between his fingers, its feathered end rising past his shoulder. Blue-grey hills and green trees stretch behind him, with a few small buildings and a spire on a far hill at right.
works.title: Saint Sebastian

works.caption: A young woman with long, crimped red-gold hair holds a small unicorn in her lap and looks straight out.
