She wears a pale green-gold dress with dark red velvet sleeves, and a pendant with a red stone and a hanging pearl on a long gold cord. Behind her, a low wall and two columns frame a blue sky and distant hills.
works.title: Young Woman with Unicorn

works.caption: A dead partridge hangs at the left beside a pair of iron gauntlets, plate above and mail at the hands, all set against a plain pale wooden board. A crossbow bolt runs diagonally through the open cuffs, and each object casts a shadow to the right. At the lower right a folded paper slip carries a few handwritten words and the year 1504.
works.collection: Bavarian State Painting Collections – Alte Pinakothek, Munich
works.title: Dead Partridge with Iron Gauntlets and Crossbow Arrows

works.caption: Red, green and yellow fruit rests on a rumpled white cloth across a wooden table, with more fruit piled on a white dish at right. A round-bodied handled pitcher stands at left beside a dark blue patterned curtain. Blue-green outlines and shadows define the cloth’s angular folds.
works.title: Rideau, Cruchon et Compotier

works.caption: The Madonna, in a blue mantle, sits on a raised throne holding the Christ Child, with two saints standing on each side. At the left a friar holds a small red book beside a long-haired man in a hair shirt who points toward the centre; at the right a mitred bishop raises a hand beside a woman in pink holding a palm and a gold dish. Above them, pale columns carry three pointed pink arches, with orange trees showing over the back wall, and a pink, green and white pavement covers the floor.
works.title: Santa Lucia de' Magnoli Altarpiece

works.caption: A religious procession advances along a broad dusty road beneath banners. At the right, men carry a tall gilded structure decorated with flowers and ribbons. Clergy and well-dressed participants occupy the centre; at left, a man with a staff reaches across the path of a younger participant using a crutch.
works.title: Religious Procession in Kursk Province

works.caption: Christ sits alone on a rock, leaning forward with his hands tightly clasped and his gaze lowered. A dark blue mantle covers his red robe, leaving his bare feet visible. Angular grey stones fill the foreground beneath a pale sky streaked with pink near the horizon.
works.title: Christ in the Wilderness

works.caption: Dante, in a red hood and pale robe, raises one hand while Virgil stands beside him in a rust-coloured mantle. A boatman turns his bare back toward the viewer at right. Nude figures grip the boat or struggle in dark green water, with flames illuminating distant walls at left.
works.collection: Department of Paintings of the Louvre
works.title: The Barque of Dante

works.caption: Three nude women stand close together on bare ground, hands resting on one another's shoulders. The one in the middle is seen from behind; the outer two face out with heads tilted down. Each holds a small, glossy red-brown ball, and two wear necklaces of red beads. Behind them are brown fields, a strip of water and blue hills under a pale sky.
works.title: Three Graces

works.caption: Astarte faces the viewer in a green gown, her hands resting on two jewelled girdles. Two attendants stand behind her holding vine-wrapped torches, their heads tilted upward and their free hands raised. A warm glow surrounds their faces beneath dark foliage.
works.title: Astarte Syriaca

works.caption: A horse-drawn wagon crosses shallow water beside a cottage and large leafy trees. Two men ride on the empty wagon, and a dog stands on the near bank. Beyond the shaded millpond, a sunlit meadow stretches beneath broad white and grey clouds.
works.title: The Hay Wain

works.caption: The Virgin bows her head and presses her hands together before a plain dark background. A white veil frames her downcast face and crosses her shoulders. Brilliant blue drapery wraps around her torso, with parts of a red garment visible at the neckline and wrists.
works.title: The Virgin in Prayer

works.caption: Broken castle walls and a tall ruined tower rise above rough ground at left. A small figure with a dog stands near the ruins, while cattle occupy the slope beyond. The Thames estuary stretches toward the distant horizon beneath an expansive sky of grey and white clouds.
works.title: Hadleigh Castle, The Mouth of the Thames--Morning after a Stormy Night

works.caption: A seated man in a dark blue suit rests his overlapping hands on a curved wooden cane. He wears a brown brimmed hat, a white collar and a striped tie. His small moustache and narrow eyes stand out against an elongated face, with grey-blue and ochre wall sections behind him.
works.title: Seated Man with a Cane

works.caption: Monet painted Camille after her death, her face almost submerged in violet-grey shadows and pale bedding. Short, restless strokes pass across both face and fabric, making the boundary between the still body and its surroundings difficult to hold in view.
works.title: Camille Monet on her deathbed

works.caption: The Holy Family travels through the dark beside a still body of water, where the moon has a bright reflection. A fire glows among people and animals farther left, and a band of tiny stars arches above the trees: Elsheimer makes the night itself the setting's great presence.
works.title: The Flight into Egypt

works.caption: Dürer presents himself in a striped cap and carefully arranged clothing, with gloved hands resting together at the ledge. His body turns slightly while his eyes meet ours; a narrow window opens onto mountains beyond the precise curls of his hair.
works.title: Self-Portrait

works.caption: Three hermits in three panels. In the centre a bald man in a pink robe kneels barefoot among ruins, hands held out towards a small crucifix. On the left a hooded, bearded old man hunches in the dark, with fires burning in the distance, small monsters around him, and naked figures beside a white cloth hung on a tree. On the right a monk with an arrow lying across his chest stands in a rocky shelter, a doe at his feet.
works.title: Hermit Saints Triptych

works.caption: Front and back of one panel, side by side. On the left a young man in a pink robe sits on a grassy hill with an open book and a pen, looking up at a pale winged figure and at a crowned woman with a child in a disc of light in the sky. A dark bird of prey stands at bottom left; at bottom right a small hybrid creature in spectacles stands by a long hooked pole. On the right, the reverse: a bright circular landscape of Passion scenes in shades of grey and brown, with a bird on a rock at its centre, set on a dark ground.
works.title: John on Patmos / Scenes of the Passion of Christ

works.caption: Christ hangs on a tall cross against a wide green landscape, with a distant city on the left and a castle on a hill to the right. At the left the Virgin Mary, in a grey cloak and white veil, joins her hands in prayer beside Saint John, red-haired in a pink and crimson mantle and holding a book. On the right a donor in a black cap and cloak and striped hose kneels in prayer while Saint Peter, holding a pair of keys, lays a hand on his shoulder; a skull and scattered bones lie on the grass.
works.collection: Royal Museums of Fine Arts of Belgium
works.title: Crucifixion with a Donor

works.caption: An old man with grey hair and a swollen, lumpy nose looks down at a small boy with long fair curls and a red cap. The boy looks up at him and reaches out an arm in a dark sleeve, laying his hand on the man's red, fur-edged robe. Through a window at the upper right, a road winds towards a building with a slender tower at the foot of a wooded hill, with a tall, pale blue rock in the distance.
works.collection: Department of Paintings of the Louvre
works.title: An Old Man and his Grandson

works.caption: A young woman with long golden hair draws a thick lock of it through her fingers and looks off to one side. Her white chemise has slipped off her shoulders above a green bodice, and her other hand rests on a small glass flask on the ledge in front. Behind her a bearded man in red holds a small mirror low at left and a large round mirror at right, where only dark shapes and a bright patch of light show in the glass.
works.collection: Department of Paintings of the Louvre
works.title: Woman with a Mirror

works.caption: Elizabeth Linley, in pale blue, rests her hands on a guitar and looks to the left. Beside her, Mary faces the viewer in a golden-brown dress, holding music on her lap. Their light sleeves and flowing skirts stand out against the dark trees of the woodland setting.
works.title: Elizabeth and Mary Linley

works.caption: A man looks toward the viewer beneath a large red chaperon, its folded fabric piled high above his head. Light reveals his lined face and stubble, while his fur-trimmed dark garment merges into the shadowy background.
works.title: Portrait of a Man (Self Portrait?)

works.caption: Venus reclines on a bed as Vulcan bends over her and pulls at the white cloth across her lap. Mars peers from beneath the draped table at right, close to a small dog. Cupid sleeps behind the couple, and a round mirror reflects Vulcan’s back.
works.title: Venus and Mars Surprised by Vulcan

works.caption: Mary bends toward the kneeling Elizabeth, resting her hands on the older woman’s shoulders as Elizabeth reaches around her. Two haloed women flank them beneath a decorated arch. Blue, red and golden-yellow drapery fills the foreground, while a walled town and pale mountains appear through the opening.
works.collection: Department of Paintings of the Louvre
works.title: Visitation

works.caption: David looks upward with parted lips and one hand on his chest. His other hand grips the hair of Goliath’s severed head, resting on a stone ledge. A white cloth wraps his waist, and a sword stands beside a red-draped helmet with pale feathers at left.
works.title: David with the Head of Goliath

works.caption: A young woman with dark hair drawn up and pearl drop earrings looks straight out, pressing a small sprig of white flowers and dark leaves to the front of her bodice. She wears a full white blouse under a dark, embroidered bodice, and a bracelet of dark and pale beads circles her wrist. She may be the courtesan Fillide Melandroni; the original canvas is lost and is known only from black-and-white photographs like this one.
works.title: Portrait of a Courtesan

works.caption: Caroline Rivière faces the viewer in a white high-waisted dress, with a pale fur wrap around her arms. One long brown glove crosses her waist. Behind her, a river passes wooded banks and a church beneath a gray-blue sky.
works.collection: Department of Paintings of the Louvre
works.title: Mademoiselle Caroline Rivière

works.caption: Dark cypresses fill most of the canvas, their curling strokes set against a blue sky streaked with white clouds. Two small figures stand beneath the trees amid red, yellow and pale flowering vegetation, with fields and a roof visible at left.
works.title: Cypresses with two figures

works.caption: Red poppies spread across a green field beneath a blue sky crossed by broad pale strokes. Slender trees punctuate the far edge of the flowers, with a darker belt of vegetation beyond. Curved foreground strokes alternate with scattered dots of red.
works.collection: Kunstmuseum Den Haag (long-term loan, Cultural Heritage Agency of the Netherlands)
works.title: Poppy field

works.caption: Two Magi kneel before Mary and the Christ Child at a rocky cave, while the central king advances with a golden vessel. Joseph stands at right. A procession with riders and animals descends the narrow path at left, and angels gather above Mary.
works.title: Adoration of the Magi

works.caption: Venus holds an apple and an arrow amid roses and honeysuckle. Yellow butterflies settle on the fruit, the arrow and her golden halo, while her steady gaze and pale skin stand out against the dense red flowers and dark foliage.
works.title: Venus Verticordia

works.caption: Men crowd around Christ on stone steps, raising and crossing wooden staffs above his thorn-crowned head. His red mantle falls open across his shoulders. A crouching armored figure fills the foreground, while a pale bust and the inscription TIBERIVS CAESAR stand above the dark doorway.
works.title: The Crowning with Thorns

works.caption: A pale young woman in a tall black bonnet, edged with gold and tiny pearls, turns her face toward the viewer, her eyes glancing a little to the viewer's right. Three strands of black and gold beads hung with small pale drops circle her neck, and white fur trims her blue dress. Behind her are a grey-brown wall and brown wooden panelling.
works.title: Portrait of a Young Lady

works.caption: A smiling boy stands barefoot beneath a broad, cloud-filled sky, carrying a wooden crutch across his shoulder. He holds a written appeal for alms in one hand and a black hat against his hip with the other. Low hills lie beyond his worn brown clothes.
works.collection: Department of Paintings of the Louvre
works.title: The Clubfoot

works.caption: A giant rises above the hills with his back turned and a fist raised. Far below, people, carts and animals scatter across the dark foreground; the difference in scale makes their panic seem almost impossible to escape.
works.title: The Colossus

works.caption: Minerva, in a plumed helmet and yellow robes, runs in from the left with spear and shield. Ahead of her a mixed crowd, some misshapen and a few part animal, flees into a pond, while winged children scatter overhead. Arches of clipped hedge open onto distant hills, and three women float in a cloud at upper right.
works.title: Minerva Expelling the Vices from the Garden of Virtue

works.caption: Dense ranks of riders, foot soldiers, spears and banners fill the battlefield beneath a sweeping view of mountains, towns and water. A crescent moon hangs at upper left, while orange sunlight breaks through clouds at right. A suspended inscribed tablet dominates the sky.
works.title: The Battle of Alexander at Issus

works.caption: Christ guides Thomas’s hand toward the wound in his side as two other disciples lean close to watch. Light from the left catches Christ’s bare chest, the joined hands and the men’s furrowed brows against a dark background. Thomas bends forward in a worn brown garment.
works.title: The Incredulity of Saint Thomas

works.caption: The Virgin, in a veil and blue mantle, steadies the naked Christ Child, who stands at her side with one foot up on her knee. She looks down as he and the infant John both take hold of a small curled white scroll with dark lettering. A bearded Joseph looms out of the dark at upper left. Below, a pink rose lies on a wooden table beside the Child's other foot.
works.title: Madonna of the Rose

works.caption: Philip IV faces the viewer in a dark doublet beneath a pale, sharply angled collar. His curled mustache and shoulder-length hair frame the illuminated face. Broad gray strokes describe the chest against a dark background with narrow vertical bands visible at right.
works.title: Philip IV in old age

works.caption: Mary sits on the grass in a pink dress and a wide blue mantle, one hand resting on a white rabbit. She reaches across to the Christ Child, held up by a woman in pale silks at the left. A woven basket with fruit lies open at her feet. At the right a bearded shepherd sits by his sheep under the trees, and a broad valley, blue mountains and a streaked yellow sky open behind.
works.title: Madonna of the Rabbit

works.caption: Mary sits on a white bed against the wall as Gabriel extends a stem of lilies toward her. White clothing and pale walls surround their golden halos, while a blue curtain and red embroidered hanging bring strong color into the narrow room. Flames surround Gabriel’s bare feet.
works.title: Ecce Ancilla Domini

works.caption: A young woman crowned with leafy sprigs takes a bearded centaur by the hair. She wears a white patterned dress under a dark green mantle and holds a tall gilded battle axe upright. The centaur, a bow in one hand and a quiver on his back, stands beside a rocky outcrop; a small ship sails on the water behind.
works.title: Pallas and the Centaur

works.caption: A haloed woman in a red dress and dark blue mantle holds up a see-through veil with one raised hand and pinches its other end near her chest. Below, a naked baby lies on a white sheet against a pillow, stretching both arms up toward the cloth. Behind her on the right, a bearded older man with a halo looks down, his hands folded. The background is a deep, dark green.
works.title: Madonna of Loreto

works.caption: Dürer turns his face toward the viewer beneath a red tasseled cap, his long hair curling over his shoulders. He holds a spiny green plant near the lower edge. A finely pleated pale shirt and dark garment edged with red stand out against the almost black background, with a date and inscription above his head.
works.collection: Department of Paintings of the Louvre
works.title: Portrait of the Artist Holding a Thistle

works.caption: Cupid sleeps on his side, his head at the right and bent legs extending left. Light picks out his face, rounded torso and limbs against a dark background. One hand rests above his body, while the other lies near an arrow; a feathered wing spreads beneath his arm.
works.title: Sleeping Cupid

works.caption: Two figures embrace on a crumpled white sheet surrounded by an angular brown landscape. The man wears a dark robe and holds the red-haired woman’s head and shoulder; her patterned red dress and pale legs extend across the folds. His face has wide, open eyes, rather than the exposed skull suggested by the title.
works.title: Death and the Maiden

works.caption: A long-haired young Christ in a blue-green robe is hemmed in by six older men, most of them bearded, set close against a dark ground. He holds one finger of his left hand with his right, while a pair of pale, bony hands reaches toward his from the right. Books crowd the front: a closed one at lower left with a slip of paper caught in its edge, and an open one with fanned pages at lower centre, held by the bald man at lower right.
works.title: Christ Among the Doctors

works.caption: Two barefoot boys sit eating fruit in a dark, sheltered corner. The boy at left lifts a bunch of grapes above his open mouth while holding a melon slice; the other looks toward him with a cut melon and knife across his lap. Torn clothes, a wicker basket and scattered rind fill the foreground.
works.title: Grape and Melon Eaters

works.caption: Mary sits in a red dress and broad blue mantle, supporting the standing Christ Child as he takes the slender cross held by the kneeling young John. Small flowers dot the foreground, while pale water, buildings and blue hills extend behind the triangular group beneath a clouded sky.
works.title: Madonna del Prato

works.caption: John the Baptist lies on a grassy ledge in a pinkish-red robe, his head propped on one hand while the other points downward. Beside him rises a fantastical plant with a large pale globe, thorny tendrils and birds. At lower right a white lamb lies at the foot of the grey rock below his hand. Behind them spreads a wide green landscape of trees, small animals and pale rock formations.
works.title: St. John the Baptist in the Wilderness

works.caption: Mary looks upward with her hands crossed over her chest, wearing a white dress and deep blue mantle. A crescent moon curves beneath the hem amid clouds and numerous child angels. Golden light surrounds her head, while darker clouds and overlapping figures gather along the right side.
works.title: The Immaculate Conception of Los Venerables

works.caption: Mary stands with her palms joined in prayer, a white dress beneath a dark blue mantle, against a golden clouded background. Winged heads surround her upper body, while child angels gather beneath the crescent moon at her feet, carrying branches and flowers.
works.title: Immaculate Conception

works.caption: The man turns his eyes to the side, away from our gaze. A loosely tied white cravat interrupts his dark coat, while uneven light picks out his forehead, cheek and greying beard against the muted background.
works.title: Portrait of a Kleptomaniac

works.caption: Christ, in a red tunic with a dark mantle over one shoulder, turns his eyes towards a balding, bearded man who leans in from the right, seen in profile. The man, in a loose white shirt and a small earring, holds up a gold coin low in the picture, and Christ points a finger at it. The background is dark.
works.title: The Tribute Money

works.caption: A nude Venus stands in the sea up to her thighs, wringing out her long reddish-gold hair, one hand raised by her temple and the other below her breast. Her body turns to the left while her head and eyes turn right. A small scallop shell floats at lower left, below a pinkish band on the horizon and a blue sky.
works.title: Venus Anadyomene

works.caption: Mary bends towards the Christ Child as he climbs from his cradle into her arms. At the left, Elizabeth supports the young John the Baptist; above them, an angel holds a wreath of flowers over Mary, while Joseph leans forward in the shadows.
works.collection: Department of Paintings of the Louvre
works.title: Holy Family of Francis I

works.caption: An older woman holds a wooden spoon above two eggs cooking in a red earthenware pot, with another egg in her other hand. Beside her, a boy carries a yellow melon and a glass flask. A plate, knife, mortar, onion and ceramic vessels crowd the foreground against the dark kitchen.
works.title: Old Woman Cooking Eggs

works.caption: Apollo, crowned with leaves and surrounded by rays, raises a finger as he addresses Vulcan and four workers in the forge. The men turn toward him with tools still in their hands. A glowing sheet of metal rests on the central anvil, and polished pieces of armor lie at lower right.
works.title: Apollo in the Forge of Vulcan

works.caption: A young woman faces left in strict profile, her golden-brown hair bound with white ribbons. She wears a pale pleated bodice with red sleeves and patterned trim. Flowers and butterflies surround her against dark foliage and a blue sky.
works.title: Portrait of a Princess of the House of Este

works.caption: A richly dressed woman sits beside a table with an open book, one hand across her chest and the other resting near the pages. A young attendant seen from behind offers her a shell-shaped goblet. An older woman is barely visible in the dark background.
works.title: Judith at the Banquet of Holofernes

works.caption: Mary sits with the Christ Child beneath a patterned canopy, flanked by Saint Donatian in a blue cope and Saint George in shining armor. Canon Joris van der Paele kneels beside the throne, holding an open book and spectacles. A geometric carpet covers the floor before them.
works.title: Madonna with Canon Joris van der Paele

works.caption: Eugenia Primavesi faces forward in a loose gown covered with red, violet and green floral shapes. Her hands hang beside the patterned fabric. A rounded green field of flowers frames her head against the yellow background, with a separate dark bird motif at upper right.
works.title: Portrait of Eugenia Primavesi

works.caption: Kirchner depicts himself in a blue military uniform with red shoulder tabs, a cigarette between his lips and his right wrist ending in a bloody stump. A nude figure stands behind him against a dark rectangle. The apparent amputation is imaginary: Kirchner did not lose his hand in the war.
works.title: Self-portrait as a Soldier

works.caption: Two men carry the dead Christ in a white cloth, his head and one arm hanging, toward a dark opening in the rock at left. A woman with loose fair hair holds his hand. At right, three women hold up a fainting woman in a dark blue mantle, and on a far hill stand three crosses.
works.title: The Deposition

works.caption: Two nude women sit on cloths beside the water while a third, seen from behind, leans toward them from the stream. The nearer seated woman raises a hand toward her companion. Two smaller bathers appear farther right, surrounded by softly painted trees and water.
works.title: The Great Bathers

works.caption: Solomon sits on an elevated throne between dark columns, extending both hands toward the disputants below. At left, a soldier holds a living infant upside down beside a drawn sword. One woman kneels with her arms outstretched; another points toward her while supporting a dead child.
works.collection: Department of Paintings of the Louvre
works.title: The Judgment of Solomon

works.caption: Mary sits between two arched openings onto a green landscape, the Christ Child on her lap. He leans down to take a small red carnation from the young John the Baptist at the lower right. John is wrapped in a fur pelt and holds a thin staff whose cross rises above his head. Mary looks down, one arm around John, her other hand holding a fold of blue cloth beside Christ.
works.title: Garvagh Madonna

works.caption: A green sculpted group of mourners supports the dead Christ beneath a cross. In front, a Breton woman sits in blue and white clothing; beyond her, a winding path leads past small figures towards the sea. Gauguin brings the stone monument and everyday life into the same sharply coloured landscape.
works.collection: Royal Museums of Fine Arts of Belgium
works.title: The Green Christ

works.caption: Four dancers join hands in a circle as the winged figure of Time plays a stringed instrument at right. A child blows bubbles at lower left, and another holds an hourglass beside Time. Above them, Apollo’s horse-drawn chariot crosses the clouds behind Aurora, who scatters flowers.
works.title: A Dance to the Music of Time

works.caption: A long-haired young man in a black cap and a black tunic with wide red sleeves looks straight out. His left arm rests on a balustrade and his hands overlap in front of him, two rings on the upper one. Behind him is a low landscape of hills, water and trees under a blue sky with clouds.
works.title: Portrait of Agnolo Doni

works.caption: Gabriel and Mary face one another across two panels, painted in pale gray as if they were stone statuettes. Gabriel raises a hand, Mary holds an open book, and a dove hovers above her. Their bases project across the painted red-marble surrounds of the dark niches.
works.title: Annunciation

works.caption: Snow covers a low, dilapidated shelter beneath the twisted trunks and bare shoots of pollarded willows. A dark wooden door leans across the open entrance. Dead grass and fallen branches break through the snow in the foreground, and no people or animals appear.
works.title: Snowy cottage

works.caption: A young man in white briefs stands with his hands on his hips and his gaze lowered. One foot steps forward across the blue-gray ground. Short patches of pink, green and blue shape both his body and the bare landscape behind him.
works.title: The Bather

works.caption: Lightning cuts through black clouds above a red-orange sky as statues topple from a building. People crowd the stone street, shielding their heads, carrying relatives and clinging to one another. A woman lies across the foreground beside a small child, while an older man is carried away at the right.
works.title: The Last Day of Pompeii

works.caption: Actaeon raises his hands beside a red curtain as he discovers Diana and her attendants bathing among stone ruins. At the right, the goddess lifts a white cloth while an attendant helps cover her. Across the pool, other women turn toward the hunter, reach for cloths or peer from behind a pillar.
works.collection: National Gallery, London / National Galleries of Scotland
works.title: Diana and Actaeon

works.caption: Christ’s pale body stands out against a dark green-black background. His head bows beneath a crown of thorns, with long hair falling across part of his face. Each foot is nailed separately to a wooden support, and thin streams of blood run down the cross beneath his hands and feet.
works.title: Christ Crucified

works.caption: Émile Zola sits in a patterned armchair, holding an open illustrated book while looking to the right. A Japanese screen stands behind him, and three reproductions hang above his crowded desk. His black coat contrasts with the pale pages, papers and inkwell beside him.
works.title: Portrait of Émile Zola

works.caption: A knight in dark armour and a plumed helmet, on a rearing white horse, swings a curved sword over his head. At the left a winged dragon, with a striped stump of lance in its chest, claws at one of the horse's hind legs. The rest of the red-and-white lance lies in pieces on the grass. At the right a woman in a pink dress runs off up a green slope.
works.title: Saint George and the Dragon

works.caption: Perseus stands beside Andromeda, loosening her bonds with the help of two small winged figures. At the left, others clamber around Pegasus; the defeated sea monster lies below the rocky ledge, its open mouth still visible in the surf.
works.title: Perseus Freeing Andromeda

works.caption: Brutus sits in shadow at the left as bearers carry his sons’ bodies into the room behind him. At the right, a woman reaches toward the procession while supporting a collapsing young woman. Another seated figure hides her face beneath a blue-green cloth.
works.collection: Department of Paintings of the Louvre
works.title: The Lictors Bring to Brutus the Bodies of His Sons

works.caption: Mary, in a blue mantle over a pink dress, holds the naked Christ Child against her, her cheek pressed to his. Her eyes are lowered, while the child's gaze goes out of the picture. Behind them, low on each side, lie water, hills and pale buildings under a clear blue sky.
works.collection: Alte Pinakothek, Bavarian State Painting Collections
works.title: Tempi Madonna

works.caption: The cardinal turns towards us in a red cap and shimmering red cape, its fine patterns traced by the light. His white sleeve cuts across the bottom of the portrait, balancing the pale face against a dark green background.
works.title: Portrait of a Cardinal

works.caption: A young man holds a green parasol above a seated woman in a blue bodice and bright yellow skirt. She turns toward the viewer with a folded fan in her outstretched hand. A small black dog rests on the pale cloth across her lap, beside a dark wall and an open view of trees and sky.
works.title: The Parasol

works.caption: Judith stands with her gaze lowered, holding a long sword point-down beside her pink-red dress. The garment opens to reveal a bare leg, and her foot rests on Holofernes’s severed head. A broad tree trunk and low wall frame her against distant buildings, blue hills and a pale sky.
works.title: Judith

works.caption: Nude figures recline, embrace, play music and dance in a landscape of yellow ground, orange foliage and pink and green trees. A small ring of dancers occupies the distant clearing. Dark blue, green and red outlines link the large foreground bodies to the curving trunks and branches around them.
works.title: The Joy of Life

works.caption: Europa sits on a white bull kneeling beside the sea, surrounded by attendants in white, gold and blue. Above them, small winged figures gather near a dark eagle on a cloud. Rocky shadows frame the group at the left, while bright blue sky and open water stretch across the right.
works.title: The Rape of Europa

works.caption: Mary in a blue cloak and the older Elizabeth in red and a white headdress meet on a path, their arms crossing, each with a hand on the other's belly. Behind them rise a large Gothic building with a tower, orchards and a pond, under a blue sky with clouds.
works.title: Visitation

works.caption: A flock of gulls rises beside Quillebeuf's waterfront while a breaking wave surges across the Seine. Turner sets the church and lighthouse against a vast, turbulent sky, with dark foreground water giving way to pale spray and haze.
works.title: Quillebeuf, Mouth of the Seine

works.caption: Dürer faces straight out of a near-black ground, long reddish-brown curls falling over a brown robe with a deep fur collar. One hand comes up to the collar, a finger resting in the fur. A gold date and monogram sit at the left; a gold Latin inscription sits at the right.
works.collection: Bavarian State Painting Collections – Alte Pinakothek, Munich
works.title: Self-Portrait with Fur-Trimmed Robe

works.caption: Two slender women embrace amid gold hair, curling plants and patterned serpent forms. One face is turned toward us with closed eyes; the other's is hidden. A large fish head peers from the lower right of Klimt's narrow, densely ornamented composition.
works.title: Girlfriends (Water Serpents I)

works.caption: Two angels hold a delicate crown above Mary as she writes in an open book. The Child reaches toward her writing hand and shares a split pomegranate with her; wingless angels, golden curls and transparent veils fill Botticelli's circular composition.
works.title: Madonna of the Magnificat

works.caption: A woman kneels with her back to us, holding a large sieve over grain scattered on a white sheet. Another sorts grain by hand at the left, while a boy peers into a wooden winnowing machine at the right.
works.title: The Wheat Sifters

works.caption: A bearded man in a white tunic and a billowing pink cloak wades through green-blue water, gripping a forked staff from which a large fish hangs. A haloed child in a dull red robe rides on his back, one hand raised, holding a thin staff topped by a small cross. Behind them a wide river winds past a ruined castle towards blue hills; on the right a huge pale jug is lodged in a tree.
works.collection: Museum Boijmans Van Beuningen (loan from its foundation)
works.title: Saint Christopher Carrying the Christ Child

works.caption: Christ, in a blue-grey robe and a crown of thorns, kneels and clasps a large wooden cross, a rope round his waist, while a dense crowd in helmets, turbans and hoods presses in around him under raised spears and a ladder. A tall pole rises at right. Below, a half-dressed man with bound arms is led along at left, and at right a tonsured man in a grey habit leans close to another bound man kneeling by the pole.
works.title: Christ Carrying the Cross

works.caption: Eve reaches up to pluck a fruit while holding another at her side; Adam raises a hand beside her. A female-headed creature with a reptilian body and long tail stands by the tree, amid carefully painted flowers, grasses and distant trees.
works.title: The Fall of Man (Vienna Diptych)

works.caption: A dense crowd fills a woodland clearing to hear a bearded preacher in brown, standing a little left of centre with one arm stretched out. In the foreground listeners turn their backs to us in hoods, wide hats, headscarves and striped cloaks. Through a gap in the trees at the upper right, a river winds toward a distant town.
works.title: The Sermon of Saint John the Baptist

works.caption: Two farm workers bow their heads for the Angelus beside a basket of potatoes; a fork and loaded wheelbarrow mark the work they have paused.
works.title: The Angelus

works.caption: A dark steam tug, its funnel trailing smoke, draws the pale, ghostly Temeraire up the Thames to be broken up, beneath a thin crescent moon and a blazing sunset.
works.title: The Fighting Temeraire

works.caption: At Esther's banquet, the queen extends a hand beside Ahasuerus while Haman lowers his head in shadow; her gold cloak glows against the dark room.
works.collection: Pushkin State Museum of Fine Arts, Moscow
works.title: Ahasuerus and Haman at the Feast of Esther

works.caption: A blue foal inclines its pale face above yellow ground, surrounded by rounded red, violet and blue hills and pointed green leaves.
works.title: Blue Horse I

works.caption: Samson sleeps across Delilah's lap while an accomplice cuts his hair by candlelight; armed men wait beyond the open doorway at the right.
works.title: Samson and Delilah

works.caption: Against a black background, a young woman in a blue dress and a sheer veil looks down at the naked baby she holds on a pale blue cloth. Her long, wavy, reddish-blond hair falls past her shoulders. The curly-haired child glances up and to the side, a small slice of pear in one hand. The date 1512 and Dürer's monogram sit at the upper right.
works.title: Mary and Child

works.caption: In a garden at lower left, a fair-haired woman sits on a patterned carpet while one woman brushes her long hair and another kneels by a basin at her bare feet; a third stands holding a basket. Two men lurk among the trees at far left. Beyond a balustrade, a huge palace of pale stone and red trim rises under a swirling blue sky, with crowds on its forecourt and mountains to the left.
works.collection: Bavarian State Painting Collections – Alte Pinakothek, Munich
works.title: Susanna and the Elders

works.caption: A young woman sits half-turned with her ringed hands crossed in front of her, in wide blue patterned sleeves over an orange-red bodice; a dark blue band down its centre carries paired round gold buttons. A jewelled pendant with a large pearl hangs at her neckline. Behind her, a slender tree, low hills and a cloudy blue sky.
works.title: Portrait of Maddalena Doni

works.caption: A man in a dark cap rests his forearms on a pale parapet and looks towards the viewer; a window at the left opens onto distant hills.
works.title: Portrait of Perugino

works.caption: A winged angel supports the reclining Saint Francis in a dark wooded landscape, with light catching the saint's face, brown habit and open hand.
works.title: Saint Francis of Assisi in Ecstasy

works.caption: A fortune-teller holds a young man's outstretched hand while they exchange glances, his feathered hat and golden sleeve contrasting with her white blouse and headcloth.
works.title: The Fortune Teller

works.caption: Pope Leo X sits at a red-covered table, a magnifying glass in his hand beside an open illuminated book and an ornate bell, his eyes turned away from the page. Two cardinals in red stand behind him; the one on the right grips the tasselled post just below the golden ball that tops the pope's chair.
works.title: Portrait of Leo X

works.caption: A youth with one shoulder exposed cradles a woven basket filled with apples, grapes and leaves, looking towards the viewer with his head tilted.
works.title: Boy with a Basket of Fruit

works.caption: Juliette Récamier turns towards the viewer from a curved wooden daybed, her white dress trailing towards a low footstool and her bare feet resting on the cushion.
works.title: Portrait of Madame Récamier

works.caption: Blossoming peach trees rise before a yellow fence and dark cypresses, their pale flowers and the blue sky broken into a dense pattern of small strokes.
works.title: Orchard with Peach Trees in Blossom

works.caption: A mulberry tree spreads curling yellow-orange foliage across a blue-violet sky, its dark trunk rooted in pale stony ground and casting a long diagonal shadow.
works.title: The Mulberry Tree

works.caption: Huge grey-blue plane-tree trunks fill a village street, with small figures, heaps of road material and green-shuttered houses visible between them.
works.title: The Large Plane Trees (Road Menders at Saint-Rémy)

works.caption: Laure Bellelli stands beside her two daughters while their father sits turned towards them, the family arranged around a table in a blue-grey room.
works.title: The Bellelli Family

works.caption: A partridge flies just above the wheat, where red poppies punctuate green and yellow stalks beneath a broad, lightly clouded sky.
works.collection: Van Gogh Museum, Amsterdam (Vincent van Gogh Foundation)
works.title: Wheatfield with Partridge

works.caption: A young woman turns towards the viewer from a virginal, with a painted Cupid behind her and an empty blue chair in the foreground.
works.title: A Young Woman Standing at a Virginal

works.caption: A young military musician plays a dark fife, his black jacket, red trousers and white straps standing out against a plain grey background.
works.title: The Fifer

works.caption: Overlapping figures enact works of mercy in a dark street, with a torch below and the Virgin, Child and two winged angels above.
works.title: The Seven Works of Mercy

works.caption: Elisabetta Gonzaga faces straight out, cut off just below the chest, in a black dress set with gold and greyish rectangles and a white neckline lettered in gold. A thin cord across her forehead holds a small scorpion jewel. Behind her, green hills with a tree at the left and a sunlit crag at the right.
works.title: Portrait of Elisabetta Gonzaga

works.caption: Catherine looks towards the viewer beside a broken spiked wheel, holding a sword diagonally across her dark dress. A long palm lies over the red cushion and the floor, while light from the right illuminates her face, white sleeves and hands.
works.title: Saint Catherine of Alexandria

works.caption: David extends Goliath’s severed head by the hair, looking down towards it while lowering his sword across the foreground. His exposed chest and pale shirt emerge from the dark background; the Borghese catalogue identifies Goliath’s face as Caravaggio’s own likeness.
works.title: David with the Head of Goliath

works.caption: An older waterseller and a boy share their grip on a clear stemmed glass, while a third man drinks in shadow behind them. A large ridged earthenware jar fills the foreground, with droplets on its surface; a smaller greenish jug and a drinking cup stand at the left.
works.collection: Apsley House, The Wellington Collection, London
works.title: The Waterseller of Seville

works.caption: The Virgin, in deep blue with a white veil, holds out the naked Child to an old, bald king who kneels in a red robe lined with fur. Behind them a long-haired king in green and gold lifts a tall gold cup, and a young Black king in a blue cloak and red hose holds out a round gold vessel. Ruined brick arches and a timber shed with an ox close in the group; beyond, riders gather below a hilltop town.
works.title: Adoration of the Magi

works.caption: Mary supports the Christ Child on her lap as he turns towards the older, beardless Joseph at the left. Joseph rests both hands on a staff; thin gold halos trace the three heads, and an arched opening reveals a pale landscape beyond the room.
works.title: Madonna with Beardless Saint Joseph

works.caption: A woman in a billowing pink dress swings above a young man reclining among flowering shrubs. Her slipper flies towards the upper left, while an older man pulls the ropes in the shadows at the right; statues and dense blue-green foliage surround the encounter.
works.title: The Swing

works.caption: The Virgin sits on a raised throne holding the Christ Child, under a broad green curtain pulled back on the right to show blue sky. At the left a winged angel leads a kneeling boy who holds a fish on a cord. At the right a bearded old man in a red robe reads a green-bound book, and a lion crouches in the corner below him.
works.title: Madonna with the Fish

works.caption: Christ stands with hands joined as John pours water from a small bowl above his head and a white dove spreads its wings overhead. Three angels gather beside the pale trunk of a walnut tree, while the stream winds past smaller figures into a hilly landscape.
works.title: The Baptism of Christ

works.caption: A young woman is seen in strict profile facing left, her breasts bare above a striped cloth that wraps her shoulders. Her golden hair is braided and coiled, threaded with strings of pearls and topped by a jewel set with two large pearls. A green snake twists through the chain at her neck. A dark cloud and a bare tree rise at the left, leafy trees and blue sky at the right, and a name runs along the bottom in capitals.
works.title: Portrait of a Woman, called Simonetta Vespucci

works.caption: Cardinal Alessandro Farnese stands in a red cap, a wide red cape fastened with round buttons and a long red robe, with full white sleeves and a white band down the front. He looks out at the viewer and holds a folded paper. At the right, an arched opening shows a river, a stone bridge, pale buildings and blue hills.
works.collection: Museo e Real Bosco di Capodimonte, Naples
works.title: Portrait of Cardinal Alessandro Farnese

works.caption: Mounted knights and foot soldiers crowd the battlefield beneath torn and streaming banners. Near the centre, a red-clad rider raises both arms, while at the left a white-cloaked commander is attacked; fallen bodies, horses and weapons fill the foreground.
works.title: Battle of Grunwald

works.caption: Two figures dance with raised tambourines as companions sit and recline on the riverbank. Tall trees frame a broad expanse of water, with boats, a mill and a distant town; cattle gather beside a small stream at the left.
works.title: Landscape with the Marriage of Isaac and Rebekah ('The Mill')

works.caption: A white ceramic cup of water stands on a silver plate beside a pink rose. Light catches the cup's curved handles, the thin metal rim and the petals reflected below, making three ordinary objects feel unusually still and distinct.
works.title: A Cup of Water and a Rose in a Plate of Silver

works.caption: Men push and pull Christ’s cross into a steep diagonal, with mourners on the left wing and mounted figures on the right.
works.title: The Elevation of the Cross

works.caption: Christ has fallen under the cross, one hand braced on a stone, and looks towards a group of haloed mourners on the right. One of them, a woman in a white veil, stretches both arms towards him. Men heave at the cross behind him, and a man at the left holds a rope. At the far upper left a rider carries a red banner. On the right, helmeted soldiers crowd beside a white horse.
works.title: Christ Falling on the Way to Calvary

works.caption: Two damned men wrestle on the ground, one biting the other's neck. Dante and Virgil watch from the left as a winged demon hovers behind them; the harsh light and strained limbs make Bouguereau's scene painfully physical.
works.title: Dante and Virgil in Hell

works.caption: Mary supports the dead Christ beneath a massive stone niche, surrounded by figures whose gestures break the stillness. Titian intended this painting for his burial place; left unfinished at his death, it was completed with limited additions by Palma Giovane.
works.title: Pietà

works.caption: Three bear cubs explore a fallen pine while an adult bear stands below them. Morning light filters through the tall trunks and pale mist; Shishkin painted the forest, while Konstantin Savitsky contributed the bears.
works.title: Morning in a Pine Forest

works.caption: Christ’s pale body is lowered on a broad white sheet, with helpers above and mourners reaching to receive him below.
works.title: The Descent from the Cross

works.caption: A waitress carries beer through a crowded café while a dancer performs on the stage behind her. Cropped figures and a foreground drinker's blue smock make this busy interior feel glimpsed at close quarters.
works.title: Corner of a Café-Concert

works.caption: Lord Ribblesdale stands in hunting clothes and a long dark coat, holding a riding whip against the pale panelling of Sargent’s studio.
works.title: Lord Ribblesdale

works.caption: Philip IV’s pale face and upturned moustache emerge above a broad collar, with a fine gold chain catching light against his black clothing.
works.title: Philip IV of Spain

works.caption: Christ kneels with open hands before an angel holding a chalice, while disciples sleep at the left and armed figures approach from the right.
works.title: The Agony in the Garden of Gethsemane

works.caption: A boy holds out Belisarius’s helmet for alms as a woman gives and a soldier raises his hands in astonishment at the fallen general.
works.title: Belisarius Begging for Alms

works.caption: A richly dressed figure holds a red rosebud beneath a wide horned headdress, with the other hand resting on a marble parapet.
works.title: An Old Woman ('The Ugly Duchess')

works.caption: Two pilgrims kneel with joined hands before Mary and the child at a worn doorway, the man’s bare soles prominent in the foreground.
works.collection: Basilica of Saint Augustine in Campo Marzio
works.title: Madonna di Loreto

works.caption: In a meadow, Elizabeth kneels at left in a white headcloth, her hand on a small child who stands at her knee holding a scroll. Mary sits at right in red and blue with a book in her hand, and a second child, leaning back against her lap with one knee raised, reaches for the scroll. Joseph leans on a staff above them all. Winged child angels look down from clouds in the top corners, and towns and hills fill the distance.
works.title: Canigiani Holy Family

works.caption: A young man in a red cap and fur-trimmed coat holds a golden apple at the edge of a green ledge. The small gold squares on his clothing and the soft brown fur reward close looking, while a quiet landscape opens behind his shoulders.
works.title: Portrait of a Young Man with an Apple

works.caption: Gabriel kneels with a lily as Mary bends towards him, their outstretched hands nearly meeting across the bare room. Sweeping drapery intensifies their gestures, while the tiled floor leads the eye towards a quiet landscape beyond the doorway.
works.title: Cestello Annunciation

works.caption: Saint Jerome bends over an open book and extends a pen across the table, with a skull on the books at the opposite end.
works.title: Saint Jerome

works.caption: Mary supports Jesus as their overlapping bare feet press down on a serpent; Saint Anne watches with clasped hands, her upright figure set beside their bending bodies.
works.title: Madonna and Child with Saint Anne

works.caption: Seen through a wide stone arch, Saint Jerome in a red robe sits reading at a wooden desk raised on a platform inside a tall vaulted hall. A partridge, a peacock and a metal bowl stand on the ledge in front, and a lion walks in the aisle at the right.
works.title: Saint Jerome in His Study

works.caption: David holds Goliath's severed head by the hair, with his sword resting across his shoulder. Strong light separates the young victor's face and bare arm from the darkness, while the heavy head hangs at the far end of his outstretched hand.
works.title: David with the Head of Goliath

works.caption: Magdalene bows her head over hands resting in her lap; discarded pearls, jewellery and a jar of ointment beside her skirt give this quiet scene its penitential meaning.
works.title: Penitent Magdalene

works.caption: Christ, in a pale robe, looks straight out as four men crowd around him. At top left a man in a green headdress raises a crown of thorns in an armoured glove; at top right a man wears oak leaves in his hat and a spiked collar. A hand rests on Christ's shoulder, and the two men below reach for his robe.
works.title: Christ Mocked (The Crowning with Thorns)

works.caption: Maffeo Barberini, the future Pope Urban VIII, sits bearded in a wooden chair, wearing a tall black cap, a white collar and a dark green-black robe over billowing white sleeves. One arm stretches out to point off to the left, and his eyes turn the same way, while the other hand grips a few folded papers.
works.title: Portrait of Maffeo Barberini, later Pope Urban VIII

works.caption: Sunlight and blue-grey shadows cross the women’s pale dresses and the curving garden path; a branching tree divides the clustered figures at the left from the woman reaching towards flowers at the right.
works.title: Women in the Garden

works.caption: A reclining woman looks towards us from white pillows, her pale clothing crossed by a pink sash and framed by a yellow jacket with black decoration; pointed shoes extend towards the left.
works.title: The Clothed Maja

works.caption: Arrieta supports the pale, weakened Goya around the shoulder and offers him a glass; the inscription below thanks the doctor for the care that saved the painter’s life.
works.title: Self-Portrait with Dr. Arrieta

works.caption: At the left and right edges, two large bearded men hold back green curtains hung from a rod to show the Nativity. Shepherds rush in from the left. Mary kneels in blue before the Child in a slatted wooden manger. Angels gather round, with an ox and a donkey behind and Joseph kneeling at the right. A tied sheaf of grain lies in front.
works.title: Adoration of the Shepherds

works.caption: The oldest king kneels before Mary and the child, his red robe spread across the floor and his jewelled hat set beside a gold vessel; two other kings approach with gifts from the right.
works.title: Monforte Altarpiece (The Adoration of the Magi)

works.caption: Potocki turns towards us with his hat extended, sitting upright on a pale horse that lifts one foreleg; a spotted dog looks up from the lower left.
works.collection: Museum of King Jan III’s Palace at Wilanów, Warsaw
works.title: Equestrian Portrait of Stanisław Kostka Potocki

works.caption: Venus reclines with her back towards us while Cupid holds up a mirror containing her blurred reflection. Pink ribbons loop across his wrist, and the sweep of the grey sheet echoes the curve of her body beneath the deep red curtain.
works.title: Rokeby Venus

works.caption: A man in strict profile faces left against a black ground. A bowl of brown hair sits low over his brow, and his light-skinned face and long neck rise from a high collar with a white rim. His gold-and-red patterned garment is crossed by grey-green bands at the shoulder.
works.title: Portrait of Sigismondo Pandolfo Malatesta

works.caption: Pink and white rose petals engulf the reclining guests below a raised marble terrace, where another group dines beside a fruit-laden table.
works.title: The Roses of Heliogabalus

works.caption: Lise stands in a white dress beside a shaded tree, her tilted hat shading her face and a black lace parasol raised behind her shoulder.
works.title: Lise with a Parasol

works.caption: A girl in a white dress with pink stripes sits beneath a pine, facing the viewer above the river and sunlit village of Castelnau.
works.title: View of the Village

works.caption: A head in profile, facing left, built from fire-making things: a flint for the cheek, steel strikers for the nose and ear, and a small oil lamp with a lit wick under a bundle of white sticks. Its hair is a heap of burning sticks and flames. A jewelled gold chain lies across a chest of gun barrels and cannon.
works.title: Fire

works.caption: A head in profile, facing left, made of sea creatures. A flat ray lies across the cheek, a fish's open jaws form the mouth, and a pale shell ear wears a pearl drop. Red coral branches stick out at the upper front of the head, and a small spiky crown sits on top. A string of large pearls circles the neck above a turtle, with a big crab at lower left and an octopus at right.
works.title: Water

works.caption: Fritza Riedler sits with her hands loosely joined, her pale dress spreading over an armchair covered in eye-like patterns. Small geometric shapes punctuate the orange background, and a curved patch of mosaic-like ornament frames her head.
works.title: Fritza Riedler

works.caption: A man crouches behind a seated woman, with a clothed child nestled between her knees. Their bodies form a close, rising triangle, but their gazes turn in different directions; patches of green, ochre and pink make the skin seem restless against the dark furnishings.
works.title: The Family

works.caption: A nude Venus stands under an apple tree, one arm raised to hold a fruiting branch and one leg lifted onto a fallen bough. She wears a wide red hat ringed with white feathers and a thick red-gold collar, and looks out of the picture. At lower left a small winged Cupid clutches a honeycomb, his hand to his forehead and bees on his skin. A stag and a hind stand in the dark wood at left; a lake and a rocky crag open up at right.
works.title: Cupid Complaining to Venus

works.caption: A heavily bearded man in a black cap and dark armour trimmed with gold stands before a pale column and a violet curtain. His right hand rests on a helmet set on a green-covered ledge; his left lies over the dark scabbard of the sword at his hip. Lettering runs along the column's base.
works.collection: Gallerie Nazionali Barberini Corsini, Palazzo Barberini, Rome
works.title: Portrait of Stefano IV Colonna

works.caption: Agnew stands at the left of a surgical demonstration, while white-gowned doctors and a nurse attend the patient before rows of dark-clothed students.
works.title: The Agnew Clinic

works.caption: Truth stands in a white dress holding a book and a sceptre, beside the winged figure of Time with his hourglass. Below them, History writes in an open book. The pale clothing and broad wings open a luminous space against the surrounding darkness.
works.title: Truth, Time and History

works.caption: A wedding party travels by boat across calm fjord water, with further boats near the shore and snow-covered mountains rising behind.
works.title: Bridal Procession on the Hardangerfjord

works.caption: Pisa’s pale face and hands emerge above a dark, fur-trimmed robe, with both hands resting on an open book laid across a blue-green tablecloth.
works.title: Portrait of Dr. Francisco de Pisa

works.caption: Peter in ochre and Paul in rose and green stand beneath a clouded sky, their hands crossing without touching beside Paul’s upright sword.
works.collection: Museu Nacional d’Art de Catalunya, Barcelona
works.title: Saint Peter and Saint Paul

works.caption: Marie de’ Medici arrives beside an elaborately gilded galley, welcomed by allegorical figures beneath flying Fame, while sea divinities gather in the foreground.
works.title: The Disembarkation at Marseilles

works.caption: Red roofs and pale walls appear through a lattice of bare branches. Pissarro repeats the warm reds across the hillside and foreground earth, setting them against green patches and a cool sky; the village emerges gradually from the busy surface of the paint.
works.title: The Red Roofs, Côte Saint-Denis at Pontoise, Winter Effect

works.caption: A nude woman sits on a chest painted with large flowers, beside a heap of pillows and a pink quilt. Roses repeat across the blue wallpaper, surrounding her with the saturated colour and crowded decoration of the bedroom.
works.title: The Beauty

works.caption: A dark-haired woman turns her face toward the viewer above a pale garment patterned with pink, blue and yellow brushstrokes, set against a deep green background.
works.collection: Galleria d’Arte Moderna Ricci Oddi, Piacenza
works.title: Portrait of a Lady

works.caption: Three arched panels. At the top of the centre, Christ in a pink-red mantle sits in a pale circle, his feet on a small blue sphere, with trumpeting angels and kneeling saints on either side. Below him a dark plain is crowded with small naked figures, monsters and huge strange objects, among them a harp, a bell and a pink-hooded bed. The left wing shows a pale tower in a green landscape; on the right, buildings burn under an orange sky.
works.title: Last Judgement

works.caption: Three panels. In the centre, a winged angel in white faces a young woman in a red robe who sits low in front of a bench, reading, in a room with a many-sided table, a jug of lilies, a candlestick and a brass vessel hanging in a niche. At left a man and a woman kneel outside an open door in a walled garden, with a bearded man standing at the gate behind them. At right an old man in a blue turban drills into a board at his workbench, a town square seen through the window behind him.
works.collection: The Metropolitan Museum of Art, The Cloisters, New York
works.title: Mérode Altarpiece

works.caption: A woman in a striped dress sits beside a straw-hatted man holding an oar, with moored boats, bright blue water and distant buildings behind them.
works.title: Argenteuil

works.caption: Saint Luke draws Mary holding the infant Jesus beneath a patterned canopy, with columns framing a distant river and town beyond the room.
works.title: Saint Luke Drawing the Virgin

works.caption: Light streams through ceiling openings onto a bath interior, where two foreground women turn toward a standing attendant beside blue floral tiles and a pool.
works.title: Pool in a Harem

works.caption: A man with thick, shoulder-length brown hair turns his head back over his shoulder and looks out from under a slightly drawn brow. At lower left a metal shoulder edge catches white highlights above a green sleeve with small orange-red ties; a dark red cloth shows at the right, against a near-black ground.
works.title: Self-Portrait as David

works.caption: David turns toward the viewer in a brown coat with broad reddish lapels and a loosely tied white shirt, holding painting tools against a plain ochre background.
works.title: Self-portrait

works.caption: Gauguin wears a broad brown hat and dark coat against diagonal yellow and olive-green bands, with a framed reclining nude and a patterned cloth behind him.
works.title: Self-portrait with hat

works.caption: Rembrandt faces the viewer in a white cap and fur-trimmed dark gown, holding a palette and painting tools before two large circular outlines.
works.title: Self Portrait with Two Circles

works.caption: Dr. Pozzi stands in a scarlet dressing gown against red curtains, one hand at his collar and the other holding the waist cord, with white ruffles framing his face and hands.
works.title: Dr. Pozzi at Home

works.caption: Washington’s gray-haired head and dark collar emerge from a brown painted field, while the unfinished lower portion and left edge remain largely pale canvas.
works.collection: National Portrait Gallery, Washington, DC, and Museum of Fine Arts, Boston — joint ownership
works.title: Athenaeum Portrait

works.caption: Sebastian raises his bound wrists against a dark tree and looks upward, his pale torso pierced by arrows above a white waistcloth, with small figures in the distant landscape.
works.title: Saint Sebastian

works.caption: Sebastian looks upwards with his wrists bound above his head and arrows piercing his sides. His pale torso stands out against the dark tree and blue-grey sky, while a white cloth twists into a knot at his waist.
works.title: Saint Sebastian

works.caption: Armored Spain raises a standard at the left as the partly draped figure of Religion kneels beside a serpent-covered tree, with scattered armor and a naval scene between them.
works.title: Religion saved by Spain

works.caption: Elisabeth of Bourbon sits on a pale horse with a raised foreleg, her dark gold-patterned gown spreading over an ornate saddlecloth beneath a broad gray sky.
works.title: Equestrian Portrait of Elisabeth of France

works.caption: Two red-orange foxes overlap amid angular fields of green, blue, pink and gray, one narrow muzzle pointing downward and the other extending toward the right.
works.title: The Foxes

works.caption: Colorful fishing boats rest on the sand at the left, their bare masts crossing a pale sky, while smaller boats sail beyond the diagonal line of surf.
works.collection: Van Gogh Museum, Amsterdam (Vincent van Gogh Foundation)
works.title: Fishing Boats on the Beach at Les Saintes-Maries-de-la-Mer

works.caption: A man holds a small balance above coins on a green-covered table, while the woman beside him turns her gaze from an open illustrated book toward his work.
works.title: The Moneylender and his Wife

works.caption: Rubens stands at the left beside three scholars gathered around a table of books. A red curtain hangs above them, and a stone bust occupies a niche at the right; hands, open pages and turned heads give the group the feeling of a conversation paused.
works.title: The Four Philosophers

works.caption: A woman in a rose-pink tunic, one breast bare, strides in from the left holding out a bow. Across a stream, a figure with arms flung up staggers back as hounds leap at him, among dark, windswept trees under a stormy sky.
works.title: The Death of Actaeon

works.caption: Berthe Morisot faces the viewer in a black hat and dark clothing, her face lit from the side and a small bouquet of violets at her chest.
works.title: Berthe Morisot with a Bouquet of Violets

works.caption: A seated woman in blue-gray drapery turns towards an older man in red and gold beside a fountain, with a column separating them from a formal garden.
works.collection: Musée des Beaux-Arts de Lyon; Louvre deposit
works.title: Bathsheba at Her Bath

works.caption: Saint Catherine looks upwards beneath a jeweled crown, holding a palm frond against her chest with her other arm extended over a spiked wheel.
works.title: Saint Catherine of Alexandria

works.caption: Gabriel kneels at the left with lilies and an arm raised towards the dove in the golden clouds, while Mary bends forward with a hand at her chest.
works.collection: Museo e Real Bosco di Capodimonte, Naples
works.title: Annunciation

works.caption: A green band divides Amélie Matisse’s face beneath dark blue hair, with yellow and pink facial planes set against broad orange, violet and turquoise fields.
works.title: Green Stripe

works.caption: An enlarged iris fills the canvas with pale gray-violet petals surrounding a nearly black centre, where a thin dark-red seam runs downwards.
works.collection: The Metropolitan Museum of Art, New York
works.title: Black Iris

works.caption: Bonaparte sits on a dark horse facing the Great Sphinx, with ranks of troops across the distant desert and shadows of other riders entering at the lower left.
works.collection: Hearst Castle, San Simeon; California State Parks
works.title: Bonaparte Before the Sphinx

works.caption: Bonaparte stands in red velvet beside a document on a dark-covered table, with one hand inside his coat and Saint-Lambert Cathedral visible through the curtains.
works.title: Bonaparte, First Consul

works.caption: Bonaparte reaches towards a standing patient’s bare torso in a mosque courtyard used as a hospital, while other patients lie across the foreground.
works.title: Bonaparte Visiting the Plague Victims of Jaffa

works.caption: In a dark wood, Mary in a blue mantle kneels with joined hands before the naked Christ child, who lies on the flowery ground. Above, God the Father leans out of a burst of gold rays, with a white dove below him. At left a curly-haired boy with a staff and scroll stands on a ledge, and higher up an old bearded monk prays behind a rock.
works.title: Adoration in the Forest

works.caption: Seen from above, a nude woman crouches in a shallow round tub, one hand reaching behind her head; jugs and a brush occupy the surface beside her.
works.title: The Tub

works.caption: A brown-and-white bull stands beside a reclining cow and a group of sheep, while a farmer watches from behind a fence under the tree.
works.title: The Bull

works.caption: Gabriel, wings spread, stands at the left with his arms crossed on his chest. Opposite, Mary in red and blue lifts the edge of her veil with one hand and holds a book in the other. Above them winged children tumble through clouds around a dove in a burst of light. A column rises behind Gabriel, and a striped tiled floor and broad steps close the scene below.
works.title: Annunciation

works.caption: A seated nude with dark hair and outlined almond-shaped eyes rests her hands beside her hips, with a pale towel across her lap and dark panels behind her.
works.collection: Royal Museum of Fine Arts Antwerp
works.title: Seated Nude

works.caption: A church tower rises among brightly colored houses and dark blue-green mountains, with broad strokes of pale blue and red crossing the sky.
works.title: Murnau with Church II

works.caption: From a high window, Monet looks across a crowded Paris boulevard, with bare branches against sunlit façades and two cropped men watching from a balcony at the right.
works.collection: Pushkin State Museum of Fine Arts, Moscow
works.title: Boulevard des Capucines, Paris

works.caption: Canaletto looks across a Venetian square scattered with stone blocks and workers, past weathered houses and a wooden shed to the canal and a tall bell tower beneath a broad cloudy sky.
works.title: The Stonemason's Yard

works.caption: The actress María del Rosario Fernández, known as La Tirana, stands with one hand on her hip. A reddish shawl with gold decoration falls over her white dress, its long fringe catching the light against the subdued outdoor setting.
works.collection: Royal Academy of Fine Arts of San Fernando
works.title: La Tirana

works.caption: Liberty raises the French tricolour above an armed crowd advancing over a barricade, carrying a bayoneted musket in her other hand. Fallen bodies and broken stones fill the foreground; smoke veils the city behind.
works.title: Liberty Leading the People

works.caption: The Bonaparte sisters sit close together, one in silvery grey and the other in black, with a letter held before them. Jewelled tiaras and a crimson sofa patterned with gold bees suggest their family's status, while the encircling arm brings the portrait down to an intimate scale.
works.title: Portrait of the Sisters Zénaïde and Charlotte Bonaparte

works.caption: Five elongated women in dark coats and sweeping feathered hats stand against yellow-green street light. Kirchner gives their faces sharp pale profiles and repeats the pointed shapes in their collars, hands and shoes.
works.title: Five Women on the Street

works.caption: Monet sits in profile painting a small canvas aboard his studio boat, with his wife beside him and a blue cabin behind. Manet surrounds the dark curved hull with short strokes of blue, green and pale reflected light.
works.collection: Bavarian State Painting Collections, Neue Pinakothek, Munich
works.title: Claude Monet painting in his studio boat

works.caption: Mounted soldiers and men on foot clash at close quarters in a Madrid street. A white horse dominates the center, with a red-trousered rider hanging from its saddle, while fallen bodies and discarded weapons cover the foreground.
works.title: The Second of May 1808

works.caption: Arcs, angular strokes and patches of red, yellow and blue crowd around a dark oval near the centre. Kandinsky lets sharp black lines collide with softer pools of colour, so the eye keeps finding new paths through the dense, shifting arrangement.
works.title: Composition VII

works.caption: A dismounted cuirassier turns to look back as he leads his horse down sloping ground. Light catches his helmet and breastplate against the dark sky; the horse lifts a foreleg beside his outstretched arm.
works.title: The Wounded Cuirassier

works.caption: Whistlejacket raises his bent forelegs against a plain buff background, his chestnut body facing right and his head turned outward. A pale flowing tail, small white forehead mark and white hind pastern distinguish the horse.
works.title: Whistlejacket

works.caption: Danaë rests on white bedding beneath red curtains as gold coins fall around her. A young attendant at right gathers coins in a blue cloth; a small brown-and-white dog lies on the floor below.
works.title: Danaë

works.caption: A young man with shoulder-length hair faces the viewer in a broad black cap and a black robe, its edges and sleeves trimmed with bands of small gold squares. A plain brown wall fills the left side. At the upper right an open window looks out over fields, water and buildings to hills and a distant city.
works.title: Portrait of Guidobaldo da Montefeltro

works.caption: A broad estuary runs back between classical buildings towards a pale sun in a yellow sky, with ships and a bridge in the hazy distance. On the left bank Dido, crowned and dressed in blue and white, stands among a crowd gathered round a sheet spread out on the stones, while bare-limbed figures sit on the rocks at the water's edge. Tall dark trees and a white palace with carved friezes rise on the right.
works.title: Dido building Carthage

works.caption: Manuel Osorio stands in a red suit and pale sash, holding the cord attached to a magpie. Three cats sit behind the bird at left, while finches occupy a green cage at right against the plain gray-green background.
works.collection: Metropolitan Museum of Art, New York
works.title: Manuel Osorio Manrique de Zúñiga

works.caption: Armored riders enter among kneeling and fallen figures, carrying tall lances and banners. A chestnut horse bends its head above discarded standards, while the city and blue harbor spread behind the group beneath clouds and smoke.
works.title: Entry of the Crusaders in Constantinople

works.caption: Mary sits in a blue mantle with the Child standing on her lap; he holds a small white lily at her collar, and she holds a gold vase with a taller lily and three roses. Behind them two angels hold up a gold and black patterned cloth while a winged angel's head looks down from the top, and below two small seated angels play a portable organ and a lute.
works.collection: Thyssen-Bornemisza Collection, on loan to Museu Nacional d’Art de Catalunya
works.title: Madonna of Humility

works.caption: A gray-bearded Saint Paul sits wrapped in a heavy brown cloak, with a red tunic visible beneath it. One hand rests over a closed book; a faint halo and the inscription “S. PAVLVS” identify the figure against the plain dark background.
works.title: Saint Paul

works.caption: Philip IV sits upright in armor and a pink sash on a rearing chestnut horse, both facing right. The horse lifts both white-marked forelegs above the sloping ground, while a tree frames the broad blue-gray landscape and sky.
works.title: Equestrian Portrait of Philip IV

works.caption: The young prince stands beneath a spreading tree, holding a hunting gun whose butt rests on the ground. A large brown-and-white dog lies at his left, while another dog looks toward him from the right edge; blue-gray mountains stretch behind the group.
works.title: Prince Balthasar Charles as a Hunter

works.caption: Three weathered stone arches frame Roman roofs, towers and patches of green beneath a cloud-filled sky. Grasses and low plants grow among broken masonry in the foreground, contrasting with the sunlit orange-brown piers.
works.title: A View through Three of the North-Western Arches of the Third Storey of the Coliseum

works.caption: A nude woman sits with her back toward the viewer on a bed covered in white linen. A red-and-white head wrap crowns her dark hair, while gathered white cloth, a deep green curtain and the sheet’s patterned border surround the softly lit figure.
works.title: The Valpinçon Bather

works.caption: A man seen from behind stands on a dark rocky summit, a walking stick beside his right leg. Pale fog fills the valleys below, leaving jagged outcrops and tree-topped ridges visible beneath distant mountains and a broad cloudy sky.
works.collection: Hamburger Kunsthalle, on long-term loan from Stiftung Hamburger Kunstsammlungen
works.title: Wanderer above the Sea of Fog

works.caption: A young woman turns her head upward to the right, her eyes raised and lips parted. Her loose white blouse, pale shawl and dark skirt fill the foreground, with small grave crosses, slender trees and a cloudy sky behind her.
works.title: Orphan Girl at the Cemetery

works.caption: Artists and companions raise slender glasses around a white-covered table beneath dense foliage. Bottles and plates crowd the tabletop, while a child sits on a woman’s lap in the foreground; patches of sunlight brighten the linen, clothing and leaves.
works.title: Hip, Hip, Hurrah!

works.artist: Follower of the Master of Flémalle
works.caption: Two narrow panels stand side by side. At the left, John the Baptist in a red mantle rests a hand on a lamb lying on a book, beside a kneeling man in a brown hooded habit with joined hands; a round convex mirror hangs on the plank partition behind them. At the right, Saint Barbara in a green robe sits reading on a cushioned bench beside a lit fireplace, and through the open window a tower rises in the landscape.
works.title: Wings of the Werl Altarpiece

works.caption: Madame Moitessier sits on a pink sofa in a voluminous floral dress, one finger raised beside her temple and a folded fan in her other hand. A dark mirror repeats her profile and lace-trimmed headdress behind the bright fabric and jeweled bracelets.
works.title: Madame Moitessier

works.caption: Pierrot leans forward in a loose white costume and broad-brimmed hat beside Harlequin’s red-and-dark diamond suit. Harlequin carries a pale baton across his body, while patterned curtains and a blue-gray wall enclose the two full-length figures.
works.collection: Pushkin State Museum of Fine Arts, Moscow
works.title: Mardi Gras

works.caption: A woman rests her hand on her companion’s shoulder as they face the crescent moon; a massive leaning tree and rough foreground rocks frame the pale sky.
works.title: Man and Woman Contemplating the Moon

works.caption: Mary joins her hands above a translucent moon, her pink tunic and dark blue mantle sharply lit against banks of cloud; small stars encircle her bowed head.
works.title: The Immaculate Conception

works.caption: Mary, with long loose hair and a dark blue mantle over a patterned red dress, holds the naked Christ Child on her lap. He holds a small fruit, and her fingertips reach up toward it from below. A rainbow arcs behind her. White lilies and other flowers grow by a tree at the right, a large Gothic church rises behind it, and houses and rows of straw beehives stand at the left.
works.collection: Madonna Chapel, Church of the Coronation of Mary, Stuppach
works.title: Stuppach Madonna

works.caption: On this left screen, blue irises and pointed green leaves rise in uneven clusters across a gold ground, leaving broad open spaces above and between the plants.
works.title: Irises screen

works.caption: In a tiled hall with a beamed ceiling, Christ sits at the centre of a white-covered table with twelve companions, holding a round white wafer over a chalice and raising his other hand. A man in blue stands behind him, another in a red cap waits at the right, and two faces look in through a hatch. Four smaller panels flank the scene: a kneeling man in armour offered bread and a jug, people gathering something from the ground, a group standing at a table, and an angel touching a sleeping man.
works.title: Triptych: The Last Supper

works.caption: At a laden table Christ raises his hand while one disciple flings his arms wide and the other grips his chair; the innkeeper looks on, and a fruit basket teeters on the table's front edge.
works.title: The Supper at Emmaus

works.caption: Winged Victory holds a laurel wreath above the seated Homer before a columned temple; figures crowd the steps around him, offering books, instruments and other emblems of their arts.
works.title: The Apotheosis of Homer

works.caption: Masked faces crowd the foreground beneath “VIVE LA SOCIALE”; behind a line of uniformed marchers, Christ’s small haloed head emerges amid the flags and packed procession.
works.collection: J. Paul Getty Museum, Los Angeles
works.title: Christ's Entry Into Brussels in 1889

works.caption: The crowned Mary holds Christ on her lap beneath a rose-covered trellis, surrounded by small angels; lutes, a harp and a portable organ accompany the gold-ground garden scene.
works.title: Madonna of the Rose Bower

works.caption: The young Infanta rests one hand on a blue-covered table beside a vase of flowers; pale highlights and pink patterns pick out her wide gown against the dark curtain.
