works.title: Infanta Margarita Teresa in a Pink Gown

works.caption: A small moon appears between dark clouds above a green band of reflected light on the Dnieper; the near bank and low buildings are largely absorbed into shadow.
works.title: Moonlit Night on the Dnieper

works.caption: A smiling young woman glances sideways, her dark loose hair framing the face; broad pale strokes mark the folds of her white blouse above a reddish bodice.
works.title: Gipsy Girl

works.caption: A dark nude figure holds a flute horizontally among rising snakes; a pale moon lights the sky above water, a pink bird and dense layers of foliage.
works.title: The Snake Charmer

works.caption: Christ sits at the centre of a crowded supper table beneath a dark hanging curtain; Judas, seen from behind, twists on a pale stool in the foreground.
works.title: The Last Supper

works.caption: A couple in red and black embraces on a green shoreline lawn, flanked by solitary women in white and black; other pairs dance beneath the moon and its reflection.
works.title: The Dance of Life

works.caption: Napoleon extends his arm from a raised platform as soldiers lift their hands and eagle-topped standards toward him; red curtains frame the court at the left.
works.title: The Distribution of the Eagle Standards

works.caption: A severed head rests on a pale cushion beside red flowers; a seated woman holds her head in her hands behind it, amid painted wall patterns and carved figures.
works.collection: J. Paul Getty Museum, Los Angeles
works.title: Arii Matamoe (The Royal End)

works.caption: Mary holds the Child on a carved throne between John the Baptist and John the Evangelist; tall white lilies rise above a dense enclosure of leaves and flowers.
works.title: Bardi Altarpiece

works.caption: The Child leans out from his mother's hold, one arm reaching round to her shoulder, and smiles straight at us. Mary looks down under a sheer veil. She holds one of his feet in her hand; the other stands on the ledge in front. Behind them a low landscape runs under a grey, clouded sky, with a single hill at the right.
works.title: The Madonna and Child (The Mackintosh Madonna)

works.caption: A woman in a pale ruffled bonnet looks to the side, her face brightly lit against dark clothing and background; a red scarf opens below her chin.
works.title: La Monomane de l’envie

works.caption: Mont Sainte-Victoire rises above a patchwork of green fields, trees and pale buildings; pink and ochre rock faces are divided by dark blue contours.
works.title: Mont Sainte-Victoire

works.caption: Mary kneels before the Child lying on her blue mantle, while five angels sing and play lutes beside a stone shed; Joseph and two shepherds occupy the right.
works.title: The Nativity

works.caption: A young woman in a ribboned bonnet leans forward in a theatre box, holding flowers; her companion’s face is partly hidden, and tiers of spectators fill the left background.
works.title: At the Theatre (La Première Sortie)

works.caption: A gutted ray hangs above a kitchen ledge holding fish, oysters and utensils; a cat steps among the shells at the left, opposite dark pots and a draped white cloth.
works.title: The Ray

works.caption: Mariana stands in a wide black gown traced with silver trim, one hand on a chair and the other holding a white cloth; a red curtain hangs above her.
works.title: Queen Mariana of Austria

works.caption: Queen Margarita of Austria rides a chestnut horse in an elaborate dark dress and a high lace ruff. The dense patterns of her clothing and the horse's covering contrast with the softly painted garden, fountain and distant hills at the left.
works.title: Equestrian Portrait of Margarita of Austria

works.caption: Thérèse des Hours sits with her back turned on a stone terrace, wearing a pink striped dress and black apron; pale village buildings appear between dark trees beyond her.
works.title: The Pink Dress

works.caption: Red, white and blue flags project from both sides of a Paris street; viewed from above, the crowd forms a dense trail of small coloured strokes between the buildings.
works.title: The Rue Montorgueil in Paris, Celebration of 30 June 1878

works.caption: The two children, Mary's inclined head and Joseph's leaning figure form a rising diagonal beneath the oak; a lettered scroll links their hands above the cloth-lined cradle.
works.title: The Holy Family under an Oak Tree

works.caption: Eden at the left opens into a crowded landscape of naked figures, oversized fruit and fantastic structures at the centre. At the right, the brightness gives way to a dark Hell where musical instruments become implements of torment; familiar objects turn strange as the eye moves across the triptych.
works.title: The Garden of Earthly Delights

works.caption: Mary holds the Christ Child within a ring of bare branches hung with golden letters A. Her deep red mantle stands out against the darkness, while the tree's interlacing twigs draw a delicate, thorny enclosure around the pair.
works.title: Madonna of the Dry Tree

works.caption: A kiss at the left doorway interrupts the woman's reach toward a striped cloth; her brightly folded dress stands out against dark curtains, while other women occupy the adjoining room.
works.title: The Stolen Kiss

works.caption: A singer in red extends her arm above a foreground crowded with hats, heads and an instrument neck; bright columns and round lights separate the stage from dark foliage.
works.title: Café-Concert at Les Ambassadeurs

works.caption: Dark-outlined irises spread their pointed leaves across the foreground; beyond the yellow-green meadow, a row of trees partly conceals red roofs and pale towers beneath a textured blue-green sky.
works.collection: Van Gogh Museum, Amsterdam (Vincent van Gogh Foundation)
works.title: Field with Irises near Arles

works.caption: Christ displays his wounded palms while two brightly winged angels attend him on a carved stone sarcophagus; empty crosses rise above the small figures in the landscape at the right.
works.title: Christ as the Suffering Redeemer

works.caption: Christ and the Father hold a floral crown above Mary's lowered eyes; the dove spreads its wings in radiant light, while winged children and small heads gather beneath her blue cloak.
works.title: The Coronation of the Virgin

works.caption: Saint Andrew hangs from a vertical cross as a man reaches towards the ropes binding his wrist. Light picks out their bodies against the dark background, while the faces below turn upwards towards the saint.
works.title: The Crucifixion of Saint Andrew

works.caption: Diana, with a small gold crescent moon in her hair, sits on a rock in a yellow dress while a kneeling woman in a purple skirt washes her bare foot beside a metal basin and a white cloth. A companion in a red top and blue skirt sits next to her holding one of her own feet; another in black stands behind with her head bowed, and a fourth, seen from behind and wrapped in orange drapery, sits at the left. A brown and white dog sits at lower left beside a spiky plant.
works.title: Diana and her Nymphs

works.caption: The smiling youth turns toward the viewer while embracing the ram's horned head; bright flesh, white cloth and red-orange drapery stand out against a dark setting with visible leaves and branches.
works.title: Young Saint John the Baptist with a Ram

works.caption: A woman squeezes wet cloth above a wooden pail while a child holds its handle; hanging white laundry, dense flowers and her blue dress fill the garden scene.
works.title: Laundry (Le Linge)

works.caption: Joseph, at left in blue and yellow, and Mary, at right in pink and blue, bring their hands together in front of a bearded high priest in a tall cap. Men crowd behind Joseph, where a youth in red hose bends a stick; women stand behind Mary. Beyond a wide pale square, a many-sided temple with small domes and arched side porches rises on steps, its central door open to a distant landscape.
works.title: The Marriage of the Virgin

works.caption: On top of a natural rock arch, a man in armour with a spear stands beside a naked woman, with a bed and a screen of fruit trees behind them. Below, women in red, blue, yellow and white dance on the grass. A youth plays a lyre at the far left; at the far right a young man in a red hat stands beside a spotted winged horse.
works.title: Mars and Venus, called Parnassus

works.caption: Abraham turns towards the angel, his knife lowered beside Isaac’s leg. The boy remains bound on the wood as the ram appears at the left; the concentrated light makes the pause in the threatened sacrifice unusually clear.
works.title: Sacrifice of Isaac

works.caption: A man lies across a bed with his head tipped back and a pistol hanging from one hand; a red stain marks his pale shirt, while blue-grey walls and red bedding surround him.
works.collection: Emil Bührle Collection, on long-term loan at Kunsthaus Zürich
works.title: The Suicide (Le Suicidé)

works.caption: Venus sits above a crowded company of water nymphs and tritons; winged children circle a looping striped cloth overhead, while fanciful fish and curling waves fill the foreground.
works.title: The Triumph of Venus

works.caption: A man reaches up to slide the bolt while holding a woman close beside the bedroom door. Her raised hand and turned head make the encounter difficult to read; a strong diagonal of light connects their gestures to the rumpled bedding and heavy red curtain.
works.collection: Department of Paintings of the Louvre
works.title: The Lock

works.caption: A broad feathered hat shades the woman's face above her brightly lit neck; crossed arms, red sleeves and a dark wrap fill the lower half against blue sky and grey clouds.
works.title: Portrait of Susanna Lunden (?) ('Le Chapeau de Paille')

works.caption: A boy blows through a slender straw, watching a soap bubble swell at its tip. He holds a blue-and-white bowl in his other hand; broad strokes describe his pale jacket, while a few small highlights give the bubble its fragile roundness.
works.title: Boy blowing bubbles

works.caption: Red poppies spread across the left-hand slope as two pairs of walkers appear near and far; a blue parasol marks the foreground group beneath an open, cloud-filled sky.
works.title: Poppy Field

works.caption: Three nude models show back, frontal and side views in Seurat's studio; La Grande Jatte hangs at left, while the seated figure at right handles a green stocking.
works.title: Models (Poseuses)

works.caption: One woman holds a shallow dish across her body while her companion carries pink flowers at the right. Their blue clothing and warm skin stand out against broad patches of green and yellow, with dark contours giving the figures a still, solid presence.
works.title: Two Tahitian Women

works.caption: Three naked young women stand on a strip of pale, pebbly ground against a black background. The one on the left is seen from behind, turning her head toward the others; the one in the centre faces out under a broad red hat trimmed with pale feathers; the one on the right rests an arm on the central woman's shoulder and holds her own foot up behind her. All three wear gold chain necklaces.
works.title: The Three Graces

works.caption: A huge oval heaven, tier on tier of seated saints and angels on gold, rises to Christ and the kneeling Virgin at its top. Below, apostles crowd round an open tomb full of white lilies on a dark ledge, a man in red kneels at the left and a woman in black at the right, and a river valley runs back to a domed city.
works.title: The Assumption of the Virgin

works.caption: Cloaked travellers huddle through falling snow beside a pack animal laden with a slaughtered pig; a black-and-white dog stands below them and a bare tree bends across the grey sky.
works.title: The Snowstorm or Winter

works.caption: Bathsheba lowers her head while holding David’s letter beside her knee; an attendant tends her extended foot below the glow of skin, white cloth and golden-brown fabric.
works.title: Bathsheba at Her Bath Holding King David’s Letter

works.caption: Moses lifts dark tablets inscribed in Hebrew above his head; pale sleeves frame his lit face, while a brown cloak and ochre-grey background surround the solitary figure.
works.title: Moses with the Tablets of the Law

works.caption: Bazille’s family poses on a shaded terrace, with the artist at far left; pale patterned dresses and a vivid blue skirt stand against dark jackets and the bright countryside beyond.
works.title: Réunion de famille (Family Reunion)

works.caption: A woman in a gleaming white satin dress holds the door handle as a soldier in black leans towards her. His outstretched arm braces against the door, and a small dog waits at their feet; the contrasting fabrics give this farewell much of its tension.
works.title: The Black Brunswicker

works.caption: The Virgin, in pink with a deep blue-green mantle, sits on dark clouds before a burst of light, the naked Child standing at her knee with one foot raised. Below, John the Baptist kneels on one knee in an animal skin, looking out and pointing upward, a thin reed cross behind him. At lower right a white-bearded old man in red drapery lies back among ferns, one arm over his head.
works.title: The Madonna and Child with Saints John the Baptist and Jerome

works.caption: Mary nurses the Christ Child beneath a canopy opened by two angels. Peter and John the Baptist stand at the left, with the doctor-saints Cosmas and Damian at the right; a gold jug of flowers marks the centre of the carefully arranged gathering.
works.title: Medici Madonna

works.caption: Within a painted roundel, Mary supports the red-clothed Christ Child as he turns his smiling face toward her and reaches across her blue cloak.
works.title: Madonna and Child

works.caption: Mary sits in a green landscape with the naked Christ Child on her lap, her arm around him. He rests one hand on her blue mantle at the shoulder and hooks the other into the neckline of her red dress, while turning his face out toward us. She looks down at him, a small open book raised in her other hand.
works.title: Colonna Madonna

works.caption: Mary carries the Christ Child forward on clouds between Saints Sixtus and Barbara, framed by parted green curtains; two winged children lean on the ledge below.
works.title: Sistine Madonna

works.caption: An orange sun and its broken reflection punctuate the misty harbour at Le Havre, with dark ferrymen’s boats in the foreground and cranes, chimneys and masts behind.
works.title: Impression, Sunrise

works.caption: Two aged figures emerge from a nearly black background: the one at the left holds a spoon over a bowl, while the other bends forward with a deeply shadowed face.
works.title: Two Old People Eating (Dos viejos comiendo)

works.caption: Madame de Senonnes sits on a yellow satin sofa in a red velvet dress, surrounded by jewellery and pale fabric, with the back of her head reflected in a dark mirror.
works.title: Portrait of Madame de Senonnes

works.caption: Maria Anna's auburn curls rise above a wide grey ruff, framing her pale face between two distinct textures. Gold-patterned clothing fills the lower part of the portrait, while the plain brown background keeps attention on her steady gaze.
works.title: Portrait of Maria Anna of Spain, Queen of Hungary (1606-1646)

works.artist: Venus Painter (workshop of Hans Holbein the Younger)
works.caption: Venus faces the viewer before a green curtain, extending an open hand over a pale parapet while Cupid leans forward beside her with a long arrow.
works.title: Venus with Cupid

works.caption: Eleven nude women stand, sit and recline among diagonal tree trunks, their bodies outlined in blue beneath a dense blue sky; a small dog and fruit occupy the foreground.
works.title: Bathers (Les Grandes Baigneuses)

works.caption: Rousseau stands on a Paris riverbank in a black suit and beret, holding a palette and brush; a flag-covered ship, iron bridge and distant Eiffel Tower surround his monumental figure.
works.title: Myself: Portrait – Landscape

works.caption: A stag stands on a grassy Highland slope, its broad antlers outlined against a cloudy sky and its sharply modelled coat set against misty mountains.
works.title: The Monarch of the Glen

works.caption: Menippus turns his bearded face toward the viewer above a dark cloak, standing beside books, a rolled paper and an earthenware jug in a spare interior.
works.title: Menippus

works.caption: Napoleon extends an arm from horseback amid wounded soldiers on a snowy battlefield, while bodies fill the foreground and distant formations recede beneath a dark, smoky sky.
works.title: Napoleon on the Battlefield of Eylau (9 February 1807)

works.caption: Bare oaks surround a ruined Gothic church in a dark cemetery, where a small funeral procession approaches the doorway beneath a pale evening sky and a thin crescent moon.
works.title: The Abbey in the Oakwood

works.caption: Dense trees frame a river and bright waterfall beneath a broad mountain range, with a distant snow-covered summit rising beyond the sunlit valley.
works.title: Heart of the Andes

works.caption: Dead gladiators are dragged into a dim chamber beneath the arena, their bodies catching the strongest light. Spectators cluster at the left while a woman crouches apart at the right; Luna gives the aftermath of public spectacle a weight and scale of its own.
works.title: Spoliarium

works.caption: The officer twists in his saddle as his grey horse rears, his curved sabre pointing down beside its flank. A spotted saddlecloth and flashes of gold braid stand out amid the smoke, giving the turning bodies a sharp, restless energy.
works.collection: Department of Paintings of the Louvre
works.title: The Charging Chasseur

works.caption: A young woman looks down at Orpheus’s head resting on his lyre, her richly patterned clothing set against dark rocks and a pale, distant landscape.
works.title: Orpheus (Orphée)

works.caption: Philip IV stands in a rose-red costume covered with silver embroidery, holding a baton and a broad-brimmed black hat. At a distance the decoration looks precise; closer up, quick touches of pale paint break into a lively surface around the still face.
works.title: Portrait of Philip IV in Fraga

works.caption: Pierrot stands frontally in a loose white costume, his arms hanging at his sides; four other figures and a donkey appear lower down among the surrounding trees.
works.title: Pierrot (formerly known as Gilles)

works.caption: Ambroise Vollard sits with his legs crossed and a book resting in his lap. Cézanne builds the face, brown suit and surrounding room from related patches of colour, making the figure seem both solidly present and inseparable from the painted surface.
works.collection: Musée des Beaux-Arts de la ville de Paris
works.title: Portrait of Ambroise Vollard

works.caption: Eugène Boch’s narrow face and yellow jacket stand out against a deep blue ground dotted with stars, the contours and brushstrokes keeping his head sharply defined.
works.title: Eugène Boch (The Poet)

works.caption: A young woman in a large white linen headdress, pinned and folded into wide wings, looks out at the viewer against a black background. She wears a grey-brown gown with a dark neckline, and her ringed hands rest one over the other at the lower edge.
works.title: Portrait of a Young Woman with a White Headdress

works.caption: A man in a tall, wide-brimmed fur hat turns his head towards the left. He wears a dark purple robe patterned in gold, with reddish fur at the neck and cuffs and a gold chain collar from which a small pendant hangs. His right hand, a ring on its little finger, grips a pale wooden staff.
works.title: Portrait of Baudouin de Lannoy

works.caption: Charles VII is shown half-length between white curtains drawn back beneath a red fringed valance, against green cloth. He wears a dark blue hat embroidered with gold zigzags and a fur-trimmed red robe, and his hands rest together on a patterned gold cloth.
works.title: Charles VII, King of France

works.caption: Giuliano de' Medici turns his head to the right, almost in profile, with his eyes lowered. He wears a dark red garment with a thin white collar. Behind him a pale blue opening, edged at the sides by light strips, sits within a broad greyish-brown surround.
works.title: Portrait of Giuliano de' Medici

works.caption: Louis XIV stands beneath red drapery in blue fleur-de-lis robes lined with ermine, extending one stockinged leg beside a cushion bearing royal regalia.
works.title: Portrait of Louis XIV

works.caption: In David’s sketch, Napoleon stands before a gilded throne in red coronation robes and a gold laurel wreath, holding an eagle-topped sceptre and the hand of justice.
works.title: Napoleon in Imperial Costume (sketch)

works.caption: Gris breaks Picasso’s face and jacket into intersecting blue, grey and brown planes, preserving the painter’s palette and a dedication at the lower right.
works.title: Portrait of Pablo Picasso

works.caption: Margareta van Eyck, her face turned slightly to our left, meets our eyes from beneath a white veil with crinkled, pleated edges. She wears a red gown lined with grey fur and gathered by a broad green belt; at the bottom edge a gold ring shows on her right hand.
works.title: Portrait of Margareta van Eyck

works.caption: Don Carlos stands in black court dress, holding a broad-brimmed hat in one hand and a loose glove in the other. A gold chain crosses his chest, while the pale collar, bare hand and shifting patterns in the fabric keep the dark costume from becoming a single flat shape.
works.title: Portrait of the Infante Don Carlos

works.caption: Henriette de Verninac sits sideways on a decorated wooden chair, turning her face towards the viewer above a white dress and a gold-coloured shawl.
works.title: Portrait of Madame de Verninac

works.caption: A cardinal in a red biretta and a red damask cape sits turned at an angle, his eyes sliding round to meet ours. One ringed hand holds a folded letter with a line of writing on it; broad white sleeves spread out below the cape.
works.title: Portrait of Cardinal Bibbiena

works.caption: An older man, possibly Cardinal Niccolò Albergati, turns to the left in a red robe, his lined face and short grey hair set against a dark blue background.
works.title: Portrait of a Man, possibly Cardinal Niccolò Albergati

works.caption: Pius VII sits in a gilded chair against a plain dark background, wearing red robes and a gold-embroidered stole while holding a folded paper.
works.title: Portrait of Pope Pius VII

works.caption: A goat with red cloth wound around its horns stands on a pale, salt-crusted shore. Bones lie nearby, and the still water meets a long ridge of purple mountains; the clear detail makes the animal's isolation feel especially stark.
works.title: The Scapegoat

works.caption: Moonlight breaks through clouds above two small fishing boats, illuminating rough waves while a lantern glows warmly in the nearer boat.
works.title: Fishermen at Sea

works.caption: A naked woman stands chained to a dark rock at the left. At the upper right a young man in a helmet plunges head first through the sky, a red cloak streaming behind him, a sword in one hand and a shield on the other arm. Below him a spiny sea monster rears out of the dark water with its jaws open.
works.title: Perseus and Andromeda

works.caption: Two boxers lean into a close struggle above the ring ropes, their brightly painted bodies surrounded by spectators emerging from a dark room.
works.title: Stag at Sharkey's

works.caption: The Virgin sits with the naked Child on her lap inside a glowing oval of clouds and small child heads, between two trees hung with fruit. Two saints stand at each side of her. At the bottom, three young angels sing from a sheet of paper next to a small organ.
works.title: Madonna in Glory with Saints (Trivulzio Altarpiece)

works.caption: A long-haired, bearded figure in a jewelled tiara and red cope rises from banks of cloud against a gold ground. He raises his right hand and rests his left on a large crystal globe, gripping a tall staff topped with a jewelled cross. Three winged angels on each side sing from open books.
works.collection: Royal Museum of Fine Arts Antwerp
works.title: God the Father with Singing Angels (central panel)

works.caption: A girl sits facing the viewer on the edge of a pale bed, her hands crossed low over her knees, beside a large dark shadow rising across the wall.
works.title: Puberty

works.caption: Ruggiero leans from a winged hippogriff to drive his lance into a sea monster, while Angelica stands chained to a rock above the foaming water.
works.title: Ruggiero Rescuing Angelica

works.caption: Two women sit in a long orange skiff on blue water, an oar extending towards the foreground as a white sail and a railway bridge appear across the river.
works.title: The Skiff (La Yole)

works.caption: Pale triangular sails gather beside Argenteuil’s green riverbank, their reflections broken into broad strokes across the blue Seine beneath red-roofed houses.
works.title: Regattas at Argenteuil

works.caption: Saint John turns his shadowed face to the right, his bare torso lit above red drapery as one hand rests on the reed cross running across the foreground.
works.title: Saint John the Baptist (Corsini)

works.caption: Saint John sits beneath dark trees with his head lowered, holding a reed cross beside a scarlet cloak and fur-edged clothing as light falls across his arms and knees.
works.collection: Nelson-Atkins Museum of Art, Kansas City
works.title: Saint John the Baptist in the Wilderness

works.caption: A white-bearded Jerome with a halo sits on a rock at the mouth of a cave, holding prayer beads and a closed red book. A broad red hat and two wooden sandals lie on the ledge below him. Books rest on a rock shelf, a lion's head looks out from the shadow beneath it, an owl perches on the summit, and a landscape with trees opens at the right.
works.title: Saint Jerome Penitent in the Desert

works.caption: Saint Serapion hangs with wrists bound and head bowed to the left, his closed eyes and pale face emerging above broad folds of white cloth against darkness.
works.collection: Wadsworth Atheneum Museum of Art, Hartford
works.title: Saint Serapion

works.caption: Two women in red and blue gowns and tall feathered hats stand amid blue-coated men, their pointed outlines set against a tilted pink street and vivid green buildings.
works.collection: Neue Galerie New York and Private Collection
works.title: Berlin Street Scene

works.caption: Suzanne Manet sits in profile at the piano with both hands on the keys, her black dress and pale sleeves set against a panelled wall beneath a mantel clock and mirror.
works.title: Suzanne Manet Playing the Piano

works.caption: Christ kneels in a dark garden in a white robe and blue mantle, a ring of light round his head, his hands spread open and his eyes turned upward. An angel in pink swoops down from the upper left, one hand reaching towards him. At the right, dim figures lie in warm brown light beneath dark trees and a strip of pale sky.
works.title: Agony in the Garden

works.caption: Lemminkäinen's mother kneels beside his pale, motionless body, one hand resting on his chest as she looks upwards. Skulls and small flowers lie on the stony bank, while a swan floats on the black water beyond the red rocks.
works.title: Lemminkäinen's Mother

works.caption: Four dark figures float above a tree-lined landscape: one holds a small doll-like form, another raises a circular object, and the figure at the right lifts scissors beside a raised hand.
works.title: The Fates (Atropos)

works.caption: Christ raises his face beneath a crown of thorns, his pale body stretched across a wooden cross against a dark background, with both feet resting on a small ledge.
works.title: Christ Crucified

works.caption: Adele Bloch-Bauer’s pale face and folded hands emerge from a gold field of spirals, rectangles and eye-shaped motifs, with a broad patterned gown spreading across the lower canvas.
works.title: Portrait of Adele Bloch-Bauer I

works.caption: Two figures in pale carnival costumes stand beneath a full moon among bare trees, beside a dark hut with a small face at its edge and a lamp rising behind its roof.
works.title: Carnival Evening

works.caption: A man in a bright blue chaperon with jagged, hanging ends turns his face towards the left. He wears a dark garment with reddish-brown fur and holds up a small gold ring between thumb and finger, while his other hand rests along the bottom edge. A faint AD monogram sits in the upper left corner.
works.title: Portrait of a Man with a Blue Chaperon

works.caption: Four nymphs surround a dark-haired satyr at a woodland pool, grasping his head and arms while a pale figure seen from behind draws him towards the water.
works.title: Nymphs and Satyr

works.caption: Diana sits on blue and white drapery beside a crouching companion, with a quiver and two dogs to the left and a heap of dead game beneath her bow at the right.
works.title: Diana leaving her Bath

works.caption: Across a wide bay, a young man in a winged helmet stands on the back of a huge tusked sea monster, his sword drawn back over his head. At left, a half-draped young woman is bound to a stump by the rocks, and below her a group hide their faces or lie on the ground. At right, a crowd gathers beside two players with oddly shaped instruments, and high in the sky an armoured figure flies in on winged feet.
works.title: Perseus Freeing Andromeda

works.caption: Aesop stands in a loose brown robe with a book at his side, his grey-haired face turned towards the viewer above worn shoes and scattered objects on the floor.
works.title: Aesop

works.caption: A large pink circle edged in red overlaps an ochre quadrilateral against a dark blue-violet ground, with smaller coloured circles clustered around a central grey square.
works.collection: Centre Pompidou, Musée national d’art moderne, Paris
works.title: Accent on Pink

works.caption: Eve raises her hand to an apple offered by a child-headed serpent in the tree, while seated Adam reaches towards her beneath a red parrot and above a fox at her feet.
works.title: Adam and Eve (after Titian)

works.caption: Mary sits at the centre with the Christ Child on her lap, under a rough roof of poles and straw slung between a bare tree and broken stone walls. Kings and their followers in red, gold, blue and black robes crowd in from both sides, some kneeling; at the left a youth sets a crown on a man in red. Horsemen ride over the hills behind, and a star shines at the top.
works.title: Adoration of the Magi

works.caption: Mary, in dark blue beside a pink open-sided shed, holds out the child to three haloed kings: an old man kneeling, a man standing in green, and a young man kneeling in red. Two crowns lie on the ground. A crowd of travellers in turbans and tall hats, with a white horse, a camel and a hound, fills the right; shepherds rest on pale rocks above, and prophets and an Annunciation fill the gold spaces at the top.
works.title: Adoration of the Magi

works.caption: Mary kneels before the child lying on cloth in front of an inscribed sarcophagus, with shepherds at the right and a long mounted procession winding through the landscape.
works.title: Adoration of the Shepherds

works.caption: Two simplified figures in long garments stand amid broad areas of white, blue, yellow, green and red, their heads and clothing bounded by dark contours.
works.title: Improvisation 6 (African)

works.caption: Five women sit among curved red sofas in a brothel salon, while a sixth stands cropped at the right; a foreground woman’s dark stockinged leg cuts across the broad empty seat.
works.title: In the Salon at the Rue des Moulins

works.caption: The young halberdier grips his weapon upright and rests his other hand on his hip. A gold badge and pale feather decorate his red cap; the full cream sleeves, fine chain and bright red clothing below give his military pose an unexpectedly delicate finish.
works.title: Portrait of a Halberdier, Francesco Guardi?

works.caption: A large black disc overlaps a larger blue circle with a pale glowing edge, surrounded by smaller coloured circles that overlap or stand apart against an uneven dark ground.
works.collection: Solomon R. Guggenheim Museum, New York
works.title: Several Circles

works.caption: A seated woman holds a compass beneath a small star, her feet resting on clouds. Artemisia painted the figure nude; the sweeping drapery now covering her body was added later by Volterrano, so the image preserves the work of two different hands.
works.title: Allegory of Inclination

works.caption: A triptych. In the centre, the Virgin in a white veil and blue mantle joins her hands over the naked Child, asleep on a cushion, while small angels carry a red crown above her. On the left wing an old bearded man in blue rests his hands on a book; on the right a young man, bare to the waist, holds his hands together in prayer.
works.title: Dresden Altarpiece

works.caption: Winged Cupid bends towards the sleeping Psyche, reaching for the blue cloth above her head, beneath a leafy tree beside a bare trunk and a pale, clouded sky.
works.title: Cupid and Psyche

works.caption: A winged angel, barefoot in a pale robe and holding a lily, steps toward Mary across a room whose two arched openings look out on a domed building and a hill town. Mary, in red under a dark blue mantle, raises one hand above an open book on a lectern, in front of a canopied bed. A plain wooden chair stands empty between them.
works.title: Annunciation

works.caption: John the Baptist stands at the left with a thin cross-topped staff, one hand raised. A kneeling angel with a wreath of flowers in his hair holds out a lily to Mary, who bows her head with a hand on her chest. At the right Saint Andrew, in an orange cloak, stands behind a tall wooden cross, one hand laid flat against it and the other gripping it lower down. Beyond a low garden wall, a city with a domed cathedral lies among hills.
works.collection: Museo e Real Bosco di Capodimonte, Naples
works.title: Annunciation with Saints John the Baptist and Andrew

works.caption: A red-orange dog lowers its head beside two seated women, one holding a pipe to her mouth, beneath a spreading tree amid bands of green, yellow and red.
works.title: Arearea

works.caption: Cosimo, seen to the waist in engraved silver armour studded with gold rivets and trimmed with crimson, keeps his face almost to the front while his eyes turn hard to the viewer's right. Two round plates with spikes sit on his breastplate. A bare hand rests on a helmet at the lower right, against a deep blue curtain.
works.title: Portrait of Cosimo I de’ Medici in Armour

works.caption: Modigliani sits with a palette and brushes, his elongated face tilted above a blue-grey scarf and rust-red jacket against loosely painted rectangular surfaces.
works.collection: Museu de Arte Contemporânea da Universidade de São Paulo
works.title: Self-portrait

works.caption: Rubens faces us beneath a broad-brimmed black hat, his bare left hand resting beside the hilt of his sword. The pale collar, face and hand emerge from the dark costume, while a massive column rises behind him.
works.title: Self-portrait

works.caption: Van Gogh’s orange beard stands out against his pale blue-green suit and a background of curling brushstrokes, with the head sharply outlined above the broad shoulders.
works.title: Self-portrait

works.caption: Van Dyck turns towards the viewer in a glossy black costume with pale shirt fabric showing through, one hand hanging over a column base and the other set at his waist.
works.title: Self-portrait

works.caption: Heemskerck’s bearded head fills the left foreground beside the ruined Colosseum, while a much smaller figure sits sketching the arches at the lower right.
works.title: Self-portrait with the Colosseum

works.caption: Light catches Rembrandt’s ageing face beneath a brown cap, while his dark red robe and folded hands recede into shadow.
works.title: Self-Portrait at the Age of 63

works.caption: Artemisia Gentileschi leans towards her raised brush, combining a self-portrait at work with the female personification of Painting.
works.title: Self-Portrait as the Allegory of Painting (La Pittura)

works.caption: Endymion Porter, dressed in white, and Van Dyck, in black, each rest a hand on the same rock. Their hands remain separate, but the shared support connects the two figures as firmly as the strong contrast between their clothes distinguishes them.
works.title: Self-portrait with Sir Endymion Porter

works.caption: Rembrandt faces the viewer in a golden garment and dark mantle, a red sash across his waist and a metal-tipped staff in one hand.
works.title: Self-Portrait

works.caption: Rembrandt turns towards the viewer above a stone ledge, wearing a broad dark hat and fur-trimmed costume drawn from Renaissance portraiture.
works.title: Self-Portrait at the Age of 34

works.caption: Men, women and children drink, dance and sprawl on the grass under tall trees by the sea. A naked woman lies asleep across the lower right corner, and beside her a small boy lifts his shirt to urinate. A sheet of music lies in the grass; an old man sleeps on the sunlit hill at right, and a white-sailed ship stands far out on the water.
works.title: The Bacchanal of the Andrians

works.caption: Valentin dances opposite a woman lifting her skirts, surrounded by spectators, while a pink-clad woman dominates the foreground.
works.title: At the Moulin Rouge: The Dance

works.caption: A formally dressed couple turns in a ballroom, her pale blue-white gown and long gloves standing out against his dark evening coat.
works.title: Dance in the City

works.caption: Riders clash on an arched bridge as horses and fallen warriors tumble towards the river, leaving only a narrow opening beneath the crowded combat.
works.title: The Battle of the Amazons

works.caption: Courbet stands on a country road with his painting equipment, greeting Alfred Bruyas and his servant as a dog watches between them.
works.title: The Meeting, or Bonjour, Monsieur Courbet!

works.caption: Van Gogh’s closely cropped head and rust-brown coat stand against a green ground, with a faint dedication to Gauguin above him.
works.title: Self-Portrait Dedicated to Paul Gauguin

works.caption: An ox carcass hangs from a wooden frame in a dim interior, its pale exposed flesh contrasting with the shadowed figure behind it.
works.title: A Slaughtered Ox

works.caption: Hunters in red and other bright clothes, on horseback and on foot, run with hounds after deer through a dark forest of slender trees. Men and animals grow smaller as they head into the wood towards the centre. Felled logs lie on the grass, and a thin crescent moon shows in the night sky between the treetops.
works.title: The Hunt in the Forest

works.caption: Christ twists between recoiling traders and calmer apostles, his raised arm and blue drapery setting the central figure apart from the crowded temple scene.
works.title: Christ Driving the Traders from the Temple

works.caption: A young man with long reddish-brown hair, in a black quilted tunic with gold embroidery, presses a hand to his chest and looks away to the left. In front of him a stone parapet carries a small wreathed medallion with a tiny head and two small dark tablets.
works.title: Portrait of a Young Man (The Broccardo Portrait)

works.caption: A woman in a pink dress and orange shawl, a pale blue mantle over her knees, sits on a bank in an open landscape with three small children. One feeds at her breast. Another kneels in the crook of her other arm, a white-and-gold cloth knotted at his hips, and holds something small up to her. The third lies on the ground at her feet, his face hidden in his folded arms.
works.title: Charity

works.caption: A carriage carrying Paul Valpinçon, his wife, their wet nurse and baby dominates the foreground, while scattered riders occupy the distant field beneath an expansive pale sky.
works.title: At the Races in the Countryside

works.caption: Thatched cottages crowd a sloping garden beneath curling clouds. Closely packed strokes and dark, winding outlines carry movement through roofs, trees and foreground vegetation.
works.title: Chaumes de Cordeville à Auvers-sur-Oise

works.caption: A young armed rider on a pale horse stands out against a dark, rocky landscape. His identity and the painting’s precise subject remain uncertain.
works.title: The Polish Rider

works.caption: Christ sits behind a round table laid with a white cloth, one hand raised and the other on a loaf of bread. Two men sit on stools in front: one in white and red holding a metal jug, the other in green holding bread and a knife. Monks in pale habits stand in the dark behind them. Above, an eye in a triangle glows; a dog lies at the bottom left, and two cats peer from the shadows.
works.title: Supper at Emmaus

works.caption: Cleopatra raises a snake toward her chest, tilting her face upward as her illuminated body emerges from a dark background. Red cloth gathers beneath her seated figure.
works.title: Cleopatra

works.caption: Mourners crowd round Christ's body, laid out on a white sheet below the cross, with a town and mountains beyond. Small kneeling figures and two coats of arms fill the lower corners, and a crown of thorns lies on the ground.
works.collection: Bavarian State Painting Collections – Alte Pinakothek, Munich
works.title: Lamentation of Christ

works.caption: Haloed mourners surround Christ’s body on a white cloth beneath the empty cross. Bright robes and repeated gestures of prayer form a close gathering before a distant walled city.
works.title: Lamentation over the Dead Christ

works.caption: Mourners gather round Christ's body, laid on a white sheet across the foreground. Far behind, horsemen and other figures stand below crosses on a hill at the left, and a bridge leads to a town under mountains. Small kneeling figures and shields line the bottom edge, with a crown of thorns between them.
works.title: Lamentation of Christ

works.caption: Christ's body lies across the foreground among grieving men and women, with a skull and a hammer on the ground below. A tall cross splits the background: the Crucifixion far off at upper left, the Resurrection at upper right, a walled city by the water between. A narrow strip of small scenes runs beneath.
works.title: Lamentation over the dead Christ

works.caption: A keyboard player turns toward a companion touching his shoulder, while a feather-capped singer looks outward. The three half-length figures emerge from a dark background.
works.title: The Concert

works.caption: Two clothed men sit with a lute in a wooded landscape, accompanied by two nude women. One woman holds a wind instrument, while the other tips a glass vessel over a stone basin.
works.title: Pastoral Concert

works.caption: Mary sits at the centre with the dead Christ stretched across her knees, under a portico of stone pillars and arches that opens onto distant hills. At left a young man holds up Christ's head and shoulders; at right a seated woman with a halo bows her head over clasped hands, Christ's legs lying across her lap and his feet reaching past her knee. Behind them a young man looks upward with palms pressed together and an old bearded man looks down.
works.title: Pietà

works.caption: The dead Christ, eyes closed and wearing a crown of thorns, is held upright by two winged angels behind him. The angel on the left bends toward his face, one hand on his shoulder and the other at his side; the angel on the right holds his wrist and looks upward. Wounds show in his hands and side. A pink cloth hangs behind him, a white cloth lies across his lap, and the background is a plain turquoise.
works.title: Dead Christ Supported by Two Angels

works.caption: Three crosses rise against a blue sky and a sharply cut rocky landscape. At the foot of the central cross, mourning figures on the left face a group of soldiers on the right.
works.collection: Department of Paintings of the Louvre
works.title: Crucifixion

works.caption: Christ raises his face toward the sky, his arms extended upward on the cross above a dark landscape. His separately nailed feet rest on a wooden support, with a skull among the stones below.
works.title: The Crucified Christ

works.caption: One wide landscape holds at least twenty-five small scenes: a walled city of towers and domes at the centre, ships on the water beyond, and riders with banners passing between rocky hills. In the foreground a bald king kneels before Mary and the Child at a brick shelter. At the lower left a man and a youth kneel outside a stable; at the lower right a woman in black kneels beside a crowded room.
works.title: The Seven Joys of the Virgin

works.caption: Christ looks upward while holding bread above a white-covered table, surrounded by apostles leaning closely toward him. Candles burn at the right, and a foreground diner turns toward the viewer beneath a sweep of golden drapery.
works.title: Last Supper

works.caption: A woman with tall grey curls and a feathered blue headpiece gathers shimmering blue fabric against her chest. A black ribbon circles her neck above a small gold cross, while pale, loose strokes describe the translucent fabric across her shoulders.
works.title: Portrait of a Lady in Blue

works.caption: Danaë reclines with one arm behind her head and the other hand closed near her thigh as gold falls over the bed. Behind her, a servant lifts a fold of blue cloth to catch the shower, turning her back on the pale figure stretched across the dark red bedding.
works.title: Danaë

works.caption: Holbein’s wife sits against a dark background with a young child supported at her side and an older boy below. Her hand rests around the boy’s shoulder, while both children look to the right beyond the surviving edge.
works.title: Portrait of the Artist's Family

works.caption: Two young men carry Christ's pale body, wrapped at the hips in a grey-green cloth: one stands at the left holding him round the chest, the other crouches below with the legs across his back. Around them a crowd of figures in pink, blue, green and orange rises to the top of the arched panel. A small cloud floats at upper left, and a bearded man in a green turban looks out from the far right edge.
works.title: The Deposition from the Cross

works.caption: Two men carry Christ's pale body in a white shroud, while a young man in red holds the raised arm. Christ's chest is sunk in shadow, and his other arm hangs down at the right. Two women follow at the left, one in a blue mantle with her hands clasped. A ring of thorny twigs lies against a stone block at the bottom.
works.title: The Entombment of Christ

works.caption: Men on two ladders lower Christ's greenish body from a broad wooden cross against a flat blue sky; a third ladder slants up beneath him, and a white-bearded old man leans over the crossbeam. Below, women hold up a veiled figure as a woman in red kneels and clasps her legs; at the right a man bends forward, his face in his hands.
works.collection: Pinacoteca e Museo Civico di Volterra
works.title: Descent from the Cross

works.caption: Floodwater leaves two patches of high ground. On the left, people climb a slope carrying children, bundles and an upturned stool piled with pots; in the middle, a boat is packed with struggling figures; on the right, a group crowds under a cloth stretched over a rocky island. A boxy wooden ark stands farther back. Nude youths twist and lean on the painted frame above and below; one at the top is mostly lost under a large pale patch.
works.title: The Deluge

works.caption: A thick black arch crosses a burgundy form above broad blue and red-orange areas. Thin black lines sweep and loop across the colours, while a pink circle floats at the left against a pale, loosely brushed ground.
works.title: Picture with a Black Arch

works.caption: Two panels that were once one picture, shown one above the other. Above is the lagoon hunt now in the Getty Museum: men in long boats hunt with bows on green water, with thatched buildings, reed beds, distant hills and lines of birds in the sky. Below is this panel: two women sit on a terrace by a balustrade, among doves, a parrot, a large brown bird and two dogs, while a boy stands behind the columns at left.
works.title: Two Venetian Ladies

works.caption: A woman raises her sword over a fallen opponent, holding a dark oval shield before her. Behind a wooden barrier, spectators watch beneath upright spears, while the standing fighter’s orange and mauve drapery fills the right side.
works.title: Women Gladiators

works.caption: Heracles lifts Antaeus off the ground, leaning back as his opponent arches and cries out. Their intertwined limbs fill the tiny panel, while a distant landscape beneath a pale blue sky makes the struggle seem to take place high above the surrounding country.
works.title: Heracles and Antaeus

works.caption: A maid holds out a folded letter to a woman seated at a writing table. The seated woman turns toward her with fingers against her chin, her yellow jacket and spotted white trim brightly lit against a dark background.
works.title: Mistress and Maid

works.caption: Dozens of winged children crowd an orchard under tall trees, flying up into the branches, hugging, kissing and gathering apples into wicker baskets. At the right a stone statue of Venus stands on a carved pedestal, holding out a small shell in one hand. Below it one woman raises an oval mirror and another, in blue, looks up. Beyond lie green hills, a building and a cloudy blue sky.
works.title: The Worship of Venus

works.caption: An open window frames boats with orange masts on pink and pale blue water. Flowerpots crowd the sill, while broad turquoise and pink walls surround the smaller strokes of foliage, sky and harbour.
works.title: Open Window, Collioure

works.caption: Courbet portrays himself reclining against a tree, with closed eyes and a red stain on his open white shirt. A sword leans at the left, while his hand rests across the dark fabric covering his body.
works.title: The Wounded Man

works.caption: A village lies under snow and a grey sky. On the left a crowd presses against the front of an inn, while people cross the frozen ponds, carts and barrels stand in the snow and bare trees rise over the roofs. In the lower centre a cloaked woman rides a donkey, with an ox beside her.
works.collection: Royal Museums of Fine Arts of Belgium
works.title: The Census at Bethlehem

works.caption: Orange-yellow, bell-shaped flowers hang beneath crowns of narrow green leaves. Their copper vase stands on a streaked tabletop against a blue background covered with small, pale dabs of paint.
works.title: Fritillaries in a Copper Vase

works.caption: A woman leans forward from white bedding and lifts a red curtain with one hand. Light picks out her face, bare shoulder and gold-trimmed headdress against the dark space behind her.
works.title: A Woman in Bed

works.caption: A woman looks down as she lifts her white shift above the water with both hands. Broad pale strokes describe the garment, while red and gold fabric lies on the bank behind her and her legs are reflected in the stream.
works.title: A Woman Bathing in a Stream (Hendrickje Stoffels?)

works.caption: A seated woman holds a powder puff beside a small standing mirror. Dense coloured dots describe her pale skin, dark bodice and full yellow skirt, against a blue-green wall with a framed flower arrangement above.
works.title: Young Woman Powdering Herself

works.caption: A young woman, naked but for a pink cloth, holds up a small hand mirror. The cloth hangs from that arm and down to her hip, and more of it lies in folds at lower left. Her other arm is raised behind her head, and a round mirror behind her shows the back of her blue patterned headcloth. At the left a window looks out on hills, houses and distant blue mountains.
works.title: Young Woman at her Toilette

works.caption: Judith grips Holofernes’s hair and cuts his neck with a sword while another woman restrains him. Their extended arms cross above the bed, where blood runs down the white bedding beneath red drapery.
works.title: Judith Beheading Holofernes

works.caption: Judith pauses with her sword lowered and a hand raised beside the candle. Her maid crouches over Holofernes’s head and a cloth sack; both women look to the left, while the small flame throws their faces and hands into sharp relief.
works.title: Judith and Maidservant with Head of Holofernes

works.caption: Five men using crutches and wooden supports gather in a walled courtyard. Their varied headgear includes a red crown-like cap and a paper mitre, while fox tails hang from several cloaks; these strange costumes leave the scene’s precise meaning open to interpretation.
works.collection: Department of Paintings of the Louvre
works.title: The Beggars

works.caption: A young man looks to one side while extending a hand towards us and holding a skull in the other. His sweeping red feather and loosely painted cloak give the figure an air of performance, while the skull introduces a reminder of mortality.
works.title: Young Man holding a Skull (Vanitas)

works.caption: Dancers link hands before a golden bull raised on a decorated altar. A white-robed man stands beside it, while people kneel and raise their arms at the right and two figures descend the rocky slope at the left.
works.title: The Adoration of the Golden Calf

works.caption: A white-clad figure carries a sword and smoking torch above a black horse with outstretched legs. Bodies and black birds fill the ground beneath, framed by broken trees and red-pink clouds.
works.title: La Guerre

works.caption: A young woman, seen to below the waist, looks out at the viewer. She wears a blue dress embroidered in gold, with puffed blue upper sleeves, burgundy lower sleeves slashed to show white puffs, a long gold chain and earrings with pearl drops. Her golden hair is braided and pinned up, one braid falling over her right shoulder. Her left hand touches a twisted gold cord at her waist; her right, below a dark fur draped over the forearm, holds its gold end. The background is plain and dark.
works.title: La Bella

works.caption: Beneath a leafy, flowered hat, Flora turns left and extends blossoms; her pale sleeves and yellow skirt emerge from the dark background.
works.title: Flora

works.caption: Festival crowds and carriages fill the meadow beside the Manzanares, while Madrid’s palace and domes rise across the river.
works.title: The San Isidro Meadow

works.caption: Helena Fourment looks towards the viewer, holding a dark fur wrap across her body above a red floor covering.
works.title: Helena Fourment in a Fur Robe

works.caption: Clouds fill the sky above Argenteuil’s riverbank, where walkers, small boats and white sails gather beside the tree-lined promenade.
works.title: Le Bassin d'Argenteuil

works.caption: A couple embraces beside a pale curtain, their dark forms joined at the right of a blue-toned window overlooking the street.
works.collection: National Museum of Art, Architecture and Design
works.title: Kiss by the Window

works.caption: Boats and slender masts line the pale channel, while a curving quay and receding mooring posts lead towards the distant waterfront.
works.title: The Channel of Gravelines, Petit Fort Philippe

works.caption: A pale sail and dark fishing boats occupy the broad blue-green basin, with a white lighthouse rising on the far-right bank.
works.title: The Channel of Gravelines, in the Direction of the Sea

works.caption: Bentheim’s towers rise above a steep wooded hill, with scattered houses below and bright clouds beside a darker bank of cloud.
works.title: The Castle of Bentheim

works.caption: Polyphemus’s single large eye appears above a purple ridge, while Galatea lies asleep amid the richly coloured slope below.
works.title: The Cyclops

works.caption: A youth in a broad brown hat sits on a red chair, his warm-toned face and resting hands contrasting with blue-grey clothes and a blue wall.
works.title: The Little Peasant

works.caption: Dancers practise and wait in the Opéra’s dance foyer, with a raised leg at the barre, a music stand and an empty chair on the broad floor.
works.title: The Dance Foyer at the Opéra on rue Le Peletier

works.caption: A bearded man in a broad green hat faces the viewer, his striped clothing set against dense strokes of grass and foliage.
works.collection: Galleria Nazionale d'Arte Moderna e Contemporanea di Roma
works.title: Young Peasant

works.caption: Men examine cotton samples, read a newspaper and work at a desk in a busy trading office. The white cotton spread across the long table leads the eye into the room, linking the separate figures within Degas’s sharply angled view.
works.title: A Cotton Office in New Orleans

works.caption: A blue-violet bridge stretches across the misty Thames, with small dark boats below and distant buildings barely emerging through the haze.
works.title: Waterloo Bridge. Effect of Fog

works.caption: A woman holding a baby, an older woman with a basket and a sleeping boy sit on the front bench of a crowded railway carriage.
works.title: The Third-Class Carriage

works.caption: A large black shape rises above curved outlines and bright colour patches, while yellow spreads across the right half of the canvas.
works.title: Impression III (Concert)

works.caption: Mary kneels before God the Father as he crowns her, surrounded by rows of saints and angels carrying tall stems of white lilies.
works.title: Coronation of the Virgin

works.caption: Christ, seated at right, lowers a jewelled gold crown onto Mary's bowed head as a white dove spreads its wings above them against fine gold rays. Their robes and the hanging behind them are patterned in gold, and an angel at each side holds a scroll lined with musical notes and words. The image includes a gilded frame with twisted columns.
works.title: Coronation of the Virgin

works.caption: Christ, seated beside Mary under a pale Gothic canopy, sets a crown on her bowed head. Haloed saints crowd the two side arches, and below, three angels kneel on small clouds inside a starry blue arc. Spires and gilded carving frame the whole, with a row of small scenes along the base.
works.title: Coronation of the Virgin

works.caption: Jacopo Pesaro kneels with a red banner before Saint Peter, while Pope Alexander VI stands behind him in a green and gold cope.
works.collection: Royal Museum of Fine Arts Antwerp
works.title: Jacopo Pesaro, Bishop of Paphos, being presented by Pope Alexander VI to Saint Peter

works.caption: Jeanne Hébuterne sits in an ochre-yellow sweater, her long neck and pale blue eyes set against a grey-green wall and reddish furniture.
works.title: Jeanne Hébuterne with Yellow Sweater

works.caption: Jeanne Samary rests her cheek against one hand, wearing a blue-green dress against a pink background traced with loose blue and green marks.
works.title: Portrait of the actress Jeanne Samary

works.caption: Two girls lean towards an open musical score, one seated at the piano and the other resting her arm beside the pages.
works.title: Girls at the Piano

works.caption: Gondolas crowd the Grand Canal below the old wooden Rialto bridge, and a throng of townspeople fills the quay at the lower left. In a loggia at the upper left, churchmen and white-hooded brothers gather around a man in black whose head is thrown back.
works.title: Miracle of the Relic of the Holy Cross at the Rialto Bridge

works.caption: A red-streaked trunk divides into twisting dark branches that spread across a blue field, with scattered yellow and pink strokes below.
works.title: Avond (Evening): The Red Tree

works.caption: The accused wear tall penitential caps before a tribunal in a crowded, vaulted hall. Light catches their bowed heads and pale garments, separating them from the mass of dark-clothed spectators and making their public exposure especially stark.
works.collection: Royal Academy of Fine Arts of San Fernando
works.title: The Inquisition Tribunal

works.caption: Musicians crowd the orchestra pit beneath a bright strip of dancers, whose heads are cut off by the upper edge; a bassoon stretches diagonally across the foreground.
works.title: L'Orchestre de l'Opéra

works.caption: Small red, orange and blue strokes build the Eiffel Tower against a pale blue sky, its broad arch narrowing into a faint summit.
works.collection: Fine Arts Museums of San Francisco
works.title: The Eiffel Tower

works.caption: Diagonal floorboards lead past a dancer with a green sash toward the ballet master and his long staff, while pupils rest and adjust their clothes around the room.
works.title: The Ballet Class

works.caption: Branching channels reflect the evening sky between dark banks, while rows of trees and a small sailboat lie beneath the wide yellow-blue horizon.
works.title: The Grosse Gehege near Dresden

works.caption: A frightened cleric pours oil into a lamp as shadowy donkeys rear behind him. Goya draws on a comic play in which the man has been tricked into believing that his life will end if the flame goes out.
works.title: The Bewitched Man

works.caption: A man holds his companion’s hand and parts the greenery beside a narrow path; her white dress catches the light against the dark foliage.
works.title: La Promenade

works.caption: A woman in a pale striped dress stands beside friends gathered around a small table, with patches of light breaking through the dark leafy canopy.
works.title: In the Garden (Under the Trees of the Moulin de la Galette)

works.caption: A burning candle and two pale books rest on a green armchair seat, surrounded by curved reddish wood, blue shadows and a patterned floor.
works.title: Gauguin’s Chair

works.caption: A red-haired woman sits with her back towards us beside a bathing tub. Quick strokes follow her spine, the folds of the cloth beneath her and the wicker furniture, letting the bare cardboard show through parts of the lightly painted scene.
works.title: La Toilette

works.caption: Saint George raises his sword above a dragon trapped beneath a rearing pale horse, while a princess stands at the left beside a sheep.
works.title: Saint George and the Dragon

works.caption: Goya turns toward the viewer with brush and palette in hand, his dark hat and red-trimmed jacket outlined against a bright studio window.
works.collection: Royal Academy of Fine Arts of San Fernando
works.title: Self-portrait in the Studio

works.caption: A mother holds a sleeping child beside an older woman whose face is hidden by her hand and falling hair. Circles, flowers and geometric patterns surround the figures, drawing the three stages of life into a single narrow column against the darker background.
works.collection: Galleria Nazionale d'Arte Moderna e Contemporanea di Roma
works.title: The Three Ages of Woman

works.caption: Leda sits beneath a broad tree with a white swan across her lap; musicians gather at the left, while bathers and attendants occupy the water’s edge at the right.
works.title: Leda and the Swan

works.caption: Pale lilac blossoms rise through dense green leaves beside a narrow pink path, with yellow flowers and a blue background surrounding the bush.
works.title: Lilac Bush

works.caption: Dancers kick their legs high in a row, skirts lifted, above a double bass and the back of the conductor, while a leering man in a hat looks up from the lower right; everything is built from fine coloured dots under round lights.
works.title: Le Chahut

works.caption: Beneath immense branching trees, Jacob leans into a winged angel while travellers and animals pass along the path at the right.
works.title: Jacob Wrestling with the Angel

works.caption: Lucretia, seen in profile against a black background, tips her head back and looks upward with her lips parted. Her golden hair is braided and strung with pearls. One breast is bare, and silvery drapery with a broad gold band crosses her body to a round clasp at her shoulder. Her hand grips a dagger with an ornate gold hilt.
works.title: Lucretia

works.caption: Magdalena Ventura faces the viewer while nursing an infant, with her husband behind her and a long inscription on stone blocks at the right.
works.title: Magdalena Ventura and Her Husband (The Bearded Lady)

works.caption: Miss La La hangs by a leather mouthpiece held between her teeth, seen from below against the orange ceiling and green girders of the circus.
works.title: Miss La La at the Cirque Fernando

works.caption: Behind a pink veined ledge, a woman in a deep blue mantle looks down as she holds a child in a white shirt. He twists away, gazing up with his mouth open, one foot and one knee on the ledge. A small painted label on its front carries the painter's name.
works.title: Lochis Madonna

works.caption: Peter Martyr’s cleaver and chest wound stand beside Mary and the two children, with a winding river and distant mountains behind the sacred group.
works.title: Madonna and Child with the Young St John the Baptist and St Peter Martyr

works.caption: Mary and the child lower their eyes above her blue mantle, framed by a green curtain and a slender tree in the distant landscape.
works.title: Madonna and Child

works.caption: Against a dark ground, a woman in a blue mantle patterned with gold holds a pale baby close, his cheek against hers and his arm across her chest. His eyes roll upwards and his mouth is open; she does not look at him. Both have thin gold haloes.
works.title: Virgin and Child

works.caption: Mary, in a mantle of raised gold with a green lining, looks down at the curly-haired Christ Child. He sits on the stone ledge in front of her, on the green lining, steadied by her two hands and clutching a fruit to his chest. Figs and peaches hang above her, in front of a dark red cloth, with sky and trees on either side. A carnation stands upright at the left end of the cracked ledge, while two violets and a fly lie on top of the ledge to the right, above Crivelli's carved-looking signature.
works.title: Virgin and Child

works.caption: A young woman with curling hair under a gold-brown veil bends her cheek to a sleeping baby. One hand cups his head; the other lies across his tightly wrapped body. Her blue dress shows beneath a gold cloak that curves round them both, against a dark background.
works.title: Madonna and sleeping child

works.caption: A man and a woman in dark clothes kneel in profile at the lower left, looking up. At the right the Virgin, in a red dress and blue mantle, holds the naked Christ Child on her lap, and he stretches a hand toward them. Behind, a green curtain hangs beside a window onto trees, water and distant mountains.
works.title: Madonna and Child with Two Donors

works.caption: A fair-haired woman in a lilac dress and blue mantle sits in a dark, rocky cave, with plants around her and a glimpse of blue landscape at the top right. Her hand steadies a small boy, seen from behind, who holds a thin cross. A curly-haired child sitting on a white cloth on her knee reaches a hand out towards him. One of her feet wears an elaborate strapped sandal.
works.title: Madonna and Child with the Young Saint John

works.caption: Mary sits between Saint Anthony, in a plain friar’s habit, and Saint Roch, carrying a pilgrim’s staff and showing his bare thigh; the Christ child stands on her lap. A green curtain gathers the figures into a quiet group, with glimpses of landscape at either side.
works.title: The Virgin and Child between Saint Anthony of Padua and Saint Roch

works.caption: A winged angel holds a small wreath over Mary's head. Mary, in a blue robe, sits on the ground with the Christ Child on her lap, and he reaches for a red book held by a young woman saint in green. At the right a bearded saint in red and grey-blue joins his hands, a long staff beside him. A large tree shades the group, with hills and sky beyond.
works.title: Madonna and Child with Saints Catherine and Thomas

works.caption: Mary steadies the Christ Child, seated on a cushion above a wooden chest, between an aged Saint Jerome holding a crucifix and Saint Nicholas of Tolentino, a tall lily rising between them against a green curtain and a deep landscape.
works.title: Virgin and Child with Saints Jerome and Nicholas of Tolentino

works.caption: Red cherub heads float in the clouds around the Madonna and Child, who turn inward toward each other above a low parapet with a landscape opening at either side.
works.title: Madonna of the Red Cherubim

works.caption: The naked Christ Child stands on a green-marbled parapet before the Madonna, who holds him in her blue mantle, two tall poplars rising symmetrically beyond the green hanging behind them.
works.title: Madonna of the Small Trees

works.caption: Mary sits on a high throne with the child on her lap, under a dark green canopy whose curtains two flying angels hold open. Two saints stand on each side; the one in a bishop's mitre, front right, looks out at us. At the foot of the throne two small winged boys sing from a scroll.
works.title: Madonna of the Baldacchino

works.caption: The Virgin, in pink and blue, presses her hands together as the naked Christ Child sits on her lap. St Anne leans in behind him and supports his raised arm while he reaches towards the kneeling infant St John, who holds a thin cross. At upper left a bearded, haloed man in orange stands apart beside a dark pillar, with an opening to the sky behind him.
works.title: Madonna of Divine Love

works.caption: The Virgin faces the viewer almost frontally, long hair falling over her red gown, while the Christ Child holds a small apple and a red carnation against a dark green ground streaked with fine light.
works.title: The Madonna of the Carnation

works.caption: An angel crowned with roses holds up the Christ Child, who pinches the little finger of the hand Mary raises to her breast, while a second angel behind him looks straight out. Mary looks down. Her blue cloak has jewelled gold borders. Above a wall with mottled red panels, dark trees and a fan-leaved palm stand against the sky.
works.title: The Virgin and Child with Two Angels

works.caption: The Virgin sits in a flowering garden with the Child on her lap, a rose trellis behind her and a gold sky above. Angels fly overhead, read from a book, fill a basket with roses and gather round a tall golden fountain at upper left. Below right sits a crowned saint holding a wreath, with a wheel and a sword at the bottom edge.
works.title: Madonna of the Rose Garden

works.caption: The Virgin sits with the Child on a rocky seat between the gaunt Saint Jerome and Saint Louis of Toulouse in bishop's robes, a tall orange tree rising behind them over an open landscape.
works.title: Madonna of the Orange Tree

works.caption: The Virgin holds the sleeping Christ Child before an open blue sky, a vine with two grape clusters overhead and a golden band of zodiac signs curving above her shoulders.
works.title: Madonna of the Zodiac

works.caption: The Virgin holds the Christ Child before a cloth of gold, a single pear resting on the parapet below and a wide landscape opening at either side.
works.title: Alzano Madonna

works.caption: The Virgin, in a red dress with a white veil under her hood, looks down at the naked Child she holds. He looks up at her, gripping her fingers with one hand and holding a sprig of small red berries in the other. At the right, an arched opening shows a brick wall.
works.title: Bagnacavallo Madonna

works.caption: The Virgin holds the Christ Child against a gold ground, his hand raised to her cheek, two angels leaning in from the upper corners.
works.title: Madonna di Crevole

works.caption: The Virgin sits high on a throne with the Child on her lap and reaches a hand down toward a kneeling friar at left; a second friar holding a lily and a book stands behind him. At right a woman rests her foot on a wheel beside a bearded man in a red cloak who points. Columns frame the scene, with children's heads in a cloud above and two winged children flying at either side.
works.title: Madonna with St. Francis

works.caption: Against a dark ground the Virgin clasps the Christ Child, whose feet rest on the sill below and who looks out sadly with a small fruit in one hand; the red Greek letters naming the Mother of God stand at the upper corners.
works.title: Madonna with the Child

works.caption: The Virgin, in a red gown and white veil, steadies the Christ Child as he stands on a sill at the right before a green striped hanging, with open country and buildings visible at the left.
works.title: The Gypsy Madonna

works.caption: Lucretia, her chemise slipping from one shoulder, grasps a dagger and turns her face upward, a bearded man close behind her in the shadow.
works.title: Lucretia and her Husband Lucius Tarquinius Collatinus

works.caption: Isabella d'Este wears a pearl-set, turban-like headdress and a dark gown with gold-embroidered, fur-trimmed sleeves, her hands resting low against a dark ground.
works.title: Portrait of Isabella d'Este

works.caption: A procession crowds a brick bridge over a green Venetian canal while, below, the confraternity's leader, in white, rises from the water holding up the golden reliquary, watched by richly dressed women on the left bank and five kneeling men on the right.
works.title: Miracle of the Cross at the Bridge of S. Lorenzo

works.caption: The Virgin, in blue before a red cloth, holds the Christ Child on a red cushion while a small yellow-green bird leans in at his shoulder, children crowd in at the lower right with a sprig of lilies of the valley, and two cherubs hold a wreath above her head.
works.title: Madonna with the Siskin

works.caption: Monet, in a dark bowler hat, sits in profile smoking a long pipe and reading a folded newspaper, his warm face lit against a dark, softly brushed ground.
works.title: Claude Monet Reading

works.caption: Two Tahitian women sit in a field of dry yellow grass, the nearer one cross-legged in a white top and a red-and-yellow patterned skirt with a flower in her hair, the other in a pale violet dress behind her, blue mountains rising beyond.
works.title: When Will You Marry?

works.caption: On a wooden table below a grey-green wall, onions with pale green shoots are heaped with a white cloth beside a dark bottle, a small glass and a knife.
works.title: Still Life with Onions

works.caption: Apples and oranges spill across white drapery between a shallow plate, a raised bowl and a flower-painted jug. The folds and patterned fabrics tilt and turn around the fruit, making the tabletop feel carefully constructed yet oddly unstable.
works.title: Apples and Oranges

works.caption: Lit by a candle that a maidservant shields with her hand, Peter in a white cloak denies knowing Christ while soldiers look on, and in the shadows at the right Christ is led away.
works.title: The Denial of Saint Peter

works.caption: Across a field of muted greys, curved and angular shapes in red, blue, pink and white overlap with heavy black lines, a black bow-like arc at the upper left and a dark diagonal band through the centre.
works.title: In Grey

works.caption: A dog helps itself from the table while a pig noses through the disorder on the floor. Drinking, music and scattered possessions fill the room; Steen turns household chaos into a comic warning about excess.
works.title: Beware of Luxury (“In Weelde Siet Toe”)

works.caption: A nude woman lies on her back across the full width of the canvas, one arm stretched above her head, against deep red patterned drapery and a blue-grey cloth.
works.title: Nu couché

works.caption: Christ, a white cloth about his waist and a hoe in one hand, steps back from the kneeling Mary Magdalene, who reaches up toward him in a green landscape with a walled town on the hill behind.
works.title: Noli me tangere

works.caption: The risen Christ, bare-chested in a blue robe, points upward with one hand and reaches down with the other toward Mary Magdalene. She has sunk to the ground in a patterned yellow dress over red drapery and looks up at him. A broad tree trunk rises behind him, with a long-handled tool leaning against it; a straw hat and a second iron blade lie on the ground at the lower right.
works.title: Noli me tangere

works.caption: A nude woman lies on her side on rumpled white sheets with her back to us, turning her head over her shoulder to look out; one knee is drawn up and the other leg stretched along the bed, against a dark green background.
works.title: Reclining nude (on the left side)

works.caption: A nude woman leans her head against her own shoulder with closed eyes, her body turned toward the viewer, a dark red chair beside her against a teal-green wall.
works.title: Female Nude

works.caption: Christ kneels in prayer on a rocky ledge as cherubs carrying the instruments of the Passion hover on a cloud, three disciples lie asleep in the foreground, and Judas leads a band of soldiers down from the walled city.
works.title: The Agony in the Garden

works.caption: Juno, seated on clouds beside her gilded chariot, presses her breast as the infant Hercules reaches for it, a jet of milk streaming off into stars; Jupiter broods at the left with his eagle and thunderbolts, and her peacocks wait at the right.
works.title: The Birth of the Milky Way

works.caption: A dark hill with a slender tower at its left rises against a deep blue sky, crossed in front by broad bands of red, yellow and violet, with a large white form and three pale round shapes above.
works.title: Murnau, Landscape with a Tower

works.caption: Three haloed saints stand on a marble floor before a balustrade and a wide landscape: the deacon Vincent in red velvet at left, James the Great at centre with a tall pilgrim's staff and his hat at his feet, and Eustace at right in a dark fur-trimmed tunic and red hose.
works.title: Saints Vincent, James the Great and Eustace

works.caption: Under a shell-topped throne with a red canopy held back by angels, the Virgin and Child sit enthroned, flanked by Saint Catherine, Saint Augustine and Saint Barnabas on the left and Saint John the Baptist, Saint Ignatius and the archangel Michael in armour on the right.
works.title: San Barnaba Altarpiece

works.caption: A still, lily-covered pool lies among tall oaks and beeches, a great withered tree leaning over the water at the right and a felled trunk lying in the foreground, with a small figure far off between the trunks.
works.title: A Wooded Marsh

works.caption: A bald, bearded old man with a white cloth over one shoulder stands in a small boat in the middle of a wide blue-green river, a tiny pale figure seated in front of him. On the left bank, wooded green islands with small winged figures; on the right, green trees before a dark round tower with an arched gate, and fires glowing under black clouds beyond.
works.title: Landscape with Charon Crossing the Styx

works.artist: Jan Brueghel the Elder and Peter Paul Rubens
works.caption: In a dense green paradise Eve, one arm raised into the apple tree where the serpent coils, hands an apple to the seated Adam, while horses, deer, big cats, a peacock, an ostrich and countless birds fill the garden around them.
works.title: The Garden of Eden with the Fall of Man
