works.caption: In a colonnaded city street under a blue, clouded sky, a crowd recoils from the plague-struck dead and dying — a woman lies dead at the centre with a child at her breast — while two men carry a body down the steps behind.
works.collection: Department of Paintings of the Louvre
works.title: The Plague at Ashdod

works.caption: The Piazza San Marco opens in sharp perspective, the Campanile rising above the domes of the basilica, the colonnades of the Procuratie running down either side and small figures crossing the sunlit pavement.
works.title: The Piazza San Marco in Venice

works.caption: The Virgin, in a white veil and a dark blue mantle, sits on the ground holding the dead Christ across her lap, one hand under his head. He wears a crown of thorns and a white loincloth; one arm hangs down onto bright blue drapery beside a rock. Behind them lie a walled town with towers and a dome, hills crossed by winding paths, and pale mountains under a blue sky.
works.title: Pietà

works.caption: A painter stands back from his easel in a sparsely furnished room, holding his brushes and palette. We see the back of the painting, so its subject remains hidden; the large panel and the space before it make the act of looking feel as important as painting.
works.title: Artist in his studio

works.caption: A man in black sits beside an oversized open book, with more volumes, loose papers and an inkwell below. His face and the pale pages stand out against the subdued rocky landscape, giving the portrait a concentrated, still presence.
works.title: Buffoon with books, formerly known as portrait of "el Primo"

works.caption: Five panels. In the tall centre, Christ rises on a cloud holding a banner, one arm flung wide, above two soldiers: one looks up, the other, in armour, crouches with a hand on the ground. A tower and buildings stand against a glowing sky behind them. At top left an angel holds up a scroll lettered GRATIA PLENA; at top right the Virgin, in a green mantle, lowers her eyes with a hand at her breast. Lower left, a young man in armour and a red cloak stands beside a bearded man and a man with his hands joined in prayer. Lower right, Saint Sebastian, nearly naked with an arrow in his side, is tied up by the arms, one foot raised on a stone drum.
works.collection: Church of Saints Nazarius and Celsus
works.title: Averoldi Polyptych

works.caption: A sunlit grassy bank slopes down to the Seine, where two figures stand by the water and a sailboat and moored masts rise before the bridge at Courbevoie, a factory chimney smoking in the haze beyond; a dark bare tree stands at the right.
works.title: The Bridge at Courbevoie

works.caption: In a sunlit classical harbour, Ursula, in yellow and carrying a flag with a red cross, watches her companions embark with their bows and arrows, a great round temple rising at the left and ships receding toward a hazy horizon.
works.title: Seaport with the Embarkation of Saint Ursula

works.caption: In a wide square closed by a domed basilica, Saint Mark stands on a raised platform preaching, while a dense crowd of turbaned townsfolk and kneeling white-veiled women fills the foreground and camels and a giraffe move behind.
works.title: Saint Mark Preaching in Alexandria

works.caption: In a dim church an elderly official with a star on his coat holds a candle beside a very young bride in white lace and a flower wreath, her eyes cast down, as the priest reaches for her outstretched hand; a young man with folded arms watches from the right.
works.title: The Unequal Marriage

works.caption: The Virgin, seated on a stone bench, holds the standing Christ Child against her, their cheeks touching, a long rosary hanging between them as they look out at the viewer.
works.title: The Virgin of the Rosary

works.caption: Esther lifts both arms to gather up her fair hair while two attendants bring a gilded vessel and a box of pearls, readying her to be presented to King Ahasuerus.
works.collection: Department of Paintings of the Louvre
works.title: The Toilette of Esther

works.caption: White-robed brothers of a Venetian confraternity carry their gold reliquary of the True Cross across Piazza San Marco, with the basilica's glittering mosaic facade filling the background.
works.title: Procession in St. Mark's Square

works.caption: A street singer steps out of a Paris café, guitar under one arm and cherries wrapped in paper, raising a few of them to her lips as she meets our gaze.
works.title: Street Singer

works.caption: Dancers yawn, stretch and wait their turn on a half-lit stage while a man in a top hat sprawls on a chair, all in Degas's near-monochrome browns and creams.
works.title: Ballet Rehearsal on Stage

works.caption: Laurel-crowned Apollo flays the satyr Marsyas as he hangs head-down from a tree, watched by a musician, a brooding King Midas and a boy with a dog, while a little dog laps the blood.
works.title: The Flaying of Marsyas

works.caption: A small red-haired angel rests his cheek on a lute nearly as big as himself and plucks its strings with absorbed care, his red-and-white wings spread against a dark ground.
works.title: Angel Playing the Lute

works.caption: A whirl of colour patches and black and white lines, said to hold a troika and a lance-bearing St George, is cradled by a soft white border that swells up from the bottom edge.
works.title: Painting with White Border

works.caption: A young woman in white plays an upright piano while another sews on a red sofa behind her, in a dim family interior that Cézanne linked to Wagner's Tannhäuser.
works.title: Girl at the Piano (Overture to Tannhäuser)

works.caption: A huge eagle hoists a bawling toddler into a stormy sky by his shirt, the boy still clutching his cherries and wetting himself in fright — Rembrandt's irreverent take on Ganymede.
works.title: The Rape of Ganymede

works.caption: Rubens's Ganymede twists skyward in the grip of Jupiter's eagle, arm flung up toward a flash of lightning as his red cloak streams out behind him.
works.title: The Rape of Ganymede

works.caption: Christ emerges from the tomb with a white banner as the guards recoil below him. John the Baptist and Saint Martina occupy the side panels, their still poses framing the sudden movement at the centre.
works.title: The Resurrection of Christ

works.caption: Christ points to the gaunt Lazarus, still in his grave cloths, as Mary kneels in awe and Martha turns away, in the vast altarpiece Sebastiano painted with Michelangelo's help to rival Raphael.
works.title: The Raising of Lazarus

works.caption: A young man in a red cap looks straight out of the darkness, his face modelled by a single strong light in the Netherlandish manner Antonello brought to Venetian portraiture.
works.title: Portrait of a Man

works.caption: A red cap and robe frame the sitter’s lined face, set off by a broad black scarf. Behind this close view, tiny figures move among ancient buildings, opening a second, much more distant world on either side of his head.
works.title: Portrait of a Man

works.caption: Prince Charles stands at the centre in a shiny rose-red suit with a broad lace collar, resting his left hand on the head of a huge mastiff. To the left stand Princess Mary and Prince James, the taller of the two in a shiny white dress and pearls and the smaller in a lace cap; on the right Princess Elizabeth holds the infant Princess Anne, who sits on a chair draped in pinkish cloth, and a small brown and white spaniel lies at bottom right. A gilt jug and a basket of fruit stand on a red-covered table at upper right, and a green curtain hangs behind the children at upper left, with trees and sky beyond.
works.title: Five Eldest Children of Charles I

works.caption: The Duke and Duchess of Osuna gather their four small children around them, two in green suits beside a toy carriage and two in grey dresses holding fans, in Goya's silvery family portrait.
works.title: The Duke and Duchess of Osuna and their Children

works.caption: A man in a black cap and coat looks straight out, holding up a coin of the emperor Nero, against a landscape with swans, a rider on a white horse and a palm tree.
works.collection: Royal Museum of Fine Arts Antwerp
works.title: Man with a Roman coin

works.caption: The Count-Duke of Olivares looks out from a plain dark ground, his broad face framed by black hair, upturned moustaches and a pointed beard above a white collar and black coat.
works.title: Portrait of the Count-Duke of Olivares

works.caption: Cardinal Guido Bentivoglio sits in crimson silk over a white lace-trimmed tunic, a letter in his hand, turning to look up and away, with a crimson curtain behind him and a draped table at his side.
works.title: Portrait of Cardinal Guido Bentivoglio

works.caption: Cardinal Ludovico Trevisan, grey-haired and heavy-lidded, turns in three-quarter view against a dark ground, a red cloak of watered silk framing his pleated white surplice.
works.title: Portrait of Cardinal Ludovico Trevisan

works.caption: Emperor Maximilian I, grey-haired under a broad black hat and wrapped in a robe with a wide fur collar, holds a split pomegranate against a green ground, his coat of arms and a long Latin inscription above him.
works.title: Emperor Maximilian I

works.caption: Red bows and a wide sash punctuate the duchess’s white dress, with another red bow on the little dog beside her. Her pointing hand draws attention to Goya’s dedication and the date on the ground, balancing the formal pose with a small, specific gesture.
works.title: Portrait of the Duchess of Alba

works.caption: Agatha Bas stands inside a painted ebony frame, one thumb curled over its edge and an open fan in her other hand.
works.title: Portrait of Agatha Bas

works.caption: The old man’s black cap and broad brown sleeves stand against a streaked pink background. The inscription identifies Dürer’s father at seventy, but this painting is probably a later copy of a lost portrait, rather than Dürer’s own record of the sitting.
works.dateDisplay: Possibly second half of the 16th century
works.title: Portrait of Dürer's Father at 70

works.caption: Andrea Odoni sits at a green-covered table among statues and broken fragments, cradling a small statuette of Diana of Ephesus in one hand, his other hand on his chest, a small gold cross at his fingertips.
works.title: Portrait of Andrea Odoni

works.caption: Bia de' Medici sits on a curved wooden chair in a white dress, pearls at her throat and a gold medal with her father's profile on a long chain, against a deep blue ground that lightens around her head.
works.title: Portrait of Bia de' Medici

works.caption: Bartolomeo Panciatichi leans on a stone balustrade in a long black jacket over slashed red satin sleeves, his red beard combed into two points, while a black puppy peers up from the lower right.
works.title: Portrait of Bartolomeo Panciatichi

works.caption: Camilla Gonzaga stands in dark red velvet among three young sons, gripping the jewelled gold head of a sable fur that hangs from her shoulder.
works.title: Portrait of Camilla Gonzaga and Her Three Sons

works.caption: Charles I, in armour, rides a tan horse beneath a great tree, a tablet naming him King of Great Britain hanging from the trunk, while an attendant at the right holds out his helmet.
works.title: Equestrian Portrait of Charles I

works.caption: Charles I rides a white horse straight towards us through a great arch hung with green curtains, his riding master walking at the right with the royal helmet and the crowned royal arms resting at the lower left.
works.title: Charles I (1600-1649) with M. de St Antoine

works.caption: Charles I stands in a silver satin doublet and broad black hat, hand on a cane, while behind him a groom leans on his grey horse, which lowers its head, and a young man holds what looks like the king's coat.
works.collection: Department of Paintings of the Louvre
works.title: Charles I at the Hunt

works.caption: Two young brothers in gleaming armour and wide lace collars stand before a red and gold brocade curtain that opens on a landscape, the elder at left holding a baton and wearing a gold chain with a medallion.
works.collection: Department of Paintings of the Louvre
works.title: Portrait of Charles Louis Elector Palatine (1617-1680) and his brother, Rupert of the Palatinate (1619-1682)

works.caption: A young woman in a broad, round headdress of gold and pink bands looks calmly out at us, in a loosely painted pink dress with puffed sleeves over a white blouse, a green curtain at the left.
works.title: Portrait of a Young Woman

works.caption: Francesco Maria della Rovere, Duke of Urbino, stands in polished black armour before a crimson velvet drape, a baton in his fist, with a dragon-crested helmet at the left and a bundle of batons and an oak sprig at the right.
works.title: Portrait of Francesco Maria della Rovere

works.caption: A pale, thin-faced man in a crimson folded headdress and a fur-trimmed green robe turns towards the viewer's left, holding a small folded paper in one hand.
works.title: Portrait of a Man in a Red Chaperon (Giovanni Arnolfini?)

works.caption: Giovan Carlo Doria charges towards us on a rearing white horse beneath a dark oak, a red cross on his breastplate and a red sash flying from his arm, while a dog leaps below.
works.title: Equestrian Portrait of Giancarlo Doria

works.caption: The old miniaturist Giulio Clovio, white-bearded and dressed in black, points to an open illuminated book in his hand, while a window at the right opens on a stormy landscape.
works.title: Portrait of Giulio Clovio

works.caption: Hieronymus Holzschuher, silver-haired and white-bearded in a fur-collared coat, glances sideways against a blue-green ground, his name, the year 1526 and his age inscribed at the top left.
works.title: Portrait of Hieronymus Holzschuher

works.caption: Jakob Muffel, a Nuremberg patrician, looks out past us in a black cap banded with gold and a coat with a thick fur collar, his name and age inscribed at the upper left.
works.title: Portrait of Jakob Muffel

works.caption: Jan Six, in a broad black hat, grey coat and scarlet cloak flung over one shoulder, looks out at us while his hands work at a pale glove against a dark ground.
works.title: Portrait of Jan Six

works.caption: The white-bearded Count of Benavente stands in armour richly decorated with gold, a general's sash across his chest, one gauntleted hand on a helmet beside a baton, before a curtain that opens on a landscape.
works.title: Juan Francisco Pimentel, conde de Benavente

works.caption: Two young brothers in lace-trimmed satin pose on a step beside a stone pillar, Lord John in gold leaning back at the left, Lord Bernard in silver and blue stepping forward and looking straight at us.
works.title: Lord John Stuart and His Brother, Lord Bernard Stuart

works.caption: Lorenzo Cybo, bearded under a red hat with a white plume, grips the hilt of a great two-handed sword that a small boy helps to hold, beside a table with a die and gold coins, before a screen of leaves.
works.title: Portrait of Lorenzo Cybo

works.caption: Lionello d'Este is seen in strict profile in a brocade coat edged with round buttons and a band of red cloth, against a deep blue sky and a rose bush in bloom.
works.title: Portrait of Lionel d'Este

works.caption: Hortense Fiquet, Madame Cézanne, sits upright and expressionless in a dark, high-necked dress, hands folded in her lap, against a mottled blue-green background.
works.title: Portrait of Madame Cézanne

works.caption: Marie Antoinette, in a blue-grey silk dress trimmed with lace and a large hat with grey plumes, holds a pink rose and buds tied with a ribbon against a dark, leafy garden.
works.title: Marie Antoinette with a Rose

works.caption: Marie Antoinette sits in red velvet with her baby son on her lap, her daughter leaning on her arm, while a small boy at the right points to an empty cradle.
works.title: Marie Antoinette and Her Children

works.caption: Maria Portinari, hands joined in prayer, wears a tall black headdress with a sheer veil, a dark red gown with a broad white collar and an elaborate gold necklace set with pearls and gems.
works.title: Portrait of Maria Portinari

works.caption: Dürer's old teacher Michael Wolgemut looks out in a black silk cap and fur-collared coat against a bright green ground, an inscription at the upper right recording his age and, later, his death.
works.title: Portrait of the Nuremberg Painter Michael Wolgemut

works.caption: The aged Pope Paul III, bareheaded and white-bearded, sits turned in a red velvet chair, a red velvet cape over his white robes, one ringed hand resting on a red object in his lap.
works.title: Portrait of Pope Paul III Without Cap

works.caption: Parmigianino sets the bearded count, in a dark fur-lined robe with one hand on his sword hilt, against gold brocade; beside him a narrow opening holds books, a statuette and a glimpse of landscape.
works.title: Pietro Maria Rossi, Count of San Secondo

works.caption: Holbein's courtier, in a black cap with a cameo badge and a dark gown, looks off to the right against a mottled green ground, between Latin inscriptions giving the date and his age.
works.title: Portrait of Sir Richard Southwell

works.caption: A young knight in shining armour grips his sword hilt in a landscape full of birds, animals and flowers, while a mounted knight in checked livery rides past a castle behind him.
works.title: Young Knight in a Landscape

works.caption: A young man with reddish shoulder-length hair, a black cap and a high-collared black coat looks out at us in front of a white patterned curtain. A thin green band runs down the curtain at the right, and in the top right corner a small lamp burns on a shelf.
works.title: Portrait of a Young Man with a Lamp

works.caption: A richly dressed young man in a soft red cap looks off to the side, a coat lined with spotted lynx fur open over a gold garment and white shirt, one gloved hand resting on the hilt of his sword.
works.title: Portrait of a Man in a Red Cap

works.caption: One hand marks a place in a book while the other rests on the young man’s hip. The carved faces on the furniture offer a curious counterpoint to his composed expression, amid the precise folds and slashes of his black clothing.
works.title: Portrait of a Young Man with a Book

works.caption: Copper-coloured curls fall beside a square neckline trimmed with gold, while pearls and dark stones form a close necklace. Against the black background, these small accents lead the eye back to the woman’s softly lit face.
works.title: Portrait of a Venetian Woman

works.caption: In a long vaulted hall, men lower a body from a wall tomb as Saint Mark appears at left, arm raised; at his feet lies a pale corpse, traditionally read as his own body, beside a kneeling patron in gold.
works.title: Discovery of the Body of Saint Mark

works.caption: Mary pauses over an open book to lift the covering of Christ’s cradle, while Joseph works in the shadows behind her. Little angels descend at the upper left, bringing a sacred presence into the warm, closely observed household.
works.title: The Holy Family with Angels

works.caption: Bonnard's orange-walled dining room opens through a pale blue door and a window onto a sunlit garden; cats sit on the chair at right and his wife Marthe, in red, leans on the sill.
works.title: Dining Room in the Country

works.caption: Under a green glare, a woman in an elaborate hood laughs beside the champagne, while her companion at right turns away, his face cut off by the edge.
works.title: In a Private Dining Room (At the Rat Mort)

works.caption: Christ frees one arm from the cross to embrace Saint Francis, who rests a foot on a globe, while two angels hold up an open book against a dark, cloudy sky.
works.collection: Museo de Bellas Artes de Sevilla
works.title: Saint Francis embracing Christ on the Cross

works.caption: Barefoot Saint Francis stands with arms open outside his rocky shelter, gazing up into light from the upper left, while a donkey, a heron and a shepherd's flock share the valley behind him.
works.title: Saint Francis in the Desert

works.caption: The church and tower of San Giorgio Maggiore stand in dark silhouette against a blazing orange and yellow sunset, their reflection broken across the water.
works.title: San Giorgio Maggiore at Dusk

works.caption: White-robed Saint Jerome sits reading on a rock beneath an overhanging cliff, his lion half-hidden in a den at right, while a city of towers and domes rises across the water behind.
works.title: Saint Jerome in the Desert

works.caption: Kneeling in a blue robe before a crucifix wedged in a tree stump, Saint Jerome strikes his chest with a stone, his lion lying beside him under a stormy sky lit yellow at the horizon.
works.title: Saint Jerome

works.caption: Saint Mark dives down from the clouds, haloed in rays of light, and seizes a nearly naked man above a small, crowded boat. In the boat a white-bearded man in pink grips a long oar, another in a gold robe reaches out an arm, and other sailors twist among the oars against huge green waves. At the left a tilting ship founders, and below the boat a turbaned head rises from the water.
works.title: St. Mark rescues a Sarracen

works.caption: An old, white-bearded Saint Peter kneels in a dark cell, his hands clasped, lit by a shaft of golden light; two keys lie on the floor nearby.
works.title: Saint Peter in Prison (The Apostle Peter Kneeling)

works.caption: Saint Peter, in a yellow cloak over blue, walks down a Florentine street followed by two companions, one haloed, past sick men waiting by the wall, one of them on his knees with small wooden supports in his hands.
works.collection: Brancacci Chapel, Santa Maria del Carmine
works.title: St. Peter Healing the Sick with His Shadow

works.caption: Delilah sits beneath a vine-hung tree, holding shears to a lock of hair on Samson's head as he sleeps slumped against her knees. Both figures are painted in greys like carved stone, set against a background streaked red, yellow and green like veined marble. On the right, water runs from a stone fountain into a trough.
works.title: Samson and Delilah

works.caption: Armoured Philistines haul Samson away from Delilah, who reaches towards his face from her couch, while an old woman watches from the shadows and a small dog rears up at the end of the couch.
works.title: The Capture of Samson

works.caption: In a gold brocade cope and mitre, Saint Ambrose blocks the cathedral steps to the emperor Theodosius, in red cape and laurel wreath, with soldiers crowding behind the emperor and a boy in white beside the bishop.
works.title: The Emperor Theodosius Is Forbidden by Saint Ambrose to Enter Milan Cathedral

works.caption: Circe sits on a throne with snarling lion heads, holding out a cup in one hand and raising a wand in the other; in the round mirror behind her a bearded man appears, and a pig lies at her feet.
works.title: Circe Offering the Cup to Ulysses

works.caption: A crowd of staring, mask-like faces under top hats and wide straw hats presses towards us down an evening street, while a lone dark figure stands in the empty road to the right.
works.title: Evening on Karl Johan

works.caption: A vast army of pikemen fills the mountainside, with a river valley and a distant city under red smoke beyond, while at the left King Saul lies fallen on his sword on a rocky ledge.
works.title: The Suicide of Saul

works.caption: On a stone ledge, the naked Susanna twists away from two elders leaning over the wall behind her, one with a finger raised to his lips, her hands raised to fend them off.
works.title: Susanna and the Elders

works.caption: A naked woman sits at the edge of a pool, one foot drawn up as she dries her leg with a white cloth. A mirror leans against a hedge of roses beside her, with pearls, a comb and a small jar in front. One old man peers round the near end of the hedge, another round its far end.
works.title: Susanna and the Elders

works.caption: Under a dark storm sky, a rainbow arcs down to the right of Salisbury Cathedral's spire as a horse-drawn cart fords the river and a dog stands on the bank.
works.title: Salisbury Cathedral from the Meadows

works.caption: An old man with a long white beard lies on his back in a blue cloak while monsters set on him: one drags him by the hair, others raise sticks, and a huge grey bird-headed creature looms at right. Horned, fanged beasts crowd behind, and at lower left sits a bloated figure covered in sores. Beyond lie a wrecked timber hut, bare trees and pale crags; high in the sky a figure glows in a burst of light.
works.title: Temptation of Saint Anthony

works.caption: Moses reads to the gathered people at the right, while smaller episodes of his final days unfold across the hillside behind them. The crowded foreground and distant scenes let several moments in the story occupy one continuous landscape.
works.title: Testament and Death of Moses

works.caption: Framed by an arch of trees, Salisbury Cathedral's spire rises against a cloudy sky; cattle graze and drink at a pond in the meadow, and at the left a man raises his stick towards the view beside a woman at a gate.
works.title: Salisbury Cathedral from the Bishop's Grounds

works.caption: A nude woman with long red-gold hair stands in a dark forest, a great snake coiled around her body and legs, its head on her shoulder as she lowers her face towards it.
works.title: Lilith

works.caption: The Virgin, seated on a throne with a scrolled arm, holds the Christ Child and a split pomegranate on her lap, while behind her the birth of the Virgin and the meeting of Anne and Joachim unfold in a palace.
works.title: Virgin with the Child and Scenes from the Life of St Anne

works.caption: Christ in white robes stands on a grassy height between Moses and Elijah, each holding a scroll, while three men below look up in alarm, one gesturing, one kneeling, one drawing his cloak up beside his head, with farms and towns behind.
works.title: Transfiguration of Christ

works.caption: Bacchus and Ariadne ride in separate chariots amid a procession of dancers, musicians and revellers. Flying cupids fill the sky above them, while the overlapping bodies below turn the long ceiling panel into a dense, rhythmic celebration.
works.title: Triumph of Bacchus and Ariadne

works.caption: Charles I appears three times against a cloudy blue sky, in profile at left, full face in the centre and three-quarter view at right, each in different clothes and a differently patterned lace collar.
works.title: Charles I in Three Positions

works.caption: A great bunch of blue irises with long green leaves bursts from an ochre vase against a bright yellow wall, some stems spilling onto the table at the right.
works.title: Irises

works.caption: On a bright autumn morning, a couple set off on a farm cart past the manor of Het Steen at left, while a hunter crouches in the foreground and a wide, misty landscape stretches to the horizon.
works.title: A View of Het Steen in the Early Morning

works.caption: Venus, seen from behind, throws her arms around Adonis as he turns to leave with his spears and straining hounds; Cupid sleeps under a tree at left, and a small goddess appears among bright clouds above.
works.title: Venus and Adonis

works.caption: The white domes of Santa Maria della Salute rise at the left, a tall bell tower and palace fronts beyond, while laden boats and gondolas crowd the brownish water in front.
works.title: Venice from the Giudecca

works.caption: Massive draft horses, grey, black and chestnut, wheel and rear along a dusty tree-lined boulevard as their handlers struggle to lead them, a domed building rising at the far left.
works.title: The Horse Fair

works.caption: A nun with a lute and a monk gape at a round morsel dangling on a string between them, amid a drunken crowd in a small boat whose mast is a leafy tree; naked swimmers in the water hold up a bowl, and a fool sits drinking in the branches.
works.title: Ship of Fools

works.caption: A girl with long dark hair and a white ribbon, in a pale blue dress with a small gold cross, sits facing us with her hands folded; 'ALICE' is painted at the top left.
works.title: Alice

works.caption: A barefoot girl with loose red-brown hair sits hunched on a stone by a dark forest pool, her head resting on her hands on her knees, among young fir and birch trees with fallen leaves on the water.
works.title: Alyonushka

works.caption: In a sunlit garden, a man in a straw hat reads in the shade of orange trees growing in tubs, while a girl leans on a tub beyond and a dog sleeps on the bright path at right.
works.title: Les orangers

works.caption: A great pyramid of bleached human skulls rises from a parched desert plain, crows perching on it and wheeling overhead, with dead trees and a ruined town in the distance.
works.title: The Apotheosis of War

works.caption: Morozova holds two fingers aloft as her sledge passes through a snowbound crowd. A seated man at the lower right echoes the gesture; the surrounding faces range from laughter to anxious attention, giving her raised hand a different answer at every turn.
works.title: Boyarina Morozova

works.caption: On a red-covered bed, a woman in a dark dress towels a naked girl who turns away to look in a hand mirror, a pink bow in her hair; a doll with a matching bow lies abandoned on the rug.
works.collection: National Museum of Women in the Arts
works.title: The Abandoned Doll

works.caption: The white walls of thatched cottages catch the last pink light on a dark hillside, under a rose and yellow evening sky, with black trees massed around them.
works.title: Evening in Ukraine

works.caption: On a cape where a river bends, a white monastery with green onion domes catches the low evening sun among trees, its walls mirrored in the still water; a boat full of people is out on the river, and two more lie by the near bank.
works.title: Evening Bells

works.caption: A rider on a dark horse bursts through a wall of snow as snow flies around him, a crowd in fur hats and shawls cheering on either side and sledges drawn up at left and right.
works.title: Taking a Snow Town

works.caption: In an autumn meadow, a fair-haired boy in a white shirt stands with hands clasped before a hooded, haloed monk under an oak, with a wooden church and a wide valley behind.
works.title: The Vision to the Youth Bartholomew

works.caption: A pale dirt road runs towards the horizon beneath a broad grey sky. A solitary figure stands near the roadside shrine, small against the open land; the converging tracks make the distance feel both inviting and immense.
works.title: The Vladimirka

works.caption: A bishop in a jewelled mitre and gold brocade cope, holding a windlass, faces a Black saint in shining plate armour with a jewelled wreath, while an old cleric in red and soldiers crowd behind.
works.title: Saint Erasmus and Saint Maurice

works.caption: A dark-haired girl in a pink blouse with a black bow sits at a white-covered table, holding a peach, with more peaches and maple leaves before her and a sunlit window behind.
works.title: Girl with peaches

works.caption: Diana, seated at right among her attendants, points accusingly as nymphs at left pull the clothes from Callisto, while water trickles from a cherub's urn on a stone fountain into the stream between them.
works.collection: National Gallery and National Galleries of Scotland
works.title: Diana and Callisto

works.caption: A smiling young street seller looks up and away, a broad basket balanced on her dark hat, her face and cloak dashed in with quick, loose strokes.
works.title: The Shrimp Girl

works.caption: A colossal smiling archaic statue of a girl, a blue bird in her hand, stands before a vast bird's-eye view of a coast torn apart, as lightning strikes and the sea floods over cities and ruins.
works.title: Terror Antiquus

works.caption: A Tahitian woman in a high-necked blue-grey dress with a white collar sits before a red chair and a yellow wall patterned with flowers, a white flower in her hair and a yellow flower in her hand; 'Vahine no te Tiare' is written at the top.
works.title: Tahitian Woman with a Flower

works.caption: Under flowering hawthorn, Nimue in a clinging blue-grey robe, snakes in her hair and a book held open in her hands, looks back at the enchanted Merlin, who slumps helplessly against a tree.
works.title: The Beguiling of Merlin

works.caption: Slender birches blaze yellow and orange on a sunny slope at left, and a dark, still stream winds through brown meadows towards distant fields and a few farm buildings under a blue sky with white cloud.
works.title: Golden Autumn

works.caption: On a red-patterned carpet in a dim room, the wild-eyed old tsar clutches his dying son, pressing a hand to the bleeding wound on his head; the staff lies on the floor in front.
works.title: Ivan the Terrible and his son Ivan on November 16, 1581

works.caption: A dark-haired woman in a sheer white gown leans her head and arms around a large patterned pot of basil on an inlaid stand draped with embroidered cloth, a small skull worked into the pot's side.
works.title: Isabella and the Pot of Basil

works.caption: Stanisław Małachowski is carried above the crowd, holding the newly adopted constitution aloft. At the left, the king approaches the church steps; banners, raised arms and tightly packed figures turn the procession into a sweeping public celebration.
works.title: Constitution of May 3, 1791

works.caption: Twisting blue tree trunks and roots crowd a long canvas of ochre earth, with green leaves and dashes of red, yellow and white.
works.title: Tree Roots

works.caption: The Virgin holds the Child between her knees, one of his feet on a wicker cradle, beside an old woman in a headscarf, Saint Anne, who leans her chin on her hand; the young John brings an offering from the left, and ruins and a river open up at right.
works.title: The Holy Family, or 'The Pearl'

works.caption: A woman in deep blue velvet stretches her back, hands pressed to the small of it, as she rises from her embroidery by a stained-glass window; autumn leaves lie on the cloth and the floor, and a mouse creeps across the boards.
works.title: Mariana

works.caption: In bright March sun, a horse harnessed to a sledge waits by the porch of a yellow wooden house, while snow lies heaped and thawing on the track and bare birches and dark pines stand against a deep blue sky.
works.title: March

works.caption: The scholar and papal librarian Tommaso Inghirami looks upward, his pen poised beside the inkwell. Red clothing fills most of the picture, while the open book, paper and hands gather the act of writing into its lower edge.
works.title: Portrait of Tommaso Inghirami, called Fedra

works.caption: Four racehorses, each with a jockey in coloured silks, fly across the green turf with legs stretched out front and back, under a dark, stormy sky; a white post stands at the right.
works.title: The 1821 Derby at Epsom

works.caption: Berthe Morisot rests on a dark red sofa, her outstretched arms opening the composition around her white dress. Above her, a turbulent Japanese print contrasts with the still pose, while broad strokes of pale paint give the fabric a lively surface.
works.collection: Rhode Island School of Design Museum
works.title: Repose

works.caption: In a golden temple hung with lamps, a boy in a striped violet robe stands barefoot while a woman embraces him and a bearded man bends over them both; to the left, bearded elders in turbans and prayer shawls sit holding scrolls.
works.title: The Finding of the Saviour in the Temple

works.caption: Two flags fly over a seaside terrace bright with red flowers; a man in a straw hat sits in a wicker chair beside a woman under a white parasol, while a couple stand talking at the railing above a sea crowded with sailing ships and steamers.
works.title: Garden at Sainte-Adresse

works.caption: The young guitarist looks away from her instrument as her hands continue their separate tasks on strings and frets. Her yellow jacket and pale skirt brighten the room, while a framed landscape and stacked books fill the space behind her.
works.title: The Guitar Player

works.caption: A sixteen-year-old widow in mourning stands full-length against a blue-green wall, her black satin gown open over a fur lining, white ruffles at her neck and wrists, hands clasped around a pair of pale gloves.
works.title: Christina of Denmark, Duchess of Milan

works.caption: A woman in a huge black feathered hat and a long fur wrap over a white gown sits sideways in a pale panelled room, one hand at the pearls on her chest, a large gilt-framed painting on the wall above her.
works.title: Princess Olga Orlova

works.caption: A young woman in a tall feathered hat and a shimmering pale satin gown over a rose-pink and red skirt rests one arm on the base of a great stone column, a feather fan in her other hand, trees and a stormy sky behind.
works.collection: National Galleries of Scotland (Scottish National Gallery)
works.title: The Honourable Mrs Graham

works.caption: A young woman in strict profile faces right against a black ground. Her red-gold hair is part braided, part loose and wavy, wound with red ribbon and strings of pearls, with a spray of white feathers rising from a red jewel at the crown. Two long pearl-studded braids fall over her white dress, and a dark cameo hangs from fine gold chains at her throat.
works.title: Idealised Portrait of a Lady (Portrait of Simonetta Vespucci as Nymph)

works.caption: A winged young man carries a woman in his arms up into a pale sky above rocky peaks; her eyes are closed, her arms crossed over her chest and her head resting against his neck, while violet drapery swirls around them.
works.title: The abduction of Psyche

works.caption: Under a streaked yellow and blue sky, the Virgin in a blue hood and cloak spreads her arms wide behind the slumped body of the dead Christ, whose red-haired head lolls against her; a dark rock rises at the right.
works.collection: Van Gogh Museum, Amsterdam (Vincent van Gogh Foundation)
works.title: Pietà (after Delacroix), The

works.caption: A dirt track winds into a field of ripe golden rye that stretches to the horizon, where tall pines stand singly and in groups, one of them dead and bare, under a pale summer sky with a few birds.
works.title: Rye Fields

works.caption: On the sea floor, among fish, shells and weed, a bearded merchant in a fur-trimmed coat stands gazing upward while a glowing procession of richly dressed young women passes him, a mermaid in front of them; a plainly dressed girl stands apart at the upper left.
works.title: Sadko

works.caption: A dancer stands on bare boards in a white lace mantilla and shawl, a full black skirt patterned with red and yellow flowers and edged with red pompoms, a half-open fan in her hand and pink slippers on her feet; behind her are the backs of stage flats, and through a gap at right, tiers of theatre boxes.
works.title: Lola de Valence

works.caption: A magpie perches on a gate at the left of this snowy landscape. Blue and violet shadows cross the foreground, while sunlit snow softens the fence, roofs and bare branches.
works.title: The Magpie

works.caption: A young man with arrows in his body stands almost naked against a tree trunk, hands behind his back, looking upward. Behind him a square paved in red and white leads to arches and a terrace where onlookers lean over hanging carpets; a man lies asleep at the left and a fallen column lies at the right.
works.collection: Gemäldegalerie Alte Meister, Staatliche Kunstsammlungen Dresden
works.title: Saint Sebastian

works.caption: Mary Magdalene, her long hair loose over a white shift and a striped shawl, looks up with tears on her cheeks, one hand pressed to her breast and the other holding the shawl at her waist. An open book lies on a skull beside her, a glass jar stands at the left, and a dark rock and a small tree frame a landscape under a blue sky.
works.title: Penitent Magdalene

works.caption: A man in a straw hat and dark blue suit sweeps a young woman in a pink ruffled dress and red bonnet round in a dance, their faces close, while people drink at a café table under the trees behind them; a small bunch of purple flowers lies on the ground.
works.title: Dance at Bougival

works.caption: A young maid in a pink cap, a golden-brown bodice, a grey skirt and a long white apron walks to the right in profile, carefully carrying a black tray with a glass of water and a porcelain cup of chocolate on a saucer.
works.collection: Gemäldegalerie Alte Meister, Staatliche Kunstsammlungen Dresden
works.title: The Chocolate Girl

works.caption: A long, rickety wooden footbridge crosses a still river toward a wooded bank, beyond which rise the white walls, tall bell tower and green onion domes of a monastery, all mirrored in the water under a pale sky with pink-gold clouds.
works.title: Quiet Abode

works.caption: Under a dead tree hung with moss, Death, a withered corpse holding an hourglass and a broken lance, clasps a gaunt old woman. She rests one hand on the far shoulder of a young nude woman and with the other pulls at the veil the young woman holds against her body. A dead infant lies on the ground at lower right, one hand on the lance's lower tip, and an owl stares out at lower left.
works.title: The Ages of Woman and Death

works.caption: On a sunny street, navvies dig a trench while all kinds of people crowd around them: a ragged flower seller and ladies with parasols at left, riders on horseback behind, a girl in a red dress minding small children in front, and two gentlemen watching from the right.
works.title: Work

works.caption: A row of low cottages with green and golden thatched roofs and smoking chimneys runs along a sloping meadow below a grassy hill, with a red-roofed house at right, under a blue sky streaked with white cloud.
works.title: Cottages

works.caption: A pale young woman in a towering jewelled headdress and a gauzy veil looks back over her shoulder as her body dissolves into great white swan's wings on dark water; behind her, at upper left, a dusky island with a glowing castle.
works.title: The Swan Princess

works.caption: A long-haired young man in a blue robe leans over a table spread with a map and a heavy patterned rug, a pair of dividers in his hand, and looks out of a leaded window; a globe stands on the cupboard behind him and a framed map hangs on the wall.
works.title: The Geographer

works.caption: Two figures in long dark coats and wide hats stand side by side on a grassy rise, seen from behind as silhouettes, looking out over a low landscape of water and hills toward a band of orange sunset glow.
works.title: Sunset (Brothers)

works.caption: The crowned Virgin stands in a great scallop-shell niche holding the Christ Child, a dark cloak falling behind her; on the left a man kneels in prayer behind a youth holding a naked toddler, and on the right two women in white headdresses and a girl with a rosary kneel on an oriental carpet.
works.title: Madonna of Mayor Jacob Meyer zum Hasen (Darmstadt Madonna)

works.caption: A heavy-set man with an upturned moustache and a stiff white collar stands full-length in black satin, one hand on a table draped in red velvet; a gold chain crosses his chest, a large gold key and a pair of gold spurs hang at his waist, and a red cross marks his doublet.
works.collection: Museu de Arte de São Paulo (MASP)
works.title: Portrait of the Count-Duke of Olivares

works.caption: A dark, flame-shaped cypress rises at left into a night sky of swirling blue and white currents, glowing stars and a yellow crescent moon, above a small village with a pointed church steeple among blue hills.
works.collection: Museum of Modern Art, New York
works.title: The Starry Night

works.caption: A bald farmer in round glasses and overalls stares straight out, holding a three-pronged pitchfork upright, beside a woman in a dark dress, white collar and cameo brooch who looks off to the side, in front of a white wooden house with a pointed Gothic window.
works.title: American Gothic

works.caption: A young woman in a white satin skirt and a large yellow shawl sits at a virginal, hands on the keys, and turns to look out at us; red ribbons and a strand of small beads are in her curled hair, an open music stand rests on the instrument, and a bare wall rises behind.
works.title: Young Woman Seated at a Virginal

works.caption: A woman in white satin and blue sits with one foot on a globe and a hand on her heart, gazing up at a glass sphere hanging from a ribbon; beside her a table holds a chalice, a crucifix and an open book, a large Crucifixion painting hangs behind, and a crushed snake and an apple lie on the chequered floor below a tapestry curtain.
works.title: Allegory of the Catholic Faith

works.caption: An officer in a huge black hat and red coat sits with his back half to us, one arm on his hip, facing a smiling young woman in a white headscarf who holds a wine glass; light pours in through an open leaded window at left onto a large map of Holland on the wall.
works.title: Officer and Laughing Girl

works.caption: Mary sits in a blue mantle inside a timber stable, the naked child on her lap in a white cloth. Three kings bring gifts: one kneels in pink and green with an open bowl, one stands in red with a gold lidded cup, and one in a long pale fringed robe holds out a green vessel. Helmeted soldiers with halberds and staring onlookers crowd in behind.
works.title: The Adoration of the Kings

works.caption: A woman stands full-length and square to us in a huge dark hat, a high lace collar and a long white dress with a dark blue sash and a fur-trimmed wrap, against bands of red with small Asian-style figures, green strewn with flowers, pink, and a patterned violet floor.
works.title: Adele Bloch-Bauer II

works.caption: A young horned sheep lies on a grey ledge against a black background, its feet tied together with cord, its head resting on the stone and its eyes half closed, every curl of its fleece caught in a hard, directed light.
works.title: Agnus Dei

works.caption: Two boys carry a fair-haired angel in white on a wooden stretcher along a dirt path by the water; the angel sits hunched with a bandage over her eyes and a few white flowers in her hand, a red mark on one wing, while the boy behind stares out at us.
works.collection: Finnish National Gallery / Ateneum Art Museum
works.title: The Wounded Angel

works.caption: A woman sits in a wicker chair with a folded fan in her hands, her dark dress edged with pale lace. Beyond her, the sea and cliffs dissolve into looser strokes; Renoir probably assembled this seaside setting in his studio from coastal studies.
works.title: By the Seashore

works.caption: A smiling, naked boy with large brown-feathered wings and a fistful of arrows stands with one foot on the floor and the other knee raised onto a white-draped ledge; around him lie a violin, a lute, sheet music, a set square and compass, a written page under a sprig of laurel, black armour, and a crown and sceptre.
works.title: Cupid as Victor

works.caption: A laughing woman in a white cap and ruffled collar grips the handle of a big pewter jug with its lid flipped open, while an owl perches on her shoulder.
works.title: Malle Babbe

works.caption: A young woman in a red and blue dress with a long black bead necklace and a thin black band across her forehead looks off to one side, resting her hand on a white ermine held against her chest, against a black background with faint lettering at the top left.
works.title: Lady with an Ermine

works.caption: In a hall of three arches, three helmeted young men stretch out their arms toward three swords raised high by an older man in a red cloak; at right, women sit slumped together, one with her head in her hand, while another woman shelters two small children behind them.
works.title: The Oath of the Horatii

works.caption: Two girls rest together beside a field after rain, their hands clasped beneath a shared shawl. The younger turns towards the double rainbow behind them, while a butterfly has settled on the older girl’s shoulder: small details that reward looking beyond the central faces.
works.title: The Blind Girl

works.caption: Mary sits on a tall carved marble throne with her hands pressed together in prayer, looking down at the naked Christ Child asleep across her knees with one arm hanging loose; blue sky and white clouds show on either side of the throne.
works.title: Enthroned Madonna Adoring the Sleeping Christ Child

works.caption: A crowd of Cossacks in fur hats and bright coats bursts out laughing around a rough wooden table where a clerk in black writes with a quill; a bald, bare-backed man leans over the table, a stout man in a red coat and white fur hat clutches his belly, and lances and flags rise against a pale sky.
works.title: Reply of the Zaporozhian Cossacks

works.caption: A young woman in a yellow cloche hat and a fur-trimmed green coat sits alone at a round white table, holding a small cup with one bare hand while the other is still gloved; behind her a large black window holds two trailing rows of ceiling lights, and a bowl of fruit stands on the sill.
works.title: Automat

works.caption: The Guillemets sit and lean on opposite sides of a garden bench, their hands close but their gazes directed apart. Dense leaves surround the couple, while the woman’s pale yellow gloves and parasol interrupt the cool blues and greys of her dress.
works.title: In the Conservatory

works.caption: Curtains of pale green and red light fill a dark night sky above a great dark cliff; far below, a small two-masted ship sits locked in the pack ice, and a tiny dog sled crosses the ice beside it.
works.title: Aurora Borealis

works.caption: Against a black background, an old woman with long grey hair, her lips parted over a few teeth, holds a white cloth purse heaped with gold coins in both hands; a red cloth slips off one shoulder, leaving a breast bare.
works.title: Avarice

works.caption: Christ, nearly naked, a white cloth streaming from his hips and a white banner with a red cross in his hand, rises into a sky streaked with pink cloud; below, beside a dark open tomb cut into the rock, one soldier sleeps, another sits holding his head and two more stand, while a dark bird perches in a bare tree at upper left and a walled town climbs a hill at right.
works.title: Resurrection of Christ

works.caption: The dead Christ rests across Mary’s lap beneath a tall, empty cross. The clustered mourners fill the foreground, while a stretch of water, rocky slopes and distant buildings open the scene behind them.
works.title: Lamentation over the Dead Christ with the Virgin, Joseph of Arimathea, Mary Magdalene, Martha and possibly Philip Benizi

works.caption: The pale thunder god and green wind god face across a wide expanse of gold. A ring of drums surrounds one, while the other grips a billowing wind bag; their coloured bodies and twisting ribbons stand out against dark clouds.
works.title: Wind God and Thunder God

works.caption: The Virgin sits with the Child on her lap under a timber roof set against broken stone walls, Joseph leaning behind; an old grey-haired man in a dark gold-patterned robe kneels holding the Child's foot in a white cloth, a man in a red cape and another in white kneel in front, and richly dressed men crowd in from both sides, among them a young man with a sword at far left and a young man in an orange-brown cloak at right who looks straight out.
works.title: Adoration of the Magi

works.caption: A young woman sits on a cushion inside a curved colonnade of veined columns, one breast bare, a loose wrap over her thighs and her lower legs bare with knees apart, looking up as a shower of gold drops falls from the ceiling into the cloth in her lap; through the columns rise the towers and domes of a city, and a Latin signature is cut into the step below.
works.title: Danae

works.caption: A flat plain of yellow and green fields runs back to a line of hills on the horizon: in front, a picket fence and a small figure among green bushes; behind them, a tall stack with ladders against it, an empty blue cart with its shafts on the ground and a red wheeled implement, then more carts, farmhouses with orange roofs and a tall white house at right, under a blue-green sky.
works.title: The Harvest

works.caption: Angélique Satre appears in Breton dress within a large circular outline, set beside a small seated figure. The blue floral background and sharply bounded shapes make the portrait feel assembled from separate images, rather than placed in one continuous room.
works.title: La belle Angèle

works.caption: Christ hangs high at the top centre against a burst of pale light; below him, men haul a second cross upright with ropes at left, a third man lies stretched on a cross on the ground at right, mourners gather round a fainting woman at the foot of the cross, and horsemen fill both ends of the long canvas.
works.title: Crucifixion

works.caption: Two walls of tall autumn poplars, painted in yellow, line a straight avenue and leave only a narrow strip of sky between them; a man in a hat and, further right, a woman walk on the path with smaller figures behind, low stone blocks run along the left side, and a dark conifer stands at right.
works.title: Les Alyscamps

works.caption: Two young women in pale dresses and hats sit in a long, narrow pinkish-red boat that runs off the right edge of the canvas. An oar trails out across dark water marked with long wavy strokes, under a bank of green foliage.
works.title: The Canoe on the Epte

works.caption: A woman with long red hair, a white rose tucked into it, rests her folded arms on a ledge and holds a sprig with a single orange flower. She wears gold earrings, a gold ornament in her hair and a gold necklace over a dark robe. An apple sits on the ledge at right, and orange marigolds bloom in dark foliage behind her.
works.title: Bocca Baciata

works.caption: A grey-bearded man, bare to the hips, stands half-turned with his eyes to the right. The shaft of a trident passes through his loosely open right hand; its prongs rise against a wooden mast wound with a coil of rope. His left hand holds a grey sail across his hips. A. DORIA is lettered on the mast.
works.title: Portrait of Andrea Doria as Neptune

works.caption: A dense crowd fills a long Paris boulevard, seen from above, between rows of tall buildings and bare, budding trees. Left of centre a band of figures in red, green and yellow runs up the street, and a few dark-coated, top-hatted figures stand or walk on the open roadway in the foreground.
works.title: Boulevard Montmartre, Mardi Gras

works.caption: Seen from high above, a pale, crowded Paris boulevard runs off into haze beneath rows of bare trees. Tall buildings line the left, carriages wait under the trees, a figure at right carries a bunch of pink balloons, and a dark top-hatted figure leans in at the right edge.
works.title: Boulevard des Capucines

works.caption: A nude woman lies asleep on a deep red cushion and a white sheet spread over the grass, one arm folded behind her head, in a rolling landscape with a dark bank and a leafy sapling at left, farm buildings on a hill at right, blue mountains far off and a cloudy sky.
works.title: Sleeping Venus

works.caption: Near the bottom of a tall canvas, the dark head of a dog, muzzle tilted upward, shows just above the edge of a dark brown slope that rises toward the right; most of the canvas above is a vast, mottled expanse of pale ochre and grey.
works.title: The Drowning Dog

works.caption: A yellow Christ hangs on a brown cross set left of centre in a hilly autumn landscape of orange-red trees, yellow fields and a village with a church spire; three women in white caps gather around the foot of the cross, and farther back a man climbs over a stone wall beside two small figures.
works.title: The Yellow Christ

works.caption: Three hunters with spears and a pack of dogs trudge through deep snow past bare trees on a hilltop, while at left people tend a fire outside a house with a hanging sign; below, a snowy valley holds a village, a church, skaters on frozen ponds and, far off, jagged mountain peaks under a grey-green sky.
works.title: The Hunters in the Snow

works.caption: A tall, sunlit Gothic cathedral, one of its two front towers unfinished, rises from woods on a hill under a dark storm sky crossed by a rainbow; a castle stands at upper left, a crowded procession of riders and walkers climbs the slope in the foreground toward a balustraded bridge between the castle and the cathedral, and a city on a bridged river stretches away at right.
works.title: Medieval City on a River

works.caption: A woman in a pink tunic and blue drapery sits enthroned at the centre, raising a staff twined with snakes and holding a horn of fruit, with a small boy holding an arrow beside her. Nude and draped figures crowd around her with a globe, a wheel, a sword and scales. Above, two winged figures hold out a laurel wreath and blow a trumpet; below, bodies sprawl on the ground.
works.title: Allegory of Happiness

works.caption: A small man in a red jacket and white trousers leans against a large boulder on a grassy rise, a staff in his hand, below a dark, steep mountain; a faint, pale rainbow arcs across the heavy clouded sky almost from one edge of the canvas to the other.
works.title: Mountain Landscape with Rainbow

works.caption: Seen from inside a dim room, through a pair of glazed doors hung with sheer white curtains, a woman in a bright red hood and a dark coat stands outside in the snow, her face turned toward the glass, with snow-covered green bushes behind her.
works.title: The Red Kerchief

works.caption: In a restaurant beside a large window, a woman in a green dress and dark cloche hat faces a woman in a blue hat and grey coat, seen from behind, across a white table with a small teapot; behind them a man in a dark suit sits at another table with a woman in a red hat just visible at the left edge, a coat hangs on the wall, and outside the window a red sign shows the letters SUEY.
works.title: Chop Suey

works.caption: An old, balding, grey-bearded man, bare to the waist with a red cloak over his lap, leans over a plain wooden table writing in a book with a pen, a small ink pot in his other hand; at the table's end lie a stone, a skull and a crucifix beside an unlit candle, all set against a dark background, with a red hat hanging on the wall at upper left and a small coat of arms at lower right.
works.title: Saint Jerome Writing

works.caption: Christ, in a crown of thorns with a rope knotted around his neck, turns his face upward with lips parted, tears and small red drops running down his skin; a pale column rises behind him at the left.
works.collection: Department of Paintings of the Louvre
works.title: Christ at the Column

works.caption: A bare-shouldered, barefoot woman in a dark green patterned robe stands above green-blue water, holding out a wide shallow bowl from which a thin bright green stream falls straight into the sea; brown rocks and dark tree trunks rise behind her, and a dark finned shape lies in the water at her feet.
works.title: Circe Invidiosa

works.caption: In a dark interior, an old bearded man in a red cloak bends over a young man with a shaved head and ragged clothes who kneels with his back to us, one foot bare; the old man rests both hands on the young man's shoulders while several figures watch from the right and from the shadows behind.
works.title: The Return of the Prodigal Son

works.caption: Trees, rocks and buildings emerge through layers of mist as the mountain rises towards the top of the scroll. Painted in ink on silk, the view moves between steep heights, winding depths and an open river valley at the left.
works.title: Early Spring

works.caption: The countess sits with her hands together, her pale gown spreading across the chair into the dark surrounding space. Blue ribbons and ears of wheat decorate her hair, while small touches of gold pick out the chair and jewellery.
works.title: Countess of Chinchon

works.caption: Two tall panels side by side: at left Saint John, in a white robe, holds up the kneeling Virgin in a pale blue mantle, her hands clasped; at right Christ hangs on the cross beneath an INRI sign, his loincloth fluttering; a red cloth hangs on the grey stone wall behind each panel's figures, and a skull and a bone lie on the green ground.
works.title: The Crucifixion, with the Virgin and Saint John the Evangelist Mourning

works.caption: Across a still stretch of water, a walled town of red and blue roofs, towers and a gate with two pointed turrets lies under a wide sky of white and dark grey clouds; boats are moored along the quay, and a few small figures stand on the sandy bank in the foreground.
works.title: View of Delft

works.caption: A man in a black cap and a dark, fur-collared coat with crumpled red velvet sleeves sits holding a folded slip of paper; a gold chain of S-shaped links with a rose pendant lies across his shoulders, and behind him hangs a green curtain with a red cord.
works.title: Sir Thomas More

works.caption: Elegantly dressed couples gather on a grassy slope under tall trees, and more crowd around a gilded boat at the water's edge on the left, where winged children fly up into the sky; at right a stone statue hung with roses stands among the trees, and misty water and pale mountains fill the distance.
works.collection: Department of Paintings of the Louvre
works.title: The Embarkation for Cythera

works.caption: The Virgin, in a red robe and white headdress, sits in a grey stone niche with the Christ Child on her lap; he turns the pages of a book, and above them, under carved tracery, an angel holds out a gold crown.
works.title: Durán Madonna

works.caption: Two women stand close together and look sharply off to the right: one, her braided hair pinned with a jewel, holds a sword on her shoulder; the other, seen from behind in a white headwrap and yellow dress, carries a basket holding a severed head.
works.title: Judith and Her Maidservant

works.caption: A young man lies face down on a rock at the edge of a pool, wearing a leaf wreath and a red cloth, and stares at his reflection; at left a woman in pink drapery, bare to the waist, sits by a tree trunk and looks toward him, with yellow irises growing at the water's edge.
works.title: Echo and Narcissus

works.caption: A crowded village runs down to a river and the sea, full of people acting out sayings: a woman in red drapes a blue-green cloak over a stooped figure with a stick, a man shovels earth into a pit where a calf lies, and a globe with its cross pointing down sits on a bracket on a house wall.
works.title: Netherlandish Proverbs

works.caption: A dancer in a long white skirt sweeps across a dim stage, one arm stretched out to the right at shoulder height, lit from below; along the grey wall behind sit men in dark hats, two of them playing guitars, while women at the far right raise their arms, and two more guitars hang on the wall.
works.title: El Jaleo

works.caption: A woman in a pale blue corset pauses before her mirror and turns towards the viewer. Her white petticoat catches the light, while a seated man is cut off by the right edge, leaving her as the picture’s commanding presence.
works.title: Nana

works.caption: Jerome, in a red robe and a red broad-brimmed hat, rests his head on one hand as he reads a thick book on a slanted stand. Books, an astrolabe, a labelled jar and an hourglass crowd the shelf and table at right. A lion lies on the floor in front of the desk, head up, looking out.
works.title: Saint Jerome in His Study

works.caption: On a wooden platform before a red brick wall, a balding dealer in a yellow toga stretches a hand toward a crowd raising their arms below, beside a naked young woman in a leaf wreath who lifts an arm to her brow; another naked woman sits at right hugging her knees, near a figure in black holding a child.
works.title: Slave Market in Ancient Rome

works.caption: Before tall trees and distant blue hills, a young woman in a blue mantle and an older woman in a headscarf sit on the ground, both with thin gold haloes. Between them two haloed infants meet: the one standing at right holds the other's face in his hands.
works.collection: Department of Paintings of the Louvre
works.title: The Holy Family, known as the Small Holy Family

works.caption: A long line of mourners in black stands at the lip of a grave below pale limestone cliffs: a crucifix rises over the group at left, a priest reads with two men in red robes and hats just right of him, a man kneels by the turned earth, and a white dog stands at right.
works.title: A Burial at Ornans

works.caption: Two women, bare to the waist, sit side by side in a bath lined with white cloth, framed by heavy pink-red curtains. The one at left pinches the other's nipple between finger and thumb; the one at right holds a gold ring between finger and thumb at the edge of the bath. In the room behind, a woman in a red dress sews near a fireplace and a green-covered table.
works.collection: Department of Paintings of the Louvre
works.title: Gabrielle d'Estrées et une de ses sœurs

works.caption: A long-haired man in a loose blue-green robe leans forward to touch a celestial globe by a leaded window, his other hand resting beside an open book on a table heaped with patterned blue and gold cloth. A chart hangs on the cupboard behind him, and a dark framed picture hangs on the wall at right.
works.collection: Department of Paintings of the Louvre
works.title: The Astronomer

works.caption: A tiger leaps onto a man riding a grey horse, amid a crush of hunters and animals: a turbaned horseman in red raises a spear at left, riders in armour and plumed helmets strike from the right, a bare-chested man wrenches at a lion's jaws at lower left, and a leopard lies bleeding on the ground at lower right.
works.title: The Tiger Hunt

works.caption: Christ's body lies on a reddish stone slab, seen from the feet, with the nail-pierced soles at the front edge. His chest and upturned face stay clearly visible. In the upper left corner, mourners press in at the edge: an old woman holds a white cloth to her eye beside a younger face, open-mouthed, with a tear on the cheek.
works.title: Lamentation of Christ

works.caption: A bearded man with blue eyes, shown half-length and turned three-quarters, wears a large soft black hat, a black doublet over a gathered white shirt, and a thick grey fur over-sleeve. His hands are clasped at the lower left, against a plain grey-beige background.
works.collection: Department of Paintings of the Louvre
works.title: Portrait of Baldassare Castiglione

works.caption: A nude woman with long dark hair reclines on a red-brown sofa in the middle of a dense jungle, one arm stretched out. Around her, two big cats peer from the leaves, an elephant is half-hidden behind flowers, a dark figure in a striped skirt plays a pipe, and a full moon shines above orange fruit, birds and large pale blossoms.
works.title: The Dream

works.caption: A young knight in armour lies on the ground with his eyes closed, beneath a slender tree. On the left a woman in blue with her hair covered holds an upright sword and holds out a book; on the right a woman with loose fair hair and a fluttering veil offers a sprig of white flowers. Behind them, a rocky crag with buildings, a river with a bridge and blue hills.
works.title: The Dream of a Knight

works.caption: A line of soldiers with bandaged eyes, most with a hand on the man in front, walks past wounded men lying all over the ground, towards a walkway of wooden boards at right. A second, smaller line of men stands further off, ahead of them. Between their legs, far in the distance, men play football and white tents stand on the plain, under a hazy pinkish sky.
works.title: Gassed

works.caption: Artemisia portrays herself with Catherine’s crown, palm and broken spiked wheel. One hand rests on the wheel at the left while the other holds the palm across her chest; her turned head brings her gaze directly towards us.
works.title: Self-Portrait as Saint Catherine of Alexandria

works.caption: A young man with brown hair falling to just above his shoulders turns his head back over his shoulder to look out at us. He wears a soft black cap and a black robe, with a thin line of white shirt at the neck, against a brown background that darkens towards the right.
works.title: Self-portrait

works.caption: A bearded young man in a cream doublet with a small white ruff, full red breeches and a red belt stands at a table and looks straight out at us. His right hand grips a large pair of shears; his left rests on a piece of black cloth marked with faint white chalk lines.
works.title: The Tailor

works.caption: Three men lie sprawled on the grass around a tree whose trunk carries a round tabletop laden with dishes. At upper left a man in armour sits under a roof tiled with round tarts; an egg with a knife stuck in it walks on little legs, a roast pig with a knife in its back crosses at right, and a man pushes out of a great cloud-like mass in the distance.
works.title: The Land of Cockaigne

works.caption: A woman in a long black dress with a train stands with her hands clasped at her waist and a thin string of pearls at her high collar, looking off past the viewer; behind her, on a pale grey wall, hangs a large framed panel showing arches and a ceiling cornice.
works.title: Portrait of Maria Yermolova

works.caption: A tree's long, dark, curving branches spread across the whole canvas, and short, blocky strokes of pale grey and white fill the sky between them and the ground below.
works.title: Gray Tree

works.caption: A young woman in a red dress and dark blue mantle holds a naked baby on her lap and looks down at him, her left hand held open at her side; a lettered scroll curls across her lap toward a haloed boy at left in a brown tunic with a thin cross-staff, while a second haloed boy, half-clothed, looks on at right, all in front of a low wall and a landscape of towns, hills and rocky cliffs.
works.title: Terranuova Madonna

works.caption: An older woman in a dark headdress smiles down over a younger woman in a rose-pink bodice and blue robe seated in front of her, who reaches down and takes hold of a naked baby; he holds a lamb by the neck with one leg over its back. A ledge of layered rock runs along the bottom, with a tree at right and pale blue mountains behind.
works.collection: Department of Paintings of the Louvre
works.title: The Virgin and Child with Saint Anne

works.caption: A man in a white tunic stands bound to the mast of a galley under a red sail while seven winged creatures with women's heads and birds' bodies swoop around the ship, one perched on its side close to a rower; the oarsmen, most with their heads wrapped in cloth, pull at their oars between tall grey cliffs.
works.title: Ulysses and the Sirens

works.caption: At the top, the letters IHS under a cross glow in a golden sky, ringed by winged figures kneeling on clouds. Below, a crowd gazes upward: at the front a man in black with a white ruff kneels beside a figure seen from behind in a yellow, ermine-trimmed mantle, and at right an enormous open mouth lined with teeth swallows a mass of naked bodies.
works.title: The Adoration of the Name of Jesus

works.caption: A barefoot boy sits in a patch of sunlight, picking at his clothing. An earthenware jug and scattered shrimp shells lie beside him; the dark room makes his absorbed gesture stand out.
works.collection: Department of Paintings of the Louvre
works.title: The Young Beggar

works.caption: Under a dark sky, a man leaning over the crossbar lets down a long white sheet, and the pale body of Christ slides along it into the arms of the men below: one in blue clings to a ladder, a bald man reaches from the right, a youth looks up from underneath. At right a man in a turban and long robe stands apart with a staff, watching, and figures in shadow look on from the left.
works.title: The Descent from the Cross

works.caption: Red clouds sweep across the sky above dark wooded hills and reflective water. A narrow band of yellow light marks the horizon, while bare branches at the edges make the foreground feel close beside the vast sunset.
works.title: Twilight in the Wilderness

works.caption: Inside a shallow gold box with painted tracery in its upper corners, Christ's pale body is lowered from the cross: a white-bearded man in a red cap holds him under the arms with a white cloth, a man in a gold brocade robe holds his legs, and a youth on a ladder stands behind. At left the Virgin, in blue, collapses in a faint, held by a man in red and a woman in green; at right a woman wrings her hands, and a skull lies on the ground.
works.title: The Descent from the Cross

works.caption: An older man in a white cloth cap and a dark robe with a reddish collar stands half-turned towards us, his face lit against a brown background. Low at right he grips brushes, a palette and a long stick, and the dark edge of a canvas on an easel runs down the right side.
works.collection: Department of Paintings of the Louvre
works.title: Self-portrait with easel

works.caption: A bearded man in a lace collar, patterned doublet and orange stockings sits with one leg crossed and one hand resting on a sword hilt. Beside him, lower down on the grass, a young woman in a tall hat, a wide lace ruff and an embroidered bodice lays her hand over his. Honeysuckle and dark leaves arch behind them, with sky and distant land at left.
works.title: Rubens and Isabella Brant in the honeysuckle bower

works.caption: In a shallow grey stone recess against a black background, a branch of lemons, a cluster of apples on strings, two small birds and a pair of partridges hang from above; a row of little birds is tied to a cane at left, carrots and radishes rest on the ledge, and a large thistle with thick pale stalks leans at right.
works.title: Still Life with Game, Vegetables and Fruit

works.caption: Two tall, narrow panels. At left, Christ hangs on the cross between two crucified men, above a crowd of riders, soldiers and mourners, with a city and snowy mountains behind. At right, Christ appears in judgment with raised hands among saints and angels; below, an armoured winged figure stands on a huge winged skeleton, and naked bodies tumble into a dark hell crowded with beasts.
works.title: The Crucifixion; The Last Judgment

works.caption: Two seated figures occupy the foreground beneath pink blossoms, one facing us and the other turned sideways. Behind them, a red-bearded figure props his chin on his hand; the three distinct poses sit within broad, sharply bounded areas of colour.
works.title: Barbarian Tales

works.caption: A square of cool, faintly grey white, tilted and pushed toward the upper right, sits on a warmer, creamier white ground; brushmarks and an uneven paint surface show across both whites.
works.title: Suprematist Composition: White on White

works.caption: In front of a distant city, a young man with long fair hair and a sword at his hip buries his face against the chest of an older man in a feathered turban and an embroidered robe, who holds him and looks down; a dark rock face rises at right, and a reddish bag and a tied bundle of shafts lie on the ground at lower right.
works.title: David and Jonathan

works.caption: A young man lies stretched across the foreground with his eyes closed, small white flowers near his head; behind him a winged child holding a lit torch stands by a golden cloak, a long arrow leaning beside him, and at upper left a pale woman leans against a rock beneath the trees.
works.collection: Department of Paintings of the Louvre
works.title: Echo and Narcissus

works.caption: Inside a dark cave, a naked young man with two spears rests one foot on a boulder, his elbow on his knee, and points up at a winged creature with a woman's face perched on a ledge in the shadows. A skull, ribs and the sole of a human foot lie in the bottom left corner; at right, through an opening in the rock, a naked, bearded man, red cloak streaming, runs off toward a distant city.
works.collection: Department of Paintings of the Louvre
works.title: Oedipus and the Sphinx

works.caption: Under dark storm clouds, with a rainbow arching down on the left, a stream rushes past a broken tree trunk through a graveyard of heavy stone tombs, one of them white and lit by the sun. Behind, the tall ruins of a church rise on a wooded hill, and a pale, half-dead tree stands at right.
works.title: The Jewish Cemetery

works.caption: A youth with dark curls and a pale rose behind his ear jerks back, brow knotted and mouth open, as a small lizard hanging from his finger bites him. White drapery slips from his bare shoulder. In front of him lie cherries and other fruit, and a clear glass vase holds a pink rose, leaves and small white flowers.
works.title: Boy Bitten by a Lizard

works.caption: A huge red horse with a dark blue mane plunges forward across the canvas, its body breaking up into streaks of colour, while men lean back and strain against it; a pale grey horse charges at left. Behind, scaffolding poles and brick walls rise under a hazy sky.
works.title: The City Rises

works.caption: The Grand Canal stretches away between rows of palaces toward a domed church and distant towers. Gondolas cross the green water; in the foreground, moored boats with masts and a loose white sail lie beside a quay at right, where people sit and stand under a tall house with a woman leaning from its balcony and a man up on a chimney.
works.title: The Grand Canal from San Vio, Venice

works.caption: Seen from behind, a painter in a black beret and a black doublet slit open across the back sits at his easel, painting a few blue leaves; his model, in blue with a crown of leaves, holds a long trumpet and a yellow book in front of a large wall map under a chandelier, while a patterned cloth is drawn back at left and the floor is tiled in black and white.
works.title: The Art of Painting

works.caption: A man displays coins in his open palm and places his other hand on the young woman’s shoulder. She continues sewing, looking down at her work; candlelight catches her white clothing and the offered money, holding the two actions close together.
works.title: The Proposition

works.caption: A pale two-storey farmhouse with an orange-pink roof stands among dark green trees, an ochre field with thin bare trees stretching away to its right, beneath a long blue-grey mountain ridge with steep rock faces and a pale cloudy sky.
works.title: House in Provence

works.caption: Mary, in a white robe, blue mantle and golden-yellow veil, stands on a globe with her hands raised together, a crescent moon at her feet and a serpent with an apple in its jaws beneath her; winged children and cherub heads float around her in a golden sky, a white dove and small stars above, a palm and a gilt-framed mirror below.
works.title: The Immaculate Conception

works.caption: A very tall, dark cypress rises up the middle of the canvas, its top cut by the edge, against a blue sky of short circling strokes with one large yellow-green star at left, a smaller light below it and a thin orange crescent moon at upper right; a pale road curves past tall yellow grasses, with a yellow carriage drawn by a white horse and two walkers on it and a green-roofed house behind.
