works.title: Country Road in Provence by Night

works.caption: Angels in pale, pink and yellow robes, some blowing long trumpets, drive a tangle of falling monsters down from a bright opening in the sky; at the centre a slim figure in gold armour swings a sword, a shield with a red cross on his arm, while below him fish, toads, shells, a helmeted creature and a head seen from behind with butterfly wings pile up in the dark.
works.collection: Royal Museums of Fine Arts of Belgium
works.title: The Fall of the Rebel Angels

works.caption: An armoured angel with spread wings sets one sandalled foot on a horned, bat-winged demon sprawled across the rocks, a long spear gripped in both hands and its point angled down. A blue sky and green hills open behind him; small flames glow in the dark rocks at the lower left.
works.title: St. Michael Vanquishing Satan

works.caption: A woman in a broad yellow straw hat, a high-collared blue-violet blouse flecked with orange-red dots and a cream apron sits with her hands resting in her lap, in front of tall green and yellow stalks of wheat with a few round orange blooms among them.
works.title: Peasant Woman Against a Background of Wheat

works.caption: Soldiers in classical dress and bright blue, yellow and red tunics stand talking and gesturing on rocky ground in front, with halberds and a big crimson banner behind them; on the left, in the middle distance, a crowd gathers round a kneeling naked man, while bodies and a severed head lie at the bottom-left edge; above, in bright clouds, angels play a lute and a large bowed instrument while others fly down holding wreaths and palm branches.
works.collection: Royal Monastery of San Lorenzo de El Escorial
works.title: The Martyrdom of St. Maurice

works.caption: Three women in long robes of red and blue, green, and pale grey stand in a meadow before a young man in a blue tunic and red hose, who sits on a low stone wall under a tree and holds out a lettered golden ball to the woman in grey as she reaches for it; two dogs, an ox, sheep and goats stand or lie around him, and on the shore at the left a ship stands propped up on land below a domed city, with a towered city on the hills at the right.
works.title: Judgement of Paris

works.caption: A young woman with centre-parted hair under a fine veil turns her head to the side; her red fur-lined coat lies open over one bare breast, and her right hand holds its fur edge. Behind her, dark laurel branches stand out against a black ground.
works.title: Laura

works.caption: A torchlit night crowd presses in from the right toward Mary, who holds the Child on a manger at the left: a kneeling king in a gold brocade cloak offers a gold vessel, an old white-bearded king in red and a dark-skinned king in a white turban and blue cloak stand behind him, and pages, muscular half-naked porters, a man on horseback at the upper right, camels and a donkey with a gold disc over its eyes crowd the space under flying cherubs and a starry sky.
works.title: Adoration of the Magi

works.caption: A white-haired, barefoot old man in a red cloak flies across the upper half of the picture, one arm stretched out ahead of him. Below and around him, birds fly, fish swim and animals run the same way: a white swan and dark ducks at upper left, fish in the sea below, and at the right a stag, an ox and a white horse-like head with a long straight horn.
works.title: Creation of the Animals

works.caption: Two bearded figures in blue sit on a bank of cloud with orbs and sceptres, a white dove in a blaze of light between them; a woman in a blue mantle stands below at left, people in white kneel at right beside a gold crown, and a crowd of half-naked men, with a woman in green silk among them and one man lifting a wooden box topped by a dove, surges up on clouds above a small green landscape, a large eagle at lower left.
works.title: La Gloria

works.caption: Two winged angels stretch a long scroll lettered GLORIA IN EXCELSIS DEO across the top, with small winged children tumbling between them; below, under stone arches, a woman in red holds up the edges of a white cloth around a brightly lit baby lying on it while men and a blue-robed angel gather round, and a barefoot man in green kneels near a white lamb lying on its back.
works.collection: National Museum of Art of Romania
works.title: Adoration of the Shepherds

works.caption: An angel in green with great grey wings stands on a cloud at right, arms crossed on his chest, facing a young woman in a rose dress and blue mantle who raises one hand, a book on a stand behind her. A white dove flies in a burst of light between them, a bush tipped with white flames rises beside a basket heaped with cloth, and above, angels on clouds play a harp, a recorder, a large bowed instrument and a box-shaped instrument.
works.title: The Annunciation

works.caption: Dozens of naked men tumble head over heels out of a bright break in dark storm clouds into a heap below; in front, big muscular figures twist, sprawl and stare upward or out at us, one with wild hair and gaping mouth at the centre, a torch burns at left, a snarling dog's head shows at the far left, and butterflies and a winged insect cover the groins of the nearest bodies.
works.title: The Fall of the Titans

works.caption: Three angels gather Christ’s blood in their outstretched hands beneath the dark sky. Mary and John stand on either side of the cross, while Mary Magdalene kneels at its foot; their long figures carry the eye upward towards Christ.
works.title: The Crucifixion

works.caption: A young woman in a dark dress with a black ribbon at her throat sits beside a white cradle, her chin resting on one hand, watching a baby asleep under a sheer white net that hangs from above; her other hand holds the edge of the net at the cradle's rim.
works.title: The Cradle

works.caption: Against a dark ground, a young woman sleeps with one arm thrown over her head, her body covered by a blanket of purple and blue spirals and flowers, while other women lie tangled around her, some with eyes closed and some open.
works.title: Virgin

works.caption: Beneath a huge red drape hung from the ceiling beams, the Virgin in a red dress lies dead on a low bed, barefoot, one arm hanging over the edge, while bearded apostles crowd round, some hiding their faces, and a young woman sits bent double on a chair in front.
works.collection: Department of Paintings of the Louvre
works.title: The Death of the Virgin

works.caption: Four administrators sit around a dark table, with the home’s house mother standing behind them. White collars and cuffs give structure to the black clothing, while Hals’s broad strokes distinguish each face and pair of hands.
works.title: Regentesses of the Old Men's Alms House

works.caption: Christ hangs on the cross under a gold sun and a dark moon, each with a face, while two angels in green and gold hold up cups beneath his wounds; below, two standing figures with clasped hands and two kneeling figures, an old bearded man and a young woman in pink, frame a landscape of hills and water.
works.title: The Mond Crucifixion

works.caption: On a stone ledge with steps, a smiling fair-haired boy in a tall fur cap, light blue jacket and yellow breeches shoulders a gun with fixed bayonet; another child with a pack and gun stands behind him, a boy in a red headscarf beats a drum at right, and a boy lying at left holds a small toy bell tower.
works.title: Boys playing soldiers

works.caption: Mary, in a red dress and a blue-green mantle, holds up a small open book while the naked Child on her lap turns his head to look up toward it, a goldfinch on a fine string in his hands; behind them, low green hills with slender trees and a distant blue valley.
works.title: Solly Madonna

works.caption: A naked woman, seen from behind and seated on a draped rock, throws her arms around a young man in a short rose-coloured tunic who grips a spear and holds his hunting dogs on leashes; at left a child sleeps under a tree hung with a bow and quiver, and at upper right light breaks through dark clouds.
works.title: Venus and Adonis

works.caption: Villagers crowd a long table in a barn: two men carry bowls of porridge on a door taken off its hinges, the front one in a long white apron; two bagpipers stand at left, the nearer in red; a man at lower left pours from one jug into another; a child in a big red cap sits on the floor eating from a plate; and the bride sits before a green hanging with a paper crown suspended above her.
works.title: The Peasant Wedding

works.caption: Four vessels stand in a row on a wooden ledge against a dark background: a gold cup on a pewter plate, a white two-handled jug with a frilled lip, a squat reddish vase with a tall ringed neck and small handles, and a white fluted jug on a second pewter plate.
works.title: Still Life with Vessels

works.caption: In a lamplit bedroom with flowered wallpaper, a woman in a white slip sits hunched and turned away at left, while a bearded man in a dark jacket stands at right with a hand in his pocket, his shadow large on the wall; between them an open sewing box glows on a round table, a corset lies on the floor and a top hat rests on the dresser.
works.title: Interior

works.caption: A boy with long brown hair stands full-length in a shimmering blue satin suit with a lace collar, one hand on his hip and the other holding a black hat with a white plume, against brown hills, trees and a dark, cloudy sky.
works.collection: The Huntington Library, Art Museum, and Botanical Gardens
works.title: The Blue Boy

works.caption: A round head fills most of the picture, divided into flat patches of pink, yellow, white and orange. Its two almond-shaped eyes have red disc pupils, with a white triangle above one and an arched green brow above the other, and a small purple mark sits at its centre; the head rests on a narrow neck of coloured squares against an orange ground.
works.title: Senecio (Baldgreis)

works.caption: Under a dark storm sky, flood water pours over rocks and falls through a wooded valley, carrying broken trees and an animal caught in branches; a rainbow arcs at lower left over figures lying on the rocks, and at right, on a path, an old woman crouches and an old man stoops over his stick beside two half-naked men, one in a red cloak pointing across the valley.
works.title: Landscape with Philemon and Baucis

works.caption: In a tall landscape, women at the edge of a river lift a baby from the water as a woman wearing a small crown approaches with her companions; a shepherd sleeps on a rock in the foreground near a goat, and beyond stand a palm and other tall trees, a tower, small falls with an arched bridge behind them, and a walled city at right.
works.title: The Finding of Moses

works.caption: In the open lower centre, a winged angel in a pale top and blue skirt walks beside a youth in orange who kneels over a large dark fish; tall trees rise at right, a round tower stands on a rocky bank at left, and a river runs toward distant hills under a golden sky with birds.
works.title: The Archangel Raphael and Tobias

works.caption: An imaginary harbour of Ostia opens between tall classical buildings towards a hazy sun low on the horizon, with a distant lighthouse, a round tower and tall-masted ships at anchor. Boatmen load rowing boats at the water's edge on the left, while on the stepped quay to the right a crowd gathers to see Saint Paula off, among them a veiled woman in a long brown cloak, children and a seated man holding out his hand.
works.title: Landscape with the Embarkation of Saint Paula Romana at Ostia

works.caption: A young man with dark hair, in a dark suit with full sleeves over a white shirt, looks out at us as he turns the pages of a large leather-bound book on a table spread with green cloth. Pink rose petals, folded letters, a gold ring and a thin gold chain lie scattered beside a pale blue fringed shawl, where a small lizard rests. A wooden box stands behind the book, and a narrow window at the far left opens onto blue sky and distant hills.
works.title: Portrait of a gentleman in his studio

works.caption: Sorolla’s wife, Clotilde, and their daughter María walk along the beach at Valencia. The breeze lifts their white dresses and veil; long blue and mauve strokes turn the water and wet sand into a moving backdrop.
works.title: Strolling along the Seashore

works.caption: A white dove sends rays of light down from the top of the arched canvas, and small flames hover over the heads of the crowd below. The Virgin Mary sits at the centre in a blue mantle and deep red robe, hands joined in prayer and face turned upward, with a woman in a grey veil beside her and the apostles crowded round; at the upper left a man raises an open hand. In the foreground two apostles, one in green and dark red seen from behind, the other in blue and gold, throw out their arms and look up.
works.title: The Pentecost

works.caption: The Virgin, in a dark blue mantle with a jewelled border, holds the Child on a tall throne topped with pinnacles and set on lions, inside a vaulted Gothic church. Five councillors in red robes lined with white kneel with joined hands, three at left and two at right, each group beside a standing saint holding a cross.
works.title: Virgin of the Councillors

works.caption: Clouds of white and grey steam rise beneath the dark iron trelliswork of the Pont de l'Europe, which cuts diagonally across the right side of the picture. Pale buildings of the rue de Rome stand behind, a locomotive waits at the far left, and a railwayman and a red signal disc on a post are small details among the tracks.
works.title: Pont de l'Europe, gare Saint-Lazare

works.caption: A young Tahitian girl, Teha'amana, lies naked on her stomach on a bed spread with a white sheet, her face turned sideways towards us. Behind her at the left is a dark hooded figure in profile, the tupapaú, a spirit of the dead in Polynesian belief, and pale feathery shapes float on the purple wall. The bed's deep blue cover is patterned with yellow-orange flowers.
works.title: Manaò tupapaú

works.caption: Christ sits stripped to the waist, his wrists bound with rope and his head sinking to one side, as a soldier in armour lowers the crown of thorns onto him. A kneeling man in a white headband presses a reed against his bound arms, a man in blue clenches his fist at the left, and onlookers peer in through a barred window behind. A long-haired black-and-white dog looks up at the lower left.
works.title: The Crown of Thorns

works.caption: Anne of Cleves faces us squarely against a deep blue background, her hands folded at her waist with rings on her fingers. Her red velvet gown has wide sleeves and gold bands studded with pearls, over a gold bodice set with jewelled rosettes and a buckled belt. She wears a gold-embroidered headdress under a sheer veil, ruffled white cuffs, a jewelled collar hung with a gold cross set with dark stones, and layered gold chains.
works.collection: Department of Paintings of the Louvre
works.title: Betrothal portrait of Anne of Cleves

works.caption: Lady Cockburn sits beneath heavy red curtains with her three small sons clambering over her: one on her lap at the left points upward as she turns to him, another peers over her shoulder towards us, and the baby lies across her lap. A red-and-blue macaw perches on the base of a stone column at the right, against a blue sky.
works.title: Lady Cockburn and Her Three Eldest Sons

works.caption: Mary Tudor sits turned three-quarters in a red chair with a framed panel of gold embroidery on its back and a fringed arm at the right. She wears a dark gown open over a pale skirt patterned with leaves. Pearls edge her black hood, and a jewel with a hanging pearl sits below her collar. She holds a red rose in her right hand and gloves in her ringed left hand.
works.title: Portrait of Mary Tudor

works.caption: Pax, the nude woman at the centre, presses her breast as a small child reaches up to her, while behind her the helmeted Minerva pushes back the armoured Mars, with what is probably a Fury beside him. A kneeling satyr holds out a horn of fruit towards a group of children, a leopard rolls on the ground, and at the left two women carry a tambourine and a gold vessel.
works.title: Minerva Protects Pax from Mars

works.caption: Mary nurses the infant Christ as Anne leans towards his head and Joseph supports his foot. Hands and glances draw the family closely together, while vivid pink, blue and yellow folds stand against an open, cloud-filled sky.
works.title: Holy Family with Saint Anne

works.caption: The Virgin, in a red dress and dark blue mantle, holds the Christ Child on her lap, his eyes closed, while her mother, Saint Anne, in a white veil and yellow cloak, draws a white cloth back from him at the left. Saint Joseph in green looks out from behind at the right, and the naked infant John the Baptist stands at the lower right with a finger at his lips beside a glass bowl of fruit. Grey and blue clouds fill the sky.
works.title: The Holy Family

works.caption: Saint Andrew, a gaunt old man with white hair and beard, is shown half-length and stripped to the waist against a dark background, a white cloth at his hips. One hand grips a large wooden cross at the right, and the other holds a fish by a cord on a table at the lower left.
works.title: Saint Andrew

works.caption: Saint Ildefonsus stands in gold-brocade vestments, a white pallium marked with black crosses and a tall gold mitre, looking down at an open book. In his white-gloved right hand he holds a gold crozier hung with a green cloth, and grey-blue clouds fill the sky behind him.
works.collection: Royal Monastery of San Lorenzo de El Escorial
works.title: Saint Ildefonso of Toledo

works.caption: Sebastian lies on his back on the ground at night, an arrow lodged in his side. A kneeling maid in a red dress holds up a torch and grips his wrist, while Saint Irene, in a dark robe with a red belt and red headscarf, stands looking down at him. Behind them one veiled woman joins her hands and another, in a turban, weeps into a white cloth; a steel helmet lies on the ground at right.
works.title: Saint Sebastian tended by Saint Irene

works.caption: Saturn, an old man with long grey hair and beard, naked but for a dark cloth about his hips, stands on clouds and bites into the chest of a screaming infant held against his arm, blood running from the wound. With his other hand he grips a tall scythe whose curved blade shows at top left. Three stars shine in the dark sky above.
works.title: Saturn

works.caption: Two young Parisian women in dark dresses and broad dark hats are shown close together. The one at left faces us, her fingers raised to her lips and a white ruff at her neck, while her companion, with a pale blue bow at her throat, turns her face towards her and rests one arm on a table. The table holds a glass and an orange, and blurred figures fill the background behind them.
works.title: Young Girls in Black

works.caption: Marie-Anne Lavoisier, in a white dress with a ruffled lace collar and a pale blue sash, her powdered hair falling in long curls down her back, stands leaning on her husband's shoulder and looks out at us. Antoine Lavoisier, seated in black with a white lace jabot, keeps his quill on the paper and looks up at her. The red-draped table carries papers, an inkwell and glass scientific apparatus, and a large glass flask lies on the floor at right, before a grey marble wall with fluted pilasters.
works.title: Portrait of Antoine-Laurent Lavoisier and his wife

works.caption: In an open timber stable under a thatched roof, the Virgin kneels in white before the Child, who lies on the bare ground in a burst of gold rays. Joseph, in red, holds a small candle. Two richly dressed women, one standing and one kneeling, are at right, three shepherds look in through an opening behind, an ox lies behind a slatted partition at left, and angels holding banners hover over the roof. Beyond, a road winds past bare trees toward a walled town beside open water.
works.title: Nativity

works.caption: A young man presents a detailed plan beside the panoramic view of Toledo. Above the city, a heavenly group hovers in the clouds; the map and the shifting painted streets offer two very different ways to look at the same place.
works.title: View and Plan of Toledo

works.caption: Christ rises with his feet together above a tangle of soldiers, naked but for a white loincloth, a crimson cloak flying behind him and a diamond-shaped halo round his head. He raises one hand and holds a white banner on a long staff. Below, a bearded soldier at left lifts a sword and a round shield over his head, a man in blue at right stretches an arm and turns his face upward, and another sprawls head-down in yellow in the foreground.
works.title: The Resurrection

works.caption: Two lovers in deep blue robes embrace amid crumbling ruins, seated close together at the right: the young man puts one arm round the red-haired woman and rests his cheek on her head, while she reaches up to his neck and looks outward. A small stringed instrument lies across his lap. At left, thorny briars with pink wild roses climb in front of a stone doorway topped by a frieze of carved infants, and a broken block of stone lies on the ground.
works.title: Love Among the Ruins

works.caption: John Ruskin stands on layered rocks in front of a rushing waterfall at Glenfinlas in Scotland, one foot set on a higher ledge. He wears a long black coat and holds a brown hat and a pale walking stick in one hand, looking off to the left. White water pours down on both sides of him, with dark foliage and mossy rock above.
works.title: John Ruskin

works.caption: Lady Howe stands full-length in a landscape in a pale pink silk dress, a sheer patterned apron over the skirt and deep lace ruffles at her elbows, under a wide straw hat trimmed with white ribbon. A choker of pearls circles her neck, and one hand rests on her hip, a black bracelet round its wrist. A slender tree rises at right against a heavy, cloudy sky, with a wooden fence behind her.
works.title: Portrait of Mary, Countess Howe

works.caption: A beardless Jupiter, crowned with a fan of red-gold rays, sits enthroned at the centre of a towering, densely ornamented palace under a deep blue sky, holding a lyre at his side. The pale, naked Semele lies struck down against his knee, one arm flung out. Below the throne a dark eagle spreads its wings beside the goat-footed Pan, and at the bottom Hecate, winged and with a crescent moon above her head, appears among a crowd of shadowy figures.
works.title: Jupiter and Semele

works.caption: A flock of black crows flies over a yellow wheatfield under a dark blue sky broken by two small pale clouds. A red-brown path edged with green grass curves into the wheat at the centre and ends there, while other paths run off at the left and along the lower right.
works.title: Wheatfield with Crows

works.caption: Wreathed revellers sprawl, drink and embrace on draped couches in a hall of tall fluted columns, with a pale woman in white reclining at the centre below a marble statue of a standing nude youth. More statues look down from the sides, and at far right a man in a fluttering red cloak clambers up one of them. A boy sits apart on a plinth at the left, and at the right two bearded men in red and blue robes look on.
works.title: The Romans of the Decadence

works.caption: Marat lies dead in his bath, his head in a white cloth turban slumped to one side and a bleeding wound on his chest. One arm hangs over the sheet-draped edge to the floor, still holding a quill, with a bloodstained knife lying nearby; the other hand rests on a green-covered board, gripping a letter. A plain wooden block at right, with an inkwell and papers on top, is lettered À MARAT, DAVID, and the wall behind is dark and bare.
works.collection: Royal Museums of Fine Arts of Belgium
works.title: The Death of Marat

works.caption: A long, dense file of pilgrims trudges out of the distance along a path at the foot of a dark wooded hill and a great reddish-brown rock. At right, a close-packed group in black and white shawls and hoods comes towards us, among them a man in black with a white collar and a chain who has been identified as an inquisitor. On the left, pale cloudy sky opens over a bare brown plain.
works.title: Pilgrimage to the Fountain of San Isidro

works.caption: The woman in yellow opens her palm beneath a coin offered by the man behind her, while the older woman watches closely. A patterned carpet fills the foreground, its reds and golds echoed in the clothing, glass and blue-and-white jug above.
works.title: The Procuress

works.caption: A suspension bridge on a massive stone pier crosses the Seine from the left towards a sunlit riverside village, its dark iron cables and railings set against blue sky and white clouds. On the far bank, cream houses with grey roofs and shutters stand above a green slope, with small boats drawn up at the water's edge. Near the pier, a man in black stands in a green rowing boat with two seated passengers in straw hats.
works.title: The Bridge at Villeneuve-la-Garenne

works.caption: A crowded feast spreads beneath tall Corinthian columns, with guests pressing round a table laid with a white cloth. At right a bearded man in red with a blue mantle sits half turned towards a woman in a green mantle, while a fair-haired woman in blue and orange-gold kneels at his feet. She holds one of his bare feet, her loose hair falling over it, and rests her other hand on a small ornate jar on the floor. Left of the table a man in a yellow mantle points downwards beside a white and brown dog, and a second dog noses out from under the cloth. Above, onlookers lean over a balcony where a green parrot perches.
works.title: The Feast in the House of Simon the Pharisee (Veronese, Turin)

works.caption: A nobleman with short dark hair and a pointed beard, dressed in black, looks straight out at us above a white lace ruff. His right hand, in a matching lace cuff, lies spread across his chest, and the gilded hilt of a sword shows at the lower right. Behind him the background is plain and greyish brown.
works.title: The Nobleman with his Hand on his Chest

works.caption: King Cophetua, in dark armour, sits on the steps below with his ornate red-and-gold crown held in his lap, gazing up at the beggar maid. She sits above him on a cushioned ledge in a plain grey dress, barefoot, with her hands resting at her sides and her eyes turned towards us. On a gallery above, two youths lean together over a scroll, and a red-shafted spear and a shield stand at the right.
works.title: King Cophetua and the Beggar Maid

works.caption: A woman bends over her letter while her maid waits by the window with folded arms. Behind them hangs the biblical Finding of Moses, a large, dark scene that sets off the writer’s bright sleeves and the light falling across the floor.
works.title: Lady Writing a Letter with her Maid

works.caption: The Archangel Gabriel, with red, green and gold wings, kneels in a sunlit street holding a white lily, beside Saint Emidius in a jewelled mitre, who balances a model of a towered, walled town. At right the Virgin kneels with crossed hands in a room crowded with household things, as a golden ray from a burst of light in the sky brings a dove down to her. Above her doorway a patterned carpet hangs over a balcony where a peacock perches, while people in the street and on a bridge beyond carry on regardless. An apple and a long green gourd lie on the ledge in front.
works.title: The Annunciation, with Saint Emidius

works.caption: The four Boit sisters occupy separate parts of their family’s Paris apartment, from the light foreground to the shadowed doorway. Large Japanese vases stand beside them, making the children’s different heights and distances unusually noticeable.
works.title: The Daughters of Edward Darley Boit

works.caption: Joan of Arc stands in silver armour over a pink skirt patterned with gold roundels, a thin gold halo behind her head and her eyes raised. Her right hand grips the red staff of a white banner, and her left rests on an altar crowded with gold candlesticks, vessels and a crown. At left a tonsured monk reads a small book, a boy in green clasps his hands and an armoured man stands behind them, while a helmet lies at her feet on blue cloth strewn with yellow fleurs-de-lis. The dark hanging behind her is dotted with gold fleurs-de-lis.
works.collection: Department of Paintings of the Louvre
works.title: Joan of Arc at the Coronation of Charles VII

works.caption: Gold sparks hang in the smoky darkness above barely defined spectators at Cremorne Gardens. Whistler lets the fireworks dissolve into streaks and flecks of paint, leaving just enough of the setting to suggest a crowded night outdoors.
works.title: Nocturne in Black and Gold – The Falling Rocket

works.caption: A young kitchen maid in a white cap and an olive-green jacket leans over a table, one hand flat on the board and the other holding a white jug painted with grey-blue leaves. Around her stand a brass bowl, a white two-handled jar, a dark upturned jug, stacked dishes, a brass mortar and pestle and a garlic bulb, and a basket with a white cloth hangs on the wall. Through a small hatch at upper left, a haloed Christ sits at a table with his followers.
works.title: Kitchen Scene with the Supper in Emmaus

works.caption: Medusa's severed head lies on a stone ledge with its face turned upwards, the eyes wide and red-rimmed and the mouth open, its hair a tangle of writhing snakes. Small snakes wriggle out of the pool of blood at the neck, beside a crumpled white cloth. In the foreground a black-and-yellow salamander, two spiders and a scorpion crawl near a tightly coiled snake.
works.title: Head of Medusa

works.caption: A young woman in a gold cap is seen half-length before a green curtain, behind a grey stone ledge. She wears a red bodice with white puffed slashes and full gold-orange sleeves, and looks down with her head tilted. One hand is held out palm up over the ledge; the other rests on a dark blue cloth. A small heap of gold coins lies on the ledge, which is inscribed LAIS CORINTHIACA 1526 in capitals and numerals.
works.title: Lais of Corinth

works.caption: A young bearded man in a red biretta looks out at us. A red cape with a pale, wavy watered pattern, buttoned down the front, falls over full white sleeves, and a small white ruff edges a blue collar. One hand holds brown gloves. A green curtain hangs at the upper left against a dark brown wall.
works.title: Portrait of Cardinal Alessandro Farnese

works.caption: Mary, in a deep red cloak, sits before a wooden trellis thick with roses, where small birds perch against a gold ground. The naked Child on her lap has one arm round her neck. Above her head two angels with dark wings hold up a large gold crown. A carved gilt arched frame with small angel musicians surrounds the painting.
works.collection: Église des Dominicains, Colmar (property of the Collégiale Saint-Martin)
works.title: Madonna of the Rose Bower

works.caption: A carriage crosses the pale road between green fields, while a train trails white steam along the distant horizon. In this view of Auvers, rows of crops become bands of violet and green that lead the eye back and forth across the canvas.
works.title: Landscape with a Carriage and a Train

works.caption: An old, long-bearded Jerome in a torn white robe sits under a towering reddish rock, one hand raised and the other resting on an open book on a ledge. A lion sits facing him with one front paw lifted. A tiny rabbit crouches at bottom left; behind, a horse grazes on a pale plain with a haystack and a wooden fence, below green hills.
works.title: Saint Jerome in the Wilderness

works.caption: The Virgin, in a red dress and blue mantle, sits beneath an apple tree holding the Christ Child, who stands on her lap, while Joseph rests his head on his hand in the shadows at the left. To the right a ring of winged children dances hand in hand, and two partridges fly across the sky above them. A blue-and-yellow parrot perches on a branch at the upper left, a sunflower rises behind Mary, and fruit lies on the ground at her feet.
works.title: Madonna with Partridges

works.caption: God the Father, white-bearded and wearing a tall white mitre, holds the slumped body of Christ, who leans back against him on a white cloth spread over his lap, with wounds in his side, hands and feet. The dove of the Holy Spirit hovers above them in golden light. Winged angels in violet, green, blue and red robes crowd round on either side, and small winged cherub heads appear in the clouds at Christ's feet.
works.title: The Holy Trinity

works.caption: The Virgin lies in a bed against white pillows, her hands folded on a blue cloak and her eyes turned upward. Apostles crowd around the bed: one in a white vestment takes hold of a candle that another holds out, while others pray, lean in or sit on the plank floor. Above, Christ appears with arms spread in a ring of light, flanked by two angels holding his red mantle.
works.title: Death of the Virgin

works.caption: A young woman with brown hair parted in the centre and smoothed down over her ears looks out from behind a grey ledge against a black background. Her face is turned almost straight to us, her eyes slightly to one side. A thin cord with a small jewel crosses her forehead. She wears strands of dark beads and a red dress with an embroidered square neckline, its white-puffed sleeves tied with wide olive-gold ribbons.
works.collection: Department of Paintings of the Louvre
works.title: Portrait of a Woman, wrongly called La Belle Ferronnière

works.caption: Copernicus, in a fur-trimmed dark green robe, half-kneels on a wooden tower roof at night and gazes up at the stars, his right hand raised and a pair of dividers in his left. Beside him a board bears a chart of concentric orbits, with books, papers and a lantern on the boards nearby. The brick towers of Frombork cathedral rise beyond the balustrade at the left, and a long wooden instrument angles up into the sky at the right.
works.title: Astronomer Copernicus, or Conversations with God

works.caption: The jester Stańczyk sits alone in a dark room, slumped in a high-backed chair in a red costume and red jester's hood, his hands folded and his eyes cast down. A sealed letter lies on the cloth-covered table beside him, and his jester's staff lies on the floor. Through an opening at the right, richly dressed figures crowd a red-lit room where a ball is going on, while the window at the left shows a dark tower and a comet in the night sky.
works.title: Stańczyk

works.caption: Dr Nicolaes Tulp, in a broad black hat and a black suit with a white lace collar, sits at the right and lifts the muscles of a corpse's dissected forearm with a pair of forceps, his other hand raised. Seven men in white ruffs crowd in from the left, two of them leaning close over the arm and one holding a sheet of paper. The pale body lies on a table across the foreground, with a large open book propped at its feet in the lower right corner.
works.title: The Anatomy Lesson of Dr. Nicolaes Tulp

works.caption: A huge gold figure 5 fills the picture, with two smaller 5s nested inside it, over the red, boxy front of a fire engine reduced to flat shapes. Angled grey and black buildings and white globe lights crowd around it. The name BILL is lettered in red at the top, CARLO appears in small dots of light near the centre, and the initials C.D. and W.C.W. sit in red along the bottom edge.
works.title: I Saw the Figure 5 in Gold

works.caption: Two young men play cards at a table covered with a red patterned cloth. At left one in a dark red velvet doublet studies the cards in his hand, while an older man in a feathered hat peers over his shoulder and raises a gloved hand with two fingers spread. At right a youth in a yellow-and-black striped doublet, a dagger at his hip, looks across at the young man and holds cards hidden behind his back.
works.title: The Cardsharps

works.caption: A woman stands with her bare back to us, a white cloth wrapped round her hips and a gold hoop in her ear, raising one hand to the bun of her dark hair. Her other hand rests on a green-covered table beside a small open box. In an oval mirror with a red frame on the grey-green wall, her reflection looks down, her face lit and her arm lifted to her head.
works.title: A nude woman doing her hair before a mirror

works.caption: A long column of soldiers on foot and on horseback, many in armour and carrying pikes, climbs a steep rocky mountain path under tall dark fir trees. Near the middle, small among the crowd, a man in blue, probably Saul, lies on his back beside a fallen horse while men bend over him. Riders in black and in yellow on pale horses fill the right foreground, and at left the land drops away to a distant plain and sea.
works.title: Conversion of Paul

works.caption: A peasant in a hood, brown jacket and grey hose strides towards us, a stick in one hand, pointing back with the other at a tree where a nest robber in red breeches clings to the trunk, his hat falling. At the peasant's feet the path ends at the edge of a stream. Behind him a sunny meadow stretches to thatched farm buildings and two brown horses.
works.title: The Peasant and the Nest Robber

works.caption: Looking west along Yosemite Valley, the tall tower of Sentinel Rock rises on the left and the sheer wall of El Capitan stands on the right, with the pointed spire of Middle Cathedral Rock far off in golden haze between them. The Merced River winds across the flat, tree-dotted valley floor. A grassy slope with boulders and trees fills the foreground under a sky of streaked orange and grey cloud.
works.title: Looking Down Yosemite Valley, California

works.caption: A rider in a tall blue headdress and gold tunic sits on a pale horse in a dark forest, one hand raised towards a stag on the right that carries a crucifix between its antlers. Hounds gather round the horse, a greyhound chases a hare, and deer, birds and a bear are scattered through the woods. A blank scroll lies across the front.
works.title: The Vision of Saint Eustace

works.caption: Two figures sit close together in a shaded interior, with a pale cat curled in front of them. The nearer figure holds a cigarette; beyond the open doorway, a dark dog and distant people occupy a much brighter space.
works.title: Not to work

works.caption: In a Tahitian landscape, a bare-chested man in dark blue shorts stands at right with both hands raised together above his shoulder, near white smoke rising from a small fire on red ground. Two peafowl, one deep blue with a long green tail, walk across the foreground. Behind them two figures stand near a hut with a sloping roof, and a slender palm leans across hills of orange, yellow and pink.
works.title: Matamoe (Death), Landscape with Peacocks

works.caption: Mary, in a deep blue mantle over a red dress, holds the naked Christ Child as he stands on a parapet. He holds her chin with one hand, and his other hand shows at her far shoulder, while she looks down and away. A green cloth hangs behind them, with blue sky, clouds and hills on either side. IOANNES BELLINVS is lettered on the parapet.
works.collection: Museu de Arte de São Paulo (MASP)
works.title: The Virgin with the Standing Child Embracing his Mother (Madonna Willys)

works.caption: Mary wears a pale veil under a dark mantle traced with fine gold lines, and holds the Child on her arm beneath a round-topped arch. He tugs at the edge of her veil and looks up at her. Above the arch, three winged angels on each side lean over the frame.
works.title: Madonna with Child and six Angels

works.caption: Matisse's wife Amélie sits against a plain blue background in a red headscarf patterned with yellow, her dark hair showing beneath it. She wears a dark blue-green robe with rust-orange leaf shapes and white trim flecked with black, and rests her hands one over the other on a yellow upright. Her pale face, with pink cheeks and red lips, is turned slightly to our left.
works.title: Madras Rouge

works.caption: A naked young man sits on a rock at left, playing a wooden pipe. At right Apollo stands naked, one hand on his hip and the other gripping a tall staff. Between them a lyre leans against a tree stump. Behind are slender trees, a river with an arched bridge, a towered town and blue hills, with birds flying overhead.
works.collection: Department of Paintings of the Louvre
works.title: Apollo and the Shepherd Daphnis

works.caption: Inside the Café de la Gare at Arles at night, a green billiard table with a cue lying on it stands in the middle of a yellow wooden floor, under red walls and a green ceiling. The owner, in a white suit, stands beside it, and hanging lamps glow with rings of yellow light. A few customers sit slumped at small tables along the walls, and at the back are a counter with bottles and a vase of pink flowers, a clock and an open doorway.
works.title: The Night Café

works.caption: Christ, haloed and wrapped in a red cloak, stands in the air above an open tomb. He raises one hand and holds a staff flying a white banner with a red cross. Two winged angels fly on either side, one in lilac, one in green. Below, four soldiers twist and gesture around the tomb, whose lid lies askew, and behind them three haloed women walk along a path through green hills.
works.title: Resurrection of Christ

works.caption: Christ, crowned with thorns and with his eyes closed, bows his head beside the diagonal beam of the cross. Grimacing, gaping faces press in on every side against a dark ground. At lower left a woman lowers her eyes above a cloth printed with his face.
works.title: Christ Carrying the Cross

works.caption: Jeanne-Marguerite Lecadre, the wife of Monet's cousin, stands at the left of a sunlit lawn in a long white dress, holding a white parasol and facing away into the garden. In the centre a tree covered in pale blossom rises from a round bed of red flowers, with a yellow-green shrub and a row of small standard trees in flower to the right. Dark trees fill the background beneath a blue sky, and long shadows stretch across the grass.
works.title: Woman in the Garden

works.caption: Orange-gold cliffs of a quarry, dotted with green trees and topped with grey blocks of stone, fill the foreground. Behind them the pale blue-grey peak of Mont Sainte-Victoire rises into a blue sky, and a tall, thin tree climbs the right edge.
works.title: Mountains Mont Sainte-Victoire Seen from the Bibémus Quarry

works.caption: Dancers and seated friends fill an outdoor gathering at the Moulin de la Galette. Patches of sunlight break across faces, dresses and dark jackets, linking the foreground tables to the crowd beneath the trees.
works.title: Bal du moulin de la Galette

works.caption: Christ, in a blue mantle over a red robe, stands at the centre of a packed crowd of men, his arms hanging at his sides. One man presses a red rod against his head, another reaches a hand over his halo, and others clutch at his arm. Their hose is red or blue, and two carry swords; two buildings with blue roofs rise against the gold ground.
works.title: The Mocking of Christ

works.caption: Three labourers struggle to raise a heavy wooden cross to which the old, white-bearded Peter is already nailed, his head lower than his feet. One hauls on a rope over his shoulder with his back to us, another grips the cross beside Peter's feet, and a third crouches underneath, bearing it up on his back while one hand reaches for a spade on the rocky ground. Peter, naked but for a white loincloth, lifts his head and shoulders from the beam.
works.title: Crucifixion of Saint Peter

works.caption: Crowds on foot and on horseback stream across a hilly landscape towards a ring of people on a distant hilltop. Near the centre a man has fallen under a cross. Mourners sit and kneel in the right foreground, and a windmill stands on top of a tall rock left of centre.
works.title: The Procession to Calvary

works.caption: The artist's mother sits in profile, facing left, in a long black dress and a white lace cap whose ends fall to her shoulders, her hands folded in her lap and her feet on a low footstool. Behind her a framed view of the Thames hangs on a plain grey wall, and at left a dark curtain patterned with small pale flowers falls to the floor.
works.title: Whistler's Mother

works.caption: God the Father, crowned and in a gold cope over a blue robe, holds the crucified Christ in front of him, while angels spread a green cloak out to either side and a white dove hovers at the top. Crowds of saints fill the sky: women with palm fronds and crowns at left, men at right, one holding stone tablets and another a harp. Below, a pope, a cardinal, a crowned emperor and a man in gold armour stand out in a crowd floating on clouds above a landscape with water. In the bottom right corner a tiny Dürer stands beside a signed tablet.
works.title: Adoration of the Trinity

works.caption: A domed church and ancient ruins around the Roman Forum fade into a golden haze, with a pale moon in the misty sky left of centre. Two tall columns carrying a broken piece of entablature rise on the right. In the foreground women and children gather on a slope at left, and goats climb and graze across the rocky ground.
works.title: Modern Rome – Campo Vaccino

works.caption: A crowded town square seen from above. In the foreground a fat man in red hose sits astride a barrel and levels a spit of roast meat. Facing him, a thin, pale figure in a tall woven hat sits on a red wheeled platform and holds out a long paddle bearing two fish. A church stands at the right, with people in dark hooded cloaks near its door.
works.title: The Fight Between Carnival and Lent

works.caption: A tall pine trunk rises at the left edge, and its long branches stretch across the top of the picture, curving with the outline of Mont Sainte-Victoire beyond. The mountain, in pale pinks and blues, stands above a broad valley of green and yellow fields with scattered houses, and a railway viaduct crosses the valley at right.
works.title: Mont Sainte-Victoire with Large Pine

works.caption: Trees with red trunks and leaves dashed in blue and green crowd the foreground above yellow-green grass, with lilac strokes marking a path. Behind them the mountains are laid in flat patches of orange, coral and bright blue, and cream and pink clouds swirl across a green-blue sky.
works.title: Mountains at Collioure

works.caption: A lone, bare-headed monk in a dark robe, seen from behind, is on a pale strip of shore before a nearly black sea. A few white gulls fly over the water, and above them the huge sky passes from grey mist low down to clear blue at the top.
works.title: The Monk by the Sea

works.caption: Hundreds of children fill a broad town square, seen from above, playing in groups among the houses and around a large stone building. In the foreground two children bowl hoops and one sits astride a barrel. At upper left, beyond a fence and trees, more children play by a stream in green fields.
works.title: Children's Games

works.caption: The newborn Christ lies glowing in a manger in a dark stable, lighting the face of Mary, who bends over him with her fingertips joined. Five angels gather at the left, most with their hands joined or raised, and an ox and a donkey look on from the shadows. Joseph stands in the gloom at the far right, one hand raised to his chest. Through a gap in the back wall, shepherds by a fire on a hillside look up at a shining angel in the night sky.
works.title: Nativity at Night

works.caption: Mary, looking down, holds up a red carnation by its stem, and the child on a cushion beside her lifts both hands toward it. Behind them, arched windows between slim columns look out on jagged blue mountains. A vase of flowers stands at the lower right.
works.title: Madonna of the Carnation

works.caption: A great red curtain hangs across the top of the canvas above the Virgin, who sits with the infant Jesus on her arm and gestures towards St Dominic at left. He holds out strings of rosary beads in both hands to a crowd of kneeling people, two of them barefoot, who reach up towards him. At right St Peter Martyr, with a bleeding wound on his head, looks out at us and points back towards the Child, and at the far left an older man in a white ruff peers out from under Dominic's black cloak.
works.title: Madonna of the Rosary

works.caption: Herdsmen drive cattle along a hillside track between bare trees, one reaching out with a long stick beside a white cow with black patches, while a cloaked man on a grey-white horse and men with poles over their shoulders follow at right. In the middle distance, people work in a vineyard on a slope that runs down to a wide river, which winds through a valley between craggy rocks under dark clouds.
works.title: The Return of the Herd

works.caption: A man and a woman embrace on a patch of flowered meadow, wrapped in golden robes against a speckled gold ground. He bends to kiss her cheek, cupping her face in his hands, with green leaves in his dark hair; she kneels with her eyes closed, flowers in her hair and one hand laid on his. His robe is patterned with black, white and grey rectangles and hers with coloured circles, and only their heads, hands and her arms, shoulders and bare feet show as skin.
works.title: The Kiss

works.caption: A bearded man in a black doublet with shiny red sleeves, a white ruff and heavy gold chains with a medallion leans over a table, holding up a small nude statuette while he looks off to our right. A grey-white fur hangs from his shoulders and a sword hilt shows at his side. On the table lie coins, a folded letter and a white stone torso. Two books lie on top of a cupboard behind him, a gilt-framed inscription hangs at upper right, and the letters TITIANVS F appear at upper left.
works.title: Portrait of Jacopo Strada

works.caption: A young man with chin-length brown hair, a white frilled collar and a dark fur-trimmed coat looks out from a round panel, as if seen in a curved mirror. His hand, in a ruffled white cuff, swells across the bottom of the panel, wider than his face. Behind him the room bends: window panes arc round the upper left, and the pale wall curves away to the right.
works.title: Self-portrait in a Convex Mirror

works.caption: A woman reads beside an open window, her face faintly reflected in the glass. Behind her, the painting of Cupid uncovered during restoration changes the room’s balance; a green curtain partly screens it from view.
works.title: Girl Reading a Letter at an Open Window

works.caption: A nude young woman, seen from behind, sits on a white cloth over a mossy bank and leans back, her head tipped up. A dark grey cloud covers the upper canvas and reaches down round her waist, and a faint face in the mist hovers at her lips. A large clay jar stands at right, and a drinking deer's antlers rise from the shadows at its foot.
works.title: Jupiter and Io

works.caption: Lucretia, bare to the waist against a dark background, tips her head back with her eyes turned upward and her lips parted, holding a dagger whose point rests at the side of her chest. Strings of pearls run through her auburn hair and pearl drops hang from her ears, a sheer veil and pale drapery slip from her arms, and her other hand is spread open at lower left.
works.title: Lucretia

works.caption: Ludovic-Napoléon Lepic, bearded, in a top hat and grey coat with a cigar in his mouth and an umbrella under his arm, strides across the Place de la Concorde with his two small daughters in grey coats and black hats and a lean grey dog. At the far left a man in a top hat, perhaps the playwright Ludovic Halévy, is cut off by the edge of the canvas, while behind them a carriage and a rider cross the wide, empty square in front of a long stone wall.
works.title: Place de la Concorde

works.caption: Painted almost entirely in pale and deep blues, the view looks across the Thames to the dark band of the Chelsea shore, where small pale lights glint and the tower of Chelsea Old Church rises at the right. A low, dark barge lies on the water at left, and in the foreground a lone fisherman in a hat stands at the water's edge, a long thin rod angled towards the barge. A small dark panel at the bottom centre holds a butterfly mark.
works.title: Nocturne: Blue and Silver – Chelsea

works.caption: A young woman sits beside an open window that looks onto wooded hills and a blue mountain, with a dark red curtain patterned in gold hanging at the left. Her fair hair is braided and threaded with pearls. She wears a high white ruffled collar, a dark red velvet bodice and gold-embroidered oversleeves slit over white puffed sleeves and pink silk. A long string of pearls loops across her bodice, caught up at a jewelled brooch. Her hand at the right holds a small open book, and she looks away to the side.
works.title: Portrait of Isabella of Portugal

works.caption: A heavily built man with a long, grey-streaked beard is set against a dark background, his head turned to look off to the right. A wide red robe with broad, pale-streaked lapels fills most of the canvas, open over an olive-green doublet and a heavy gold chain. A gloved hand shows near the bottom, just right of centre.
works.title: Portrait of Pietro Aretino

works.caption: Van Gogh's mother is shown head and shoulders against a flat bright green background. She wears a high-collared dark dress with a thin white edge at the neck, and a dark headdress of large ribbon loops tinged with green. Her face, pale with green and pink strokes, is turned slightly to the right, and she looks out with a faint smile.
works.title: Portrait of the Artist's Mother

works.caption: A naked young woman with long golden-brown hair lies on white sheets and pillows over a red couch, looking straight at us and holding a small bunch of roses in her right hand. A small dog sleeps curled at the foot of the bed. Behind her, beyond a dark green curtain and screen, two maids are busy at a painted chest in a tiled room, one kneeling in white and one standing in red with a garment over her shoulder, while a potted plant stands on the window sill.
works.title: Venus of Urbino

works.caption: Philip’s outstretched arms are bound to a beam as men haul on ropes to raise him. His pale body hangs against an open blue sky, while onlookers gather below, some absorbed in the execution and others turning away.
works.title: The Martyrdom of Saint Philip

works.caption: A court jester, traditionally thought to be Sebastián de Morra but now identified by the Prado as the jester known as el Primo, sits on the floor against a plain brownish wall and stares straight out at us. His legs point towards us so that the pale soles of his shoes face the viewer, and his closed hands rest on his thighs. He has dark hair and a full beard, and wears a green doublet with white lace collar and cuffs under a red cape edged in gold.
works.title: The Buffoon El Primo

works.caption: A festival procession of barefoot young women and children in flower crowns comes down marble steps between pale stone buildings, carrying baskets and branches of blossom; a girl at the front right plays a pipe. Onlookers lean over the rooftops and balconies above, waving and dangling garlands of purple flowers. Under the central arch, figures watch from a box, with a gold standard on tall blue poles hung with purple garlands in front of them.
works.title: Spring

works.caption: A friar in a grey habit, at a green table, points a long stick at a figure drawn on a framed slate lettered EVCLIDES, his other hand on an open book. Behind him at right a young man with long red hair, in a fur-trimmed coat, looks out at us. A glass polyhedron, half full of water, hangs on a thread at upper left; a wooden many-sided solid sits on a red book at right, and a quill, inkwell and dividers lie on the table.
works.title: Portrait of Luca Pacioli

works.caption: Small white sails scatter across blue-green water as spectators watch from the beach at Sainte-Adresse. The curved shoreline carries the eye past seated figures and parasols towards the houses on the low rise beyond.
works.title: Regatta at Sainte-Adresse

works.caption: Before a dark rock tomb, the fainting Virgin in a black mantle slumps sideways with Christ's pale body across her lap, while John, in blue and red, holds her up from behind. A kneeling woman in red over blue presses her cheek to Christ's face, another in a lilac dress and green cloak holds his feet, and a third, behind, covers her mouth with her green cloak. Haloed men stand at the sides: at left an old man bare to the waist holding a stone and a long-bearded man with a sword, at right a grey-bearded man in blue and yellow holding keys and a book.
works.title: Lamentation over the Dead Christ

works.caption: A naked young woman with reddish hair and a pink flower behind her ear reclines on white pillows and sheets, resting her left hand on her thigh and looking straight out at us. She wears a black ribbon tied round her neck, a gold bracelet and pearl earrings, with a flowered shawl spread beneath her. Behind her, a Black servant in a pink dress holds out a large bouquet wrapped in white paper, and at the foot of the bed a black cat stands with its tail raised.
works.title: Olympia

works.caption: The dead Saint Eulalia lies on her back on snowy paving, arms flung wide and long auburn hair spread round her head, with a red cloth over her lower body and her bare feet pointing away from us. Beside her at the right rises the base of a tall wooden cross bound with ropes, and grey and white pigeons gather on the snow around her as flakes fall. Behind, a helmeted soldier with a spear stands by the cross, a woman in white kneels, and a crowd of onlookers, children among them, watches from in front of a colonnade while a white dove flies above.
works.title: Saint Eulalia

works.caption: John the Baptist stands barefoot before a dark rock face, bearded and bare-chested, wearing an animal skin over a pale cloth. His right arm is raised with one finger pointing upward, and his left hand holds a thin staff topped by a cross. A white lamb lies curled up at the lower left. To the right, trees and a small stream of white water lead back to blue hills under a cloudy sky.
works.title: Saint John the Baptist

works.caption: Rembrandt faces us squarely with his hands on his hips, wearing a black beret and a loose brown robe tied at the waist with a sash, a dark collar and a strip of white shirt at his throat. Light falls on his lined face, which looks straight out from a plain dark brown background.
works.title: Self Portrait

works.caption: An angel plays the violin from music held by Joseph, who watches from the left. On the other side of the angel’s white drapery, Mary rests her head against the sleeping child, dividing the scene between attentive listening and sleep.
works.title: Rest on the Flight into Egypt

works.caption: A youth with curly auburn hair, in a grey-and-white patterned doublet with full cream sleeves and blue breeches, kneels at the edge of still, dark water. He leans out on both hands to look down at his reflection, and the water mirrors his arms, sleeves and bent knee across the lower half of the canvas. All around is black shadow.
works.title: Narcissuss

works.caption: The court jester identified as Juan Calabazas sits low in a dark greenish suit and cloak with a broad white lace collar and lace cuffs, his hands clasped over one raised knee. He grins with narrowed, squinting eyes. A gourd lies on its side on the floor at the left and another stands at the right, and a small glass of red liquid sits at the lower right, against a plain brown wall.
works.title: The Jester Calabacillas

works.caption: On the left, three girls gather beside a slender tree at the edge of pale, still water: one in a pink-red skirt stretches up into its branches, a small one stands nearby, and another kneels in a red headscarf to gather flowers from the grass. A larger leaning tree spreads its grey-green foliage across the right and top of the canvas, and soft hills fade into a misty sky on the far shore.
works.collection: Department of Paintings of the Louvre
works.title: Recollection of Mortefontaine

works.caption: Six nude men bathe from a rocky stone pier in still water edged by woods: one reclines at the left, one sits with an arm raised, one stands with his hands on his hips, and one dives head first at the right. In the water below, a red-haired man standing waist-deep reaches up towards the pier, a reddish-brown dog paddles nearby, and at the lower right Eakins himself swims towards the dog. Dark green trees fill the background, with a sunny meadow at the upper right.
works.collection: Amon Carter Museum of American Art
works.title: Swimming

works.caption: Matisse stands in profile at the left in blue-and-white striped pyjamas, one hand in his pocket, facing his wife Amélie, who sits on the right in a black dress with a green collar on a blue chair. Between them, against a flat deep-blue wall, a window with a black curling iron railing opens onto a green garden with a tree trunk, round blue beds dotted with red flowers and a pink building beyond.
works.title: The Conversation

works.caption: A maid in a white cap, white collar and blue skirt stands on a step at the right, holding a dish and the hand of a little girl in a yellow skirt who looks up at her. To the left, through a brick archway with an inscribed tablet above it and a red shutter beside it, a woman in a black jacket and red skirt stands with her back to us at the end of a passage. The sunny courtyard has a herringbone brick floor, a wooden bucket and a broom in the foreground.
works.title: The Courtyard of a House in Delft

works.caption: Christ hangs dead on the cross under the INRI scroll, his grey-green body streaked with red blood from the nails and the wound in his side. Mary stands at the left in a pale pink head-cloth, grey mantle and purple robe with her hands clasped, and John stands at the right in a green robe and red cloak, gazing up at Christ with his hands folded. A skull and bones lie at the foot of the cross, under a dark sky with a few stars above a low horizon.
works.title: The Crucifixion with the Virgin and St John

works.caption: The Queen of Sheba, wearing a crown and a red dress, comes down the steps of a columned palace at the right with her attendants, while two men in the foreground carry a chest into a rowing boat. Ships lie at anchor in the harbour, one moored beside ruined columns at the left and another near a round tower and a bridge. The sun sits low over the sea left of centre, lighting the clouds and the rippling water.
works.title: The Embarkation of the Queen of Sheba

works.caption: Women and children of a royal household kneel on a terrace before a crowd of men in armour at right. At the front a woman in a blue cloak lined with ermine kneels with her back half turned; a young man in deep rose turns toward the group, one hand held open. Behind them stands a pale arcade topped by a balustrade, where onlookers lean over, and a monkey crouches on a parapet at left.
works.title: The Family of Darius Before Alexander

works.caption: A red fox, seen from behind, flounders through deep snow, one dark foreleg stretched out ahead of it. Above, two large black crows swoop down with wings spread, and more crows fly in low at right. Beyond the snowy rise lie dark rocks, a reddish-brown thicket and a green sea under a grey sky, with a sprig of red berries poking through the snow at left.
works.collection: Pennsylvania Academy of the Fine Arts
works.title: Fox Hunt

works.caption: A long line of barefoot young women in pale silvery-grey robes, some with blue sashes and leafy wreaths in their hair, comes down a curving stone stair. They carry musical instruments, among them long trumpets, pipes, a violin and cymbals. White doves perch on a tiled roof at the top, against a patch of blue sky.
works.title: The Golden Stairs

works.caption: A shirtless Black man in pale trousers lies propped on the deck of a small dismasted boat that tilts in heavy blue-grey waves, his face turned to the right. Sharks, some with open jaws, swim close around the boat, and jointed green and yellow stalks spill from the hold and over the side. A waterspout rises from the sea at upper right, and a distant sailing ship shows on the horizon at upper left.
works.title: The Gulf Stream

works.caption: King Arthur lies asleep in dark armour on a bier under a gold canopy decorated with relief panels, dark curtains hanging behind him. His head rests in the lap of Morgan le Fay, seated in white at the left end, and at the other end a crowned woman in green rests her cheek on her hand. Women in robes of rose, green, red and white sit, kneel and stand around the bier and in the pavilion, which opens onto a flowering meadow.
works.title: The Last Sleep of Arthur in Avalon

works.caption: A man in a red waistcoat, presumably the lock-keeper, strains at a crowbar with one knee raised against the post of a wooden lock gate on the River Stour. Beyond him a dark barge waits in the lock under a tall, leafy tree at right, a man in a white shirt holding its rope. At left a boy in a red cap, a dog and a horse wait by the far gate, and a church tower stands far off across flat green meadows under grey and white clouds and blue sky.
works.title: The Lock

works.caption: A woman draws a glowing circle around herself and a smoking cauldron, holding a crescent-shaped blade in her other hand. Her pale dress stands out against the earth and rock, while dark birds wait beyond the line.
works.title: The Magic Circle

works.caption: A man is strangled at the left while another attacker twists his arm; a bound woman faces away in the foreground. Jagged limbs, tilted furniture and cramped space turn the room into a scene with no apparent escape.
works.title: The Night

works.caption: Behind green iron railings, between open green shutters, the painter Berthe Morisot sits in a white dress with a fan in her hand, leaning on the rail. The violinist Fanny Claus stands at right in white with a flower in her hair, pulling on a glove and holding a green parasol, and the painter Antoine Guillemet stands between them in a dark suit and blue tie. A boy, probably Manet's son Léon, is half lost in the dark room behind, and a hydrangea in a blue-and-white pot and a small dog with a ball sit at the foot of the balcony.
works.title: The Balcony

works.caption: In a dark cave, Christ in a purple robe with a gold sash stands on the edge of a tomb with his right arm raised high. Below him at right, Lazarus, pale and wrapped in a white shroud and head cloth, lifts his head from the grave. At left, Mary Magdalene, lit, with her hands raised, and three old men, two of them in turbans, lean forward to watch, while a sword, a quiver and other belongings hang on the wall above the tomb.
works.collection: Los Angeles County Museum of Art
works.title: The Raising of Lazarus

works.caption: A Shoshone encampment of tipis, horses and people spreads across a green meadow in the foreground, with tall trees at left. Beyond, a waterfall pours down between cliffs into a still lake, and snow-covered peaks of the Wind River Range rise into a pale blue sky.
works.title: The Rocky Mountains, Lander's Peak

works.caption: Under a tree in a golden wheat field, harvesters sit eating from bowls and a basket of bread, while a man in a white shirt sleeps sprawled on his back beside them. At left, men cut the standing wheat and another walks out of a path cut through it with a jug in each hand; at right, figures bend to bind sheaves among the stooks. Beyond, the land falls away past farms, a church, a loaded wagon and a pond to a wide bay with ships.
works.title: The Harvesters

works.caption: A bearded man dressed as a dervish, in a long red robe and a striped turban, bends forward to watch five tortoises crawling over a stone floor strewn with green leaves. A ney flute rests in his hands, clasped behind his back, and a small drum hangs between his shoulders. Behind him are walls of blue tiles and an arched niche with gold calligraphy, with a window at the left.
works.title: The Tortoise Trainer

works.caption: A woman drinks from a wine glass while a man waits beside her with a jug. The patterned window, tiled floor and cloth-covered table give this small encounter an unusually spacious setting.
works.title: The Wine Glass

works.caption: A smiling youth with long curling hair leans out of a dark background, his bare shoulder turned towards us. His right arm crosses his body and the hand is raised, forefinger pointing upward; the fingers of his other hand show at his chest. Dark fur hangs at his side, and a thin cross is just visible in the shadows at upper right.
works.collection: Department of Paintings of the Louvre
works.title: Saint John the Baptist

works.caption: The sick prince Antiochus lies back on a canopied bed under a dark green curtain, while the physician Erasistratus, wrapped in a grey mantle, keeps one hand on him and raises the other to his mouth, looking across the room. Another figure lies collapsed face down across the bed in red and orange drapery. At far left Stratonice, in a pale violet robe, stands apart with her head bowed, in a red-walled room of columns and painted decoration.
works.title: Antiochus and Stratonice

works.caption: Gentlemen in powdered wigs and knee breeches fill a corner of the Tribuna in the Uffizi, its red walls hung frame to frame with paintings above shelves of busts and statues. Near the centre the Venus of Urbino, a painting of a reclining nude, is held up before a group of visitors, while at right others gather beneath a marble statue of Venus. At left a second group crowds round a painting of a woman and a small child, and more sculpture lies across the floor in front.
works.title: The Tribuna of the Uffizi

works.caption: A nude Venus, wearing a pearl necklace and gold bracelets, reclines on a bed draped in dark red velvet and looks down at a small brown dog that paws up at her. At left an organist in a black doublet and golden sleeves keeps one hand on the keyboard but turns to look at her. Through a large window behind them, a garden with a fountain stretches back between rows of tall trees, and a red curtain hangs at upper right.
works.title: Venus and Music

works.caption: Two fair-haired women sit at either end of a carved stone sarcophagus in a wide landscape. At left one wears a full pale satin gown with a red sleeve, gloves and a wreath of leaves, holding flowers in one hand and resting the other on a dark lidded jar. At right the other is nude but for a white cloth over her lap and a red cloak, and holds up a small dark vessel trailing smoke. Between them a winged child reaches into the water inside the sarcophagus, beside a shallow metal dish. A towered town rises at upper left; a village with a church spire stands by a lake at right.
works.title: Sacred and Profane Love

works.caption: A young woman's head tilts toward the viewer's left, her eyes lowered and almost closed. The face is fully modelled in light and shade, while loose, wavy hair is sketched around it in quick dark strokes. Her neck and shoulders are only roughly indicated.
works.title: Head of a Woman

works.caption: A nude young man with long dark curls and a few leaves in his hair sits on a shadowy bank under dark trees, one leg crossed over the other and a spotted animal skin across his lap. Smiling faintly, he points across his chest with his right hand; his left hand points down over a bunch of grapes, and a long thin staff rises beside him. Beyond, at left, a deer stands on a sunlit slope and a stag lies in the shade, before a stretch of water and pale blue mountains.
works.title: Bacchus

works.caption: Caillebotte’s brother René stands bareheaded at an open window, looking across the balcony towards a sunlit Paris street. His dark suit frames the view, while a red armchair draws the eye back into the shaded room.
works.title: Young Man at His Window

works.caption: On the left the royal family, headed by King Sigismund, gathers with richly dressed courtiers beneath a red canopy, a white dog at their feet. A bishop in a white mitre stands near the centre. On the right, workmen in rough clothes haul on ropes and heave on wooden handles beside a great bronze bell, while others climb the timber frame above, under the direction of the bell-founder Hans Behem; castle towers and roofs rise in the background.
works.title: The Hanging of the Sigismund bell at the Cathedral Tower in 1521 in Kraków

works.caption: A towering woman in a helmet and breastplate strides to the left, a sword in one hand and a basket, a sack and pans under her arm. At the far left a giant face gapes with toothed jaws, full of small creatures. Behind her a crowd of women in white headcloths surges among monsters, and helmeted soldiers are massed at the right. The sky glows dark red, with fires along the horizon.
works.title: Dull Gret

works.caption: Manet sits at his easel in light grey trousers, a brush held out to the canvas and a palette in his other hand, with Zacharie Astruc seated beside him in a blue-upholstered armchair. Six men in dark coats stand watching: Otto Schölderer behind Manet, Renoir in a hat, Zola with his eyeglasses in his hand, Edmond Maître, the tall Bazille and, half-hidden at the far right, Monet. On a red-draped table at the left stand a white statuette of Minerva and a dark jar.
works.title: A Studio at Les Batignolles

works.caption: Lorenzo offers Isabella a plate as the diners crowd around a brilliantly patterned table setting. Across from them, her brother kicks towards the dog resting its head in her lap, interrupting the lovers’ quiet exchange with a gesture of cruelty.
works.title: Isabella

works.caption: A woman presents an order of release while supporting her sleeping child and her wounded husband. His face rests against her shoulder as the dog rises to greet him; the guard’s red coat and the child’s blue wrap punctuate the dark doorway.
works.title: The Order of Release

works.caption: Camille, who would later become Monet's wife, stands with her back half-turned to us before a dark reddish-brown curtain, her face seen in profile and her eyes lowered. She wears a black jacket edged with olive-brown fur and a feathered bonnet, and raises both hands to the ribbon at her throat. Her green and black striped silk skirt spreads behind her across the floor in a long train.
works.title: Camille

works.caption: Naked and half-clothed inmates crowd the floor of a vaulted cell lit by a high barred window at the upper left. At the centre a naked man in a three-cornered hat stands with his back to us, one arm thrust forward, and to the left a man in a feathered headdress holds what looks like a bow. On the right a man in white with a crown of cards grips a sceptre, and in front of him a reclining figure in a makeshift tiara raises one hand.
works.collection: Royal Academy of Fine Arts of San Fernando
works.title: The Madhouse

works.caption: Venus lifts a flower crown towards Mars as Cupid loosens his sandal below. Behind the reclining pair, three attendants handle his helmet, sword and shield, turning the god of war’s disarmament into an elaborate scene of leisure.
works.collection: Royal Museums of Fine Arts of Belgium
works.title: Mars Being Disarmed by Venus

works.caption: Christ in a red mantle sits on clouds high in the centre, one arm raised, among a crowd of saints and a woman in a blue mantle. On the left, angels pull the naked blessed upwards, one of them holding out a green wreath. On the right, the damned tumble downwards, driven by Saint Michael and other angels, and at the lower right a horned devil and other monsters seize them beside red flames.
works.title: The Great Last Judgement

works.caption: A woman in a deep blue mantle stands in a garden holding a child, who presses his face to her cheek with one arm around her neck and a string of red beads in his other hand. Behind her, two angels with many-coloured wings hold up a red cloth patterned in gold. At the left a tall metal fountain topped by a small lion spills thin streams into its basin, in front of a hedge of red roses and a low stone wall.
works.collection: Royal Museum of Fine Arts Antwerp
works.title: Madonna at the Fountain

works.caption: A young woman in a yellow jacket and a pearl necklace sits at a table by a window on the left, turning her head to look out while she tunes her lute, one hand at the pegs. A large map of Europe hangs on the white wall behind her, and books lie open on the table. In the dark foreground a chair is draped with a blue cloth, and another chair stands against the wall at the right.
works.title: Woman with a Lute

works.caption: A woman in a sheer orange dress sleeps curled up on a marble seat, her cheek resting on her bent arm and her long auburn hair spread out behind her, one bare foot showing below the folds. Behind her a low white parapet opens onto a glittering sea with a distant island under a gold-patterned band, and a flowering oleander branch leans over the wall at the upper right.
works.title: Flaming June

works.caption: Two pale bodies stretch across the foreground, while two more faces emerge among the flowing hair at the right. Klimt threads the figures through bands of flowers and curling gold lines, making their outlines merge with the surrounding ornament.
works.title: Water Serpents II

works.caption: The long-necked Virgin, in a pale silvery dress and a blue-green mantle, sits beneath a red and gold curtain with one slender hand raised to her breast. She looks down at the sleeping Child stretched across her lap. Young angels crowd in from the left, the nearest holding up a large urn. To the right a tall white column rises, and at the lower right a small St Jerome unrolls a scroll.
works.title: Madonna with the Long Neck

works.caption: A young woman faces us against a dark olive-green background, her eyes on the viewer. A brown animal fur hangs over her right shoulder, its head with bared teeth resting on her brown-gloved hand, a gold chain at its mouth. She wears a golden dress striped in silver-grey with huge puffed sleeves, the one nearest us much the larger, over a white apron with bands of dark embroidery, plus a long gold chain and pearl drop earrings. Her bare left hand, a ring on one finger, rests against her chest.
works.title: Antea

works.caption: The dead Icarus lies limp across a dark rock at the water's edge, his dark-skinned body still strapped into huge brown and cream feathered wings. Two sea-nymphs lean over him, the further one holding a small lyre, while a third rises from the water below with her back to us. Beyond them the sea stretches away to gold-lit cliffs.
works.title: The Lament for Icarus

works.caption: Villagers skate and play on a frozen stretch of water that winds between snow-covered houses, a church and bare trees under a pale yellowish sky. A small boat rests on the ice near the left bank, and a dark patch opens in the ice near the bottom edge. At right, small birds peck in the snow beside a wooden board propped up on a short stake, while dark birds perch in the branches.
works.collection: Royal Museums of Fine Arts of Belgium
works.title: Winter Landscape with a Bird Trap
