works.caption: Three men of different ages stand or sit under trees beside a dark rock face. A curly-haired youth in white and green sits on a stone ledge with a set square in his hands, looking up towards the rock. Beside him stand a man in a white turban and red robe with a lilac collar, and a white-bearded old man in a dark red hood and robe under a yellow mantle. He holds a sheet drawn with a crescent and circles. Beyond them, green hills and a village lie under a sky pale and golden near the horizon.
works.title: The Three Philosophers

works.caption: One woman holds a tightly swaddled baby while her companion shields the candle with a raised hand. The hidden flame lights the child’s face and the broad red dress, leaving the surrounding room almost entirely dark.
works.title: The Newborn

works.caption: Psyche sits on a pink cloth on a grassy bank, a sheer white veil over her lap and her arms folded across her chest, looking straight out at us as the winged Cupid leans in to kiss her forehead. His large brown and gold wings spread to the right, and a pale butterfly hovers above her head against a blue sky. Green hills stretch away behind them.
works.collection: Department of Paintings of the Louvre
works.title: Cupid and Psyche

works.caption: The cloth merchant Willem van Heythuysen stands full length in a broad black hat and patterned black clothes with a wide white ruff and lace cuffs. One hand rests on the hilt of a sword planted point-down on the floor, the other is set on his hip, and a reddish-brown curtain hangs behind him. At the left, a garden with rose bushes opens beyond, and a single rose lies on the floor at the lower right.
works.title: Willem van Heythuysen posing with a sword

works.caption: Three panels. In the centre, Mary kneels over the newborn child on the ground of a ruined stable, with Joseph holding a lit candle on one side and a donor in black kneeling on the other. On the left, Emperor Augustus kneels with a sibyl beside him, before a vision of the Virgin and Child in a window. On the right, three kings kneel on a hillside and look up at a star in the shape of a child.
works.title: Bladelin Triptych

works.caption: A small crucifix stands on the summit of a dark rocky peak ringed by tall fir trees, the figure of Christ on it seen from the side, facing left. Pale rays from the setting sun, hidden below the hill, fan upward into a sky of grey and orange-pink clouds. The canvas has a rounded, arched top.
works.title: Altarpiece Tetschen

works.caption: Hope, a barefoot woman in a pale grey-green dress with a white blindfold over her eyes, sits hunched on top of a brownish globe. She bends her head down against a small wooden lyre held up in one hand, loose broken strings dangling from its crossbar, while her other hand rests close to her face. The background is a hazy blue.
works.title: Hope

works.caption: A young woman in a white cap and a yellow, fur-trimmed jacket sits by a window reading a letter, a blue cushion on her pink skirt. To the right a maid, seen from behind with a pail on her arm and another letter in her hand, draws back a green curtain from a painting of a ship on rough sea hanging on the wall. A small brown-and-white dog stands up on its hind legs between them, and a red slipper lies on the tiled floor at the lower left.
works.title: Woman Reading a Letter

works.caption: A nude infant lies at the far right, while an old woman curls into herself at the far left. Between them, figures sit, gather fruit and turn away beneath blue-green trees, giving the painting’s questions about life a wide, mysterious stage.
works.title: Where Do We Come From? What Are We? Where Are We Going?

works.caption: Cupid, a curly-haired boy with green-grey wings, stands naked with his back to us and looks round over his shoulder as he shaves a bow with a curved blade, one foot on a pair of books. Between his legs two small children press together: one looks out at us with a half-smile while the other screws up his face, mouth open. The background is plain black above a tiled floor.
works.title: Cupid Making His Arch

works.caption: Rembrandt shows himself half-length with curly shoulder-length hair, looking at us from under a black beret topped by a tall white plume and a curling golden-brown feather, fastened with a gold clasp. He wears a dark velvet cloak edged with gold embroidery, a metal neckband and gold chains, one hanging down to a medallion at his chest. His shadow falls on the grey wall to the right.
works.title: Self-portrait wearing a white feathered bonnet

works.caption: The young John the Baptist sits on a long red cloth in a dark setting, naked except for a white loincloth, his folded arms resting on a mound of the red cloth at his side and a thin reed staff in his hand. He looks out at us with his head tilted. Behind him at the left a ram raises its head towards dark leaves overhead.
works.title: Saint John the Baptist

works.caption: The dead Adonis lies stretched on a dark blue cloth at the edge of a wood, blood at his side and a spear on the ground below him. Four naked women gather round in grief: one kneels at the left and touches his face, another lifts a white cloth from his body. Cupid, in tears, stands at the right pulling at a cord over his head, with a quiver of arrows beside him, and at the far right two hounds wait calmly, one sniffing the ground.
works.title: The Death of Adonis

works.caption: A young woman in a brown gown with green sleeves takes hold of a dark piece on a red-and-white chessboard, while a man in a fur collar and dark cap leans in behind her, a finger pointing at the board. At the left a curly-haired young man turns away from the game. Other onlookers, among them a second woman in a white headdress, crowd round against a dark background.
works.title: A Game of Chess

works.caption: Mary Magdalene, her long auburn hair loose, gazes up towards a break of light in the clouds, one hand pressed to her breast. A lilac and blue mantle wraps her, and her other hand rests open beside a skull lying on an open book. Ivy climbs the rock behind her; at the left a lidded glass jar stands before a pale view of the sea.
works.title: The Penitent Mary Magdalene

works.caption: An elderly bishop sits facing us on a towering gilt Gothic throne, in a jewelled white mitre and a gold cope whose broad borders hold single standing saints, one above another. He holds an open book in both hands, and his crozier leans against his shoulder. Small women stand in niches on both sides of the throne, and at its peak, above his head, a woman gathers two smaller figures to her.
works.title: Saint Dominic of Silos Enthroned as a Bishop

works.caption: King Saul sits at the left in a striped turban topped by a small crown and a gold and red robe, holding a long spear, one eye hidden behind a fold of a dark curtain. At the lower right the young David, in red, plays a harp with his head bowed.
works.title: Saul and David

works.caption: Five Tahitian women in long dresses of dark green, sage green, lilac-grey, orange-red and yellow sit in a row on a green bench, several with one hand raised, their faces shown full-face or in profile. At the right edge a sixth woman in a white top and red patterned cloth stands in profile. Behind them, among blue tree trunks, two men carry fish slung from a pole, with the sea beyond.
works.title: We Shall Not Go to the Market Today

works.caption: A naked woman stands by a tree trunk and reaches up for an apple held out by a winged child among the branches, whose body ends in a serpent's tail coiling round the trunk. A bearded man sits at the left with a fig leaf over his lap, looking up at her, one hand resting on her side just below the armpit. A small fox crouches in the grass behind her legs, and blue hills lie beyond.
works.title: The Fall of Man

works.caption: Gauguin shows himself head and shoulders in a dark blue jersey with a grey-green collar, his eyes turned sideways. Behind him at the left hangs his painting of a yellow Christ on the cross above a yellow and red landscape; at the right is a reddish-brown ceramic shaped as a grotesque head, another of his own works.
works.title: Portrait of the Artist with the Yellow Christ

works.caption: Men and women dance with linked arms in a woodland clearing before a garlanded stone term of a horned, bearded man, traditionally identified as Pan though it may be Priapus. At the left a woman in blue holds up a cluster of grapes over a white bowl raised by a small child, while other children tumble on the grass. At the right a satyr pulls a fallen woman in pale drapery into his embrace as she reaches out a hand, and a wreath of flowers lies in the foreground.
works.title: A Bacchanalian Revel Before a Term

works.caption: Bathsheba, naked but for a white headcloth, rises from her bath with one leg over its wooden side, while her maid in a green bodice and pink skirt holds a large white robe open around her. A dark blue patterned canopy hangs over the bath; at the lower left a small shaggy dog stands near a brown jug and a brass basin. Her foot rests in a black slipper on the floorboards, with the other slipper lying beside it, and through the window at upper left two small figures stand on a high balcony.
works.title: Bathsheba at her Bath

works.caption: Already wearing the crown of thorns, Christ faces the viewer with his hands bound. A red cloak is lifted behind his wounded shoulders, its folds setting off the pale torso and the dark figures crowded at either side.
works.title: Crown of Thorns

works.caption: A young woman with centre-parted brown hair, under a thin veil held by a narrow beaded band, looks out at us against a dark background. Her green bodice is edged in red below a white embroidered neckline, and white puffed sleeves tied with red ribbons sit over full brown sleeves. A cross hangs on a long cord, and a red sash is knotted over a white apron at her waist. Her ringed hands lie one over the other at the lower edge, the lower one resting on something small and brown.
works.title: Portrait of a Young Woman

works.caption: Four bearded river gods sit with four women by the water, conventionally read as the continents paired with their rivers, though also as the four rivers of paradise. Europe sits raised at the upper left beside the Danube, who grips an oar; the Nile, seen from behind with grain in his hair, holds Africa, a Black woman; America is at the back with the Rio de la Plata, and Asia leans on the Ganges at the right. In the foreground a snarling tigress with suckling cubs faces a crocodile; one child lies face down along the crocodile's back, another peeps out beside a large carved grey urn, and a third reaches up from the water.
works.title: The Four Continents

works.caption: King Charles IV and Queen Maria Luisa stand at the front of their family, lined up across a room in jewels, gold-shot silks and pale blue-and-white sashes. The queen, at the centre, holds the hand of a small boy in red and has her arm round a young girl, while the king stands to the right of them. At the left the painter stands in shadow beside a large canvas, and at the right a young woman holds a baby; two large paintings hang on the wall behind.
works.title: Charles IV of Spain and His Family

works.caption: A dark banner painted with a huge grinning face is held high above a carnival crowd beneath tall trees and a blue, cloudy sky. At the centre two masked women in white dresses dance with outstretched arms, one hand in hand with a black-clad figure in a skull mask. At the left a man in a broad hat brandishes a lance and a crouching figure in a dark, bear-like costume reaches out with clawed hands, while revellers seated in the foreground throw up their arms.
works.collection: Royal Academy of Fine Arts of San Fernando
works.title: The Burial of the Sardine

works.caption: A rutted sandy road runs straight into the distance between two rows of tall, thin alders with tufts of foliage at the top, with water-filled ditches on either side. A man in a yellow coat walks towards us with his dog, and on the left the church tower of Middelharnis rises above red-roofed houses. On the right a couple stand by a farmhouse and, in the foreground, a gardener tends rows of young trees, all under a wide sky of grey-blue and white clouds.
works.title: The Avenue at Middelharnis

works.caption: A woman in a dark blue blouse and white apron leans over a table to set down a dish of fruit. The tablecloth and the wall behind are the same deep red, both covered with dark blue tendrils and baskets of flowers. On the table stand a fruit stand, two glass carafes, a vase of flowers and loose lemons, and a ladder-back chair with a yellow rush seat stands at the left. A window at the upper left looks out on a green garden with white-blossomed trees and a pink house under a blue sky.
works.title: The Dessert: Harmony in Red (The Red Room)

works.caption: In the right foreground, men carry a nearly naked body with its head hanging back, beside a large camel. Across a long paved square, pale ghostly figures run for an arcade at the left under a dark sky streaked with lightning, and a man sprawls on the paving holding a rope.
works.title: The Rescue of Saint Mark’s Body

works.caption: The young Mary, in a grey dress with long golden hair, sits at an embroidery frame covered in red cloth beside her mother, Anne, who wears a red hood and dark cloak and holds out her cupped hands. Behind them her father, Joachim, reaches up to prune a vine on a trellis, where a white dove sits inside a halo. At the left a small angel with pink wings stands beside a lily in a red vase set on a stack of books, and a bundle of palm leaves lies on the tiled floor.
works.title: The Girlhood of Mary Virgin

works.caption: The Marchioness reclines on a divan heaped with rose-red silk cushions, wearing a white high-waisted dress with thin straps and a wreath of golden leaves and fruit in her hair. She looks out at us, a white handkerchief in her lowered right hand, while her left hand rests on the frame of a gilded lyre. Dark red curtains hang behind her.
works.title: Portrait of the Marchioness of Santa Cruz

works.caption: Martha leans forward with a basket of bread while Mary sits at Christ’s feet, resting her chin on her hand. His open palm links the two women, and broad areas of red, blue and white give this early Vermeer an unusually weighty presence.
works.title: Christ in the House of Martha and Mary

works.caption: Eve sits on a low brick wall against the trunk of a tree, one hand raised to the bark, and holds out a fruit to Adam, who sits on a stone block with his back to us and leans away. A sprig of leaves lies across Eve's lap, and another hangs from the block beneath Adam. At the top of the trunk a beast-like head holds another fruit in its mouth. Far off on the right, two small figures hurry away from a glowing figure as they are driven out of the garden.
works.title: Temptation of Adam

works.caption: A zigzag of lightning cuts through grey cloud above a pale walled town and a wooden plank bridge over a stream. At the left a young man in a red jacket over a white shirt, with slashed breeches, stands holding a long staff and looks to the right. At the right a naked woman sits on a white cloth on a bushy bank, another white cloth round her shoulders, nursing a baby and looking out at the viewer. Between them two broken columns rise from a low brick base topped with a stone slab.
works.title: The Tempest

works.caption: Against a dark sky, angels lift naked souls upward towards a great round tunnel of blue-white light. Inside the tunnel an angel guides a soul towards its bright opening, where a tiny figure stands in the glow. Below, more souls rise, some with their arms raised, and one with its hands joined kneels in front of an angel with red wings.
works.title: Visions of the Hereafter: Ascent of the Blessed

works.caption: Two Tahitian women sit on yellow sand in front of bands of green and dark blue sea marked with white lines of surf. The woman on the left, in a red wrap printed with white leaves and a white top, leans on one hand and looks down, a white flower tucked behind her ear. The woman on the right, in a long-sleeved pink dress, sits cross-legged with strips of fibre in her hands and glances to the side.
works.title: Tahitian Women on the Beach

works.caption: A tiny woodcutter raises his axe over a chestnut while a fairy crowd waits among daisies and tangled grasses. Stems cross in front of the figures, making the scene feel like a miniature world discovered by looking closely at the ground.
works.title: The Fairy Feller's Master-Stroke

works.caption: Christ, bare to the waist in a white loincloth, stands with his hands bound behind him before a stone column and turns his bearded face to the left. Light falls on his body against a black background. At the right one man grips the rope at his wrists while another in a dark hat looks on, and a third arm is raised at the top edge. A red cloak lies on the ground at lower left.
works.title: Christ at the Column

works.caption: Samson sleeps face down across Delilah's lap, his back bare and an animal skin about his hips, while a grey-haired barber bends over him with big shears in one hand and the other on his hair. Delilah, in white satin with one breast bared, raises a finger in a silencing gesture; an old woman in a white headcloth and a wide-eyed young woman lean in behind her. Armoured soldiers wait beside a stone column at the left.
works.title: Samson and Delilah

works.caption: The reassembled altarpiece in a tall gilded frame with spires: the Virgin enthroned with the Child among angels at the centre, two standing saints on each side, roundels of the Annunciation angel and Virgin above, small saints on the side pilasters, and three narrative scenes along the base, the left two of them nineteenth-century copies.
works.title: Guidalotti Polyptych (Perugia Altarpiece)

works.caption: A woman in a blue skirt and a pale blue-and-white blouse, seen from behind, leans over a balcony rail into a street broken into angled facets of colour. Below her, workers in white shirts climb among tall wooden poles and piles of red brick on a building site, while pale houses with dark windows tilt inwards from every side. Brown horses run across the foreground at lower left and right, and other figures lean from balconies on both sides.
works.title: The Street Enters the House

works.caption: An old man with a full grey beard and a soft black cap sits at a table, holding a quill beside an open, well-thumbed book. He wears a fur-lined brown cloak over a dark tunic, with a gold chain across his chest, and gazes off to the left against a plain brown wall.
works.title: Scholar at his desk

works.caption: Venus, nude and golden-haired, clings to Adonis with both arms as he holds a spear high in his raised hand, a red cloak slung over his shoulder. A small winged child hugs his leg from behind, while a white hound leaps up beside him and a brown dog prowls at lower right. Two white swans and a golden chariot wait at the left, in a wooded landscape opening onto fields.
works.title: Venus and Adonis (Rubens, 1614)

works.caption: A naked woman sleeps on a white sheet and a fur in a wooded clearing, one arm behind her head, while a satyr crouching at the right holds the edge of the sheet near her legs. A winged child with a bow perches in the tree above, a quiver hanging from the trunk. At the left a man blows a horn and a young man strides past with dogs on a leash, beside a seated satyr and a woman in a white blouse and red skirt. Beyond, dogs attack a deer by a stream, a hunter runs in with hounds at the right, and the land recedes to blue mountains.
works.title: Jupiter and Antiope

works.caption: Tadeusz Rejtan lies across a doorway at the lower right, pulling his shirt open on his bare chest to bar the way out of a crowded, gilded chamber hung with red velvet. Adam Poniński, the Sejm's marshal in red court dress, points off to the right, while other nobles cover their faces or turn away. A gilded armchair lies overturned among scattered papers, a portrait of Catherine of Russia hangs on the back wall, spectators look down from a gallery at upper left, and a soldier stands in the open doors.
works.title: Rejtan

works.caption: In a rocky valley under a grey, cloudy sky, Moses, in blue and red, points upwards beside Aaron in white, while a crowd of Israelites raise their hands towards them. At the left a young woman in blue gives her breast to an old woman in yellow, and a young man bends to an old man lying on the ground. At the right, people kneel and stoop to gather manna from the earth, among them a woman in yellow with a child on her back; tents stand in the valley behind, and a natural rock arch rises at the left.
works.collection: Department of Paintings of the Louvre
works.title: The Israelites gathering Manna in the Desert

works.caption: Christ's pale body is lowered from the cross on a blood-stained white sheet, held from above by Nicodemus, a bearded man at the left, and Joseph of Arimathea, an old man in a turban and fur-lined gold robe at the top. St John, a young man in red on the ladder at the right, leans over Christ's head; the Virgin, in a grey-blue robe and dark veil, reaches up to Christ's side; and Mary Magdalene, kneeling with long golden hair in a rose-pink dress, grasps his arm.
works.title: Descent from the Cross

works.caption: A tall, dark cypress rises at the far edge of a sloping field of green wheat just turning yellow, with tall stalks and grasses bending in the foreground. To its right a small pale house with a yellow roof stands among round green bushes, and low blue hills run beneath a blue sky with white clouds.
works.title: Green Wheat Field with Cypress

works.caption: Susanna, undressed for her bath and wearing a pearl necklace and bracelets, crouches forward and looks round at us, one hand pressed to her chest and the other holding a white cloth to her lap. Her white shift and a red drape lie over a bench beside her, and a gold vessel stands on a stone pedestal at the left. In the dark bushes at the right, the face of an old man is just visible watching her.
works.title: Susanna

works.caption: In a bedroom with a red-curtained bed, Mary, in white under a dark blue mantle, sinks back with one hand on her breast. Two angels attend her: one, behind her, holds her arm; the other bends to lift the hem of her mantle. At left the angel Gabriel, in a red-and-gold cope and holding a slender staff, raises a hand towards her. A white dove hovers in a ring of light above her head, and a lily and an iris stand in a jug at lower right.
works.title: The Annunciation

works.caption: Two apostles stand side by side: at the left, grey-haired Peter in an ochre-gold mantle, holding a key low at his side, and at the right, dark-bearded Paul in a red mantle, looking straight at us. Between them Peter cups one hand while Paul stretches out an open hand, and Paul's other hand rests on the pages of an open book lying on a table beside a dark bottle.
works.title: Saints Peter and Paul

works.caption: John the Baptist sits alone on a grassy bank in a brown robe and a blue mantle, his cheek propped on one hand and one bare foot laid over the other. A white lamb with golden rays round its head lies beside him. Behind him a green, wooded parkland with a stream and a pond opens into the distance, with rabbits, a hare and deer in the meadows, a white heron by the water and birds in the sky. Far off, pale towers of a town stand against blue hills.
works.title: John the Baptist in the Wilderness

works.caption: Saint Matthew, an old man with a long grey beard and a pale cloth wound round his head, sits in a brown robe before an open book, holding a pen in his right hand and raising his left hand to his chest beneath the beard. Close behind him, a young angel with curly golden-brown hair rests a hand on his shoulder and leans in, lips near his ear. The faces, hands and book pages are lit against a dark brown background.
works.collection: Department of Paintings of the Louvre
works.title: Saint Matthew and the Angel

works.caption: An elderly Jewish woman selling oranges stands facing us in a red shawl and a patterned reddish headdress, knitting a long pale grey piece with both hands. A large wicker basket hangs at each side of her: the one at left is heaped with oranges, the one at right holds a crumpled white cloth and an orange. Behind her and an iron railing, the roofs and spires of a city fade into blue-grey haze.
works.title: Jewess with Oranges

works.caption: A huge dark eagle, its wings spread to the edges of the tall canvas, carries a curly-haired boy up into a pale blue sky. The boy holds on to one wing and looks back over his shoulder at us, a pink cloth blowing loose around his waist, while the eagle bends its open beak over his other arm and its tongue touches the skin. Far below, a white dog beside a tree stump looks up after them; a slender tree rises at left and blue hills stretch away behind.
works.title: Ganymede Abducted by the Eagle

works.caption: At La Grenouillère, a bathing and boating spot on the Seine, people in dark and white summer clothes stand and sit on a small round platform under a single tree, with narrow plank walkways leading off it to the left and right. Swimmers bob in the river at left, and at right visitors sit under the fringed roof of a moored building with large painted lettering on its side. Empty rowing boats lie in the foreground, and the rippling water is broken into blue, white and dark green strokes beneath a bank of yellow-green trees.
works.title: La Grenouillère

works.caption: Frederick the Great, in a plain dark blue coat, stands at the centre of a candlelit concert room at Sanssouci, playing the flute at a tall music stand. To the left, courtiers and ladies listen; his sister Wilhelmine sits in a pale gown on a pinkish-red sofa, and a man near the left edge gazes up at the ceiling. To the right, musicians at a harpsichord and with stringed instruments, candles burning on their stands, look towards him. A crystal chandelier hangs above, with its reflection in a mirror behind.
works.title: Frederick the Great Playing the Flute at Sanssouci

works.caption: Alof de Wignacourt stands in gleaming armour while his page holds a plumed helmet beside him. The Grand Master looks beyond the frame, but the boy turns towards us, creating a more direct connection with the viewer.
works.collection: Department of Paintings of the Louvre
works.title: Portrait of Alof de Wignacourt and his Page

works.caption: Francesco delle Opere, a man with bushy reddish-brown hair under a black cap, looks straight at us, in a dark coat over a red doublet laced down the front. His right hand holds upright a small rolled paper inscribed TIMETE DEVM, and his left hand rests on the ledge below. Behind him, water winds between green hills, slender trees and rocky banks, with the spires of a town at right under a clear blue sky.
works.title: Portrait of Francesco delle Opere

works.caption: In the lower half, Saints Stephen and Augustine, in richly embroidered gold vestments, bend to lower the dead Count of Orgaz in dark armour, watched by a close row of men in black with white ruffs, a hooded friar in grey at left, a small boy at lower left and a priest in a white surplice at right. Above them, an angel in yellow carries the count's soul, a faint small form, up through an opening in the clouds. At the top, Christ sits in white; the Virgin in red and blue and John the Baptist are on either side below him, with Saint Peter holding keys at left and crowds of other figures on the clouds.
works.title: The Burial of the Count of Orgaz

works.caption: A young woman with dark hair parted in the middle looks out at us against a dark background. A cream veil covers her head and falls past her shoulders. She wears a white gathered chemise and a huge sleeve of pale silk banded with gold, and rests her right hand on her breast. A chain of oval stones set in gold circles her neck, and a small jewel with a hanging pearl sits on the gold band in her hair.
works.title: La velata

works.caption: A young man with long light-brown hair, in a black suit with full white sleeves, sits at a table by an open window writing a letter with a quill. The table is draped with a red patterned Persian carpet that falls to the chequered floor, and small silver vessels stand by the window, through which a globe can be seen. On the pale wall at right hangs a landscape with animals in an ornate gilt frame, and his black hat hangs from the back of his red chair.
works.title: Man Writing a Letter

works.caption: The Virgin, in a dark blue mantle edged with a wavy gold hem, sits on a tall carved wooden throne hung with patterned cloth, holding the Child on her lap. Three kneeling angels are set one above another on each side, against a gold ground beneath a gabled top.
works.title: Rucellai Madonna

works.caption: The friar and poet Hortensio Félix Paravicino, with short dark hair and a beard, sits in a high-backed leather chair studded with nails and looks straight at us. He wears his black and white habit: a wide black cape over a white tunic marked on the chest with a red and blue cross, and a broad white collar. His right hand hangs loosely over the arm of the chair, and his left holds two books against his side.
works.title: Fray Hortensio Félix Paravicino

works.caption: The Virgin, under a sheer veil, holds the Christ Child up against her, her eyes lowered and her face bent to his brow. He clasps his hands at her throat and looks up at her. On the left the young St John, in a fur garment and red cloak with a thin cross-staff, looks out at the viewer beside a stone pillar holding a book. Trees and a rosebush stand behind.
works.collection: Department of Paintings of the Louvre
works.title: Madonna and Child with the Young St. John the Baptist

works.caption: A crowded banquet fills an open loggia of three tall arches, reached by stone staircases at both sides, with pale classical buildings and a white tower standing against a blue sky beyond. Christ sits at the centre of a long white-clothed table among guests in red, gold and blue, while servants, dogs and a seated dwarf jester in orange holding a parrot fill the foreground.
works.title: The Feast in the House of Levi

works.caption: Four young women in full skirts and fitted bodices stand in a ring on a grassy rise, holding out a cream blanket and tossing a life-size straw doll into the air. The limp figure, with a white painted face and red cheeks, wears a dark blue coat, red breeches and grey stockings. Trees, a square tower and a cloudy sky fill the background.
works.title: The Straw Manikin

works.caption: At a village fair a peasant couple hurry hand in hand across the street towards the dancing, the man in a black jacket and cap, the woman in a white headscarf and yellow apron. At left a bagpiper in a white jacket plays beside a table of drinkers, where a beggar or perhaps a pilgrim reaches across, and two small girls dance in front of him. Behind them more villagers dance in a ring between thatched houses, with a church tower in the distance.
works.title: The Peasant Dance

works.caption: The sitter’s hands rest separately on her blue skirt beside a white cup and a tall metal coffeepot. Cézanne gives her dress broad, solid folds that echo the wooden door panels behind her, with a strip of floral wallpaper at the edge.
works.title: La Femme à la cafetière (Woman with a Coffeepot)

works.caption: General Wolfe lies dying on the battlefield in a red coat and breeches, held by officers in red uniforms while a man in a blue coat presses a white cloth to his body. An Indigenous warrior crouches at lower left with his chin on his fist, watching him, and a soldier raises a large flag above the group. A musket lies on the ground in front, and smoke from the battle drifts across the sky, with ships' masts at the right.
works.title: The Death of General Wolfe

works.caption: A pair of worn, dark leather work boots stands side by side on a bare greyish-brown floor, their laces undone and one long lace trailing loose at the right. The top of the left boot has flopped over, and the toes are creased and scuffed. The name Vincent is signed in red at upper left.
works.title: A Pair of Shoes

works.caption: A young couple sit huddled together in an open boat as it leaves England, the bearded man in a brown greatcoat and hat, the woman wrapped in a grey shawl with a bonnet tied by a pink ribbon. Her gloved hand clasps his bare one, and a baby's tiny hand shows from under her shawl. A black umbrella shields them, while other passengers crowd the boat behind and white cliffs rise beyond a green sea.
works.title: The Last of England

works.caption: Apostles crowd around the Virgin's body on a draped bier, holding candles, a palm, a censer and a book. Behind them a wide window opens onto a lake crossed by a long covered bridge, and the pink and white chequered floor runs back towards it.
works.title: Death of the Virgin

works.caption: Two figures float through a pale ochre sky, one hiding her face in a bright red cloak, the other pointing ahead towards a huge flat-topped rock crowned with buildings. Below them a crowd of riders and people on foot gathers on a ridge. In the dark foreground at lower right, two dark figures, apparently soldiers, point long guns towards the crowd.
works.title: Asmodea

works.caption: In a carpenter's workshop strewn with wood shavings, the red-haired boy Jesus in a white smock holds up a cut palm, while his mother Mary, kneeling in blue, turns her face up to his for a kiss. Joseph, bald and in a red shirt, leans over the workbench to look at the hand, and an old woman in an orange shawl rests her hand on a pair of pincers on the bench. At right the young John the Baptist carries in a bowl of water, at left a bare-chested young man leans on the bench, and through the open door sheep crowd a fold.
works.title: Christ in the House of His Parents

works.caption: A striped tiger crouches in tall jungle grass with its body pressed low, eyes wide and fangs showing, one front paw reaching forward. Wind bends the trees and leaves towards the right, fine silvery streaks of rain run over everything, and thin white lightning flickers across the grey sky at upper right. A bush of red leaves stands out on the right.
works.title: Tiger in a Tropical Storm

works.caption: A young man with an upturned moustache and a small pointed beard smiles out at us from under a broad black hat, his elbow thrust out and his left hand set on his hip. He wears a wide white lace collar, a black sash across his body and a dark jacket with slashed sleeves embroidered in gold and coloured thread. A Latin inscription at upper right gives his age as 26.
works.title: Laughing Cavalier

works.caption: The Virgin, in a dark blue mantle over a red dress, sits enthroned with the naked Christ Child standing on her knee, and lowers a hand towards Francesco II Gonzaga, who kneels at the left in dark armour with his hands joined. Two armoured saints at the front, one with a sword at left and one with a lance at right, each hold out an edge of her mantle; two bearded older men look on from behind them. At the right the infant John the Baptist stands on the throne's base beside Saint Elizabeth, an old woman kneeling in a yellow turban. Overhead, a bower of leaves and fruit where birds perch holds a branch of red coral on strings of beads, and the base below shows Adam and Eve either side of a tree with a serpent wound round it.
works.title: Madonna della Vittoria

works.caption: In a round picture, Mary sits sideways on a chair whose turned upright, banded and topped with gold, rises at the left. She wears a white turban striped with gold and a patterned green shawl over a red sleeve, and hugs the Christ Child, in a yellow tunic, close to her. Her cheek rests against his head as she looks out at us. At the right the young St John, a thin cross at his shoulder, joins his hands and looks up at them.
works.title: Madonna della Seggiola

works.caption: Seen from above, a nude woman with red-brown hair stands bent double in a wide, shallow round tub, one hand pressing a sponge against its floor. A white towel spills over the rim at the left, blue drapery hangs behind her, and the corner of a red upholstered seat stands on the patterned carpet at the left.
works.title: Woman in a Tub

works.caption: A weeping young woman, naked but for a transparent veil across her hips, stands with her hands clasped in front of her. Behind her Death, a skull-faced figure with withered brown flesh, grips her long hair and points down to the left with his other hand. A grey-green cloth hangs behind her against a dark ground, and an inscription with a date runs across the top.
works.title: Death and the Maiden (Baldung)

works.caption: Leonidas, naked but for a plumed golden helmet, a sword belt, a red cloak and sandals, sits on a rock at the centre with a sword in one hand and a round shield and spear at his side, while his Spartans make ready around him in a rocky pass. At the upper left a warrior clings to the cliff to carve an inscription, young men raise flower wreaths beside a stone altar, and in the foreground one kneels to tie his sandal. At the upper right trumpeters on a height blow long horns as men reach up for weapons hung in the trees, and at the right of centre an old man embraces a young one. A temple stands among the rocks in the distance.
works.collection: Department of Paintings of the Louvre
works.title: Leonidas at Thermopylae

works.caption: Under a thatched roof built against a rocky cave, Mary kneels with her hands pressed together before the infant, who lies on a white cloth and reaches up towards her. An ox and a donkey look on from behind. Three angels kneel on the roof, and above them a ring of angels in white, pink and green circles a golden opening in the sky. At the bottom, angels and men embrace while small devils slip into cracks in the rocks. Three lines of Greek run across the top.
works.title: Mystic Nativity

works.caption: Proserpine, with masses of wavy dark auburn hair and a long blue-green silk robe, turns her head to one side and holds up a pomegranate, broken open to show its red seeds; her other hand grips her wrist. Behind her a square of pale light falls on the dark wall, a sprig of ivy curls in at the left, and a small gold incense burner gives off a wisp of smoke at the lower left. A panel of verse is set in the top right corner, and a scroll with the painter's name lies along the lower left.
works.title: Proserpine

works.caption: The Lady of Shalott stands barefoot inside her round loom, in a bright green-and-blue bodice, a cream chemise and a pink silk skirt, with loose threads wound round her and her long dark hair flying up above her head. Behind her a large round mirror, cracked across, reflects an arched window with a river landscape and a knight riding past. Two birds flutter by a tall silver lamp at the right, her wooden pattens and blue irises lie on the patterned floor, and gilded reliefs line the walls, among them a haloed figure reaching for apples in a tree at the right.
works.title: The Lady of Shalott

works.caption: Women spin and wind wool in a dim workshop: at the left an older woman in a white headscarf works a spinning wheel while a young woman leans in beside a red curtain, and at the right a young woman in a white blouse and dark blue skirt, her back to us, winds yarn from a reel. Between them a woman in an orange skirt sits low on the floor, and a cat lies among the scraps of wool. Through an opening behind, on a brighter raised floor, the helmeted goddess Pallas confronts Arachne in front of a tapestry with small winged figures flying in its sky.
works.title: Las Hilanderas

works.caption: A young man with tousled dark hair and a red-and-gold cap, dressed as a jester in a costume of red and black stripes with a small white ruff, plays a lute and glances up to the right with a closed-lipped smile. One hand strums near the round sound hole while the other frets the neck, against a plain grey-brown background.
works.collection: Department of Paintings of the Louvre
works.title: Jester with lute

works.caption: A young man with shoulder-length auburn hair, in a dark buttoned tunic with a high collar, looks straight at us in front of a grey-framed window that opens onto pale blue sky. Resting on the ledge, he holds in both hands a round frame set with a much older gold-ground painting of a bearded, haloed saint, a fragment from fourteenth-century Siena.
works.title: Young Man Holding a Roundel

works.caption: Sailing boats lie moored in a shallow harbour at dusk under a streaked violet sky, with a thin crescent moon low among the clouds above the sea. In the foreground a dark rowing boat, lettered on its side, rests on the water's edge, and at the right a wooden hut, nets and poles with small flags stand on the shore. Further out, a few sails move across the open water.
works.title: Boats in the Harbour at Evening
